## _deploy/build-prod.ps1

````powershell
# SUNS 生产构建（在开发机执行，产物上传到 prod）
#
# 为什么需要这个脚本：Next.js 会把 NEXT_PUBLIC_* 在构建期内联进客户端 bundle，
# 用开发环境的 .env 直接 build 会把 http://localhost:3000 固化进 CMS 前端资源。
# 同时 DEPLOYMENT_ENV / TRUST_PROXY 影响发布产物的 robots 与限流行为。
#
# 用法：pwsh -File _deploy/build-prod.ps1
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Set-Location $root

$env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL = 'https://www.opctools.cloud'
$env:DEPLOYMENT_ENV       = 'production'
$env:TRUST_PROXY          = '1'
$env:CORS_ORIGINS         = 'https://www.opctools.cloud,https://opctools.cloud'
# 构建期占位密钥：运行期由服务器 .env 提供真实值
$env:PAYLOAD_SECRET       = 'build-only-secret-not-used-at-runtime-000000000000'

# 构建期若触发数据库访问，指向本机临时实例；生产连接串只存在于服务器 .env
$connFile = Join-Path $root '.runtime/connection.json'
if (Test-Path $connFile) {
  $env:DATABASE_URL = (Get-Content $connFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).DATABASE_URL
  Write-Host "[build] DATABASE_URL 使用本机临时实例（构建期占位）"
} else {
  Write-Warning "[build] 未找到 .runtime/connection.json，构建期 DB 访问可能失败"
}

Write-Host "[build] NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=$env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL  DEPLOYMENT_ENV=$env:DEPLOYMENT_ENV"

pnpm --filter @suns/cms exec payload generate:importmap
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "生产构建失败：payload generate:importmap 退出码 $LASTEXITCODE" }
pnpm --filter @suns/cms build
# 必须显式检查：PowerShell 对原生命令非零退出不抛异常，否则 sync-prod.ps1 会拿失败/陈旧的 .next 继续部署
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "生产构建失败：next build 退出码 $LASTEXITCODE（.next 未更新，勿部署）" }

Write-Host "[build] 完成：apps/cms/.next 已生成（生产变量）"

````

## _deploy/ecosystem.config.cjs

````cjs
// SUNS 生产进程定义（PM2）
//
// 部署目标：prod 43.132.209.126 / www.opctools.cloud
// 运行用户：www（与 nginx worker 一致，媒体与静态产物可写）
//
// 启动/重载（以 www 身份）：
//   su -s /bin/bash www -c "export HOME=/home/www PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; \
//     pm2 start /www/wwwroot/opctools/ecosystem.config.cjs"
//
// 设计要点：
//   1. 直接托管 node 可执行入口，**不套 pnpm**。曾用 `pnpm --filter ... start`，
//      实测 PM2 只追踪到 pnpm 包装进程（~85MB），真正的 next-server 是子进程：
//      max_memory_restart 形同虚设，重启还会留下占住 3001 的孤儿进程。
//   2. 公开页面由 nginx 直出 static-site，不进这两个进程；它们只服务
//      /admin /manage /api /media 与发布队列。
//   3. --max-old-space-size 与该机 1.9G 内存（与 myworkbuddy 等站点共存）匹配，
//      宁可让单进程 OOM 重启，也不要拖垮整机。
module.exports = {
  apps: [
    {
      name: 'suns-cms',
      cwd: '/www/wwwroot/opctools/apps/cms',
      script: 'node_modules/next/dist/bin/next',
      args: 'start -p 3001',
      interpreter: '/usr/local/bin/node',
      node_args: '--max-old-space-size=480',
      // NODE_PATH 兜底：Next 的 .next/node_modules/<pkg>-<hash> 是构建机 trace 出来的副本，
      // 在 pnpm 隔离结构下解析不到自身的传递依赖（实测 sharp 缺 detect-libc）。
      // 该目录是 pnpm 的提升目录，含全部依赖与 Linux 平台二进制。
      env: {
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        HOME: '/home/www',
        NODE_PATH: '/www/wwwroot/opctools/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules',
      },
      max_memory_restart: '700M',
      kill_timeout: 8000,
      autorestart: true,
      time: true,
      merge_logs: true,
      out_file: '/www/wwwlogs/opctools/cms.out.log',
      error_file: '/www/wwwlogs/opctools/cms.err.log',
    },
    {
      name: 'suns-worker',
      cwd: '/www/wwwroot/opctools/apps/worker',
      script: 'node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs',
      args: 'src/index.ts',
      interpreter: '/usr/local/bin/node',
      node_args: '--max-old-space-size=256',
      env: {
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        HOME: '/home/www',
        NODE_PATH: '/www/wwwroot/opctools/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules',
      },
      max_memory_restart: '350M',
      kill_timeout: 8000,
      autorestart: true,
      time: true,
      merge_logs: true,
      out_file: '/www/wwwlogs/opctools/worker.out.log',
      error_file: '/www/wwwlogs/opctools/worker.err.log',
    },
  ],
};

````

## _deploy/nginx/opctools.cloud.conf

````conf
# ============================================================================
# www.opctools.cloud · SUNS SEO/GEO 多语言静态 CMS
#
# 架构（2026-09-27 部署）：
#   1. 公开页面 = 发布产物静态文件，nginx 直接读 /www/wwwroot/opctools/static-site，不经过 Node。
#      只有未发布的动态路径才回退到 CMS 的 /api/v1/resolve。
#   2. /admin /manage /api /media /graphql /_next → 反代 CMS（PM2 进程 suns-cms，127.0.0.1:3001）。
#   3. Worker（PM2 进程 suns-worker）消费 Redis 队列产出静态文件，不对外暴露端口。
#
# TLS：Let's Encrypt（acme.sh webroot 模式），证书落在宝塔证书目录，
#      续期由 acme.sh 自带 cron 触发，--reloadcmd 自动 nginx -s reload。
#
# 本文件手工放置，不在宝塔面板站点列表内；改完必须 `nginx -t && nginx -s reload`。
# ============================================================================

# ---- HTTP：只做 ACME 验证与跳转 -------------------------------------------
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name www.opctools.cloud opctools.cloud;

    # ACME HTTP-01（acme.sh webroot 模式写到这里）。必须 ^~，否则会被下面 443 块的
    # `location ~ /\.` 正则拦掉；80 块单独保留是为了证书续期不受 HTTPS 跳转影响。
    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
        root /www/wwwroot/opctools;
        default_type text/plain;
        allow all;
    }

    location / {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
}

# ---- HTTPS：静态站 + CMS 反代 ---------------------------------------------
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    listen [::]:443 ssl;
    http2 on;
    server_name www.opctools.cloud opctools.cloud;

    root /www/wwwroot/opctools/static-site;
    charset utf-8;
    client_max_body_size 26m;

    ssl_certificate     /www/server/panel/vhost/cert/opctools.cloud/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /www/server/panel/vhost/cert/opctools.cloud/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers EECDH+CHACHA20:EECDH+AES128:RSA+AES128:EECDH+AES256:RSA+AES256:!MD5;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    ssl_session_timeout 10m;
    add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000" always;

    add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin always;

    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/css application/javascript application/json application/xml image/svg+xml;

    # 默认语言入口；改默认语言需同步这里与 .env 的 DEFAULT_LOCALE
    location = / {
        return 302 /en;
    }

    # 动态部分：CMS（Next.js + Payload）
    # unsubscribe = 营销退订页（签名 token 链接 + 表单 POST）。它必须由 CMS 提供：
    # 生产不跑 apps/web，公开产物里也没有这页；漏掉它退订链接会落到 @resolve 变成 404。
    location ~ ^/(admin|manage|api|media|graphql|_next|unsubscribe)(/|$) {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 120s;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
    }

    location ~ /\. { deny all; }
    location = /_redirects.json { deny all; }
    location = /manifest.json { deny all; }

    location /assets/ {
        try_files $uri =404;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=300";
    }
    location ~ ^/sitemap.*\.xml$ {
        try_files $uri =404;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=60";
    }
    location = /robots.txt {
        try_files $uri =404;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=60";
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri/index.html $uri @resolve;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=0, s-maxage=600, must-revalidate";
    }

    # 未发布的路径回退到 CMS 动态解析（草稿不会公开，由 CMS 判定）
    location @resolve {
        rewrite ^ /api/v1/resolve?path=$uri break;
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3001;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
    }

    access_log /www/wwwlogs/opctools.cloud.log;
    error_log  /www/wwwlogs/opctools.cloud.error.log;
}

````

## _deploy/nginx/opctools.cloud.http.conf

````conf
# ============================================================================
# www.opctools.cloud · SUNS SEO/GEO 多语言静态 CMS  （阶段一：HTTP，待签发证书后加 SSL 段）
#
# 架构（2026-09-27 部署）：
#   1. 公开页面 = 发布产物静态文件，nginx 直接读 /www/wwwroot/opctools/static-site，不经过 Node。
#      只有未发布的动态路径才回退到 CMS 的 /api/v1/resolve。
#   2. /admin /manage /api /media /graphql /_next → 反代 CMS（PM2 进程 suns-cms，127.0.0.1:3001）。
#   3. Worker（PM2 进程 suns-worker）消费 Redis 队列产出静态文件，不对外暴露端口。
#
# 本文件手工放置，不在宝塔面板站点列表内；改完必须 `nginx -t && nginx -s reload`。
# ============================================================================
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name www.opctools.cloud opctools.cloud;

    root /www/wwwroot/opctools/static-site;
    charset utf-8;
    client_max_body_size 26m;

    add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin always;

    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/css application/javascript application/json application/xml image/svg+xml;

    # ACME HTTP-01 验证目录（acme.sh webroot 模式写到这里）
    # 必须用 ^~，否则会被下面的 `location ~ /\.` 正则拦掉
    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
        root /www/wwwroot/opctools;
        default_type text/plain;
        allow all;
    }

    # 默认语言入口；改默认语言需同步这里与 .env 的 DEFAULT_LOCALE
    location = / {
        return 302 /en;
    }

    # 动态部分：CMS（Next.js + Payload）
    location ~ ^/(admin|manage|api|media|graphql|_next)(/|$) {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 120s;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
    }

    location ~ /\. { deny all; }
    location = /_redirects.json { deny all; }
    location = /manifest.json { deny all; }

    location /assets/ {
        try_files $uri =404;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=300";
    }
    location ~ ^/sitemap.*\.xml$ {
        try_files $uri =404;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=60";
    }
    location = /robots.txt {
        try_files $uri =404;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=60";
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri/index.html $uri @resolve;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=0, s-maxage=600, must-revalidate";
    }

    # 未发布的路径回退到 CMS 动态解析（草稿不会公开，由 CMS 判定）
    location @resolve {
        rewrite ^ /api/v1/resolve?path=$uri break;
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3001;
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
    }

    access_log /www/wwwlogs/opctools.cloud.log;
    error_log  /www/wwwlogs/opctools.cloud.error.log;
}

````

## _deploy/pack-prod.py

````py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SUNS 生产包打包（剪枝遍历，供上传到 prod 43.132.209.126）。

产出：_deploy/dist/suns-prod-<UTC 时间戳>.tar.gz
内容：服务器运行 CMS + Worker 所需源码、数据库迁移、基础设施脚本，
      以及开发机上构建好的 apps/cms/.next（Next 产物，服务器不构建）。

硬性排除（安全与体积）：
  - .env / .env.*（除 .env.example）—— 生产密钥只在服务器上存在
  - node_modules / .git / .runtime / media / static-site
  - _deploy 自身、日志
  - apps/cms/.next 下的 cache / dev / diagnostics / types（本机构建缓存与 dev 产物，约 750MB）
  - apps/web、apps/worker 的 .next（生产不跑 web；worker 用 tsx 直接跑源码）

注意：必须用剪枝遍历（os.walk + dirnames 过滤），因为 pnpm 的 node_modules 里存在
坏 junction（如 @suns/geo），pathlib.rglob 会直接抛 FileNotFoundError。

用法：python _deploy/pack-prod.py
"""
import os
import sys
import tarfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

# Windows 控制台默认 GBK，中文输出会乱码
if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "dist"

EXCLUDE_TOP_DIRS = {".git", ".runtime", "node_modules", "_deploy", "media", "static-site"}
EXCLUDE_ANY_DIRS = {"node_modules", ".git", ".runtime", ".turbo"}
EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES = (".log", ".tsbuildinfo", ".tar.gz", ".zip")
EXCLUDE_NAMES = {".env", ".env.local", ".env.production", ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db"}

# apps/cms/.next 下这些子目录不参与上传（构建期缓存 / dev 产物，运行期用不到）
NEXT_DROP_SUBDIRS = {"cache", "dev", "diagnostics", "types", "turbopack"}


def excluded(rel: Path) -> bool:
    posix = rel.as_posix()

    # apps/cms/.next：保留运行时必需的 server/static/manifests，只丢缓存与 dev 产物
    if posix.startswith("apps/cms/.next/"):
        return posix[len("apps/cms/.next/"):].split("/")[0] in NEXT_DROP_SUBDIRS
    if posix.startswith("apps/web/.next") or posix.startswith("apps/worker/.next"):
        return True

    parts = rel.parts
    if parts and parts[0] in EXCLUDE_TOP_DIRS:
        return True
    if any(component in EXCLUDE_ANY_DIRS for component in parts):
        return True

    name = rel.name
    if name in EXCLUDE_NAMES:
        return True
    if name != ".env.example" and name.startswith(".env."):
        return True
    if name.endswith(EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES):
        return True
    return False


def assert_safe(archive: Path) -> str:
    """打包后自检：确认没有把 .env、node_modules 或大块缓存带进去。"""
    with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
        names = tar.getnames()
    bad = [
        n for n in names
        if Path(n).name == ".env"
        # 源码树与顶层 node_modules 一律禁止；apps/cms/.next/node_modules 是 Next 运行时依赖，必须保留
        or (n.startswith("node_modules/") or "/node_modules/" in n) and "/.next/node_modules/" not in n
        or "/.next/cache/" in n
        or "/.next/dev/" in n
    ]
    if bad:
        raise SystemExit(f"[pack] 致命错误：归档包含敏感/冗余文件 {bad[:5]}")
    return f"ok ({len(names)} entries, no .env / source node_modules / .next cache)"


def main() -> int:
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S", time.gmtime())
    archive = OUT_DIR / f"suns-prod-{stamp}.tar.gz"

    kept = skipped = 0
    total_bytes = 0
    with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as tar:
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
            here = Path(dirpath)
            rel_dir = here.relative_to(ROOT)
            # 剪枝：被排除的目录直接不进入（避免坏 junction 与无谓遍历）
            keep = []
            for d in sorted(dirnames):
                rel_d = (rel_dir / d) if rel_dir.parts else Path(d)
                if excluded(rel_d):
                    skipped += 1
                else:
                    keep.append(d)
            dirnames[:] = keep

            for f in sorted(filenames):
                rel = (rel_dir / f) if rel_dir.parts else Path(f)
                if excluded(rel):
                    skipped += 1
                    continue
                tar.add(here / f, arcname=rel.as_posix())
                kept += 1
                total_bytes += (here / f).stat().st_size

    print(f"[pack] 归档：{archive}")
    print(f"[pack] 文件：{kept} 个（跳过 {skipped} 个目录/文件），原始 {total_bytes / 1048576:.1f} MB，压缩后 {archive.stat().st_size / 1048576:.1f} MB")
    print(f"[pack] 自检：{assert_safe(archive)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

````

## _deploy/sync-prod.ps1

````powershell
# SUNS 生产同步：开发机 → prod 43.132.209.126 / www.opctools.cloud
#
# 一键：生产构建 → 打包 → 上传 → 服务器部署（修 .next 路径、修 sharp 软链、重启 PM2）→ 验收
#
# 用法：
#   pwsh -File _deploy/sync-prod.ps1
#   pwsh -File _deploy/sync-prod.ps1 -SkipBuild     # 复用现有 .next 产物
#
# 前置：
#   - SSH 私钥就绪（Windows 必须先从 Downloads 复制到临时目录并收紧 ACL，否则报 UNPROTECTED PRIVATE KEY）。
#     默认路径 $env:TEMP\suns-deploy\id_rsa，可用 -KeyPath 覆盖。
#   - 服务器只跑不构建：本机负责 Next 产物，服务器只 pnpm install（装 Linux 平台二进制）。
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [string]$KeyPath = "$env:TEMP\suns-deploy\id_rsa",
  [string]$Host_ = '43.132.209.126',
  [switch]$SkipBuild,
  [switch]$SkipAcceptance
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Set-Location $root

$remote = "root@$Host_"
$sshOpts = @('-i', $KeyPath, '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=no', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=20')

if (-not (Test-Path $KeyPath)) {
  throw "找不到 SSH 私钥：$KeyPath。请先复制 BTC.pem 并执行 icacls 收紧权限，或用 -KeyPath 指定。"
}

Write-Host "`n=== [1/5] 生产构建 ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if ($SkipBuild) {
  Write-Host "  -SkipBuild：复用现有 apps/cms/.next"
  if (-not (Test-Path "$root\apps\cms\.next\BUILD_ID")) { throw "没有现成构建产物，去掉 -SkipBuild 重跑" }
} else {
  & pwsh -NoProfile -File "$PSScriptRoot\build-prod.ps1"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "生产构建失败" }
}

Write-Host "`n=== [2/5] 打包 ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
python "$PSScriptRoot\pack-prod.py" | Tee-Object -Variable packOut
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "打包失败（含自检不通过）" }
$archive = Get-ChildItem "$PSScriptRoot\dist\suns-prod-*.tar.gz" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
Write-Host "  归档：$($archive.FullName)（$([math]::Round($archive.Length/1MB,1)) MB）"

Write-Host "`n=== [3/5] 上传 ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$remoteArchive = "/tmp/$($archive.Name)"
& scp @sshOpts $archive.FullName "${remote}:$remoteArchive"
& scp @sshOpts "$root\infrastructure\scripts\prod-deploy.sh" "${remote}:/tmp/prod-deploy.sh"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "上传失败" }

Write-Host "`n=== [4/5] 服务器部署 ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
& ssh @sshOpts $remote "chmod +x /tmp/prod-deploy.sh && /tmp/prod-deploy.sh $remoteArchive"

if ($SkipAcceptance) { Write-Host "`n[跳过验收]"; exit 0 }

Write-Host "`n=== [5/5] 公网验收 ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$targets = @(
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/',
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/en',
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/zh',
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/admin',
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/manage',
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/api/v1/health',
  'https://www.opctools.cloud/robots.txt',
  'https://opctools.cloud/en'
)
$failed = @()
foreach ($t in $targets) {
  $code = curl.exe -s -m 25 -o NUL -w '%{http_code}' -L $t
  $ok = $code -in @('200', '301', '302')
  if (-not $ok) { $failed += "$t -> $code" }
  $color = if ($ok) { 'Green' } else { 'Red' }
  Write-Host ("  {0,-50} -> {1}" -f $t, $code) -ForegroundColor $color
}

if ($failed.Count -gt 0) {
  Write-Host "`n验收失败项：" -ForegroundColor Red
  $failed | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Red }
  Write-Host "回滚：ssh 到服务器执行 /www/wwwroot/opctools/_backup_<时间戳>/ 下的 .next 覆盖回 apps/cms/.next 后 pm2 restart suns-cms" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  exit 1
}
Write-Host "`n全部验收通过。" -ForegroundColor Green

````

## .github/workflows/ci.yml

````yaml
name: Validate CMS
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env: {POSTGRES_USER: suns, POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-only-password, POSTGRES_DB: suns}
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: --health-cmd "pg_isready -U suns" --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 20
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports: ["6379:6379"]
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://suns:ci-only-password@localhost:5432/suns
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379
      PAYLOAD_SECRET: ci-only-build-secret-not-a-production-credential-00000000
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with: {version: 10.17.1}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: 22, cache: pnpm}
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run setup
      - run: pnpm db:verify
      # Payload 拥有 payload_internal，业务迁移只消费它 —— 必须先 auth:migrate 建出该 schema，
      # 025_add_client_role_enum.sql 才可能通过。（2026-09-30 首次真实 CI 在 db:migrate 上以
      # 3F000 失败，根因就是这个顺序；与 db:verify 内部的 bootstrap 顺序保持一致。）
      # E-10（2026-10-01 取证 + 加固）：`auth:migrate` 会**偶发零输出空跑** —— 进程跑满一次正常
      # 启动的时长（实测 ~3.9s，不是历史记录的 0.3s）却一个字都不打印、没建出 payload_internal，
      # 然后 exit 0；紧随其后的 db:migrate 就在 **025** 上报 `schema "payload_internal" does not exist`。
      # ⚠️ 这个错误形状与已修复的 **E-8**（步骤顺序写错）一样，但根因不同 —— **不要**再去改步骤顺序。
      # 现在由 ensure-payload-schema.mjs 承担该步骤：先自断言 schema，命中「exit 0 却没建 schema」
      # 的静默空跑时**原样重试**（默认最多 5 次；实测单次发生率约 10~20%，run 36832057991 第 1 次
      # 空跑、第 2 次成功），重试仍失败才交给 assert-payload-schema.mjs 响亮报错。
      # 机制已被 CI 探针定案：**加载器 worker 侧事件循环排空**（`void start()` 非顶层 await → exit 0）。
      # 别再走"加保活"路线 —— 实测那会把它变成永久挂起（详见 docs/待验收与遗留清单.md 的 E-10）。
      - run: node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs
        env: {NODE_ENV: production}
      - run: pnpm db:migrate
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm test
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: docker compose config --quiet
        env: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-only-password}

````

    .eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #4d715d; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 26px; height: 1px; background: #7fa15d; }
    .hero h1 { margin: 29px 0 26px; font: 500 clamp(51px, 5.1vw, 82px)/1.19 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.067em; }
    .hero h1 em { position: relative; color: #54724a; font-style: normal; white-space: nowrap; }
    .hero h1 em::after { content: ""; position: absolute; height: 10px; left: 2px; right: 1px; bottom: 0; background: rgba(190, 219, 124, .58); z-index: -1; transform: rotate(-1deg); }
    .hero-lead { max-width: 480px; margin: 0; color: #536e61; font-size: clamp(15px, 1.25vw, 18px); line-height: 1.95; }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 34px; }
    .button-primary { min-height: 53px; padding: 0 23px; background: var(--ink); color: white; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; transition: transform .2s, background .2s; }
    .button-secondary { min-height: 53px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #9fb4a4; background: rgba(255,255,255,.45); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; }
    .button-secondary:hover { background: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .hero-caption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 42px; color: #658070; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .035em; }
    .hero-caption .rule { width: 28px; height: 1px; background: #9fb19f; }
    .hero-art { position: relative; min-height: 520px; perspective: 1200px; }
    .art-halo { position: absolute; width: 480px; height: 480px; border: 1px solid rgba(44, 94, 65, .19); border-radius: 50%; top: 2%; left: 5%; }
    .art-halo::before, .art-halo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(44, 94, 65, .13); }
    .art-halo::before { inset: 42px; } .art-halo::after { inset: 94px; }
    .art-spark { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 2px solid #81a45f; transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .spark-a { top: 32px; right: 50px; } .spark-b { bottom: 22px; left: 78px; width: 6px; height: 6px; }
    .hero-window { position: absolute; top: 50px; left: 5%; width: min(520px, 92%); height: 398px; border: 1px solid rgba(37, 81, 61, .28); border-radius: 13px;
      background: rgba(252, 253, 247, .94); box-shadow: 0 40px 90px rgba(23, 68, 47, .16), 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8) inset; transform: rotateY(-6deg) rotateX(4deg) rotateZ(-2deg); transform-origin: center; overflow: hidden; }
    .window-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 46px; padding: 0 19px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: #688073; font-size: 10px; }
    .window-top strong { color: var(--ink); font: 700 13px Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .12em; }
    .window-dots { display: flex; gap: 5px; } .window-dots i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #b3c2b2; }
    .window-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 115px 1fr; height: calc(100% - 46px); }
    .window-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 11px; padding: 27px 11px; background: #163c32; }
    .window-side b { color: #b2d69a; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em; padding-left: 11px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .window-side span { display: block; height: 23px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
    .window-side span:nth-child(3) { background: #d7e7bb; }
    .window-side span:nth-child(5) { width: 70%; }
    .window-main { padding: 27px 24px; }
    .window-kicker { color: #8d9f91; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .19em; }
    .window-main h3 { margin: 7px 0 21px; font: 500 24px var(--serif); }
    .mini-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 9px; }
    .mini-cards div { height: 73px; background: #f0f3eb; border: 1px solid #e2e9dc; border-radius: 6px; padding: 13px 11px; }
    .mini-cards small { color: #78927e; font-size: 8px; } .mini-cards strong { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font: 700 12px var(--serif); color: #254c38; }
    .hero-chart { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 10px; height: 102px; margin-top: 18px; padding: 10px 15px 0; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfcf8,#f1f5e9); }
    .hero-chart i { flex: 1; height: var(--h); max-height: 80px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: #bed5b0; }
    .hero-chart i:nth-child(3n) { background: #789b79; }
    .hero-chart i:last-child { background: #397058; }
    .float-card { position: absolute; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(86, 123, 86, .22);
      background: rgba(255,255,251,.96); box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(29,68,50,.14); border-radius: 9px; padding: 13px 17px; }
    .float-card .symbol { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 37px; height: 37px; border-radius: 7px; background: #e5f0d0; color: #416d42; font-size: 18px; }
    .float-card strong { display: block; font-size: 11px; } .float-card small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: #769083; font-size: 9px; }
    .float-one { top: 12px; right: -9px; transform: rotate(5deg); animation: hover 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .float-two { bottom: 19px; left: -22px; transform: rotate(-4deg); animation: hover 6s ease-in-out infinite reverse; }
    .float-three { bottom: 35px; right: 2px; width: 154px; display: block; background: #d9e9bc; transform: rotate(4deg); }
    .float-three b { display: block; font: 500 24px var(--serif); line-height: 1; } .float-three small { line-height: 1.6; }
    @keyframes hover { 50% { translate: 0 -10px; } }
    .ticker { overflow: hidden; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: #eef2e7; }
    .ticker-track { display: flex; gap: 55px; width: max-content; padding: 17px 0; animation: drift 26s linear infinite; }
    .ticker-track span { color: #466955; font: 700 10px var(--sans); letter-spacing: .19em; white-space: nowrap; }
    .ticker-track i { color: #81a061; font-size: 13px; font-style: normal; }
    @keyframes drift { to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
    .section { padding: clamp(90px, 10vw, 150px) 0; }
    .section-top { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; margin-bottom: 42px; }
    .section-top h2 { margin: 18px 0 0; font: 500 clamp(35px, 4vw, 58px)/1.24 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.055em; }
    .section-top p { max-width: 355px; margin: 0 0 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.9; }
    .workflow-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 260px 1fr; gap: 16px; }
    .step-tabs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
    .step-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 77px; padding: 17px 20px; text-align: left; color: #547367;
      border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s, color .25s, transform .25s; }
    .step-tab:hover { background: #e8efe1; transform: translateX(3px); }
    .step-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(17, 62, 49, .16); }
    .step-tab .num { width: 45px; font: 16px Georgia, serif; opacity: .55; }
    .step-tab strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .step-tab small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; opacity: .6; font-size: 10px; }
    .step-panel { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: .86fr 1.14fr; gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 48px); align-items: center;
      min-height: 450px; padding: clamp(27px, 4vw, 57px); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid #dce5d8; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; }
    .step-panel::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 250px; height: 250px; right: -95px; bottom: -105px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #dbe6d5; pointer-events: none; }
    .step-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .step-count { color: #7f9d74; font: 700 10px var(--sans); letter-spacing: .23em; }
    .step-copy h3 { margin: 20px 0 15px; max-width: 310px; font: 500 clamp(29px, 2.8vw, 43px)/1.4 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.045em; }
    .step-copy p { margin: 0; color: #60776a; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.95; }
    .step-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin: 23px 0 30px; }
    .step-tags span { padding: 8px 10px; color: #41654a; background: #edf3e7; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 10px; }
    .next-step { padding: 0; background: none; color: #1d5c42; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; border-bottom: 1px solid #8bb274; padding-bottom: 7px; }
    .next-step:hover { color: #6d903e; }
    .sample-window { position: relative; z-index: 1; min-height: 319px; border: 1px solid #d7e2d4; border-radius: 8px; background: #f9fbf5; box-shadow: 0 20px 36px rgba(29, 71, 49, .08); overflow: hidden; }
    .sample-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe8da; color: #70887b; font-size: 10px; }
    .sample-top strong { color: #2a5944; letter-spacing: .08em; }
    .sample-main { padding: 20px; }
    .sample-label { color: #90a592; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .18em; }
    .sample-main h4 { margin: 8px 0 17px; font: 500 21px var(--serif); }
    .sample-graph { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: end; height: 81px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce6d9;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 32%, rgba(201,220,194,.25) 33%, transparent 34%, transparent 65%, rgba(201,220,194,.25) 66%, transparent 67%); }
    .sample-graph i { width: 11%; height: 30%; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: #b8cfaa; transition: height .45s ease, background .45s; }
    .sample-graph i:nth-child(3n) { background: #6e9a74; } .sample-graph i:last-child { background: #376d58; }
    .sample-list { display: grid; gap: 0; margin-top: 13px; }
    .sample-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6ece2; color: #516b5b; font-size: 10px; }
    .sample-row::before { content: ""; flex: 0 0 5px; height: 5px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9cb97b; }
    .sample-row span:first-child { margin-right: auto; } .sample-row span:last-child { color: #8ba08f; }
    .sample-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 18px; background: #edf4e9; color: #5c785f; font-size: 9px; }
    .sample-foot b { font-weight: 700; }
    .features { background: #e8ede5; border-block: 1px solid #d7e1d4; }
    .feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
    .feature { position: relative; min-height: 276px; padding: 30px; border: 1px solid #d8e2d6; border-radius: 8px; background: #f9faf4; overflow: hidden; transition: transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease; }
    .feature:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 22px 40px rgba(17, 58, 45, .09); }
    .feature.big { grid-column: span 2; background: var(--ink-deep); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink-deep); }
    .feature.big::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 330px; height: 330px; border-radius: 50%; right: -70px; bottom: -175px; border: 1px solid rgba(231,245,219,.35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 55px rgba(231,245,219,.04), 0 0 0 110px rgba(231,245,219,.03); }
    .feature .feature-number { color: #8da48e; font: 13px Georgia, serif; }
    .feature.big .feature-number { color: #b4d797; }
    .feature h3 { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 51px 0 12px; font: 500 27px var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.04em; }
    .feature.big h3 { max-width: 460px; margin-top: 35px; font-size: clamp(29px, 3vw, 43px); }
    .feature p { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 345px; margin: 0; color: #657a6d; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.85; }
    .feature.big p { max-width: 420px; color: #c7ddcb; }
    .feature-link { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 21px; color: #315f42; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; border-bottom: 1px solid #87aa77; padding-bottom: 5px; }
    .feature-link:hover { color: #70964c; }
    .feature.big .feature-link { color: #d8edb6; border-color: #a9cc8d; }
    .feature .feature-icon { position: absolute; top: 25px; right: 25px; color: #87a28d; font: 35px Georgia, serif; opacity: .58; }
    .feature.big .feature-icon { top: 28px; right: 34px; color: #b4d797; font-size: 56px; }
    #studio { scroll-margin-top: 95px; }
    .studio-note { display: inline-flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #b9cbb5; border-radius: 3px; color: #42614e; background: #eaf2e4; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; }
    .studio-note::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #82a860; }
    .studio-shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 223px minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 620px; border: 1px solid #b8cdbb; border-radius: 11px; background: #fafbf6; box-shadow: 0 35px 80px rgba(20,58,50,.13); overflow: hidden; }
    .studio-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; padding: 24px 13px; color: #eef6eb; background: #153e32; }
    .studio-sidebar-brand { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(234,248,228,.18); }
    .studio-sidebar-brand b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; flex: 0 0 31px; border-radius: 7px; background: #dbeabe; color: #244c36; font: 700 12px var(--serif); }
    .studio-sidebar-brand span { font: 500 14px var(--serif); line-height: 1.3; }
    .studio-sidebar-brand small { display: block; color: #a8c9ae; font: 8px var(--sans); letter-spacing: .15em; }
    .studio-sidebar-title { margin: 28px 12px 11px; color: #9fbca6; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .17em; }
    .studio-tabs { display: grid; gap: 3px; }
    .studio-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 11px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #d9eadb; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; transition: background .2s, color .2s; }
    .studio-tab:hover { background: rgba(223,244,212,.12); }
    .studio-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: #d8e9bf; color: #183e2c; font-weight: 750; }
    .studio-tab .index { color: inherit; opacity: .58; font: 12px Georgia, serif; min-width: 22px; }
    .studio-sidebar-foot { margin-top: auto; padding: 26px 11px 3px; color: #b9d0bc; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.7; }
    .studio-workarea { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

    .studio-canvas:focus-visible { outline-offset: -5px; }
    .studio-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 64px; padding: 13px 30px; border-top: 1px solid #dce6d8; background: #f5f8f1; }
    .studio-bottom span { color: #698574; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .studio-bottom button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #2d6748; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; }
    .studio-bottom button:hover { color: #78a150; }
    .demo-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .demo-kicker { display: block; color: #7a9a7a; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .18em; }
    .demo-head h3 { margin: 9px 0 8px; font: 500 clamp(26px,2.5vw,36px)/1.35 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.045em; }
    .demo-head p { max-width: 555px; margin: 0; color: #698073; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.8; }

    .demo-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 19px; }

    .demo-control:hover { border-color: #84a677; }
    .demo-control[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #214e3a; color: #fff; border-color: #214e3a; }
    .demo-two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 13px; }
    .demo-surface { min-width: 0; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #dae6d7; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; }
    .demo-surface.dark { background: #eaf1e8; }

    .demo-surface-header small { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; color: #92a698; }
    .demo-record { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 10px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e7eee4; background: transparent; color: #244c39; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }

    .demo-record em { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #77947a; font-size: 9px; font-style: normal; }
    .demo-preview-title { margin: 21px 0 10px; font: 500 24px/1.35 var(--serif); }

    .demo-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid #214e3a; border-radius: 5px; background: #214e3a; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

    .demo-browser-top span { margin-left: 9px; word-break: break-all; }
    .demo-website { padding: 24px; min-height: 262px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 80% 18%,#e5eddf,transparent 43%),#fcfdf9; }
    .demo-website-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font: 700 10px Georgia,serif; letter-spacing: .08em; }
    .demo-website-header span:last-child { font: 9px var(--sans); color: #7a927c; }
    .demo-website h4 { max-width: 420px; margin: 36px 0 10px; font: 500 clamp(26px,3vw,39px)/1.2 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.05em; }
    .demo-website p { max-width: 400px; margin: 0; color: #728a78; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.8; }

    .demo-timeline { display: grid; gap: 11px; }

    .demo-timeline-step b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 23px; height: 23px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e1ecdb; font: 10px Georgia,serif; }
    .demo-pipeline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 7px; margin: 15px 0 20px; }
    .demo-pipeline button { min-height: 60px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #d7e5d5; border-radius: 5px; background: #f3f7f0; color: #6c866e; cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .demo-pipeline button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #24533d; color: #fff; border-color: #24533d; }
    .demo-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 35px; height: 35px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d9e8ce; color: #3c6147; font: 500 16px var(--serif); }
    .demo-person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 19px; }
    .demo-person strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; }
    .demo-person small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: #8aa08d; font-size: 9px; }
    .demo-switch { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; color: #355f44; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
    .demo-switch input { width: 17px; height: 17px; accent-color: #28644a; }
    .demo-chart { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 9px; height: 104px; margin: 22px 0 15px; padding: 0 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce7da; }
    .demo-chart i { flex: 1; height: var(--bar-height); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: #9fbd90; transition: height .3s; }
    .demo-chart i:nth-child(2n) { background: #547e62; }
    .demo-chart i:last-child { background: #275b42; }
    .demo-source { margin: 0; padding-left: 17px; color: #607a67; font-size: 10px; line-height: 2; }
    .demo-source[hidden] { display: none; }
    .demo-copyline { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; color: #7c967f; font-size: 10px; }
    .demo-copyline strong { color: #214f38; font: 500 22px var(--serif); }
    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .studio-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .studio-sidebar { padding: 14px; }
      .studio-sidebar-brand, .studio-sidebar-title, .studio-sidebar-foot { display: none; }
      .studio-tabs { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; padding-bottom: 2px; }
      .studio-tab { flex: 0 0 150px; white-space: nowrap; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 620px) {
      .studio-top { min-height: 54px; padding: 10px 16px; }
      .studio-top span { text-align: right; }
      .studio-canvas { padding: 20px 16px; min-height: 0; }
      .studio-bottom { padding: 13px 16px; }
      .demo-head { display: block; }
      .demo-chip { display: inline-block; margin-top: 12px; }
      .demo-two { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .demo-surface { padding: 17px; }
      .demo-pipeline { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
    }
    .principles { background: var(--ink-deep); color: #f7fbf2; }
    .principles .eyebrow { color: #a8cb9b; }
    .principles .section-top p { color: #abc3b2; }
    .principle-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid rgba(224,245,221,.22); }
    .principle { padding: 39px 35px 14px 0; border-right: 1px solid rgba(224,245,221,.22); }
    .principle + .principle { padding-left: 35px; }
    .principle:last-child { border-right: 0; }
    .principle .symbol { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; color: #bedc9c; border: 1px solid rgba(190,220,156,.47); border-radius: 50%; font: 18px Georgia,serif; }
    .principle h3 { margin: 24px 0 11px; font: 500 25px var(--serif); }
    .principle p { margin: 0; color: #a9c3b2; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.95; }
    .faq-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .72fr 1.28fr; gap: 65px; }
    .faq-layout h2 { margin: 18px 0; font: 500 clamp(36px, 3.8vw, 55px)/1.25 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.05em; }
    .faq-layout .intro { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.9; }
    .faq-list { border-top: 1px solid #cddacb; }
    .faq-list details { border-bottom: 1px solid #cddacb; }
    .faq-list summary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 15px; list-style: none; padding: 25px 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
    .faq-list summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    .faq-list summary::after { content: "+"; color: #6c9c57; font: 300 26px var(--sans); transition: transform .2s; }
    .faq-list details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .faq-list p { max-width: 570px; margin: -4px 0 25px; color: #627b69; font-size: 12px; line-height: 2; }
    .closing { padding: 95px 0; background: #dceacb; }
    .closing-box { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; }
    .closing h2 { max-width: 790px; margin: 13px 0 0; font: 500 clamp(37px, 4.5vw, 65px)/1.22 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -.06em; }
    .closing h2 span { color: #4a7146; }
    .site-footer { background: #102f27; color: #eef5e8; }
    .footer-main { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 44px 0 34px; }
    .footer-main strong { font: 500 20px var(--serif); }
    .footer-main p { margin: 11px 0 0; color: #a9c5b3; font-size: 11px; }
    .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 25px; align-items: center; color: #c7dbcd; font-size: 11px; }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: #d8eba5; }
    .footer-friends { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr; gap: 25px; align-items: start; padding: 23px 0 27px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(227,244,220,.16); }
    .footer-friends > strong { color: #a9c5b3; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; }
    .friend-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 26px; }
    .friend-links a { color: #deeadc; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; transition: color .2s ease; }
    .friend-links a:hover { color: #d8eba5; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
    .footer-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 15px; padding: 16px 0 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(227,244,220,.16); color: #87a998; font-size: 10px; }
    .support-dock { position: fixed; right: clamp(16px, 2.8vw, 34px); bottom: clamp(16px, 2.8vw, 34px); z-index: 50; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: end; gap: 12px; }
    .support-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 53px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid #b9d19e; border-radius: 30px; background: #173e32; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 15px 34px rgba(9,45,31,.25); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease; }
    .support-trigger:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: #285b43; }
    .support-trigger svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .support-panel { width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 100px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 23px; border: 1px solid #cdddc9; border-radius: 13px; background: #fcfdf8; box-shadow: 0 25px 70px rgba(8,49,31,.24); color: var(--ink); }
    .support-panel[hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .support-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 12px; }
    .support-panel-head small { display: block; color: #7f9d7e; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .15em; }
    .support-panel-head h2 { margin: 8px 0 0; font: 500 25px var(--serif); }
    .support-close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; border: 1px solid #d3dfcf; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f8ef; color: #45634c; cursor: pointer; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1; }
    .support-close:hover { background: #e7f0dd; }
    .support-label { margin: 20px 0 8px; color: #748c79; font-size: 10px; }
    .support-phone { display: inline-block; color: #194932; font: 500 25px Georgia, var(--serif); letter-spacing: .015em; }
    .support-phone:hover { color: #4a7f4c; }
    .support-qr { margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 19px; border-top: 1px solid #dfe9dc; text-align: center; }
    .support-qr img { width: 220px; height: 220px; max-width: 100%; display: block; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid #e4e9e1; background: #fff; }
    .support-qr div { margin-top: 10px; }
    .support-qr strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; }
    .support-qr span { display: block; margin-top: 7px; color: #718675; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.75; }
    .js-ready .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity .75s ease, transform .75s ease; }
    .js-ready .reveal.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .brand { min-width: auto; }
      .nav { gap: 20px; }
      .hero-grid { gap: 20px; }
      .hero-art { transform: scale(.88); transform-origin: center left; margin-right: -45px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .nav { min-height: 70px; }
      .menu-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; margin-left: auto; }
      .nav-cta { margin-left: 0; }
      .nav-links { display: none; position: absolute; top: 69px; left: 0; right: 0; background: #f7f9f2; padding: 20px 26px 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
      .nav-links.open { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0; }
      .nav-links a { padding: 12px 0; }
      .hero { padding-top: 70px; }
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-copy { max-width: 680px; }
      .hero-art { width: min(610px, 100%); min-height: 465px; margin: 20px auto 0; transform: none; }
      .workflow-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .step-tabs { flex-direction: row; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0 0 7px; }
      .step-tab { flex: 0 0 170px; min-height: 67px; padding: 13px; }
      .step-tab .num { width: 30px; }
      .feature-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .faq-layout { gap: 35px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 620px) {
      .wrap { width: min(520px, calc(100% - 34px)); }
      .brand-name { font-size: 12px; }
      .brand-name small { font-size: 8px; }
      .brand-mark { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
      .nav-cta { display: none; }
      .announcement .wrap { text-align: center; font-size: 9px; min-height: 42px; }
      .hero { padding: 62px 0 48px; }
      .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(48px, 12vw, 69px); }
      .hero-lead { font-size: 14px; }
      .hero-caption { margin-top: 30px; }
      .hero-art { min-height: 370px; }
      .hero-window { top: 35px; left: 4%; width: 92%; height: 300px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
      .window-body { grid-template-columns: 75px 1fr; }
      .window-side { padding: 20px 8px; gap: 8px; }
      .window-main { padding: 19px 13px; }
      .window-main h3 { font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 13px; }
      .mini-cards div { height: 60px; padding: 8px; }
      .mini-cards strong { font-size: 9px; }
      .hero-chart { height: 70px; margin-top: 11px; }
      .art-halo { width: 325px; height: 325px; left: 10%; }
      .float-one { top: 0; right: 0; }
      .float-two { left: 0; bottom: 0; }
      .float-three { display: none; }
      .section { padding: 79px 0; }
      .section-top { display: block; margin-bottom: 30px; }
      .section-top p { margin-top: 17px; }
      .step-panel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; }
      .step-copy h3 { max-width: none; }
      .sample-window { min-height: 310px; }
      .feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .feature.big { grid-column: auto; }
      .feature { min-height: 230px; }
      .feature h3 { margin-top: 38px; }
      .principle-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .principle, .principle + .principle { padding: 29px 0; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224,245,221,.22); }
      .principle:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
      .faq-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 18px; }
      .closing { padding: 74px 0; }
      .closing-box { display: block; }
      .closing-box .button-primary { margin-top: 29px; }
      .footer-main, .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; }
      .footer-links { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
      .footer-friends { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
      .friend-links { gap: 10px 17px; }
      .support-qr img { width: 200px; height: 200px; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
      .js-ready .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

<body>
  <div id="top"></div>
  <header class="site-header">
    <nav class="wrap nav" aria-label="主导航">
      <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="玄砚企业智慧营销CMS系统，返回顶部">
        <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">玄砚</span>
        <span class="brand-name">玄砚企业智慧营销CMS系统 V3.4<small>CONTENT · DISCOVERY · GROWTH</small></span>
      </a>
      <button class="menu-toggle" type="button" aria-label="打开导航菜单" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav-links">☰</button>
      <div class="nav-links" id="nav-links">
        <a href="#trade-upgrade">外贸升级</a><a href="#studio">功能演示</a><a href="#features">系统能力</a><a href="#faq">常见问题</a>
      </div>
      <a class="nav-cta" href="#studio">体验功能工作台 <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <div class="announcement"><div class="wrap"><b>XUANYAN / PRODUCT STORY</b><span>外贸业务升级 · 多产品 RFQ · 报价协作 · 市场内容 · 客户与渠道入口</span></div></div>

  <main>
    <section class="hero" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
      <div class="wrap hero-grid">
        <div class="hero-copy reveal">
          <span class="eyebrow">ONE WORKSPACE. A CONNECTED JOURNEY.</span>
          <h1 id="hero-title">让内容<br><em>被看见</em>，<br>让机会有下文。</h1>
          <p class="hero-lead">玄砚企业智慧营销CMS系统，以强大的企业营销 CMS 为中心，串联全站 GEO/SEO 优化、多语种企业官网、产品采购资料与 CRM。从多产品询价、团队报价审核，到客户确认与获客复盘，让海外业务的每一步有据可依。</p>
          <div class="hero-actions">
            <a class="button-primary" href="#studio">体验功能工作台 <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
            <a class="button-secondary" href="#workflow">了解业务流程 <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-caption"><span class="rule"></span><span>为企业官网、多语种市场与客户增长而设计</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-art reveal" aria-label="系统工作台示意图">
          <div class="art-halo" aria-hidden="true"></div><i class="art-spark spark-a" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="art-spark spark-b" aria-hidden="true"></i>
          <div class="hero-window">
            <div class="window-top"><strong>玄砚 / OPERATIONS</strong><span>增长工作台 · 功能示意</span><span class="window-dots" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span></div>
            <div class="window-body">
              <div class="window-side" aria-hidden="true"><b>WORKSPACE</b><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
              <div class="window-main">
                <div class="window-kicker">CONTENT TO CONVERSION</div>
                <h3>每一步，都看得见。</h3>
                <div class="mini-cards"><div><small>01 · 内容</small><strong>企业 CMS</strong></div><div><small>02 · 发现</small><strong>GEO / SEO</strong></div><div><small>03 · 转化</small><strong>轻量 CRM</strong></div></div>
                <div class="hero-chart" aria-hidden="true"><i style="--h:31%"></i><i style="--h:49%"></i><i style="--h:39%"></i><i style="--h:57%"></i><i style="--h:48%"></i><i style="--h:66%"></i><i style="--h:52%"></i><i style="--h:72%"></i><i style="--h:61%"></i><i style="--h:81%"></i></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="float-card float-one"><span class="symbol" aria-hidden="true">◎</span><span><strong>前端页面多语种展示</strong><small>面向不同市场清晰表达</small></span></div>
          <div class="float-card float-two"><span class="symbol" aria-hidden="true">✧</span><span><strong>全站 GEO/SEO 巡检</strong><small>优化建议交由团队确认</small></span></div>
          <div class="float-card float-three"><b>01 → 05</b><small>从内容到复盘的<br>完整路径</small></div>
        </div>
      </div>

    <section class="section features" id="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-top reveal"><div><span class="eyebrow">THE SYSTEM, IN EIGHT MOVEMENTS</span><h2 id="features-title">企业营销能力，汇成一套系统。</h2></div><p>从内容与搜索，到多语种展示、询盘报价和客户经营，八大能力在一个工作台衔接，让团队的每一步都能接上下一步。</p></div>
        <div class="feature-grid">
          <article class="feature big reveal"><span class="feature-number">01 / CONTENT FOUNDATION</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">◇</span><h3>强大的企业营销 CMS，<br>把内容变成长期资产。</h3><p>统一管理页面、文章、产品、图片、翻译与发布流程；用结构化内容支撑企业官网和持续营销。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="0">体验内容工作台 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">02 / SEARCH READY</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">↗</span><h3>全站 GEO/SEO 自动优化</h3><p>自动巡检标题、摘要、结构化数据与页面问题，生成优化建议；GEO 采样保留模型、地区、原始回答和引用，由团队审核改动。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="1">查看优化演示 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">03 / GLOBAL PRESENCE</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">▤</span><h3>前端页面多语种展示</h3><p>按语言组织页面、产品与导航，维护独立访问路径和语言关联，让不同市场看到适合自己的内容。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="2">切换语言预览 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">04 / SMART DELIVERY</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">✳</span><h3>AI 辅助与静态发布</h3><p>AI 协助写作、翻译与诊断；内容经人工确认后生成可抓取静态页面，保留发布任务与变更记录。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="3">查看发布流程 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">05 / CUSTOMER CONTEXT</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">◎</span><h3>内建轻量 CRM 客户系统</h3><p>把询盘连接到公司、联系人、销售阶段、跟进任务和客户历史，让每一个机会都有负责人和上下文。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="4">体验客户跟进 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">06 / MEASURABLE GROWTH</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">◫</span><h3>营销自动化与 BI</h3><p>仅对明确同意的联系人触发发送；以统一指标、报表快照和逐条来源进行经营复盘。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="5">查看营销报表 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">07 / TRADE CONVERSION</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">↗</span><h3>外贸获客与报价闭环</h3><p>采购导向首页和产品资料承接海外需求；多产品 RFQ 汇总询价，团队按版本审核报价、交给客户确认。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="6">体验企业官网与询价 ↗</a></article>
          <article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">08 / MARKET TRUST</span><span class="feature-icon" aria-hidden="true">◎</span><h3>市场信任与客户协作</h3><p>为不同市场展示适合的内容；管理采购证明有效期、服务响应和客户及渠道访问，让合作进度清晰可见。</p><a class="feature-link" href="#studio" data-open-module="10">体验采购信任与服务 ↗</a></article>

    <section class="section trade-upgrade" id="trade-upgrade" aria-labelledby="trade-upgrade-title"><div class="wrap"><span class="trade-version">TRADE EDITION / V3.1—V3.4</span><div class="section-top"><div><span class="eyebrow">FROM DISCOVERY TO DECISION</span><h2 id="trade-upgrade-title">让海外客户找到你，<br>也能顺利和你做生意。</h2></div><p>官网展示只是起点。把产品资料、询价清单、报价审核、市场证明和客户入口连接起来，帮助团队接住真正的采购需求。</p></div><div class="trade-upgrade-grid"><article class="trade-upgrade-card"><small>01 / PROCUREMENT</small><h3>采购导向首页、产品资料、多产品询价</h3><p>展示产品起订量、交期与包装信息；选择多个产品并调整询价数量。</p><a href="#studio" data-open-module="6">体验企业官网与 RFQ ↗</a></article>
<article class="trade-upgrade-card"><small>02 / ACQUISITION</small><h3>从询盘来源，追溯业务结果</h3><p>按市场查看同一批询盘的有效、报价和成交标记，点击指标追溯示例记录。</p><a href="#studio" data-open-module="7">体验获客漏斗 ↗</a></article>
<article class="trade-upgrade-card"><small>03 / QUOTATION</small><h3>让报价有版本，也有审核</h3><p>切换销售、审核员与客户角色，推进草稿、审核、发出和确认。</p><a href="#studio" data-open-module="8">体验报价协作 ↗</a></article>
<article class="trade-upgrade-card"><small>04 / LOCALIZATION</small><h3>让不同市场，看到合适的内容</h3><p>切换目标市场，预览当地语言、推荐内容和独立访问路径。</p><a href="#studio" data-open-module="9">体验市场化内容 ↗</a></article>
<article class="trade-upgrade-card"><small>05 / TRUST</small><h3>用有效证明，回应采购顾虑</h3><p>查看证明有效期、到期停止展示和首响时限的工作方式。</p><a href="#studio" data-open-module="10">体验采购信任与服务 ↗</a></article>
<article class="trade-upgrade-card"><small>06 / COLLABORATION</small><h3>给每一位协作者，合适的入口</h3><p>体验客户与渠道的权限差异，以及邀请撤销后停止访问。</p><a href="#studio" data-open-module="11">体验客户与渠道入口 ↗</a></article></div><div class="trade-route" aria-label="外贸业务流程"><span>企业官网与产品资料</span><span>→ 多产品 RFQ</span><span>→ 团队报价审核</span><span>→ 客户确认</span><span>→ 商机跟进与复盘</span></div><div class="trade-upgrade-foot"><strong>可读的名称、明确的状态、可追溯的记录。</strong><span>以下为功能交互示意。正式使用需完成部署配置和业务验收。</span></div></div></section>

    <section class="section principles" id="principles" aria-labelledby="principles-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-top reveal"><div><span class="eyebrow">BUILT FOR RESPONSIBLE GROWTH</span><h2 id="principles-title">智能，更要有分寸。</h2></div><p>系统的自动化围绕可确认、可追溯的工作方式设计，让团队能放心地协作和复盘。</p></div>
        <div class="principle-grid">
          <article class="principle reveal"><span class="symbol" aria-hidden="true">✓</span><h3>人工把关</h3><p>AI 生成的是建议和草稿。关键内容由编辑核对，发布与对外动作保留审核入口。</p></article>
          <article class="principle reveal"><span class="symbol" aria-hidden="true">○</span><h3>明确同意</h3><p>询盘的隐私处理同意不等于营销订阅。营销名单、退订与发送频率分别管理。</p></article>
          <article class="principle reveal"><span class="symbol" aria-hidden="true">↗</span><h3>来源可追</h3><p>GEO 采样保存来源条件；经营报表保留指标定义和逐条记录，帮助解释每个数字。</p></article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section" id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
      <div class="wrap faq-layout">
        <div class="reveal"><span class="eyebrow">GOOD QUESTIONS</span><h2 id="faq-title">了解它，<br>从几个问题开始。</h2><p class="intro">这些边界，决定系统如何真正服务内容运营、搜索增长与客户经营。</p></div>
        <div class="faq-list reveal">
          <details><summary>全站 GEO/SEO 自动优化会直接改动已发布页面吗？</summary><p>系统可自动巡检并提出优化建议，AI 可辅助写作、翻译与内容规划。关键改动先成为建议或草稿，由编辑核对事实、语言与品牌表达后，再进入发布流程。</p></details>
          <details><summary>GEO 监测结果代表全网排名吗？</summary><p>不代表。系统对设定的问题、模型、地区和时间进行采样，保存原始回答与引用；结果用于比较同口径样本的变化，而非宣称全网排名。</p></details>
          <details><summary>营销自动化会直接使用所有询盘邮箱吗？</summary><p>不会。只有具备独立、明确营销同意记录的联系人才能进入发送队列；系统提供退订、冷却期和频率上限。</p></details>
          <details><summary>经营报表中的数字能查到来源吗？</summary><p>可以。报表生成时保存指标定义、汇总值及逐条来源快照，可按指标查看明细和导出 CSV。跨币种成交金额分开呈现。</p></details>
          <details><summary>客户可以把多个产品放进同一份询价吗？</summary><p>可以。客户在官网选择多个产品、调整数量，并补充目的地、交期、贸易条款、规格和附件。询盘进入后台后，销售可基于产品明细创建报价版本。</p></details>
          <details><summary>报价如何审核，客户确认后会自动成交吗？</summary><p>报价保留版本、币种、条款和有效期，由另一位审核员确认后发出。客户通过专属邀请查看和确认最新有效报价。确认不会自动记账、收款或将商机标记为赢单，仍由销售核实后推进。</p></details>
          <details><summary>证书过期或市场内容变更后怎么办？</summary><p>公开展示会检查审核状态、有效期与来源快照。证明过期、内容撤下或关联来源变化后，停止向新请求返回相应卡片；团队补充资料并重新审核后再展示。</p></details>
          <details><summary>客户与渠道伙伴能看到哪些资料？</summary><p>邀请限定到单份询盘，可设置期限并撤销。客户可确认最新有效报价，渠道伙伴只读；不会展示其他客户的询盘或内部报价草稿。正式企业账号、多联系人权限和渠道分级价格属于后续规划。</p></details>
          <details><summary>获客漏斗里的转化数字如何计算？</summary><p>按询盘创建日期选定同一批记录，追溯有效、已报价与关联赢单情况。访问会话只统计明确同意的访客，并与询盘数量分开解释；不会用宣传页的示例数字代表真实客户业绩。</p></details>
          <details><summary>是否已经连接好外部邮件和模型服务？</summary><p>外部服务需要在实际部署环境中配置接口、密钥与授权。这个宣传页展示系统能力与流程，不展示真实客户数据或实际投递结果。</p></details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  <script>
    (function () {
      "use strict";
      var steps = [
        { count: "01 / 05 · CREATE", title: "把专业知识，变成多语言资产。", description: "从产品事实、页面和文章出发，组织结构化内容；AI 协助起草与翻译，编辑决定最终表达。", tags: ["产品与文章", "AI 草稿", "多语言"], label: "CONTENT STUDIO", sample: "多语言内容工作台", rows: [["产品事实清单", "已整理"], ["英文页面草稿", "待审核"], ["图片 ALT 描述", "待完善"]], status: "编辑中", footnote: "人工确认后再进入发布", bars: [28, 44, 37, 61, 49, 70, 59, 77] },
        { count: "02 / 05 · PUBLISH", title: "一次审核，沉淀可抓取的静态页面。", description: "内容、SEO 字段与语言路由经过检查后，进入静态发布流程；任务、失败与变更都有记录。", tags: ["发布审核", "静态 HTML", "Sitemap"], label: "PUBLISH CENTER", sample: "发布任务与页面路由", rows: [["页面与语言版本", "已检查"], ["静态页面生成", "排队中"], ["站点地图更新", "待执行"]], status: "等待发布", footnote: "公开页面按审核结果更新", bars: [25, 35, 49, 55, 63, 66, 74, 81] },
        { count: "03 / 05 · DISCOVER", title: "让全站 GEO/SEO 优化成为日常工作。", description: "自动巡检搜索呈现并提出优化建议，记录 GEO 固定样本中的提及和引用；团队确认后再调整公开页面。", tags: ["全站巡检", "优化建议", "GEO 采样"], label: "DISCOVERY SIGNALS", sample: "全站优化工作台", rows: [["页面 SEO 巡检", "有建议"], ["GEO 固定问题采样", "已记录"], ["待审核优化项", "可查看"]], status: "观察中", footnote: "样本趋势不等于全网排名", bars: [42, 37, 56, 47, 69, 61, 74, 68] },
        { count: "04 / 05 · CONVERT", title: "让每一次询盘，都进入轻量 CRM。", description: "把线索与联系人、客户公司和销售机会连接起来；负责人、团队任务与跟进历史清晰可见。", tags: ["内建轻量 CRM", "销售阶段", "团队协作"], label: "CUSTOMER JOURNEY", sample: "客户与商机工作台", rows: [["新询盘", "待分配"], ["销售机会", "跟进中"], ["客户沟通记录", "已保存"]], status: "持续跟进", footnote: "从线索走向长期客户关系", bars: [32, 41, 55, 49, 64, 59, 73, 82] },
        { count: "05 / 05 · MEASURE", title: "把经营结果，追溯到每一条来源。", description: "在明确同意的边界内开展营销触达；按统一口径生成报表，用快照、明细与趋势解释变化。", tags: ["营销同意", "统一指标", "来源快照"], label: "BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE", sample: "经营报表与来源明细", rows: [["营销发送与退订", "可追踪"], ["成交金额", "按币种"], ["指标来源记录", "可下钻"]], status: "已生成快照", footnote: "每个数字都能找到来源", bars: [36, 46, 42, 60, 56, 75, 69, 84] }
      ];
      var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".step-tab"));
      var active = 0;
      function setText(id, value) { document.getElementById(id).textContent = value; }
      function selectStep(index, focus) {
        active = (index + steps.length) % steps.length;
        var item = steps[active];
        tabs.forEach(function (tab, i) {
          var selected = i === active;
          tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", selected ? "true" : "false");
          tab.tabIndex = selected ? 0 : -1;
        });
        document.getElementById("flow-panel").setAttribute("aria-labelledby", tabs[active].id);
        setText("step-count", item.count);
        setText("step-title", item.title);
        setText("step-description", item.description);
        setText("sample-label", item.label);
        setText("sample-title", item.sample);
        setText("sample-status", item.status);
        setText("sample-footnote", item.footnote);
        var tags = document.getElementById("step-tags");
        tags.replaceChildren();
        item.tags.forEach(function (value) { var node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; tags.appendChild(node); });
        var list = document.getElementById("sample-list");
        list.replaceChildren();
        item.rows.forEach(function (row) {
          var line = document.createElement("div");
          line.className = "sample-row";
          row.forEach(function (value) { var node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; line.appendChild(node); });
          list.appendChild(line);
        });
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("#sample-graph i"), function (bar, i) { bar.style.height = item.bars[i] + "%"; });
        if (focus) tabs[active].focus();
      }
      tabs.forEach(function (tab, index) {
        tab.addEventListener("click", function () { selectStep(index, false); });
        tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
          var target = null;
          if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowDown") target = index + 1;
          if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowUp") target = index - 1;
          if (event.key === "Home") target = 0;
          if (event.key === "End") target = steps.length - 1;
          if (target !== null) { event.preventDefault(); selectStep(target, true); }
        });
      });
      document.getElementById("next-step").addEventListener("click", function () { selectStep(active + 1, true); });
      selectStep(0, false);

      var modules = [
        { template: "studio-cms", name: "企业营销 CMS", description: "统一管理页面、产品和文章；选择一条内容，查看状态与摘要。" },
        { template: "studio-search", name: "GEO / SEO 优化", description: "在示意巡检与采样记录之间切换，查看问题、来源和待审核建议。" },
        { template: "studio-language", name: "多语种前端", description: "选择语言，观察前端页面文案、导航与访问路径的变化。" },
        { template: "studio-publish", name: "AI 与静态发布", description: "推进示例任务，了解草稿、人工审核和静态发布的衔接。" },
        { template: "studio-crm", name: "客户与商机", description: "切换示例商机阶段，并在客户历史中记录一次模拟跟进。" },
        { template: "studio-measure", name: "营销与 BI", description: "切换模拟同意状态和经营指标，查看发送资格与报表来源。" },
        {template:"studio-trade-rfq",name:"企业官网与 RFQ",description:"展示产品起订量、交期与包装信息；选择多个产品并调整询价数量。"},
        {template:"studio-trade-funnel",name:"获客漏斗",description:"按市场查看同一批询盘的有效、报价和成交标记，点击指标追溯示例记录。"},
        {template:"studio-trade-quote",name:"报价协作",description:"切换销售、审核员与客户角色，推进草稿、审核、发出和确认。"},
        {template:"studio-trade-market",name:"市场化内容",description:"切换目标市场，预览当地语言、推荐内容和独立访问路径。"},
        {template:"studio-trade-trust",name:"采购信任与服务",description:"查看证明有效期、到期停止展示和首响时限的工作方式。"},
        {template:"studio-trade-portal",name:"客户与渠道入口",description:"体验客户与渠道的权限差异，以及邀请撤销后停止访问。"}
      ];
      var moduleTabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".studio-tab"));
      var studioCanvas = document.getElementById("studio-canvas");
      var moduleIndex = 0;
      function studioText(id, value) { studioCanvas.querySelector("#" + id).textContent = value; }
      function studioNode(id) { return studioCanvas.querySelector("#" + id); }
      function pressGroup(selector, current, attribute) {
        studioCanvas.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(function (button) {
          button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", button.getAttribute(attribute) === current ? "true" : "false");
        });
      }
      function initCMS() {
        var examples = {
          pages: [
            { title: "关于我们", locale: "ZH / 中文", status: "已发布", copy: "以清晰的品牌故事、团队能力和可信事实介绍企业。", meta: ["公司介绍", "首页导航", "SEO 标题"] },
            { title: "Applications", locale: "EN / 英语", status: "待审核", copy: "展示产品在不同应用场景中的使用方式与技术重点。", meta: ["应用页面", "英文内容", "结构化字段"] },
            { title: "Kontakt", locale: "DE / 德语", status: "草稿", copy: "为德语访客提供本地化的联系入口与基础信息。", meta: ["联系页面", "德语内容", "独立路径"] }
          ],
          products: [
            { title: "Precision Glass Vessel", locale: "EN / 英语", status: "已发布", copy: "以规格、材料、图片和应用说明构成可维护的产品档案。", meta: ["产品档案", "SKU", "图片 ALT"] },
            { title: "Laboratory Collection", locale: "EN / 英语", status: "待审核", copy: "统一维护产品系列的介绍、分类及关联内容。", meta: ["产品系列", "分类", "关联内容"] },
            { title: "工艺玻璃器皿", locale: "ZH / 中文", status: "草稿", copy: "面向中文市场说明产品特点与制造工艺。", meta: ["中文内容", "规格", "应用"] }
          ],
          articles: [
            { title: "A Guide to Durable Glass", locale: "EN / 英语", status: "待审核", copy: "通过有依据的专业文章回答用户在选型时的问题。", meta: ["文章", "引用来源", "作者审核"] },
            { title: "材料与工艺笔记", locale: "ZH / 中文", status: "草稿", copy: "围绕材料特点、使用建议和常见疑问组织知识内容。", meta: ["知识内容", "问答", "内链"] },
            { title: "Design Notes", locale: "FR / 法语", status: "已发布", copy: "为法语读者提供清晰、可独立检索的文章版本。", meta: ["法语内容", "独立 URL", "语言关联"] }
          ]
        };
        var kind = "pages", selected = 0, queued = false;
        function render() {
          pressGroup("[data-cms-kind]", kind, "data-cms-kind");
          var records = examples[kind], list = studioNode("cms-list");
          list.replaceChildren();
          records.forEach(function (record, i) {
            var button = document.createElement("button"), label = document.createElement("span"), title = document.createElement("strong"), locale = document.createElement("small"), status = document.createElement("em");
            button.type = "button"; button.className = "demo-record"; button.setAttribute("aria-current", i === selected ? "true" : "false");
            title.textContent = record.title; locale.textContent = record.locale; status.textContent = record.status;
            label.append(title, locale); button.append(label, status);
            button.addEventListener("click", function () { selected = i; queued = false; render(); studioNode("cms-list").querySelectorAll("button")[i].focus(); });
            list.appendChild(button);
          });
          var record = records[selected];
          studioText("cms-count", records.length + " 条示例内容");
          studioText("cms-locale", record.locale);
          studioText("cms-title", record.title);
          studioText("cms-copy", record.copy);
          var meta = studioNode("cms-meta"); meta.replaceChildren();
          record.meta.forEach(function (value) { var chip = document.createElement("span"); chip.textContent = value; meta.appendChild(chip); });
          var review = studioNode("cms-review");
          review.disabled = queued;
          review.textContent = queued ? "已加入示例审核队列 ✓" : "模拟提交审核 ↗";
          studioText("cms-message", queued ? "示意状态已更新；本页不会保存真实草稿。" : "选择左侧内容查看详情。");
        }
        studioCanvas.querySelectorAll("[data-cms-kind]").forEach(function (button) {
          button.addEventListener("click", function () { kind = button.getAttribute("data-cms-kind"); selected = 0; queued = false; render(); });
        });
        studioNode("cms-review").addEventListener("click", function () { queued = true; render(); });
        render();
      }
      function initSearch() {
        var examples = {
          seo: {
            title: "页面检查项", records: [
              { name: "产品页标题需要更明确", hint: "/en/products/precision-glass", source: "来源：页面标题字段", copy: "示例产品页的标题只写了产品名称，未说明其核心用途。", advice: "建议编辑补充应用语境，并在发布前检查标题长度与页面事实是否一致。" },
              { name: "图片 ALT 描述待完善", hint: "/en/products/lab-collection", source: "来源：媒体描述字段", copy: "示例页面的主图缺少便于理解的替代文字。", advice: "建议描述图片实际内容，避免堆砌关键词；由编辑核对后保存。" },
              { name: "结构化数据待复核", hint: "/fr/applications", source: "来源：JSON-LD 检查", copy: "示例页面的结构化字段与展示内容需要保持一致。", advice: "建议检查产品、组织与问答字段，再决定是否更新公开页面。" }
            ]
          },
          geo: {
            title: "固定问题采样", records: [
              { name: "品牌是否出现在答案中？", hint: "英语 · 欧洲 · 示例模型 A", source: "来源：固定问题与原始回答", copy: "系统保存本次采样的问题、模型、地区、回答和引用页面。", advice: "建议对比同口径样本，并查看被引用的可核对来源。单次采样不代表全网排名。" },
              { name: "答案引用了哪些页面？", hint: "德语 · 欧洲 · 示例模型 B", source: "来源：答案引用列表", copy: "不同地区与模型的引用可能不同，需逐条查看原始回答。", advice: "建议改善目标页面的事实表达和来源信息，再在后续同口径采样中观察。" },
              { name: "内容缺口在哪里？", hint: "法语 · 北美 · 示例模型 C", source: "来源：采样趋势", copy: "示例采样显示某类产品问题缺少清楚的品牌说明。", advice: "建议先核对实际产品事实，再建立对应语言的内容草稿。" }
            ]
          }
        };
        var mode = "seo", selected = 0, marked = false;
        function render() {
          pressGroup("[data-search-mode]", mode, "data-search-mode");
          var group = examples[mode], list = studioNode("search-findings");
          studioText("search-list-title", group.title);
          list.replaceChildren();
          group.records.forEach(function (record, i) {
            var button = document.createElement("button"), label = document.createElement("span"), title = document.createElement("strong"), hint = document.createElement("small");
            button.type = "button"; button.className = "demo-record"; button.setAttribute("aria-current", i === selected ? "true" : "false");
            title.textContent = record.name; hint.textContent = record.hint; label.append(title, hint); button.append(label);
            button.addEventListener("click", function () { selected = i; marked = false; render(); studioNode("search-findings").querySelectorAll("button")[i].focus(); });
            list.appendChild(button);
          });
          var current = group.records[selected];
          studioText("search-source", current.source);
          studioText("search-title", current.name);
          studioText("search-copy", current.copy);
          studioText("search-advice", current.advice);
          var mark = studioNode("search-mark"); mark.disabled = marked; mark.textContent = marked ? "已标记待审核 ✓" : "标记为待审核建议 ↗";
          studioText("search-message", marked ? "已在本页标记；公开页面没有发生变化。" : "点选左侧记录查看详情。");
        }
        studioCanvas.querySelectorAll("[data-search-mode]").forEach(function (button) {
          button.addEventListener("click", function () { mode = button.getAttribute("data-search-mode"); selected = 0; marked = false; render(); });
        });
        studioNode("search-mark").addEventListener("click", function () { marked = true; render(); });
        render();
      }
      function initLanguage() {
        var examples = {
          en: { path: "example.com/en/products/precision-glass", nav: "Products　·　Applications　·　Contact", title: "Glass crafted for precise work.", copy: "Explore materials and forms designed for demanding applications.", link: "Explore the collection ↗" },
          de: { path: "example.com/de/produkte/praezisionsglas", nav: "Produkte　·　Anwendungen　·　Kontakt", title: "Glas für präzise Arbeit.", copy: "Entdecken Sie Materialien und Formen für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen.", link: "Kollektion entdecken ↗" },
          fr: { path: "example.com/fr/produits/verre-precision", nav: "Produits　·　Applications　·　Contact", title: "Le verre au service de la précision.", copy: "Découvrez des matériaux et des formes conçus pour des applications exigeantes.", link: "Découvrir la collection ↗" },
          zh: { path: "example.com/zh/products/precision-glass", nav: "产品　·　应用　·　联系我们", title: "让玻璃回应精密需求。", copy: "探索适用于专业场景的材料、形态与工艺。", link: "查看产品系列 ↗" }
        };
        function select(locale) {
          pressGroup("[data-demo-locale]", locale, "data-demo-locale");
          var record = examples[locale];
          studioText("language-path", record.path);
          studioText("language-nav", record.nav);
          studioText("language-title", record.title);
          studioText("language-copy", record.copy);
          studioText("language-link", record.link);
          studioNode("language-preview").setAttribute("lang", locale);
        }
        studioCanvas.querySelectorAll("[data-demo-locale]").forEach(function (button) { button.addEventListener("click", function () { select(button.getAttribute("data-demo-locale")); }); });
        select("en");
      }
      function initPublish() {
        var stage = 0, names = ["AI 建议与草稿", "编辑审核", "静态页面生成"];
        function render() {
          studioCanvas.querySelectorAll(".demo-timeline-step").forEach(function (row, i) { row.classList.toggle("is-current", i === stage); });
          studioText("publish-status", "当前状态：" + names[stage] + (stage === 2 ? "。示意页面已发布。" : "。尚未公开。"));
          studioText("publish-message", stage === 0 ? "点按“推进到下一状态”查看流程。" : stage === 1 ? "示意草稿已进入人工审核；真实发布仍需授权。" : "流程演示完成。真实站点不会受到影响。");
          var advance = studioNode("publish-advance"); advance.disabled = stage === 2; advance.textContent = stage === 2 ? "演示流程已完成 ✓" : "推进到下一状态 →";
        }
        studioNode("publish-advance").addEventListener("click", function () { stage = Math.min(2, stage + 1); render(); });
        studioNode("publish-reset").addEventListener("click", function () { stage = 0; render(); });
        render();
      }
      function initCRM() {
        var stages = {
          "new": { name: "新询盘", next: "下一步：确认产品规格与需求。" },
          "qualified": { name: "已确认需求", next: "下一步：分配负责人并准备解决方案。" },
          "proposal": { name: "方案沟通", next: "下一步：跟进客户反馈与报价问题。" },
          "won": { name: "已成交", next: "下一步：记录交付沟通与后续合作机会。" }
        };
        var stage = "new", notes = 0;
        function render() {
          pressGroup("[data-crm-stage]", stage, "data-crm-stage");
          studioText("crm-stage-name", stages[stage].name);
          studioText("crm-next", stages[stage].next);
        }
        studioCanvas.querySelectorAll("[data-crm-stage]").forEach(function (button) {
          button.addEventListener("click", function () { stage = button.getAttribute("data-crm-stage"); render(); studioText("crm-message", "示意商机阶段已切换；未修改真实客户记录。"); });
        });
        studioNode("crm-note").addEventListener("click", function () {
          notes++;
          var item = document.createElement("div"), title = document.createElement("strong"), detail = document.createElement("small");
