````html
      var moduleInitializers = [initCMS, initSearch, initLanguage, initPublish, initCRM, initMeasure, initTradeRFQ, initTradeFunnel, initTradeQuote, initTradeMarket, initTradeTrust, initTradePortal];
      function selectModule(index, focus) {
        moduleIndex = (index + modules.length) % modules.length;
        moduleTabs.forEach(function (tab, i) {
          var selected = i === moduleIndex;
          tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", selected ? "true" : "false");
          tab.tabIndex = selected ? 0 : -1;
        });
        var module = modules[moduleIndex];
        studioCanvas.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", moduleTabs[moduleIndex].id);
        studioCanvas.replaceChildren(document.getElementById(module.template).content.cloneNode(true));
        document.getElementById("studio-breadcrumb").textContent = "玄砚 / " + module.name;
        document.getElementById("studio-description").textContent = module.description;
        moduleInitializers[moduleIndex]();
        if (focus) moduleTabs[moduleIndex].focus();
      }
      moduleTabs.forEach(function (tab, index) {
        tab.addEventListener("click", function () { selectModule(index, false); });
        tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
          var target = null;
          if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowRight") target = index + 1;
          if (event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") target = index - 1;
          if (event.key === "Home") target = 0;
          if (event.key === "End") target = modules.length - 1;
          if (target !== null) { event.preventDefault(); selectModule(target, true); }
        });
      });
      document.getElementById("studio-next").addEventListener("click", function () { selectModule(moduleIndex + 1, true); });
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-open-module]").forEach(function (link) {
        link.addEventListener("click", function () { selectModule(Number(link.getAttribute("data-open-module")), false); });
      });
      selectModule(0, false);

      var menuButton = document.querySelector(".menu-toggle");
      var navLinks = document.getElementById("nav-links");
      menuButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var open = menuButton.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true";
        menuButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
        menuButton.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "关闭导航菜单" : "打开导航菜单");
        menuButton.textContent = open ? "×" : "☰";
        navLinks.classList.toggle("open", open);
      });
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(navLinks.querySelectorAll("a"), function (link) {
        link.addEventListener("click", function () {
          navLinks.classList.remove("open");
          menuButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          menuButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "打开导航菜单");
          menuButton.textContent = "☰";
        });
      });
      var supportDock = document.querySelector(".support-dock");
      var supportPanel = document.getElementById("support-panel");
      var supportTrigger = document.getElementById("support-trigger");
      var supportClose = document.getElementById("support-close");
      function setSupportOpen(open, restoreFocus) {
        supportPanel.hidden = !open;
        supportTrigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
        supportTrigger.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "关闭客服联系方式" : "打开客服联系方式");
        if (open) supportClose.focus();
        else if (restoreFocus) supportTrigger.focus();
      }
      supportTrigger.addEventListener("click", function () { setSupportOpen(supportPanel.hidden, !supportPanel.hidden); });
      supportClose.addEventListener("click", function () { setSupportOpen(false, true); });
      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) { if (event.key === "Escape" && !supportPanel.hidden) setSupportOpen(false, true); });
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) { if (!supportPanel.hidden && !supportDock.contains(event.target)) setSupportOpen(false, false); });
      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add("js-ready");
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (entry) { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add("is-visible"); observer.unobserve(entry.target); } });
        }, { threshold: .08, rootMargin: "0px 0px 40px 0px" });
        document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(function (element) { observer.observe(element); });
      }
    }());
  </script>
````

````tsx
'use client';
import {useCallback,useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './agent-desk.css';
type Row=Record<string,any>;
const get=(path:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path);
const post=(path:string,data:Row)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path,data);
const state:Row={pending:'排队中',planning:'正在制定计划',running:'正在读取资料',awaiting_approval:'等待审核',approved:'已批准，待套用',applied:'已套用到草稿',rejected:'已驳回',failed:'执行失败',cancelled:'已取消'};
const toolName:Row={read_content:'读取当前内容',seo_review:'SEO 检查',keyword_evidence:'关键词证据',competitor_evidence:'竞品资料',geo_evidence:'GEO 样本',draft_proposal:'撰写修改方案'};
const fieldName:Row={title:'标题 / 产品名',excerpt:'摘要 / 简介',description:'产品详细介绍',metaTitle:'搜索标题',metaDescription:'搜索摘要'};
function format(value:unknown){return new Date(String(value)).toLocaleString('zh-CN');}
export function AgentDesk({actorId,canReview,canApply,onOpenContent}:{actorId:string;canReview:boolean;canApply:boolean;onOpenContent:(table:string,title:string)=>void}){
 const [items,setItems]=useState<Row[]>([]),[runs,setRuns]=useState<Row[]>([]),[daily,setDaily]=useState<Row>({}),[selected,setSelected]=useState<Row|null>(null),[entity,setEntity]=useState(''),[objective,setObjective]=useState(''),[maxSteps,setMaxSteps]=useState(5),[tokenBudget,setTokenBudget]=useState(8000),[note,setNote]=useState(''),[rating,setRating]=useState(5),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
 const reload=useCallback(async()=>{const [context,history]=await Promise.all([get('agent-context'),get('agent-runs')]);setItems(context.items||[]);setRuns(history.rows||[]);setDaily(history.daily?.[0]||{});},[]);
 const open=useCallback(async(id:string)=>setSelected(await get('agent-run?id='+encodeURIComponent(id))),[]);
 useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(e=>setError(e.message));},[reload]);
 useEffect(()=>{if(!runs.some(x=>['pending','planning','running'].includes(x.status)))return;const timer=setInterval(()=>{reload().then(()=>{if(selected?.run?.id)open(selected.run.id);}).catch(()=>{});},5000);return()=>clearInterval(timer);},[runs,selected?.run?.id,reload,open]);
 async function perform(fn:()=>Promise<void>,message:string){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{await fn();await reload();setNotice(message);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 async function create(){const item=items.find(x=>x.id===entity);if(!item)return;await perform(async()=>{const run=await post('agent-runs',{entityType:item.entity_type,entityId:item.id,objective:objective.trim(),maxSteps,tokenBudget});setObjective('');await open(run.id);},'任务已排队。Worker 会记录计划和每一步结果。');}
 async function decide(action:'approve'|'reject'|'apply'|'cancel'|'rate'){if(!selected)return;await perform(async()=>{await post('agent-decision',{id:selected.run.id,action,note:note.trim()||undefined,rating:action==='rate'?rating:undefined});await open(selected.run.id);setNote('');},({approve:'已批准。内容编辑可将方案套用到草稿。',reject:'已驳回。',apply:'修改已写入草稿；公开页面需单独审核发布。',cancel:'任务已取消。',rate:'评价已保存。'} as Row)[action]);}
 const run=selected?.run;const first=selected?.steps?.find((x:Row)=>x.tool==='read_content')?.result||{};const changes=run?.proposal?.changes||{};const old:Row={title:first.title,excerpt:first.summary,description:first.description,metaTitle:first.seo?.meta_title,metaDescription:first.seo?.meta_description};
 return <div className="v2 agent-desk"><div className="v2-hero"><p>EDITORIAL AGENT</p><h2>从目标到可审核的内容方案</h2><span>Agent 会规划步骤，读取本站已有资料并提出具体修改。审核员批准后，编辑才可套用到草稿；公开发布仍走原有审核流程。</span></div>
 {error&&<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="v2-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
 <div className="agent-grid"><section className="v2-card"><h3>创建任务</h3><label>选择内容<select value={entity} onChange={e=>setEntity(e.target.value)}><option value="">选择页面、文章或产品</option>{items.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.title} · {x.locale} · {x.path}</option>)}</select></label><label>要解决的问题<textarea rows={4} maxLength={1500} value={objective} onChange={e=>setObjective(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：根据现有产品事实与 SEO 检查，优化这款产品的标题和摘要，不要改动规格参数。"/></label><div className="v2-row"><label>最多步骤<select value={maxSteps} onChange={e=>setMaxSteps(Number(e.target.value))}>{[2,3,4,5,6,7,8].map(n=><option key={n} value={n}>{n} 步</option>)}</select></label><label>本次 token 上限<select value={tokenBudget} onChange={e=>setTokenBudget(Number(e.target.value))}>{[5000,8000,12000,16000].map(n=><option key={n} value={n}>{n.toLocaleString()}</option>)}</select></label></div><p className="v2-muted">今天已预留 {Number(daily.reserved_tokens||0).toLocaleString()} / 50,000 tokens，{daily.runs||0} / 10 次。每次最多调用模型 2 次。</p><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!entity||objective.trim().length<10} onClick={create}>开始分析</button></section>
 <section className="v2-card"><div className="agent-heading"><h3>任务记录</h3><button onClick={()=>reload().catch(e=>setError(e.message))}>刷新</button></div>{runs.length?runs.map(x=><button key={x.id} className={'agent-run '+(selected?.run?.id===x.id?'active':'')} onClick={()=>open(x.id).catch(e=>setError(e.message))}><strong>{x.title||'已删除内容'}</strong><small>{format(x.created_at)} · {x.objective}</small><span>{state[x.status]||x.status} · {x.tokens_used}/{x.token_budget} tokens</span></button>):<div className="v2-empty">还没有 Agent 任务。从左侧选择内容并写明目标。</div>}</section></div>
 {run&&<section className="v2-card"><div className="agent-heading"><div><p className="v2-kicker">{run.model||'AI AGENT'} · {format(run.created_at)}</p><h3>{items.find(x=>x.id===run.entity_id)?.title||'内容任务'}</h3></div><b className="agent-status">{state[run.status]||run.status}</b></div><p>{run.objective}</p>{run.error_message&&<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{run.error_message}</p>}
 <div className="agent-steps">{selected.steps?.map((step:Row)=><div key={step.ordinal} className="agent-step"><span>{step.ordinal}</span><div><strong>{toolName[step.tool]||step.tool}</strong><small>{step.rationale} · {step.status==='completed'?'已完成':step.status==='failed'?'失败':'执行中'}</small>{step.error_message&&<p className="v2-error">{step.error_message}</p>}<details><summary>查看本步证据</summary><pre>{JSON.stringify(step.result,null,2)}</pre></details></div></div>)}</div>
 {run.proposal&&<><div className="agent-proposal"><p className="v2-kicker">待人工确认的修改方案</p><h3>{run.proposal.summary}</h3><p>{run.proposal.reason}</p>{Object.entries(changes).map(([key,value])=><div className="agent-diff" key={key}><strong>{fieldName[key]||key}</strong><div><div><small>当前</small><p>{old[key]||'（空）'}</p></div><div><small>建议</small><p>{String(value)}</p></div></div></div>)}<p className="v2-muted">依据：{(run.proposal.sources||[]).join('、')||'已记录的步骤证据'}。应用时会再次检查内容版本。</p></div><label>审核说明 / 效果备注<textarea rows={2} maxLength={1000} value={note} onChange={e=>setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="可选：记录批准、驳回或效果评价的理由"/></label><div className="agent-actions">{run.status==='awaiting_approval'&&canReview&&<><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={()=>decide('approve')}>批准修改方案</button><button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>decide('reject')}>驳回</button></>}{run.status==='approved'&&canApply&&<button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={()=>decide('apply')}>套用到草稿</button>}{run.status==='applied'&&<button onClick={()=>onOpenContent(run.entity_type,items.find(x=>x.id===run.entity_id)?.title||'')}>打开内容检查并发布 →</button>}{['applied','rejected'].includes(run.status)&&run.requested_by===actorId&&<><select aria-label="效果评分" value={rating} onChange={e=>setRating(Number(e.target.value))}>{[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=><option key={n} value={n}>{n} 分</option>)}</select><button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>decide('rate')}>记录效果</button></>}</div></>}
 {selected.evaluation&&<p className="v2-notice">SEO 诊断分：{selected.evaluation.before??'未记录'} → {selected.evaluation.current}{selected.evaluation.delta!==null?`（${selected.evaluation.delta>=0?'+':''}${selected.evaluation.delta}）`:''}。这是草稿诊断变化，不代表流量或排名效果。</p>}
 {run.status==='pending'&&run.requested_by===actorId&&<button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>decide('cancel')}>取消排队任务</button>}<p className="v2-muted">已用 {run.tokens_used} / {run.token_budget} tokens，模型调用 {run.calls_used} / 2 次。</p></section>}
 </div>;
}
````

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/AISettings.tsx

````tsx
'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest,type Row} from './api-client';

const modelPattern=/^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{2,100}$/;
const loopback=['localhost','127.0.0.1','[::1]'];

// 与后端 packages/domain/src/llm.ts 的校验保持一致，先在本地拦掉明显错误，减少无谓请求。
function formProblem(model:string,url:string,key:string){
 if(!modelPattern.test(model.trim()))return '模型名称只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线、斜杠和连字符（2–100 字符）';
 let parsed:URL;
 try{parsed=new URL(url.trim());}catch{return '接口地址必须是完整网址，例如 https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions';}
 if(parsed.username||parsed.password)return '接口地址不能包含用户名或密码';
 if(parsed.search||parsed.hash)return '接口地址不能带查询参数或锚点';
 if(parsed.protocol!=='https:'&&!(parsed.protocol==='http:'&&loopback.includes(parsed.hostname)))return '接口地址必须使用 HTTPS；仅本机调试可用 http://localhost';
 if(/\s/.test(key))return 'API 密钥不能包含空格或换行';
 if(key&&(key.length<16||key.length>500))return 'API 密钥长度不正确（应在 16–500 字符之间）';
 return '';
}

export function AISettings({onSaved}:{onSaved:()=>void}){
 const [settings,setSettings]=useState<Row|null>(null);
 const [form,setForm]=useState({model:'',url:'',enabled:true});
 const [key,setKey]=useState(''),[clearKey,setClearKey]=useState(false);
 const [busy,setBusy]=useState(''),[error,setError]=useState(''),[message,setMessage]=useState('');
 const [probe,setProbe]=useState<Row|null>(null),[pendingClear,setPendingClear]=useState(false);

 function apply(value:Row){setSettings(value);setForm({model:value.model||'',url:value.url||'',enabled:!!value.enabled});}
 useEffect(()=>{apiRequest('llm-settings').then(apply).catch(e=>setError(e.message));},[]);

 const typedKey=key.trim();
 const hasCredential=!!typedKey||!!settings?.hasSavedKey||!!settings?.hasEnvKey;
 const status=settings?.keyProblem?'密钥异常':settings?.configured?'已就绪':settings&&!settings.enabled?'已停用':'未配置密钥';
 const statusTone=settings?.configured?'ready':settings?.keyProblem?'broken':'idle';

 function reset(){setPendingClear(false);setError('');setMessage('');setProbe(null);}

 async function save(){
  const problem=formProblem(form.model,form.url,typedKey);
  if(problem){reset();setError(problem);return;}
  if(clearKey&&!pendingClear){reset();setPendingClear(true);setMessage('已勾选“删除已保存的密钥”。再次点击“确认删除并保存”才会真正删除。');return;}
  setBusy('save');setError('');setMessage('');setProbe(null);
  try{
   const value=await apiRequest('llm-settings',{model:form.model.trim(),url:form.url.trim(),enabled:form.enabled,apiKey:typedKey||undefined,clearKey},'PUT');
   apply(value);setKey('');setClearKey(false);setPendingClear(false);
   setMessage('已保存。CMS 与后台任务会立即使用新配置。');
   onSaved();
  }catch(e:any){setError(e.message||'保存失败');}
  finally{setBusy('');}
 }

 // 允许用“本次输入、尚未保存”的凭据测试，不必先存后测；测试不会写库。
 async function test(){
  if(!hasCredential){setError('请先填写 API 密钥，或保存一次密钥后再测试');return;}
  setBusy('test');setError('');setMessage('');setProbe(null);
  try{
   const result=await apiRequest('llm-test',{model:form.model.trim()||undefined,url:form.url.trim()||undefined,apiKey:typedKey||undefined});
   setProbe({...result,ok:true});
  }catch(e:any){setProbe({ok:false,message:e.message||'连接失败'});}
  finally{setBusy('');}
 }

 return <section className="llm-settings">
  <header className="llm-head">
   <div>
    <h2>AI 设置 · DeepSeek</h2>
    <p>API 密钥以 AES-256-GCM 加密后保存在数据库，保存后不再回显。留空表示保留已保存的密钥。</p>
   </div>
   <span className={'llm-badge '+statusTone}>{status}</span>
  </header>
  {error&&<p className="form-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
  {message&&<p className={pendingClear?'llm-warning':'llm-success'} role="status">{message}</p>}
  {settings?.keyProblem&&<p className="llm-warning" role="alert">{settings.keyProblem}</p>}
  {!settings
   ?(error?null:<p>正在加载设置…</p>)
   :<div className="llm-fields">
    <label><span>服务商</span><input value="DeepSeek" disabled/></label>
    <label><span>模型</span><input value={form.model} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,model:e.target.value})} placeholder="deepseek-flash"/></label>
    <label className="wide"><span>接口地址</span><input value={form.url} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,url:e.target.value})} placeholder="https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions"/>{settings.urlProblem&&<small className="llm-inline-error">{settings.urlProblem}</small>}</label>
    <label className="wide"><span>API 密钥</span><input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={key} onChange={e=>{setKey(e.target.value);setPendingClear(false);}} placeholder={settings.hasSavedKey?'已加密保存；留空则保留':'填写 DeepSeek API 密钥'}/>
     <small>当前来源：{settings.keySource}{settings.hasSavedKey&&settings.keyFingerprint?` · 指纹 ${settings.keyFingerprint}`:''}。密钥不会回显，也不会写入日志或审计记录。</small>
    </label>
    {settings.hasSavedKey&&<label className="wide llm-option"><input type="checkbox" checked={clearKey} onChange={e=>{setClearKey(e.target.checked);setPendingClear(false);}}/>删除已保存的密钥（保存后需要重新填写才能翻译）</label>}
    <label className="wide llm-option"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.enabled} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,enabled:e.target.checked})}/>启用自动翻译</label>
    <div className="wide llm-buttons">
     <button className="primary" disabled={!!busy} onClick={save}>{busy==='save'?'处理中…':pendingClear?'确认删除并保存':'保存设置'}</button>
     <button disabled={!!busy||!hasCredential} title={hasCredential?'用当前填写的配置试跑一次翻译（不会保存）':'请先填写 API 密钥，或保存一次密钥后再测试'} onClick={test}>{busy==='test'?'测试中…':'测试连接'}</button>
     {settings.updatedAt&&<span className="llm-meta">上次修改 {new Date(settings.updatedAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}{settings.updatedBy?` · ${settings.updatedBy}`:''}</span>}
    </div>
    {probe&&<div className={'wide llm-probe '+(probe.ok?'ok':'bad')} role="status">
     {probe.ok?<><strong>连接成功</strong><p>模型 {probe.model} · 耗时 {probe.durationMs} ms · 凭据来源：{probe.keySource}{probe.usage?.total_tokens?` · 用量 ${probe.usage.total_tokens} tokens`:''}</p><p>返回样例：{probe.sample}</p>{!probe.enabled&&<p className="llm-inline-error">注意：当前“启用自动翻译”未勾选，任务不会真正执行。</p>}</>
      :<><strong>连接失败</strong><p>{probe.message}</p></>}
    </div>}
   </div>}
 </section>;
}

````

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/AIWriting.tsx

````tsx
'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './ai-writing.css';

type Product={id:string;locale_id:string;name:string;sku:string};
type Section={heading:string;body:string};
type Draft={title:string;slug:string;excerpt:string;sections:Section[];metaTitle:string;metaDescription:string};
export function AIWriting({locales,onSaved,canPublish}:{locales:{id:string;code:string;native_name:string}[];onSaved:(title:string,published:boolean)=>void;canPublish:boolean}){
  const [localeId,setLocaleId]=useState(locales[0]?.id||'');
  const [topic,setTopic]=useState(''),[notes,setNotes]=useState(''),[keywords,setKeywords]=useState(''),[productId,setProductId]=useState('');
  const [context,setContext]=useState<{configured:boolean;reason:string;model:string;products:Product[]}|null>(null);
  const [draft,setDraft]=useState<Draft|null>(null),[busy,setBusy]=useState<'generate'|'save'|'publish'|null>(null),[error,setError]=useState('');
  const [runId,setRunId]=useState(''),[history,setHistory]=useState<any[]>([]);
  useEffect(()=>{let active=true;apiRequest('ai-writing/context').then(x=>{if(active)setContext(x as any);}).catch(e=>{if(active)setError(e.message);});return()=>{active=false;};},[]);
  useEffect(()=>{apiRequest('v2/ai-writing-history').then(x=>setHistory(x.rows||[])).catch(()=>{});},[]);
  const products=(context?.products||[]).filter(x=>x.locale_id===localeId);
  async function generate(){setBusy('generate');setError('');try{const result=await apiRequest('ai-writing/generate',{localeId,topic,sourceNotes:notes,keywords,productTranslationId:productId||undefined});setDraft(result.draft as Draft);setRunId(result.runId);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'生成失败');}finally{setBusy(null);}}
  async function save(publish:boolean){if(!draft)return;setBusy(publish?'publish':'save');setError('');try{const saved=await apiRequest('ai-writing/save',{localeId,draft,runId:runId||undefined});if(publish){try{await apiRequest('publish',{resource:'content_item_translations',id:saved.id,action:'publish'});}catch(e){onSaved(draft.title,false);setError('草稿已保存，但发布失败：'+(e instanceof Error?e.message:'请稍后重试'));return;}}onSaved(draft.title,publish);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'保存失败');}finally{setBusy(null);}}
  function setField<K extends keyof Draft>(key:K,value:Draft[K]){setDraft(prev=>prev?{...prev,[key]:value}:prev);}
  return <div className="aiw"><div className="aiw-head"><div><p className="aiw-kicker">CONTENT LAB / 01</p><h2>从事实资料到文章草稿</h2><p>填写主题，选择已有产品或提供可靠资料。AI 给出第一稿，你检查并修改后再发布。</p></div><div className="aiw-mark" aria-hidden="true">✦</div></div>
  <div className="aiw-steps"><span className="current">01 提供资料</span><span className={draft?'current':''}>02 校对草稿</span><span className={draft?'current':''}>03 发布上线</span></div>
  {error&&<div className="aiw-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
  {context&&!context.configured&&<div className="aiw-error">AI 服务不可用：{context.reason}。请到“自动翻译”中的 AI 设置完成配置。</div>}
  <div className="aiw-grid"><section className="aiw-panel"><p className="aiw-label">写作简报</p><label>文章语言<select value={localeId} onChange={e=>{setLocaleId(e.target.value);setProductId('');setDraft(null);setRunId('');}}>{locales.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.native_name} · {x.code}</option>)}</select></label><label>文章主题 <em>必填</em><input value={topic} maxLength={180} onChange={e=>setTopic(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：如何选择耐热玻璃器皿"/></label><label>关联产品 <small>可选，使用产品现有资料作依据</small><select value={productId} onChange={e=>setProductId(e.target.value)}><option value="">不关联产品</option>{products.map(x=><option value={x.id} key={x.id}>{x.name} · {x.sku}</option>)}</select></label><label>事实与素材 <small>未关联产品时至少 20 字</small><textarea rows={6} value={notes} maxLength={5000} onChange={e=>setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="写下实际参数、应用场景、需要引用的资料或必须避免的说法…"/></label><label>重点词语 <small>可选，不会强行堆砌</small><input value={keywords} maxLength={300} onChange={e=>setKeywords(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：硼硅玻璃、实验室器皿"/></label><button className="aiw-primary" disabled={!!busy||!context?.configured||!topic.trim()||(!productId&&notes.trim().length<20)} onClick={generate}>{busy==='generate'?'正在生成…':draft?'重新生成草稿':'生成文章草稿'} <span>↗</span></button><p className="aiw-footnote">当前模型：{context?.model||'读取中'}。资料会发送给所配置的 AI 服务。AI 结果需要人工核实。</p></section>
  <section className="aiw-panel aiw-preview"><div className="aiw-preview-head"><p className="aiw-label">文章草稿</p>{draft&&<span className="aiw-pill">未发布 · 可编辑</span>}</div>{!draft?<div className="aiw-empty"><span>✦</span><h3>你的草稿将在这里出现</h3><p>生成后可直接修改标题、摘要、正文和搜索展示信息。</p></div>:<div className="aiw-fields"><label>文章标题<input value={draft.title} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setField('title',e.target.value)}/></label><label>网址标识 <small>仅使用小写英文字母、数字和连字符</small><div className="aiw-slug"><span>/{locales.find(x=>x.id===localeId)?.code||'en'}/blog/</span><input value={draft.slug} maxLength={160} onChange={e=>setField('slug',e.target.value)}/></div></label><label>导语<textarea rows={3} value={draft.excerpt} maxLength={1000} onChange={e=>setField('excerpt',e.target.value)}/></label>{draft.sections.map((s,i)=><div className="aiw-section" key={i}><p>段落 {String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</p><input aria-label={`第 ${i+1} 段标题`} value={s.heading} maxLength={180} onChange={e=>setField('sections',draft.sections.map((x,j)=>j===i?{...x,heading:e.target.value}:x))}/><textarea aria-label={`第 ${i+1} 段正文`} rows={5} value={s.body} maxLength={5000} onChange={e=>setField('sections',draft.sections.map((x,j)=>j===i?{...x,body:e.target.value}:x))}/></div>)}<details className="aiw-seo"><summary>搜索展示信息</summary><label>搜索标题<input value={draft.metaTitle} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setField('metaTitle',e.target.value)}/></label><label>搜索摘要<textarea rows={3} value={draft.metaDescription} maxLength={500} onChange={e=>setField('metaDescription',e.target.value)}/></label></details><div className="aiw-save"><p>{canPublish?'发布后公开站会立即更新；也可以先存草稿，稍后再发。':'保存后进入待审核，由审核员发布。'}</p><div className="aiw-save-actions">{canPublish&&<button className="aiw-primary" disabled={!!busy} onClick={()=>save(true)}>{busy==='publish'?'正在发布…':'发布上线'} <span>→</span></button>}<button className={canPublish?'aiw-secondary':'aiw-primary'} disabled={!!busy} onClick={()=>save(false)}>{busy==='save'?'正在保存…':'保存草稿'}</button></div></div></div>}</section></div>
  {history.length>0&&<section className="aiw-panel" style={{marginTop:20}}><p className="aiw-label">近期生成记录</p>{history.slice(0,8).map(x=><p key={x.id} className="aiw-footnote">{x.saved_title||x.topic} · {x.model} · {x.usage?.total_tokens||0} tokens · {new Date(x.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}{x.saved_path?' · 已保存':' · 未保存'}</p>)}</section>}
  </div>;
}
````

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/api-client.ts

````ts
export type Row=Record<string,any>;

// 业务管理页统一的 /api/v1 客户端。
// 关键点：先读文本、再判状态码、最后才解析 JSON。
// 旧写法直接 await response.json()，遇到 405/204 这类空正文会抛
// "Unexpected end of JSON input"，把真实状态码整个吞掉。
export async function apiRequest(path:string,body?:Row,method?:string):Promise<Row>{
 let response:Response;
 try{
  response=await fetch('/api/v1/'+path,{credentials:'include',method:method||(body?'POST':'GET'),headers:body?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:undefined,body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined});
 }catch{
  throw new Error('无法连接服务器，请检查网络后重试');
 }
 const text=(await response.text()).trim();
 let data:Row={};
 if(text){
  try{data=JSON.parse(text);}
  catch{throw new Error(`服务器返回了无法解析的内容（HTTP ${response.status}），请稍后重试`);}
 }else if(!response.ok){
  throw new Error(response.status===405?`该接口不支持 ${method||(body?'POST':'GET')} 请求（HTTP 405）`:`服务器未返回内容（HTTP ${response.status}）`);
 }
 if(!response.ok)throw new Error(data.error||`请求失败（HTTP ${response.status}）`);
 return data;
}

````

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/BiDesk.tsx

````tsx
'use client';
import {useCallback,useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './v2-workspaces.css';
import './bi-desk.css';

type Row=Record<string,any>;
const get=(path:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path);
const post=(path:string,data:Row)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path,data);
const iso=(date:Date)=>date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const today=new Date();
const defaultFrom=iso(new Date(today.getTime()-29*86400000));
const date=(x:unknown)=>x?new Date(String(x)).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—';
function format(value:unknown,unit:string,dimension:string){const n=Number(value||0);if(unit==='money')return new Intl.NumberFormat('zh-CN',{style:'currency',currency:/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(dimension)?dimension:'USD'}).format(n);if(unit==='USD')return '$'+n.toFixed(4);return new Intl.NumberFormat('zh-CN',{maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(n);}
export function BiDesk(){
 const [catalog,setCatalog]=useState<Row>({definitions:[],reports:[]}),[report,setReport]=useState<Row|null>(null),[compare,setCompare]=useState<Row|null>(null),[compareId,setCompareId]=useState('');
 const [name,setName]=useState('经营报告 '+iso(today)),[from,setFrom]=useState(defaultFrom),[to,setTo]=useState(iso(today));
 const [drill,setDrill]=useState<Row|null>(null),[drillKey,setDrillKey]=useState<{metric:string;dimension:string}|null>(null),[drillPage,setDrillPage]=useState(1),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
 const reload=useCallback(async()=>setCatalog(await get('bi-catalog')),[]);
 useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(e=>setError(e.message));},[reload]);
 async function act(work:()=>Promise<void>,message=''){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{await work();if(message)setNotice(message);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 async function create(){await act(async()=>{const result=await post('bi-report',{name,dateFrom:from,dateTo:to});await reload();setReport(await get('bi-report?id='+result.id));setCompare(null);setCompareId('');setDrill(null);},'已生成不可变报表快照。点击指标可查看当时计入的原始记录。');}
 async function open(id:string){await act(async()=>{setReport(await get('bi-report?id='+id));setDrill(null);setDrillKey(null);setCompare(null);setCompareId('');});}
 async function openCompare(id:string){setCompareId(id);if(!id){setCompare(null);return;}await act(async()=>setCompare(await get('bi-report?id='+id)));}
 async function openDrill(metric:string,dimension:string,page=1){if(!report)return;await act(async()=>{setDrillKey({metric,dimension});setDrillPage(page);setDrill(await get('bi-drilldown?id='+report.run.id+'&metric='+encodeURIComponent(metric)+'&dimension='+encodeURIComponent(dimension)+'&page='+page));});}
 const definitions=(report?.definitions||catalog.definitions||[]) as Row[];
 const definition=(code:string)=>definitions.find(x=>x.code===code)||{label:code,unit:'count',formula:'',source_tables:[]};
 const grouped=report?definitions.map(x=>({definition:x,values:report.values.filter((v:Row)=>v.metric_code===x.code)})):[];
 return <div className="v2 bi-desk"><div className="v2-hero"><p>V3 · BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE</p><h2>每个数字，都能找到来源</h2><span>统一指标口径、UTC 日期范围、不可变快照与原始记录明细。跨币种金额分别展示，不做隐含汇率换算。</span></div>{error&&<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="v2-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
 <div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>生成经营报告</h3><p className="v2-muted">固定读取询盘、商机、营销、GEO、任务和发布记录。创建时保存指标定义、汇总值和逐条来源快照。</p><label>报告名称<input value={name} maxLength={160} onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value)}/></label><div className="v2-row"><label>开始日期（UTC）<input type="date" value={from} onChange={e=>setFrom(e.target.value)}/></label><label>结束日期（UTC）<input type="date" value={to} onChange={e=>setTo(e.target.value)}/></label></div><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||name.trim().length<2||!from||!to} onClick={create}>{busy?'生成中…':'生成快照'}</button><p className="v2-muted">单次最多 367 天、10 万条指标来源记录。较大范围请分段生成。</p></section><section className="v2-card"><h3>历史报告</h3>{catalog.reports?.length?catalog.reports.map((x:Row)=><button className={'bi-report-choice '+(report?.run?.id===x.id?'active':'')} key={x.id} onClick={()=>open(x.id)}><strong>{x.name}</strong><small>{String(x.date_from).slice(0,10)} 至 {String(x.date_to).slice(0,10)} UTC · {x.source_rows} 条来源 · {date(x.created_at)} · {x.author||'管理员'}</small></button>):<p className="v2-muted">尚无报表。选择日期后生成第一份。</p>}</section></div>
 {report&&<><section className="v2-card bi-report-header"><div><p className="v2-kicker">已保存的经营快照</p><h3>{report.run.name}</h3><p>{String(report.run.date_from).slice(0,10)} — {String(report.run.date_to).slice(0,10)} UTC · {report.run.source_rows} 条可追溯来源 · 生成 {date(report.run.created_at)}</p></div><div className="v2-row"><label>对比另一份<select value={compareId} onChange={e=>openCompare(e.target.value)}><option value="">不对比</option>{catalog.reports?.filter((x:Row)=>x.id!==report.run.id).map((x:Row)=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.name} · {String(x.date_from).slice(0,10)} 至 {String(x.date_to).slice(0,10)}</option>)}</select></label><a className="bi-export" href={'/api/v1/v2/bi-export?id='+report.run.id}>导出来源 CSV</a></div></section>{compare&&<p className="v2-muted">对比报告：{compare.run.name}（{String(compare.run.date_from).slice(0,10)} 至 {String(compare.run.date_to).slice(0,10)} UTC）。下方差异是两份快照的直接差值，请结合各自时间范围解释。</p>}
 <div className="bi-metrics">{grouped.map(({definition:d,values})=><section className="v2-card bi-metric" key={d.code}><h3>{d.label}</h3><p className="bi-formula">{d.formula}</p><small>来源：{d.source_tables?.join('、')} · 定义版本 {d.version}</small>{values.length?values.map((x:Row)=>{const other=compare?.values?.find((v:Row)=>v.metric_code===x.metric_code&&v.dimension===x.dimension);const delta=other?Number(x.value)-Number(other.value):null;return <button className="bi-dimension" key={x.dimension} onClick={()=>openDrill(d.code,x.dimension)}><span>{x.dimension==='all'?'合计':x.dimension}</span><strong>{format(x.value,d.unit,x.dimension)}</strong><small>{x.source_count} 条来源{delta!==null?' · 对比 '+(delta>=0?'+':'')+format(delta,d.unit,x.dimension):''}</small></button>;}):<p className="v2-muted">本期无记录</p>}</section>)}</div>
 {drillKey&&drill&&<section className="v2-card bi-drill"><h3>{definition(drillKey.metric).label} · {drillKey.dimension==='all'?'合计':drillKey.dimension}</h3><p className="v2-muted">以下为生成报表当时计入的来源快照，后续源记录变化不会改写这份报表。</p>{drill.series?.length>0&&<div className="bi-series" aria-label="每日指标变化">{drill.series.map((x:Row)=><div key={String(x.day)} title={String(x.day).slice(0,10)+" · "+format(x.value,definition(drillKey.metric).unit,drillKey.dimension)+" · "+x.sources+" 条来源"}><i style={{height:String(Math.max(3,Math.round(Number(x.value)/Math.max(...drill.series.map((d:Row)=>Number(d.value)),1)*100)))+"%"}}/><small>{String(x.day).slice(5,10)}</small></div>)}</div>}{drill.rows?.map((x:Row)=><div className="bi-source" key={x.source_id}><strong>{x.item_label}</strong><small>{x.source_table} · {date(x.occurred_at)} · 计入 {format(x.value,definition(drillKey.metric).unit,drillKey.dimension)}</small><details><summary>原始记录编号</summary><code>{x.source_id}</code></details></div>)}<div className="bi-pages"><button disabled={drillPage<=1} onClick={()=>openDrill(drillKey.metric,drillKey.dimension,drillPage-1)}>上一页</button><span>第 {drillPage} 页 · 共 {drill.total} 条</span><button disabled={drillPage*50>=drill.total} onClick={()=>openDrill(drillKey.metric,drillKey.dimension,drillPage+1)}>下一页</button></div></section>}</>}
 </div>;
}

````

````tsx
'use client';
import './client-home.css';

// 新手模式（client 角色）的 5 个任务入口，按「用户想做什么」而非「资源表」组织。
export type ClientTask={table:string;title:string;desc:string;icon:string;cta:string};
export const clientTasks:ClientTask[]=[
 {table:'ai_writing',title:'发文章 / 新闻',desc:'一句话说主题，AI 写好草稿，你改完就发。',icon:'✎',cta:'写文章'},
 {table:'product_wizard',title:'发布产品',desc:'一句话说产品，AI 生成完整介绍，改完就发。',icon:'◈',cta:'发产品'},
 {table:'site_settings',title:'修改首页',desc:'改标题、联系方式，或换首页轮播图。',icon:'⚙',cta:'改首页'},
 {table:'inquiry_desk',title:'查看询盘',desc:'客户留言与商机，及时回复跟进。',icon:'✉',cta:'看询盘'},
 {table:'content_item_translations',title:'我的内容',desc:'管理已发布的文章和产品。',icon:'▣',cta:'管内容'},
];

export function ClientHome({onNavigate}:{onNavigate:(table:string)=>void}){
 return <div className="client-home">
  <section className="client-hero">
   <p className="client-kicker">玄砚 · 自助工作台</p>
   <h2>今天想做什么？</h2>
   <p>选一个任务开始，剩下的交给 AI 和系统。</p>
  </section>
  <section className="client-grid" aria-label="常用任务">
   {clientTasks.map(t=>(
    <button key={t.table} type="button" className="client-card" onClick={()=>onNavigate(t.table)}>
     <span className="client-icon" aria-hidden="true">{t.icon}</span>
     <div className="client-card-body"><strong>{t.title}</strong><p>{t.desc}</p></div>
     <span className="client-cta">{t.cta} <b aria-hidden="true">↗</b></span>
    </button>
   ))}
  </section>
  <p className="client-foot">需要更多功能？找管理员开通，或在右上角切换到完整工作台。</p>
 </div>;
}
````

````css
.crm-toolbar,.crm-toolbar form,.crm-option-search,.crm-pages,.crm-member{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.crm-toolbar{justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}.crm-toolbar form input,.crm-option-search input{min-width:240px}
.crm-list-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;width:100%;padding:13px 15px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0e8df;border-radius:8px;margin:8px 0;text-align:left;color:#173e30;cursor:pointer}
.crm-list-item:hover,.crm-list-item.selected{border-color:#4d8067;background:#f2f7f1}.crm-list-item small,.crm-list-item span{color:#65776a}
.crm-pages{justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:15px}.crm-pages span{font-size:13px;color:#68766a}
.crm-record{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e8df}.crm-record strong,.crm-record small{display:block}.crm-record small{margin:5px 0;color:#69786d}
.crm-member{justify-content:space-between;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef2ec}
.crm-timeline{border-left:2px solid #c5d8c9;margin-left:5px;padding-left:18px}.crm-timeline>div{position:relative;padding:0 0 18px}.crm-timeline>div:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-23px;top:4px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#578669}.crm-timeline strong,.crm-timeline small{display:block}.crm-timeline small{font-size:12px;color:#718174;margin-top:3px}.crm-timeline p{margin:7px 0;white-space:pre-wrap}
.crm-desk .v2-card label{display:block;margin:10px 0}.crm-desk .v2-card input,.crm-desk .v2-card select,.crm-desk .v2-card textarea{max-width:100%}
@media(max-width:1000px){.crm-desk .crm-stages{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:620px){.crm-desk .crm-stages{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.crm-toolbar form,.crm-option-search{width:100%}.crm-toolbar form input,.crm-option-search input{min-width:0;flex:1}}
````

````tsx
type Row=Record<string,any>;

const date=(value:unknown)=>value?new Date(String(value)).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—';
const localDate=(value:unknown)=>value?new Date(String(value)).toISOString().slice(0,16):'';

const blankDeal=()=>({title:'',contactId:'',accountId:'',inquiryId:'',stage:'new',amount:0,currency:'USD',probability:10,ownerId:'',expectedCloseOn:'',nextAction:'',nextActionAt:'',lossReason:''});
const blankAccount=()=>({name:'',country:'',website:'',phone:'',description:'',ownerId:'',status:'active'});
const blankContact=()=>({name:'',email:'',phone:'',title:'',accountId:'',ownerId:'',status:'active'});
function historyDetail(x:Row){const d=x.details||{};if(x.event_type==='lead_note')return d.note||'';if(x.event_type==='stage_changed')return `${stageNames[d.from]||'初始'} → ${stageNames[d.to]||d.to}${d.lossReason?' · 原因：'+d.lossReason:''}`;if(x.event_type?.startsWith('activity_'))return d.detail||'';if(x.event_type?.startsWith('task_'))return d.title||'';return '';}

value={accountForm.description} onChange={e=>setAccountForm({...accountForm,description:e.target.value})}/></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||accountForm.name.trim().length<2} onClick={saveAccount}>保存公司</button><button onClick={()=>setNewCustomer(null)}>取消</button></>}{newCustomer==='contact'&&<><h3>新建联系人</h3><div className="v2-row"><label>姓名<input value={contactForm.name} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,name:e.target.value})}/></label><label>邮箱<input type="email" disabled={!!contactForm.id} value={contactForm.email} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,email:e.target.value})}/></label><label>电话<input value={contactForm.phone} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,phone:e.target.value})}/></label></div><label>关联公司<select value={contactForm.accountId} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,accountId:e.target.value})}><option value="">暂不关联</option>{accountOptions.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.name}</option>)}</select></label><div className="v2-row"><label>职位<input value={contactForm.title} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,title:e.target.value})}/></label><label>负责人<select value={contactForm.ownerId} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,ownerId:e.target.value})}><option value="">待分配</option>{overview.users?.map((x:Row)=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.display_name||x.email}</option>)}</select></label><label>状态<select value={contactForm.status} onChange={e=>setContactForm({...contactForm,status:e.target.value})}><option value="active">活跃</option><option value="archived">归档</option></select></label></div><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!contactForm.name.trim()||!contactForm.email} onClick={saveContact}>保存联系人</button><button onClick={()=>setNewCustomer(null)}>取消</button></>}{!newCustomer&&!customer&&<p className="v2-muted">选择客户查看询盘、商机和完整时间线。</p>}{!newCustomer&&customer&&<><h3>{customer.record.name}</h3>{canWrite&&<button onClick={()=>{if(customerKind==="accounts"){setAccountForm({id:customer.record.id,name:customer.record.name,country:customer.record.country||"",website:customer.record.website||"",phone:customer.record.phone||"",description:customer.record.description||"",ownerId:customer.record.owner_id||"",status:customer.record.status});setNewCustomer("account");}else{setContactForm({id:customer.record.id,name:customer.record.name,email:customer.record.email,phone:customer.record.phone||"",title:customer.record.title||"",ownerId:customer.record.owner_id||"",accountId:customer.contacts?.[0]?.id||"",status:customer.record.status});setNewCustomer("contact");}}}>编辑客户资料</button>}<p className="v2-muted">{customer.record.email||customer.record.country||''} · {customer.record.phone||'未记录电话'}</p><h4>{customerKind==='accounts'?'关联联系人':'关联公司'}</h4>{customer.contacts?.map((x:Row)=><p key={x.id}>{x.name} {x.email||x.country||''}</p>)}<h4>询盘来源</h4>{customer.inquiries?.length?customer.inquiries.map((x:Row)=><div className="crm-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.inquiry_number} · {x.name}</strong><small>{date(x.created_at)} · {x.source_url||'来源未记录'}</small></div>):<p className="v2-muted">暂无询盘</p>}<h4>销售机会</h4>{customer.deals?.map((x:Row)=><button className="crm-list-item" key={x.id} onClick={()=>{setTab('pipeline');openDeal(x.id);}}><strong>{x.title}</strong><small>{stageNames[x.stage]} · {amount(x.amount,x.currency)}</small></button>)}{canWrite&&<><h4>记录客户沟通</h4><div className="v2-row"><select value={activity.kind} onChange={e=>setActivity({...activity,kind:e.target.value})}><option value="note">备注</option><option value="call">电话</option><option value="email">邮件</option><option value="meeting">会议</option></select><input value={activity.summary} onChange={e=>setActivity({...activity,summary:e.target.value})} placeholder="沟通摘要"/></div><textarea rows={2} value={activity.detail} onChange={e=>setActivity({...activity,detail:e.target.value})} placeholder="具体内容"/><button disabled={busy||activity.summary.trim().length<2} onClick={addCustomerActivity}>保存沟通</button></>}<h4>客户历史</h4><Timeline rows={customer.events||[]}/><div className="crm-pages"><button disabled={customerEventPage<=1} onClick={()=>openCustomer(customerKind==='accounts'?'account':'contact',customer.record.id,customerEventPage-1)}>上一页</button><span>第 {customerEventPage} 页</span><button disabled={customerEventPage*50>=customer.total} onClick={()=>openCustomer(customerKind==='accounts'?'account':'contact',customer.record.id,customerEventPage+1)}>下一页</button></div></>}</section></div></>}
 {tab==='team'&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>待处理任务</h3><p className="v2-muted">逾期任务排在前面。打开对应商机可查看上下文和完整历史。</p>{overview.tasks?.length?overview.tasks.map((x:Row)=><div className="crm-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.title}</strong><small>{x.deal_title||x.contact_name} · {x.assignee} · 截止 {date(x.due_at)}</small><div className="v2-row">{x.opportunity_id&&<button onClick={()=>{setTab('pipeline');openDeal(x.opportunity_id);}}>打开商机</button>}{canWrite&&<button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>changeTask(x.id,'done')}>标记完成</button>}</div></div>):<p className="v2-muted">目前没有待办任务。</p>}</section>}
 {tab==='leads'&&<InquiryDesk/>}{tab==='sync'&&<CrmSyncDesk canAdmin={canAdmin}/>}</div>;
}

function Timeline({rows}:{rows:Row[]}){return rows.length?<div className="crm-timeline">{rows.map(x=><div key={x.id}><strong>{x.summary}</strong><small>{date(x.created_at)} · {x.actor||'系统 / 外部同步'}</small>{historyDetail(x)&&<p>{historyDetail(x)}</p>}</div>)}</div>:<p className="v2-muted">暂无历史事件。</p>;}

````

````ts
};

export const resourceGuides:Record<string,{intro:string;steps?:string[];media?:boolean}>={
 hero_slides:{
  intro:'首页顶部的大图轮播。这里只管「图片和展示方式」；每张图都必须在「轮播翻译」里至少填一种语言的文字，否则这张图不会出现在公开站上（这是「明明加了两张却只显示一张」最常见的原因）。',
  steps:['① 准备图片：新建时可直接点「上传新图片」，或到「图片与文件」上传','⚠ 每张图都要到「轮播翻译」填文字，否则公开站只显示填过文字的那些图','② 选好桌面端大图，按需要再选手机端图片','③ 填写展示时长、文案位置、图片压暗程度','④ 到「轮播翻译」填写每种语言的标题与副标题','⑤ 点工具栏「重新生成已发布页面」，公开站才会更新'],
  media:true,
 },
 hero_slide_translations:{
  intro:'轮播图上的文字，按语言分开填写：先选轮播，再选语言。',
  steps:['① 先在「首页轮播」里建好图片','② 每条记录填一种语言的标题与副标题','③ 保存后点「重新生成已发布页面」'],
 },
 media_assets:{intro:'所有图片和文件都在这里。上传后会被轮播、产品、站点 Logo 等引用；引用时也可以直接在这里找。',media:true},
 site_settings:{intro:'全站通用设置：站点名称、网址、Logo、联系方式、统计代码与是否允许搜索引擎收录。'},
 site_setting_translations:{
  intro:'站点名称、公司信息、页脚与客服欢迎语的多语言版本。',
  steps:['① 每种语言一条记录','② 中文版填中文，英文版填英文','③ 保存后点「重新生成已发布页面」'],
 },
 customer_service_channels:{
  intro:'网站上的客服入口。按渠道类型填邮箱、电话或网址即可。',
  steps:['① 渠道类型选「邮箱」/「电话」/「网页链接」','② 填写对应的邮箱、电话或网址','③ 保存后点「重新生成已发布页面」，入口才会显示','④ 欢迎语在「站点翻译」的「客服欢迎语」里按语言填写'],
 },
 customer_service_rules:{intro:'按语言或国家设置客服欢迎语与工作时间（高级功能，可留空）。'},
 menus:{intro:'网站导航菜单；菜单文字在「导航项」与「导航项翻译」里维护。'},
 menu_items:{intro:'导航菜单里的每一项：显示文字、链接地址、是否新窗口打开。'},
 faq_items:{intro:'常见问题；问题与答案在「常见问题翻译」里按语言填写。'},
 seo_metadata:{intro:'页面在搜索结果里的标题、摘要与分享图。留空时系统会用页面标题自动生成。'},
 geo_profiles:{intro:'品牌知识档案：品牌定位、核心事实与信息来源，供搜索引擎和 AI 引用。'},
 inquiries:{intro:'客户通过网站表单提交的询盘。可指派负责人、记录跟进状态。'},
 publish_jobs:{intro:'发布任务记录。每次发布都会产生一条；失败时看「失败原因」。'},
 translation_jobs:{intro:'自动翻译任务的进度与结果。'},
 locales:{intro:'网站支持的语言；默认语言决定访客首次打开看到的语言。'},
};

export function labelFor(name:string,table?:string,fallback?:string):string{
 return (table&&tableFieldLabels[table]?.[name])||fieldLabels[name]||fallback||name;
}
export function hintFor(name:string,table?:string):string{
 return (table&&tableHints[table]?.[name])||fieldHints[name]||'';
}
export function choicesFor(name:string,table?:string):{value:string;label:string}[]|undefined{
 return (table&&tableChoices[table]?.[name])||fieldChoices[name];
}

````

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/GeoMonitorDesk.tsx

````tsx
'use client';
import {useCallback,useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './v2-workspaces.css';
import './geo-monitor.css';
type Row=Record<string,any>;
type Locale={id:string;code:string;native_name:string};
const get=(path:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path);
const post=(path:string,data:Row)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path,data);
const date=(value:unknown)=>value?new Date(String(value)).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—';
const usd=(value:unknown)=>'$'+Number(value||0).toFixed(4);
const status:Row={pending:'排队中',processing:'运行中',completed:'已完成',failed:'失败',blocked_budget:'预算阻止'};
export function GeoMonitorDesk({locales,canAdmin,canWrite}:{locales:Locale[];canAdmin:boolean;canWrite:boolean}){
 const [data,setData]=useState<Row>({models:[],regions:[],targets:[],jobs:[],windows:[],workers:[]}),[prompts,setPrompts]=useState<Row[]>([]),[tab,setTab]=useState('overview'),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
 const [budget,setBudget]=useState<Row>({dailyLimitUsd:5,monthlyLimitUsd:50,maxQueuedJobs:500,enabled:false});
 const [model,setModel]=useState<Row>({code:'',displayName:'',provider:'DeepSeek',model:'',endpoint:'',credentialSource:'site_default',apiKey:'',inputRate:0,outputRate:0,maxOutputTokens:1200,enabled:false});
 const [region,setRegion]=useState<Row>({code:'',displayName:'',countryCode:'',description:'',enabled:true});
 const [target,setTarget]=useState<Row>({promptId:'',modelProfileId:'',regionId:'',intervalMinutes:1440,enabled:false});
 const [prompt,setPrompt]=useState<Row>({localeId:locales[0]?.id||'',market:'US',brandName:'SUNS',prompt:''});
 const [trendId,setTrendId]=useState(''),[trendDays,setTrendDays]=useState(30),[trend,setTrend]=useState<Row|null>(null);
 const [searchText,setSearchText]=useState(''),[filter,setFilter]=useState(''),[page,setPage]=useState(1);
 const reload=useCallback(async()=>{const monitor=await get('geo-monitor?q='+encodeURIComponent(filter)+'&page='+page);setData(monitor);setPrompts(monitor.prompts||[]);setBudget({dailyLimitUsd:Number(monitor.budget?.daily_limit_usd||0),monthlyLimitUsd:Number(monitor.budget?.monthly_limit_usd||0),maxQueuedJobs:monitor.budget?.max_queued_jobs||500,enabled:!!monitor.budget?.is_enabled});},[filter,page]);
 useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(e=>setError(e.message));if(canAdmin)apiRequest('llm-settings').then(x=>setModel(v=>({...v,endpoint:x.url||'',model:x.model||''}))).catch(()=>{});},[reload,canAdmin]);
 async function act(work:()=>Promise<void>,success:string){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{await work();await reload();setNotice(success);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 async function saveBudget(){await act(async()=>{await post('geo-monitor-budget',budget);},'预算已保存。启用后才会从队列调用模型。');}
 async function saveModel(){await act(async()=>{await post('geo-monitor-model',{...model,inputRate:Number(model.inputRate),outputRate:Number(model.outputRate),maxOutputTokens:Number(model.maxOutputTokens),apiKey:model.apiKey||undefined});setModel({...model,id:undefined,code:'',displayName:'',apiKey:'',enabled:false});},'模型已保存。请核对单价与实际供应商账单。');}
 async function saveRegion(){await act(async()=>{await post('geo-monitor-region',region);setRegion({code:'',displayName:'',countryCode:'',description:'',enabled:true});},'地区已保存。需要在该地区部署并启动专用 Worker 才会产生实际采样。');}
 async function savePrompt(){await act(async()=>{await post('geo',{...prompt,localeId:prompt.localeId});setPrompt({...prompt,prompt:''});},'固定问题已保存。现在可为它选择模型和地区。');}
 async function saveTarget(){await act(async()=>{await post('geo-monitor-target',{...target,intervalMinutes:Number(target.intervalMinutes)});setTarget({promptId:'',modelProfileId:'',regionId:'',intervalMinutes:1440,enabled:false});},'采样目标已保存。启用后按间隔进入队列。');}
 async function sample(id:string){await act(async()=>{await post('geo-monitor-sample',{targetId:id});},'已加入采样队列。请在下方查看完成或预算阻止状态。');}
 async function showTrend(id:string,days=trendDays){setBusy(true);setError('');try{setTrendId(id);setTrendDays(days);setTrend(await get('geo-monitor-trend?promptId='+encodeURIComponent(id)+'&days='+days));setTab('trends');}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'趋势加载失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 const day=data.windows?.find((x:Row)=>x.period==='day')||{},month=data.windows?.find((x:Row)=>x.period==='month')||{};
 const workerCount=(regionCode:string)=>data.workers?.filter((x:Row)=>x.region_code===regionCode).length||0;
 return <div className="v2 geo-monitor"><div className="v2-hero"><p>V3 · GEO OBSERVATORY</p><h2>按模型与地区观察答案</h2><span>固定问题、独立地区 Worker、预算预留和可比较的日趋势。地区表示请求从哪个 Worker 发出，不代表模型服务器或搜索引擎在当地定位。</span></div>{error&&<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="v2-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
 <nav className="v2-tabs" aria-label="GEO 监测功能">{[{id:'overview',name:'总览与成本'},{id:'targets',name:'采样目标'},{id:'models',name:'模型与地区'},{id:'trends',name:'趋势比较'}].map(x=><button key={x.id} className={tab===x.id?'active':''} onClick={()=>setTab(x.id)}>{x.name}</button>)}</nav>
 {(tab==='targets'||tab==='trends')&&<form className="geo-search" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();setPage(1);setFilter(searchText.trim());}}><input aria-label="搜索固定问题或模型" value={searchText} onChange={e=>setSearchText(e.target.value)} placeholder="搜索问题、品牌、模型或地区"/><button>搜索</button><span>问题 {data.promptTotal||0} 条 · 目标 {data.targetTotal||0} 条</span><button type="button" disabled={page<=1} onClick={()=>setPage(x=>x-1)}>上一页</button><span>第 {page} 页</span><button type="button" disabled={page*100>=Math.max(data.promptTotal||0,data.targetTotal||0)} onClick={()=>setPage(x=>x+1)}>下一页</button></form>}
 {tab==='overview'&&<><div className="geo-kpis"><div><small>今日已花费 / 预留</small><strong>{usd(day.spent_usd)} / {usd(day.reserved_usd)}</strong><span>上限 {usd(data.budget?.daily_limit_usd)}</span></div><div><small>本月已花费 / 预留</small><strong>{usd(month.spent_usd)} / {usd(month.reserved_usd)}</strong><span>上限 {usd(data.budget?.monthly_limit_usd)}</span></div><div><small>监测状态</small><strong>{data.budget?.is_enabled?'预算已启用':'预算未启用'}</strong><span>{data.workers?.length||0} 个在线地区 Worker</span></div></div>
 {canAdmin&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>设置成本上限</h3><p className="v2-muted">价格由管理员填写，系统根据 token 用量估算美元成本。调用前会预留保守额度；真实账单仍应与供应商核对。关闭预算将阻止新任务调用模型。</p><div className="v2-row"><label>每日上限 USD<input type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={budget.dailyLimitUsd} onChange={e=>setBudget({...budget,dailyLimitUsd:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label><label>每月上限 USD<input type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={budget.monthlyLimitUsd} onChange={e=>setBudget({...budget,monthlyLimitUsd:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label><label>最多排队任务<input type="number" min="1" value={budget.maxQueuedJobs} onChange={e=>setBudget({...budget,maxQueuedJobs:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label></div><label className="geo-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={budget.enabled} onChange={e=>setBudget({...budget,enabled:e.target.checked})}/>启用监测预算与模型调用</label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={saveBudget}>保存预算</button></section>}
 <section className="v2-card"><h3>地区 Worker</h3><div className="geo-grid">{data.regions?.map((x:Row)=><div className="geo-tile" key={x.id}><strong>{x.display_name}</strong><span>{x.code} · {workerCount(x.code)?`${workerCount(x.code)} 个在线`:'当前无 Worker 在线'}</span><small>{x.description||'请求由配置了此代码的 Worker 发出。'}</small></div>)}</div></section>
 <section className="v2-card"><h3>最近采样任务</h3>{data.jobs?.length?data.jobs.slice(0,30).map((x:Row)=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.prompt||'监测目标'}</strong><small>{date(x.scheduled_at)} · {x.region_name||'等待地区 Worker'} · {status[x.status]||x.status}{x.cost_usd!=null?' · '+usd(x.cost_usd):''}{x.error_message?' · '+x.error_message:''}</small></span></div>):<p className="v2-empty">尚无任务。先添加采样目标。</p>}</section></>}
 {tab==='models'&&<><div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>{model.id?'编辑模型':'添加模型'}</h3><p className="v2-muted">支持 OpenAI 兼容的 Chat Completions JSON 接口。复用站点密钥时须使用相同端点；专用密钥会在服务端加密保存。</p>{canAdmin&&<><div className="v2-row"><label>代码<input value={model.code} disabled={!!model.id} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,code:e.target.value})} placeholder="deepseek-chat"/></label><label>展示名称<input value={model.displayName} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,displayName:e.target.value})}/></label><label>供应商<input value={model.provider} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,provider:e.target.value})}/></label></div><div className="v2-row"><label>模型 ID<input value={model.model} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,model:e.target.value})}/></label><label>接口地址<input value={model.endpoint} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,endpoint:e.target.value})}/></label></div><div className="v2-row"><label>密钥来源<select value={model.credentialSource} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,credentialSource:e.target.value})}><option value="site_default">复用站点 AI 设置</option><option value="profile">此模型专用密钥</option></select></label>{model.credentialSource==='profile'&&<label>专用 API 密钥<input type="password" value={model.apiKey||''} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,apiKey:e.target.value})} placeholder={model.has_credential?'留空保留原密钥':'填写 API 密钥'}/></label>}</div><div className="v2-row"><label>输入 USD / 百万 tokens<input type="number" min="0" step="0.000001" value={model.inputRate} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,inputRate:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label><label>输出 USD / 百万 tokens<input type="number" min="0" step="0.000001" value={model.outputRate} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,outputRate:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label><label>最大输出 tokens<input type="number" min="300" max="3000" value={model.maxOutputTokens} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,maxOutputTokens:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label></div><label className="geo-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={!!model.enabled} onChange={e=>setModel({...model,enabled:e.target.checked})}/>启用模型</label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!model.code||!model.model||!model.endpoint} onClick={saveModel}>保存模型</button>{model.id&&<button onClick={()=>setModel({code:'',displayName:'',provider:'DeepSeek',model:'',endpoint:'',credentialSource:'site_default',apiKey:'',inputRate:0,outputRate:0,maxOutputTokens:1200,enabled:false})}>取消编辑</button>}</>}</section>
 <section className="v2-card"><h3>{region.id?'编辑地区':'添加地区'}</h3><p className="v2-muted">地区代码须与对应服务器的 GEO_WORKER_REGION_CODE 一致。填写国家代码仅为配置声明，界面会显示该地区是否有 Worker 心跳。</p>{canAdmin&&<><div className="v2-row"><label>地区代码<input value={region.code} disabled={!!region.id} onChange={e=>setRegion({...region,code:e.target.value})} placeholder="us-east"/></label><label>显示名称<input value={region.displayName} onChange={e=>setRegion({...region,displayName:e.target.value})} placeholder="美国东部"/></label><label>国家代码<input value={region.countryCode} maxLength={2} onChange={e=>setRegion({...region,countryCode:e.target.value.toUpperCase()})} placeholder="US"/></label></div><label>说明<input value={region.description} onChange={e=>setRegion({...region,description:e.target.value})}/></label><label className="geo-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={!!region.enabled} onChange={e=>setRegion({...region,enabled:e.target.checked})}/>启用地区</label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!region.code||!region.displayName} onClick={saveRegion}>保存地区</button>{region.id&&<button onClick={()=>setRegion({code:'',displayName:'',countryCode:'',description:'',enabled:true})}>取消编辑</button>}</>}</section></div>
 <section className="v2-card"><h3>已配置模型</h3>{data.models?.map((x:Row)=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.display_name}</strong><small>{x.provider} · {x.model} · 输入 {usd(x.input_usd_per_million)}/百万 · 输出 {usd(x.output_usd_per_million)}/百万 · {x.is_enabled?'已启用':'已停用'} · {x.credential_source==='site_default'?'复用站点密钥':x.has_credential?'专用密钥已保存':'缺少密钥'}</small></span>{canAdmin&&<button onClick={()=>setModel({id:x.id,code:x.code,displayName:x.display_name,provider:x.provider,model:x.model,endpoint:x.endpoint,credentialSource:x.credential_source,apiKey:'',has_credential:x.has_credential,inputRate:Number(x.input_usd_per_million),outputRate:Number(x.output_usd_per_million),maxOutputTokens:x.max_output_tokens,enabled:x.is_enabled})}>编辑</button>}</div>)}</section><section className="v2-card"><h3>已配置地区</h3>{data.regions?.map((x:Row)=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.display_name}</strong><small>{x.code} · {x.country_code||'未指定国家'} · {workerCount(x.code)?'Worker 在线':'无 Worker 在线'} · {x.is_enabled?'已启用':'已停用'}</small></span>{canAdmin&&<button onClick={()=>setRegion({id:x.id,code:x.code,displayName:x.display_name,countryCode:x.country_code||'',description:x.description||'',enabled:x.is_enabled})}>编辑</button>}</div>)}</section></>}
 {tab==='targets'&&<><div className="v2-two">{canWrite&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>添加固定问题</h3><div className="v2-row"><label>语言<select value={prompt.localeId} onChange={e=>setPrompt({...prompt,localeId:e.target.value})}>{locales.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.native_name}</option>)}</select></label><label>市场标签<input value={prompt.market} onChange={e=>setPrompt({...prompt,market:e.target.value})}/></label><label>品牌名<input value={prompt.brandName} onChange={e=>setPrompt({...prompt,brandName:e.target.value})}/></label></div><label>问题<textarea rows={3} value={prompt.prompt} onChange={e=>setPrompt({...prompt,prompt:e.target.value})}/></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||prompt.prompt.trim().length<10} onClick={savePrompt}>保存问题</button></section>}
 {canWrite&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>{target.id?'编辑采样目标':'创建采样目标'}</h3><p className="v2-muted">一个目标是一个固定问题、模型和地区的组合；重复采样会进入对应地区 Worker 的队列。</p><label>固定问题<select disabled={!!target.id} value={target.promptId} onChange={e=>setTarget({...target,promptId:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择问题</option>{target.id&&!prompts.some(x=>x.id===target.promptId)&&<option value={target.promptId}>{data.targets?.find((x:Row)=>x.id===target.id)?.prompt||"当前问题"}</option>}{prompts.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.prompt} · {x.market}</option>)}</select></label><div className="v2-row"><label>模型<select disabled={!!target.id} value={target.modelProfileId} onChange={e=>setTarget({...target,modelProfileId:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择模型</option>{data.models?.map((x:Row)=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.display_name}</option>)}</select></label><label>地区<select disabled={!!target.id} value={target.regionId} onChange={e=>setTarget({...target,regionId:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择地区</option>{data.regions?.map((x:Row)=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.display_name} · {workerCount(x.code)?'在线':'无 Worker'}</option>)}</select></label><label>间隔<select value={target.intervalMinutes} onChange={e=>setTarget({...target,intervalMinutes:Number(e.target.value)})}><option value={60}>每小时</option><option value={360}>每 6 小时</option><option value={1440}>每天</option><option value={10080}>每周</option></select></label></div><label className="geo-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={!!target.enabled} onChange={e=>setTarget({...target,enabled:e.target.checked})}/>启用定时采样</label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!target.promptId||!target.modelProfileId||!target.regionId} onClick={saveTarget}>保存目标</button>{target.id&&<button onClick={()=>setTarget({promptId:'',modelProfileId:'',regionId:'',intervalMinutes:1440,enabled:false})}>取消编辑</button>}</section>}</div>
 <section className="v2-card"><h3>采样目标</h3>{data.targets?.length?data.targets.map((x:Row)=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.prompt}</strong><small>{x.model_name} · {x.region_name} · {x.locale_code} · {x.is_enabled?`每 ${x.interval_minutes} 分钟；下次 ${date(x.next_run_at)}`:'已暂停'} · {workerCount(x.region_code)?'地区 Worker 在线':'地区 Worker 离线'}{x.last_error?' · '+x.last_error:''}</small></span><div className="geo-actions">{canWrite&&<><button disabled={busy||!x.is_enabled} onClick={()=>sample(x.id)}>采样一次</button><button onClick={()=>{setTarget({id:x.id,promptId:x.prompt_id,modelProfileId:x.model_profile_id,regionId:x.region_id,intervalMinutes:x.interval_minutes,enabled:x.is_enabled});window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});}}>编辑</button></>}<button onClick={()=>showTrend(x.prompt_id)}>趋势</button></div></div>):<p className="v2-empty">先配置模型和地区，再为固定问题建立采样目标。</p>}</section></>}
 {tab==='trends'&&<><section className="v2-card"><h3>同一问题的模型与地区比较</h3><p className="v2-muted">仅比较每个目标当前配置的样本；问题、品牌、模型、端点或地区变化会分开统计。品牌提及为字符串命中，引用为模型输出，均不是搜索排名。</p><div className="v2-row"><label>固定问题<select value={trendId} onChange={e=>{setTrendId(e.target.value);if(e.target.value)showTrend(e.target.value);}}><option value="">选择问题</option>{prompts.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.prompt}</option>)}</select></label><label>时间范围<select value={trendDays} onChange={e=>{const n=Number(e.target.value);setTrendDays(n);if(trendId)showTrend(trendId,n);}}><option value={7}>7 天</option><option value={30}>30 天</option><option value={90}>90 天</option></select></label></div></section>{trend&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>{trend.prompt.prompt}</h3><div className="geo-grid">{trend.series?.map((x:Row)=><div className="geo-tile" key={x.id}><strong>{x.model_name} · {x.region_name}</strong><span>{x.samples} 次 · 品牌提及 {x.mentionRate==null?'—':(x.mentionRate*100).toFixed(1)+'%'}</span><small>平均链接/次 {x.avgLinksPerSample==null?'—':x.avgLinksPerSample.toFixed(2)} · 成本 {usd(x.costUsd)}{x.configurationChanged?' · 旧配置样本已排除':''}</small><div className="geo-bars">{x.daily.map((d:Row)=><div key={String(d.day)} title={`${String(d.day).slice(0,10)}：${d.mentions}/${d.samples} 次品牌提及，${usd(d.costUsd)}`}><i style={{height:`${Math.max(3,d.samples?Math.round(d.mentions/d.samples*100):0)}%`}}/></div>)}</div></div>)}</div></section>}</>}
 </div>;
}
````

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/HomeDashboard.tsx

````tsx
'use client';

import {useState} from 'react';
import './home-dashboard.css';

export type HomeEntry={table:string;label:string;hint:string;icon:string};
export type PublishJob={id:string;job_type:string;status:string;created_at:string};
export type DashboardData={counts:Record<string,number>;jobs:PublishJob[]};
type Props={entries:HomeEntry[];dashboard:DashboardData;canPublish:boolean;onNavigate:(table:string)=>void;onRebuild:()=>void};

const areas=[
 {id:'content',number:'01',label:'内容与多语',title:'把好内容，变成每种语言的好体验。',description:'从页面、产品与图片出发，用 AI 辅助创作，再把翻译和内容检查接入同一条工作流。',tables:['content_item_translations','product_translations','media_assets','ai_writing','translation_jobs','review_workspace'],accent:'CONTENT · LOCALES'},
 {id:'search',number:'02',label:'搜索与 GEO',title:'让品牌在搜索与 AI 答案中被看见。',description:'研究关键词和竞品，持续观察 GEO 表现，再把证据转成可执行的内容建议。',tables:['growth_workspace','geo_monitor_desk','assistant_desk','agent_desk'],accent:'SEARCH · INTELLIGENCE'},
 {id:'customer',number:'03',label:'客户与经营',title:'从一次询盘，走向可持续的客户关系。',description:'记录客户历史和商机阶段，管理营销触达，并用可追溯报表查看经营结果。',tables:['inquiry_desk','marketing_desk','bi_desk'],accent:'CUSTOMER · GROWTH'},
 {id:'operations',number:'04',label:'协作与发布',title:'让每一次上线，都清楚可控。',description:'分配工作、配置站点、查看发布任务，让内容从草稿走向正式站点。',tables:['v21_desk','publish_jobs','site_settings'],accent:'OPERATIONS · DELIVERY'},
] as const;

const metrics=[
 {key:'content_items',label:'内容条目',resource:'content_item_translations',unit:'篇'},
 {key:'products',label:'产品资料',resource:'product_translations',unit:'项'},
 {key:'media_assets',label:'素材文件',resource:'media_assets',unit:'份'},
 {key:'inquiries',label:'客户询盘',resource:'inquiry_desk',unit:'条'},
];
const jobLabels:Record<string,string>={publish:'页面发布',unpublish:'内容下线',rebuild:'全站重建'};
const statusLabels:Record<string,string>={pending:'等待中',processing:'进行中',completed:'已完成',retrying:'重试中',failed:'失败',cancelled:'已取消'};

export function HomeDashboard({entries,dashboard,canPublish,onNavigate,onRebuild}:Props){
 const [selected,setSelected]=useState<string>('content');
 const availableAreas=areas.map(area=>({...area,items:area.tables.map(table=>entries.find(entry=>entry.table===table)).filter((entry):entry is HomeEntry=>Boolean(entry))})).filter(area=>area.items.length>0);
 const active=availableAreas.find(area=>area.id===selected)||availableAreas[0];
 const lead=entries.find(entry=>entry.table==='content_item_translations')||entries.find(entry=>entry.table==='inquiry_desk')||entries[0];
 const visibleMetrics=metrics.filter(metric=>entries.some(entry=>entry.table===metric.resource)&&typeof dashboard.counts?.[metric.key]==='number');
 const canSeeJobs=entries.some(entry=>entry.table==='publish_jobs');

 return <div className="xy-home">
  <section className="xy-home-hero" aria-labelledby="xy-home-title">
   <div className="xy-home-hero-content">
    <p className="xy-home-kicker"><span className="xy-home-kicker-mark"/>玄砚企业智慧营销 CMS <span className="xy-home-kicker-separator">/</span> YOUR GROWTH WORKSPACE</p>
    <h2 id="xy-home-title">让每一步增长，<br/><em>都有迹可循。</em></h2>
    <p className="xy-home-hero-copy">内容创作、多语展示、GEO / SEO、客户经营与发布协作，<br className="xy-home-desktop-break"/>从这里进入同一条清晰的工作流。</p>
    <div className="xy-home-hero-actions">
     {lead&&<button className="xy-home-cta" onClick={()=>onNavigate(lead.table)}>开始{lead.label}<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>}
     <a href="#xy-home-areas" className="xy-home-text-link">浏览功能区 <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></a>
    </div>
   </div>
   <div className="xy-home-orbit" aria-hidden="true"><span className="xy-home-orbit-label xy-home-orbit-label-one">CONTENT</span><span className="xy-home-orbit-label xy-home-orbit-label-two">GROWTH</span><span className="xy-home-orbit-label xy-home-orbit-label-three">CUSTOMER</span><span className="xy-home-orbit-core">XY</span></div>
   <div className="xy-home-hero-bottom"><span>一套系统 · 一条增长链路</span><span>SCROLL TO EXPLORE <b aria-hidden="true">↓</b></span></div>
  </section>

  {visibleMetrics.length>0&&<section className="xy-home-metrics" aria-label="站点概览">
   <div className="xy-home-metric-intro"><span>LIVE OVERVIEW</span><strong>此刻的站点</strong></div>
   {visibleMetrics.map(metric=><div className="xy-home-metric" key={metric.key}><span>{metric.label}</span><strong>{dashboard.counts[metric.key].toLocaleString('zh-CN')}<small>{metric.unit}</small></strong></div>)}
  </section>}

  {active&&<section id="xy-home-areas" className="xy-home-areas" aria-labelledby="xy-home-areas-title">
   <div className="xy-home-section-heading"><div><span className="xy-home-overline">EXPLORE YOUR WORKSPACE</span><h2 id="xy-home-areas-title">从工作场景出发。</h2></div><p>选择一个功能区，直接进入正在使用的业务工具。</p></div>
   <div className="xy-home-area-layout">
    <div className="xy-home-area-tabs" role="group" aria-label="功能区">
     {availableAreas.map(area=><button key={area.id} type="button" aria-pressed={active.id===area.id} aria-controls="xy-home-area-panel" className={active.id===area.id?'is-active':''} onClick={()=>setSelected(area.id)}><span className="xy-home-area-number">{area.number}</span><span>{area.label}</span><span aria-hidden="true" className="xy-home-area-arrow">↗</span></button>)}
    </div>
    <div id="xy-home-area-panel" className="xy-home-area-panel" role="region" aria-label={active.label+'功能'}>
     <div className="xy-home-area-intro"><span className="xy-home-overline">{active.accent}</span><h3>{active.title}</h3><p>{active.description}</p></div>
     <div className="xy-home-tools">{active.items.map((item,index)=><button type="button" className="xy-home-tool" key={item.table} onClick={()=>onNavigate(item.table)}><span className="xy-home-tool-top"><span className="xy-home-tool-icon" aria-hidden="true">{item.icon}</span><span className="xy-home-tool-index">{String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span></span><strong>{item.label}</strong><span className="xy-home-tool-copy">{item.hint}</span><span className="xy-home-tool-link">进入功能 <b aria-hidden="true">↗</b></span></button>)}</div>
    </div>
   </div>
  </section>}

  <section className="xy-home-bottom">
   <div className="xy-home-process"><span className="xy-home-overline">FROM IDEA TO LIVE</span><h2>从草稿，到正式发布。</h2><div className="xy-home-process-steps"><div><span>01</span><strong>创建内容</strong><small>页面、文章或产品</small></div><div><span>02</span><strong>检查与翻译</strong><small>多语、图片与 SEO</small></div><div><span>03</span><strong>提交发布</strong><small>进入生成任务</small></div><div><span>04</span><strong>持续观察</strong><small>搜索、客户与报表</small></div></div>{canPublish&&<button type="button" className="xy-home-rebuild" onClick={onRebuild}>重新生成已发布页面 <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>}</div>
   {canSeeJobs&&<div className="xy-home-recent"><div className="xy-home-recent-heading"><span className="xy-home-overline">RECENT ACTIVITY</span><h2>最近发布</h2></div><div className="xy-home-recent-list">{dashboard.jobs?.length?dashboard.jobs.slice(0,4).map(job=><div className="xy-home-job" key={job.id}><span className="xy-home-job-mark"/><div><strong>{jobLabels[job.job_type]||job.job_type}</strong><small>{new Date(job.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</small></div><span className={'xy-home-job-status status-'+job.status}>{statusLabels[job.status]||job.status}</span></div>):<p className="xy-home-no-jobs">尚无发布记录。创建并发布内容后，这里会显示任务进度。</p>}</div><button type="button" className="xy-home-all-jobs" onClick={()=>onNavigate('publish_jobs')}>查看全部发布记录 <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div>}
  </section>
 </div>;
}

````

````css
body{background:#f7f8f4;color:#1d382f}
````
