## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/MarketingDesk.tsx

````tsx
'use client';
import {useCallback,useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './v2-workspaces.css';
import './marketing-desk.css';

type Row=Record<string,any>;
const get=(path:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path);
const post=(path:string,data:Row)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path,data);
const date=(x:unknown)=>x?new Date(String(x)).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—';
const triggerNames:Row={manual:'手动一次发送',lead_received:'新询盘触发',stage_changed:'销售阶段变化触发'};
const stateNames:Row={draft:'草稿',active:'运行中',paused:'已暂停',completed:'已排队完成',pending:'排队中',sending:'发送中',sent:'已发送',failed:'失败',skipped:'已跳过',granted:'已同意',revoked:'已退订'};
const blankSegment=()=>({name:'',criteria:{country:'',inquiryStatus:'',stage:'',minInquiries:''},enabled:true});
const blankCampaign=()=>({code:'',name:'',segmentId:'',triggerType:'manual',subject:'',body:'',cooldownDays:7,dailyCap:50});
export function MarketingDesk({canWrite,canAdmin}:{canWrite:boolean;canAdmin:boolean}){
 const [tab,setTab]=useState('segments'),[data,setData]=useState<Row>({segments:[],campaigns:[],consents:[],deliveries:[],settings:{}}),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
 const [segment,setSegment]=useState<Row>(blankSegment()),[campaign,setCampaign]=useState<Row>(blankCampaign()),[audience,setAudience]=useState<Row|null>(null);
 const [contactSearch,setContactSearch]=useState(''),[contacts,setContacts]=useState<Row[]>([]),[contactId,setContactId]=useState(''),[consentState,setConsentState]=useState<'granted'|'revoked'>('granted'),[consentSource,setConsentSource]=useState(''),[consentEvidence,setConsentEvidence]=useState('');
 const [settings,setSettings]=useState<Row>({enabled:false,maxPer7Days:1,maxPer30Days:4,globalDailyCap:100});
 const reload=useCallback(async()=>{const x=await get('marketing-dashboard');setData(x);setSettings({enabled:!!x.settings?.is_enabled,maxPer7Days:x.settings?.max_per_7_days??1,maxPer30Days:x.settings?.max_per_30_days??4,globalDailyCap:x.settings?.global_daily_cap??100});},[]);
 useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(e=>setError(e.message));},[reload]);
 async function act(work:()=>Promise<void>,message:string){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{await work();await reload();setNotice(message);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 async function lookup(){await act(async()=>setContacts((await get('crm-options?kind=contacts&q='+encodeURIComponent(contactSearch))).rows||[]),'联系人列表已更新。');}
 async function saveConsent(){await act(async()=>{await post('marketing-consent',{contactId,state:consentState,source:consentSource,evidence:consentEvidence});setConsentEvidence('');},consentState==='granted'?'营销同意已记录，可核对来源与证明。':'退订已生效，待发送任务已取消。');}
 async function saveSegment(){await act(async()=>{const criteria=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(segment.criteria).filter(([,value])=>value!==''&&value!=null));if(criteria.minInquiries)criteria.minInquiries=Number(criteria.minInquiries);await post('marketing-segment',{...segment,criteria});setSegment(blankSegment());setAudience(null);},'分群已保存。名单只包含明确同意营销的联系人。');}
 async function preview(id:string){await act(async()=>setAudience({...await get('marketing-audience?segmentId='+id),id}),'受众数量已计算。');}
 async function saveCampaign(){await act(async()=>{await post('marketing-campaign',{...campaign,cooldownDays:Number(campaign.cooldownDays),dailyCap:Number(campaign.dailyCap)});setCampaign(blankCampaign());},'活动草稿已保存。管理员审核后再启用。');}
 async function changeCampaign(id:string,action:'activate'|'pause'|'resume'){if(action==='activate'&&!confirm('确认启用此活动？手动活动将对当前匹配且已同意的联系人排队；触发活动将处理之后产生的新事件。'))return;await act(async()=>{await post('marketing-campaign-action',{id,action});},action==='pause'?'活动已暂停。':'活动已启用；请留意发送记录。');}
 async function saveSettings(){await act(async()=>{await post('marketing-settings',{enabled:!!settings.enabled,maxPer7Days:Number(settings.maxPer7Days),maxPer30Days:Number(settings.maxPer30Days),globalDailyCap:Number(settings.globalDailyCap)});},'发送总开关与频率上限已保存。');}
 return <div className="v2 marketing-desk"><div className="v2-hero"><p>V3 · CONSENT FIRST</p><h2>只对明确同意的客户发送</h2><span>动态分群、事件触发、退订和全局频率控制。询盘隐私同意不会自动变成营销同意。</span></div>{error&&<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="v2-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
 <nav className="v2-tabs" aria-label="营销自动化">{[['segments','客户分群'],['campaigns','触发活动'],['consent','同意与退订'],['delivery','发送与设置']].map(([key,label])=><button key={key} className={tab===key?'active':''} onClick={()=>setTab(key)}>{label}</button>)}</nav>
 {tab==='segments'&&<div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>已保存分群</h3>{data.segments?.length?data.segments.map((x:Row)=><div className="marketing-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.name}</strong><small>{x.is_enabled?'启用':'停用'} · 条件 {Object.entries(x.criteria||{}).map(([k,v])=>`${k}: ${v}`).join('、')||'全部明确同意者'}</small><button onClick={()=>preview(x.id)}>计算可发送人数</button>{audience&&audience.id===x.id&&<span className="marketing-count">{audience.count} 位</span>}{canWrite&&<button onClick={()=>setSegment({id:x.id,name:x.name,criteria:{country:'',inquiryStatus:'',stage:'',minInquiries:'',...x.criteria},enabled:x.is_enabled})}>编辑</button>}</div>):<p className="v2-muted">尚无分群。先定义筛选条件。</p>}</section>{canWrite&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>{segment.id?'编辑分群':'建立分群'}</h3><p className="v2-muted">所有分群都会自动排除未明确同意或已退订的联系人。</p><label>分群名称<input value={segment.name} onChange={e=>setSegment({...segment,name:e.target.value})} placeholder="例如：已成交的美国客户"/></label><div className="v2-row"><label>国家 / 地区<input value={segment.criteria.country||''} onChange={e=>setSegment({...segment,criteria:{...segment.criteria,country:e.target.value}})} placeholder="例如：US"/></label><label>询盘状态<select value={segment.criteria.inquiryStatus||''} onChange={e=>setSegment({...segment,criteria:{...segment.criteria,inquiryStatus:e.target.value}})}><option value="">不限</option>{['new','processing','qualified','replied','closed'].map(x=><option key={x} value={x}>{x}</option>)}</select></label><label>商机阶段<select value={segment.criteria.stage||''} onChange={e=>setSegment({...segment,criteria:{...segment.criteria,stage:e.target.value}})}><option value="">不限</option>{['new','qualified','proposal','negotiation','won','lost'].map(x=><option key={x} value={x}>{x}</option>)}</select></label><label>至少询盘数<input type="number" min="1" value={segment.criteria.minInquiries||''} onChange={e=>setSegment({...segment,criteria:{...segment.criteria,minInquiries:e.target.value}})}/></label></div><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||segment.name.trim().length<2} onClick={saveSegment}>保存分群</button>{segment.id&&<button onClick={()=>setSegment(blankSegment())}>取消编辑</button>}</section>}</div>}
 {tab==='campaigns'&&<div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>活动列表</h3>{data.campaigns?.length?data.campaigns.map((x:Row)=><div className="marketing-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.name}</strong><small>{triggerNames[x.trigger_type]} · {x.segment_name} · {stateNames[x.status]} · 已排队 {x.queued_count} · 已发送 {x.sent_count} · 失败 {x.failed_count}</small><p>{x.subject}</p>{canAdmin&&<div className="v2-row">{x.status==='draft'&&<button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>changeCampaign(x.id,'activate')}>审核并启用</button>}{['active','completed'].includes(x.status)&&<button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>changeCampaign(x.id,'pause')}>暂停发送</button>}{x.status==='paused'&&<button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>changeCampaign(x.id,'resume')}>继续</button>}</div>}{canWrite&&x.status==='draft'&&<button onClick={()=>setCampaign({id:x.id,code:x.code,name:x.name,segmentId:x.segment_id,triggerType:x.trigger_type,subject:x.subject,body:x.body,cooldownDays:x.cooldown_days,dailyCap:x.daily_cap})}>编辑草稿</button>}</div>):<p className="v2-muted">尚无营销活动。</p>}</section>{canWrite&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>{campaign.id?'编辑活动草稿':'创建活动草稿'}</h3><p className="v2-muted">纯文本邮件支持 {'{{name}}'} 和 {'{{unsubscribe_url}}'}。系统会自动在末尾添加退订链接。触发活动只处理启用之后的新事件。</p><div className="v2-row"><label>活动代码<input value={campaign.code} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,code:e.target.value.toLowerCase()})} placeholder="autumn-followup"/></label><label>活动名称<input value={campaign.name} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,name:e.target.value})}/></label></div><div className="v2-row"><label>目标分群<select value={campaign.segmentId} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,segmentId:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择</option>{data.segments?.filter((x:Row)=>x.is_enabled).map((x:Row)=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.name}</option>)}</select></label><label>触发方式<select value={campaign.triggerType} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,triggerType:e.target.value})}>{Object.entries(triggerNames).map(([key,label])=><option key={key} value={key}>{String(label)}</option>)}</select></label><label>同活动冷却天数<input type="number" min="0" value={campaign.cooldownDays} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,cooldownDays:e.target.value})}/></label><label>每日活动上限<input type="number" min="0" value={campaign.dailyCap} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,dailyCap:e.target.value})}/></label></div><label>邮件主题<input value={campaign.subject} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,subject:e.target.value})}/></label><label>邮件正文<textarea rows={9} value={campaign.body} maxLength={10000} onChange={e=>setCampaign({...campaign,body:e.target.value})}/></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!campaign.code||!campaign.name||!campaign.segmentId||campaign.body.trim().length<10} onClick={saveCampaign}>保存草稿</button>{campaign.id&&<button onClick={()=>setCampaign(blankCampaign())}>取消编辑</button>}</section>}</div>}
 {tab==='consent'&&<div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>最近同意记录</h3>{data.consents?.length?data.consents.map((x:Row)=><div className="marketing-record" key={x.contact_id}><strong>{x.name} · {x.email}</strong><small>{stateNames[x.state]||x.state} · 来源 {x.source||'未记录'} · 同意 {date(x.granted_at)} · 退订 {date(x.revoked_at)}</small></div>):<p className="v2-muted">没有营销同意记录。现有询盘不会被自动加入。</p>}</section>{canAdmin&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>登记或撤销营销同意</h3><p className="v2-muted">只在有可核对的授权证明时选择“已同意”；客户要求停止发送时选择“退订”。</p><div className="v2-row"><input value={contactSearch} onChange={e=>setContactSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="搜索姓名或邮箱"/><button onClick={lookup}>查找联系人</button></div><label>联系人<select value={contactId} onChange={e=>setContactId(e.target.value)}><option value="">请选择</option>{contacts.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.name} · {x.email}</option>)}</select></label><label>操作<select value={consentState} onChange={e=>setConsentState(e.target.value as 'granted'|'revoked')}><option value="granted">记录明确同意</option><option value="revoked">立即退订</option></select></label>{consentState==='granted'&&<><label>同意来源<input value={consentSource} onChange={e=>setConsentSource(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：线下签署同意书"/></label><label>证明说明<textarea rows={3} value={consentEvidence} onChange={e=>setConsentEvidence(e.target.value)} placeholder="记录日期、表单或文件所在位置，便于事后核对"/></label></>}<button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy||!contactId||consentState==='granted'&&(consentSource.trim().length<2||consentEvidence.trim().length<5)} onClick={saveConsent}>保存同意状态</button></section>}</div>}
 {tab==='delivery'&&<><div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>发送状态</h3><p className="v2-muted">HTTPS 服务接口：{data.deliveryConfigured?'已配置':'未配置'}。未配置时发送总开关不能启用。真实投递、退信和收件箱到达率需由服务商确认。</p><p>总开关：{data.settings?.is_enabled?'运行中':'关闭'} · 最近发送记录 {data.deliveries?.length||0} 条</p></section>{canAdmin&&<section className="v2-card"><h3>全局频率控制</h3><div className="v2-row"><label>每人 7 天最多<input type="number" min="0" value={settings.maxPer7Days} onChange={e=>setSettings({...settings,maxPer7Days:e.target.value})}/></label><label>每人 30 天最多<input type="number" min="0" value={settings.maxPer30Days} onChange={e=>setSettings({...settings,maxPer30Days:e.target.value})}/></label><label>每天总发送上限<input type="number" min="0" value={settings.globalDailyCap} onChange={e=>setSettings({...settings,globalDailyCap:e.target.value})}/></label></div><label className="marketing-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={!!settings.enabled} onChange={e=>setSettings({...settings,enabled:e.target.checked})}/>启用营销发送总开关</label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={saveSettings}>保存设置</button></section>}</div><section className="v2-card"><h3>最近投递</h3>{data.deliveries?.length?data.deliveries.map((x:Row)=><div className="marketing-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.campaign_name} · {x.contact_name}</strong><small>{x.email} · {stateNames[x.status]||x.status} · 创建 {date(x.created_at)} · 发送 {date(x.sent_at)}{x.skip_reason?' · '+x.skip_reason:''}{x.error_message?' · '+x.error_message:''}</small></div>):<p className="v2-muted">尚无发送记录。</p>}</section></>}

 const visibleColumns=views[resource]?views[resource].map((name:string)=>columns.find((c:Row)=>c.name===name)).filter(Boolean):columns.slice(0,7);
 const cell=(c:Row,row:Row)=>{const value=row[c.name];if(resource==='hero_slides'&&c.name==='desktop_media_id'){const codes=slideLangCodes(row);return nameOf(c.reference,value)+(codes.length?'（文字：'+codes.join('/')+'）':'（未填文字：公开站不会显示）');}if(value==null||value==='')return '—';if(typeof value==='boolean')return value?'是':'否';if(c.reference)return nameOf(c.reference,value);if(c.name.endsWith('_at'))return new Date(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN');if(['status','publish_status','job_type'].includes(c.name))return states[value]||String(value);const choice=choicesFor(c.name,resource)?.find(o=>o.value===value);if(choice)return choice.label;if(c.name.endsWith('_id')||c.name==='entity_id')return '记录 #'+String(value).slice(0,8);return String(value);};

 async function open(row:Row|null){if(!listing)return;setEditing(row);const data:Row={};for(const col of listing.columns){if(col.readonly)continue;const value=row?.[col.name];data[col.name]=col.type==='jsonb'?JSON.stringify(value??(col.name==='body'||col.name==='features'||col.name==='applications'?[]:{}),null,2):(value??(col.type==='boolean'?col.default==='true':''));}setDraft(data);const refs=[...new Set<string>(listing.columns.map((c:Row)=>c.reference).filter(Boolean))];for(const ref of refs){if(!lookups[ref])api('reference-options?resource='+ref).then(x=>setLookups(prev=>({...prev,[ref]:x.rows}))).catch(()=>{});}}
 function recordKey(row:Row){return Object.fromEntries(listing!.resource.key.map((k:string)=>[k,row[k]]));}
 async function submit(){if(!draft||!listing)return;await act(async()=>{const data:Row={};for(const c of listing.columns){if(c.readonly)continue;const value=draft[c.name];if(!editing&&value===''&&c.default)continue;if(value===''&&c.nullable){data[c.name]=null;continue;}data[c.name]=c.type==='jsonb'?parseJsonField(value,c.name):['integer','bigint','numeric','smallint','double precision'].includes(c.type)&&value!==''?Number(value):value;}if(resource==='media_assets'){for(const name of Object.keys(data))if(name!=='original_filename')delete data[name];}if(editing&&['content_item_translations','product_translations'].includes(resource)){const k=resource==='product_translations'?'publish_status':'status';if(['published','scheduled'].includes(data[k]))data[k]='draft';}if(editing?.updated_at)data._expectedUpdatedAt=editing.updated_at;await api('records?resource='+resource,{data,key:editing?recordKey(editing):undefined},editing?'PATCH':'POST');setDraft(null);setNotice(resource==='hero_slides'?'已保存。提醒：每张轮播都要在「轮播翻译」里至少填一种语言，否则公开站不会显示这张图。':active?.publishMode==='rebuild'?'已保存。站点级配置不会随单条内容发布，请点工具栏的“重新生成已发布页面”。':active?.publishMode==='record'?'已保存草稿。点击列表中的“发布”后，公开页面才会更新。':'已保存。');});}
 const editable=listing?.columns.filter((c:Row)=>!c.readonly)||[];
 const simple=guided&&simpleFields[resource]?editable.filter((c:Row)=>simpleFields[resource].includes(c.name)&&(!['features','applications'].includes(c.name)||plainList(draft?.[c.name])!==null)):editable;
 const extra=guided?editable.filter((c:Row)=>!simple.some((x:Row)=>x.name===c.name)):[];
 // 在字段里直接上传图片：上传成功后自动选中，并保存预览地址
 async function uploadAndSelect(column:string,file:File){
  const form=new FormData();form.set('file',file);
  const res=await fetch('/api/v1/upload',{method:'POST',body:form});
  const created=await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
  if(!res.ok)throw new Error(created.error||'上传失败，请重试');
  if(!created.id)throw new Error('上传失败：服务器未返回图片编号');
  setDraft(prev=>(prev?{...prev,[column]:created.id}:prev));
  if(created.object_key)setMediaPreview(prev=>({...prev,[created.id]:created.object_key}));
  setLookups(prev=>{const list=prev.media_assets||[];return list.some((r:Row)=>r.id===created.id)?prev:{...prev,media_assets:[{id:created.id,name:created.original_filename||'新图片'},...list]};});
  return created as Row;
 }
 function channelConfigField(){
  const raw=String(draft?.config??'{}');
  const current=objectValue(raw);
  const spec=channelConfig[draft?.channel_type]||{key:'url',label:'链接地址',placeholder:'https://example.com/chat',type:'url'};
  if(!current)return <><textarea rows={4} spellCheck={false} value={raw} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,config:e.target.value})}/><small>当前内容不是合法 JSON，请修正后再保存（字段名和文本都用英文双引号）。</small></>;
  return <><input type={spec.type} value={String(current[spec.key]??'')} placeholder={spec.placeholder} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,config:JSON.stringify({...current,[spec.key]:e.target.value})})}/><small>按渠道类型填写{spec.label}；保存后点工具栏「重新生成已发布页面」，公开站的客服入口才会更新。</small><details className="raw-id"><summary>高级：直接编辑 JSON</summary><textarea rows={3} spellCheck={false} value={raw} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,config:e.target.value})}/></details></>;
 }
 function field(c:Row){
  const name=c.name,value=draft?.[name],hint=hintFor(name,resource);
  const choices=choicesFor(name,resource);
  const optionText=(v:string)=>states[v]||choices?.find(o=>o.value===v)?.label||v;
  const isMedia=c.reference==='media_assets',isTime=/^timestamp/.test(String(c.type));
  let control:any;
  if(c.type==='jsonb'&&resource==='product_translations'&&['features','applications'].includes(name)&&plainList(value)!==null){
   control=<><textarea rows={4} value={plainList(value)!.join('\n')} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:JSON.stringify(e.target.value.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean))})}/><small>每行填写一条。已有复杂格式请在“更多设置”中维护。</small></>;
  }else if(c.type==='jsonb'&&(name==='body'||(resource==='content_blocks'&&name==='data'))){
   control=<BlockEditor value={value} singleType={resource==='content_blocks'?draft!.block_type||'rich_text':undefined} onChange={v=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:v})}/>;
  }else if(resource==='customer_service_channels'&&name==='config'){
   control=channelConfigField();
  }else if(c.type==='boolean'){
   control=<input type="checkbox" checked={!!value} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.checked})}/>;
  }else if(c.options){
   control=<select value={value??''} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择</option>{c.options.filter((x:string)=>!['content_item_translations','product_translations','content_items'].includes(resource)||!['published','scheduled'].includes(x)||!['status','publish_status'].includes(name)).map((x:string)=><option key={x} value={x}>{optionText(x)}</option>)}</select>;
  }else if(choices){
   control=<select value={value??''} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择</option>{choices.map(o=><option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>)}</select>;
  }else if(c.reference&&lookups[c.reference]){
   control=<><select value={value??''} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value})}><option value="">请选择</option>{value&&!lookups[c.reference].some((r:Row)=>r.id===value)&&<option value={value}>{nameOf(c.reference,value)}</option>}{lookups[c.reference].map((r:Row)=><option key={r.id} value={r.id}>{referenceNames[c.reference]?.[r.id]||recordName(r)}</option>)}</select>
    {isMedia&&<label className="inline-upload">＋ 直接上传新图片<input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/avif" onChange={e=>{const picked=e.target.files?.[0];if(picked)act(async()=>{const created=await uploadAndSelect(name,picked);setNotice('已上传并选中：'+(created.original_filename||'新图片')+'，保存后生效。');});}}/></label>}
    {isMedia&&mediaPreview[String(value)]&&<img className="field-preview" src={'/media/'+encodeURIComponent(mediaPreview[String(value)])} alt=""/>}
    {!isMedia&&<details className="raw-id"><summary>找不到关联记录？</summary><input aria-label="手动填写关联编号" value={value??''} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value})}/></details>}</>;
  }else if(isTime){
   control=<input type="datetime-local" value={toLocalInput(value)} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value?new Date(e.target.value).toISOString():''})}/>;
  }else if(c.type==='jsonb'||['description','answer','message','excerpt','short_answer','definition','company_description'].includes(name)){
   control=<textarea rows={c.type==='jsonb'?7:4} spellCheck={c.type!=='jsonb'} value={value??''} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value})}/>;
  }else{
   control=<input type={c.type==='integer'||c.type==='numeric'?'number':'text'} step="any" value={value??''} onChange={e=>setDraft({...draft!,[name]:e.target.value})}/>;
  }
  const fallbackHint=c.type==='jsonb'&&name!=='body'?'高级数据，请填合法 JSON。':name==='path'?'完整路径示例：/en/products/beaker':'';
  const help=hint||fallbackHint;
  return <label key={name}><span>{labelFor(name,resource,labels[name])}{!c.nullable&&!c.default?' *':''}</span>{control}{help&&<small>{help}</small>}</label>;
 }

````tsx
'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';

type Row=Record<string,any>;
type Props={translation:Row;onClose:()=>void;onDone:()=>void};
async function request(path:string){const response=await fetch('/api/v1/'+path,{credentials:'include'});const value=await response.json();if(!response.ok)throw new Error(value.error||'操作失败');return value;}
export function ProductTradeEditor({translation,onClose,onDone}:Props){
 const [product,setProduct]=useState<Row|null>(null),[form,setForm]=useState<Row>({}),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState('');
 useEffect(()=>{let active=true;request('records?resource=products&filter='+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({id:translation.product_id}))).then(result=>{if(!active)return;const row=result.rows?.[0];if(!row)throw new Error('未找到产品主体');setProduct(row);setForm({min_order_quantity:row.min_order_quantity??'',order_unit:translation.order_unit??'',lead_time_days:row.lead_time_days??'',packaging_details:translation.packaging_details??'',customization_details:translation.customization_details??'',sample_policy:translation.sample_policy??''});}).catch(e=>{if(active)setError(e.message);});return()=>{active=false;};},[translation]);
 const field=(name:string,label:string,help:string,kind:'text'|'number'|'textarea'='text')=><label key={name}>{label}{kind==='textarea'?<textarea rows={3} value={form[name]??''} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,[name]:e.target.value})}/>:<input type={kind} min={kind==='number'?1:undefined} step={name==='min_order_quantity'?'0.001':'1'} value={form[name]??''} onChange={e=>setForm({...form,[name]:e.target.value})}/>}<small>{help}</small></label>;
 async function save(){
  if(!product)return;setBusy(true);setError('');
  try{
   const payload={translationId:translation.id,expectedProductUpdatedAt:product.updated_at,expectedTranslationUpdatedAt:translation.updated_at,minOrderQuantity:form.min_order_quantity===''?null:Number(form.min_order_quantity),leadTimeDays:form.lead_time_days===''?null:Number(form.lead_time_days),orderUnit:String(form.order_unit||'').trim()||null,packagingDetails:String(form.packaging_details||'').trim()||null,customizationDetails:String(form.customization_details||'').trim()||null,samplePolicy:String(form.sample_policy||'').trim()||null};
   const response=await fetch('/api/v1/trade-product',{method:'POST',credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
   const result=await response.json();if(!response.ok)throw new Error(result.error||'保存失败');onDone();
  }catch(e:any){setError(e.message||'保存失败，请重试');}finally{setBusy(false);}
 }
 return <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose}><section className="editor trade-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="产品外贸采购资料" onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}><header><div><p className="eyebrow">外贸采购资料</p><h2>{translation.name}</h2></div><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="关闭">×</button></header><div className="trade-editor-body"><p className="editor-help">起订量与交期在所有语言共用；订购单位、包装、定制与样品政策按当前语言单独填写。仅填写已核实的信息。</p>{error&&<p className="form-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{!product&&!error?<p>正在读取产品资料…</p>:product&&<div className="fields">{field('min_order_quantity','起订量（MOQ）','留空表示未公布；不自动生成价格。','number')}{field('order_unit','订购单位','例如 件、套、箱。')}{field('lead_time_days','参考交期（天）','仅填写经销售确认的典型交期。','number')}{field('packaging_details','包装方式','按当前语言描述包装材料、装箱方式等。','textarea')}{field('customization_details','可定制内容','例如尺寸、颜色、印刷或工艺，不能承诺尚不支持的项目。','textarea')}{field('sample_policy','样品政策','说明是否可申请样品及适用条件。','textarea')}</div>}<footer><button type="button" onClick={onClose}>取消</button><button type="button" className="primary" disabled={!product||busy} onClick={save}>{busy?'保存中…':'保存采购资料'}</button></footer><small>保存后重新发布产品；共用字段变化时，请把该产品的各语言版本逐一重新发布。</small></div></section></div>;
}

'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './ai-writing.css';

type Draft={name:string;slug:string;short_description:string;description:string;features:string[];applications:string[];metaTitle:string;metaDescription:string};
function randomSku(){return 'P-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8).toUpperCase();}
export function ProductWizard({locales,onSaved,canPublish}:{locales:{id:string;code:string;native_name:string}[];onSaved:(name:string,published:boolean)=>void;canPublish:boolean}){
 const [localeId,setLocaleId]=useState(locales[0]?.id||'');
 const [name,setName]=useState(''),[notes,setNotes]=useState(''),[keywords,setKeywords]=useState('');
 const [draft,setDraft]=useState<Draft|null>(null),[busy,setBusy]=useState<'generate'|'save'|'publish'|null>(null),[error,setError]=useState('');
 const [runId,setRunId]=useState(''),[sku,setSku]=useState(''),[configured,setConfigured]=useState(true);
 useEffect(()=>{apiRequest('ai-writing/context').then(x=>setConfigured(Boolean((x as any).configured))).catch(()=>setConfigured(false));},[]);
 async function generate(){setBusy('generate');setError('');try{const result=await apiRequest('ai-product/generate',{localeId,name,notes,keywords});setDraft(result.draft as Draft);setRunId(result.runId);setSku(randomSku());}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'生成失败');}finally{setBusy(null);}}
 async function save(publish:boolean){if(!draft)return;setBusy(publish?'publish':'save');setError('');try{const saved=await apiRequest('ai-product/save',{localeId,sku,draft,runId:runId||undefined});if(publish){try{await apiRequest('publish',{resource:'product_translations',id:saved.id,action:'publish'});}catch(e){onSaved(draft.name,false);setError('草稿已保存，但发布失败：'+(e instanceof Error?e.message:'请稍后重试'));return;}}onSaved(draft.name,publish);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'保存失败');}finally{setBusy(null);}}
 function setField<K extends keyof Draft>(key:K,value:Draft[K]){setDraft(prev=>prev?{...prev,[key]:value}:prev);}
 function setList(key:'features'|'applications',text:string){setDraft(prev=>prev?{...prev,[key]:text.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean)}:prev);}
 return <div className="aiw"><div className="aiw-head"><div><p className="aiw-kicker">PRODUCT LAB / 02</p><h2>从一句产品说明到完整介绍</h2><p>写下产品名和基本参数。AI 生成多语言介绍、特点和用途，你检查后发布。</p></div><div className="aiw-mark" aria-hidden="true">◈</div></div>
 <div className="aiw-steps"><span className="current">01 提供资料</span><span className={draft?'current':''}>02 校对介绍</span><span className={draft?'current':''}>03 发布上线</span></div>
 {error&&<div className="aiw-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
 {!configured&&<div className="aiw-error">AI 服务不可用。请先由管理员在“自动翻译”中配置 AI 密钥。</div>}
 <div className="aiw-grid"><section className="aiw-panel"><p className="aiw-label">产品简报</p><label>产品语言<select value={localeId} onChange={e=>{setLocaleId(e.target.value);setDraft(null);setRunId('');}}>{locales.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.native_name} · {x.code}</option>)}</select></label><label>产品名称 <em>必填</em><input value={name} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：高硼硅玻璃量筒"/></label><label>基本参数与说明 <small>帮助 AI 写得更准</small><textarea rows={6} value={notes} maxLength={5000} onChange={e=>setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="写下材质、容量、用途、需避免的说法…"/></label><label>重点词语 <small>可选</small><input value={keywords} maxLength={300} onChange={e=>setKeywords(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：硼硅玻璃、实验室"/></label><button className="aiw-primary" disabled={!!busy||!configured||name.trim().length<2} onClick={generate}>{busy==='generate'?'正在生成…':draft?'重新生成介绍':'生成产品介绍'} <span>↗</span></button><p className="aiw-footnote">资料会发送给所配置的 AI 服务。AI 结果需要人工核实。</p></section>
 <section className="aiw-panel aiw-preview"><div className="aiw-preview-head"><p className="aiw-label">产品介绍草稿</p>{draft&&<span className="aiw-pill">未发布 · 可编辑</span>}</div>{!draft?<div className="aiw-empty"><span>◈</span><h3>产品介绍将在这里生成</h3><p>生成后可修改名称、介绍、特点和用途。</p></div>:<div className="aiw-fields"><label>产品名称<input value={draft.name} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setField('name',e.target.value)}/></label><label>网址标识 <small>仅小写字母、数字和连字符</small><div className="aiw-slug"><span>/{locales.find(x=>x.id===localeId)?.code||'en'}/products/</span><input value={draft.slug} maxLength={160} onChange={e=>setField('slug',e.target.value)}/></div></label><label>一句话简介<textarea rows={2} value={draft.short_description} maxLength={500} onChange={e=>setField('short_description',e.target.value)}/></label><label>详细介绍<textarea rows={6} value={draft.description} maxLength={5000} onChange={e=>setField('description',e.target.value)}/></label><label>产品特点 <small>每行一条</small><textarea rows={4} value={draft.features.join('\n')} onChange={e=>setList('features',e.target.value)}/></label><label>应用领域 <small>每行一条</small><textarea rows={4} value={draft.applications.join('\n')} onChange={e=>setList('applications',e.target.value)}/></label><details className="aiw-seo"><summary>搜索展示信息</summary><label>搜索标题<input value={draft.metaTitle} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setField('metaTitle',e.target.value)}/></label><label>搜索摘要<textarea rows={3} value={draft.metaDescription} maxLength={500} onChange={e=>setField('metaDescription',e.target.value)}/></label></details><div className="aiw-save"><label>产品编号（SKU）<input value={sku} maxLength={100} onChange={e=>setSku(e.target.value)} placeholder="留空会自动生成"/></label><p>{canPublish?'发布后公开站会立即更新；也可以先存草稿。':'保存后进入待审核，由审核员发布。'}</p><div className="aiw-save-actions">{canPublish&&<button className="aiw-primary" disabled={!!busy} onClick={()=>save(false)}>{busy==='save'?'正在保存…':'保存草稿'}</button></div></div></div>}</section></div></div>;
}

'use client';

import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './trade-desk.css';
type Row=Record<string,any>;
const get=(s:string)=>apiRequest('trade/'+s),post=(s:string,v:Row)=>apiRequest('trade/'+s,v);
const dt=(v:any)=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—';
const names:Row={draft:'草稿',review:'待审核',approved:'已审核',sent:'已发出',accepted:'客户已确认',rejected:'客户已拒绝',void:'已作废',published:'展示中',withdrawn:'已撤下',market:'市场推荐',certificate:'资质证书',case:'客户案例',service:'服务承诺',new:'新询盘',processing:'跟进中',qualified:'有效询盘',replied:'已回复',closed:'已结束',spam:'垃圾询盘',customer:'客户确认权限',partner:'渠道只读权限'};
const tabs=[['funnel','01','获客漏斗'],['quotes','02','报价协作'],['market','03','市场化内容'],['trust','04','采购信任与服务'],['portal','05','客户与渠道入口']];
const blankQuote=()=>({currency:'USD',incoterm:'FOB',validUntil:new Date(Date.now()+30*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),terms:'',opportunityId:'',lines:[] as Row[]});
const blankCard=()=>({localeId:'',country:'',kind:'market',title:'',summary:'',sourceUrl:'',validUntil:''});
export function TradeDesk({canLeads,canWriteLeads,canContent,canWriteContent,canReview,actorId}:{canLeads:boolean;canWriteLeads:boolean;canContent:boolean;canWriteContent:boolean;canReview:boolean;actorId:string}){
 const [tab,setTab]=useState(canLeads?'funnel':'market'),[data,setData]=useState<Row>({inquiries:[],locales:[],rules:[]}),[market,setMarket]=useState<Row>({cards:[],locales:[],rules:[],pages:[]}),[detail,setDetail]=useState<Row|null>(null),[selected,setSelected]=useState(''),[q,setQ]=useState(''),[search,setSearch]=useState(''),[page,setPage]=useState(1),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
 const [quote,setQuote]=useState(blankQuote),[card,setCard]=useState(blankCard),[role,setRole]=useState('customer'),[recipient,setRecipient]=useState(''),[days,setDays]=useState(7),[invite,setInvite]=useState(''),[note,setNote]=useState(''),[sla,setSla]=useState({localeId:'',country:'',hours:24});
 const [filters,setFilters]=useState({from:new Date(Date.now()-30*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),source:'',locale:'',country:'',product:''}),[report,setReport]=useState<Row|null>(null),[reportFilter,setReportFilter]=useState('');
 useEffect(()=>{let live=true;const suffix='?q='+encodeURIComponent(search)+'&page='+page;Promise.all([canLeads?get('workspace'+suffix):null,canContent?get('market'+suffix):null]).then(([a,b])=>{if(!live)return;if(a)setData(a);if(b)setMarket(b);}).catch(e=>{if(live)setError(e.message);});return()=>{live=false;};},[canLeads,canContent,search,page]);
 async function reload(){const suffix='?q='+encodeURIComponent(search)+'&page='+page;if(canLeads)setData(await get('workspace'+suffix));if(canContent)setMarket(await get('market'+suffix));if(selected)setDetail(await get('inquiry?id='+selected));}
 async function act(work:()=>Promise<void>,message='已保存。'){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{await work();await reload();setNotice(message);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 async function open(id:string){setBusy(true);setError('');setInvite('');try{const d=await get('inquiry?id='+id);setSelected(id);setDetail(d);setRecipient(d.inquiry.email);setRole('customer');setNote('');setQuote({...blankQuote(),lines:d.items.map((x:Row)=>({itemId:x.id,name:x.product_name_snapshot,quantity:Number(x.quantity),unitPrice:0}))});}catch(e){setError((e as Error).message);}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 const visible=tabs.filter(x=>['market','trust'].includes(x[0])?canContent||x[0]==='trust'&&canLeads:canLeads);
 const locales=market.locales.length?market.locales:data.locales;
 const languageOptions=<><option value="">请选择语言</option>{locales.map((l:Row)=><option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.native_name} · {l.code}</option>)}</>;
 const changeTab=(v:string)=>{setTab(v);setInvite('');setNotice('');setPage(1);setSearch('');setQ('');};
 return <div className="trade-desk"><header className="trade-heading"><div><p className="trade-eyebrow">TRADE OPERATIONS / 外贸业务</p><h2>让每一份需求<br/>都有明确的下一步。</h2><p>从市场内容到询盘、报价与客户确认，沿着业务流程完成工作。</p></div><div className="trade-heading-note"><span>工作顺序</span><strong>收到需求 → 编制报价<br/>团队审核 → 客户确认</strong><small>确认报价后，由销售人员核实成交并更新商机。</small></div></header>
 <nav className="trade-tabs" aria-label="外贸功能">{visible.map(([key,n,label])=><button key={key} aria-current={tab===key?'page':undefined} onClick={()=>changeTab(key)}><small>{n}</small>{label}</button>)}</nav>
 {error&&<p className="trade-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="trade-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
 <fieldset disabled={busy} className="trade-body">
 {tab==='funnel'&&<><div className="trade-intro"><h3>查看询盘如何走向成交</h3><p>以所选时间收到的询盘为同一批次；后续行为统计至当前时刻。每项可在下面的询盘明细中追溯。</p></div><form className="trade-form trade-filter" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();act(async()=>{setReport(await get('funnel?'+new URLSearchParams(filters)));setReportFilter(JSON.stringify(filters));},'数据已更新。');}}>{[['from','开始日期','date'],['to','结束日期','date'],['source','UTM 来源','text'],['country','询盘国家 / 地区','text'],['product','产品名称 / SKU','text']].map(([k,l,t])=><label key={k}>{l}<input type={t} value={(filters as Row)[k]} required={t==='date'} onChange={e=>setFilters({...filters,[k]:e.target.value})}/></label>)}<label>语言<select value={filters.locale} onChange={e=>setFilters({...filters,locale:e.target.value})}><option value="">全部语言</option>{data.locales.map((l:Row)=><option key={l.id} value={l.code}>{l.native_name}</option>)}</select></label><button className="trade-primary">生成漏斗</button></form>
 {report&&<><p className="trade-help">生成时间：{dt(report.generatedAt)}{reportFilter!==JSON.stringify(filters)?' · 筛选条件已改变，请重新生成。':''}</p><div className="trade-metrics">{[['inquiries','收到询盘'],['qualified','曾标记为有效'],['quoted','已有发出报价'],['won','关联已赢单商机']].map(([k,l],n)=><div key={k}><span>0{n+1} / {l}</span><strong>{report.totals[k]}</strong><small>{n?Math.round(report.totals[k]/Math.max(1,report.totals.inquiries)*100)+'% / 占本批询盘':'不含垃圾与已删除询盘'}</small></div>)}</div><p className="trade-help">同期间同来源和语言的自愿统计会话：{report.visits??'国家 / 产品筛选下不适用'}。本批有会话关联的询盘：{report.totals.tracked}。访问会话与询盘不是同一统计单位；不计算跨口径转化率。有效、报价、成交是独立业务标记，允许跳过阶段。</p><div className="trade-table"><table><thead><tr><th>询盘 / 客户</th><th>来源</th><th>语言 / 地区</th><th>有效</th><th>报价</th><th>成交</th></tr></thead><tbody>{report.rows.map((r:Row)=><tr key={r.id}><td><button className="trade-link" onClick={()=>{setTab('quotes');open(r.id);}}>{r.inquiry_number} · {r.name}</button></td><td>{r.source||'未记录'}</td><td>{r.locale} / {r.country||'未填写'}</td>{['qualified','quoted','won'].map(k=><td key={k}>{r[k]?'●':'—'}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table>{!report.rows.length&&<p className="trade-empty">这个时间范围还没有询盘。</p>}</div></>}
 {!report&&<p className="trade-empty">选择日期和市场条件，点击“生成漏斗”查看真实业务记录。</p>}</>}
 {['quotes','portal'].includes(tab)&&<><div className="trade-intro"><h3>{tab==='quotes'?'先选择询盘，再编制报价':'为指定询盘创建专属访问入口'}</h3><p>{tab==='quotes'?'每次保存都会创建独立版本。另一位审核员确认后，点击“发出”即可在客户入口查看。':'客户可确认该询盘的最新报价，渠道邀请仅可查看这一份询盘。邀请不会自动发送。'}</p></div><form className="trade-search" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();setSearch(q);setPage(1);}}><input aria-label="搜索询盘" placeholder="搜索客户、公司或询盘号" value={q} onChange={e=>setQ(e.target.value)}/><button>搜索</button></form><div className="trade-columns"><aside className="trade-inquiries">{data.inquiries.map((i:Row)=><button key={i.id} aria-current={selected===i.id?'true':undefined} onClick={()=>open(i.id)}><strong>{i.company||i.name}</strong><span>{i.inquiry_number}</span><small>{i.language} · {i.quotes} 个报价版本</small></button>)}{!data.inquiries.length&&<p className="trade-empty">尚无匹配的询盘。客户提交 RFQ 后会出现在这里。</p>}<div className="trade-pages"><button disabled={page===1} onClick={()=>setPage(page-1)}>上一页</button><span>{page}</span><button disabled={page*50>=data.total} onClick={()=>setPage(page+1)}>下一页</button></div></aside><div className="trade-detail">{!detail?<p className="trade-empty">选择左侧询盘，查看采购需求与操作步骤。</p>:<><div className="trade-panel"><p className="trade-eyebrow">{detail.inquiry.inquiry_number}</p><h3>{detail.inquiry.company||detail.inquiry.name}</h3><p>{detail.inquiry.name} · {detail.inquiry.email} · {names[detail.inquiry.status]}</p><p className="trade-pre">{detail.inquiry.message}</p><p>首响期限：{dt(detail.inquiry.response_due_at)}<br/>已记录回复：{dt(detail.inquiry.first_response_at)}</p>{canWriteLeads&&!detail.inquiry.first_response_at&&<form onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();act(async()=>{await post('response',{inquiryId:selected,note});setNote('');},'已记录首次人工回复时间。');}}><label>实际回复记录<textarea required minLength={5} maxLength={2000} placeholder="已通过什么渠道回复，处理了哪些问题？" value={note} onChange={e=>setNote(e.target.value)}/></label><button>记录已回复</button></form>}</div>
 {tab==='quotes'&&<>{canWriteLeads&&detail.items.length>0&&<form className="trade-panel" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();act(async()=>{await  {detail.quotes.map((r:Row)=><article className="trade-panel" key={r.id}><div className="trade-row"><h3>报价 V{r.version}</h3><span className="trade-badge">{names[r.status]}</span></div><p key={l.itemId}>{l.name} · {l.quantity} {l.unit} × {r.currency} {l.unitPrice}</p>)}<p className="trade-pre">{r.terms||'未填写附加说明'}</p></details><div className="trade-actions">{canWriteLeads&&<button onClick={()=>{if(confirm('作废此报价版本？客户将无法确认此版本。'))act(async()=>{await post('quote-action',{id:r.id,action:'void'});});}}>作废</button>}</div>{r.status==='review'&&r.created_by===actorId&&<p className="trade-help">请另一位有审核权限的同事登录并审核。</p>}</article>)}{!detail.quotes.length&&<p className="trade-empty">还没有报价版本。</p>}<details className="trade-panel"><summary>报价操作历史</summary>{detail.events.map((e:Row)=><p key={e.id}>{dt(e.created_at)} · {({created:'创建版本',submit:'提交审核',approve:'通过审核',return:'退回草稿',issue:'发出报价',void:'作废',accepted:'客户确认',rejected:'客户拒绝'} as Row)[e.action]||e.action} · {e.actor||'客户'} {e.note}</p>)}</details></>}
 {tab==='portal'&&<>{canWriteLeads&&<form className="trade-panel" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();act(async()=>{const r=await post('grant',{inquiryId:selected,recipient,role,days});setInvite(location.origin+'/api/v1/trade-public/portal-page#'+r.token);},'邀请已创建。请核对收件人后，手动发送给对方。');}}><h3>创建限时邀请</h3><label>访问权限<select value={role} onChange={e=>{setRole(e.target.value);setRecipient(e.target.value==='customer'?detail.inquiry.email:'');}}><option value="customer">客户：查看和确认报价</option><option value="partner">渠道：仅查看</option></select></label><label>接收人邮箱<input type="email" required value={recipient} readOnly={role==='customer'} onChange={e=>setRecipient(e.target.value)}/></label><label>有效天数<input type="number" min={1} max={30} required value={days} onChange={e=>setDays(Number(e.target.value))}/></label><button className="trade-primary">生成邀请链接</button><p className="trade-help">持有链接的人即可访问本份询盘；请使用可信渠道发送。服务器只保存令牌哈希。</p></form>}{invite&&<div className="trade-panel"><label>邀请链接（仅本次显示）<textarea readOnly value={invite} onFocus={e=>e.target.select()}/></label><button onClick={()=>navigator.clipboard.writeText(invite).then(()=>setNotice('链接已复制。')).catch(()=>setError('请选中链接后手动复制。'))}>复制链接</button></div>}{detail.grants.map((g:Row)=><article className="trade-panel" key={g.id}><strong>{g.recipient}</strong><p>{names[g.role]} · {g.revoked_at?'已撤销':new Date(g.expires_at)<new Date()?'已过期':'有效'} · 到期 {dt(g.expires_at)}</p>{canWriteLeads&&!g.revoked_at&&<button onClick={()=>{if(confirm('撤销此邀请？原链接将立即失效。'))act(async()=>{await post('revoke',{id:g.id});setInvite('');},'邀请已撤销。');}}>撤销访问</button>}</article>)}{!detail.grants.length&&<p className="trade-empty">还没有访问邀请。</p>}</>}
 </>}</div></div></>}
 {['market','trust'].includes(tab)&&<><div className="trade-intro"><h3>{tab==='market'?'把适合当地市场的内容放到官网':'用有效证明与明确服务建立采购信任'}</h3><p>选择语言和国家，填写可核对的来源，经另一位审核员发布。关联页面变更或证明到期后，官网自动停止展示。</p></div>{tab==='trust'&&canWriteLeads&&<form className="trade-panel" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();act(async()=>{await post('service',sla);},'响应时限已保存，将应用于此后收到的新询盘。');}}><h3>设置首次响应时限</h3><div className="trade-form"><label>语言<select required value={sla.localeId} onChange={e=>setSla({...sla,localeId:e.target.value})}>{languageOptions}</select></label><label>国家代码（留空适用所有国家）<input pattern="[A-Z]{2}" maxLength={2} placeholder="US / DE" value={sla.country} onChange={e=>setSla({...sla,country:e.target.value.toUpperCase()})}/></label><label>自然小时（含周末）<input type="number" min={1} max={720} required value={sla.hours} onChange={e=>setSla({...sla,hours:Number(e.target.value)})}/></label><button>保存时限</button></div><p className="trade-help">国家使用 ISO 两位代码；指定国家优先于语言默认规则。历史询盘时限保留原值。</p>{(data.rules||[]).map((r:Row)=><p key={r.id}>{r.language} · {r.country||'全部国家'}：{r.response_hours} 小时</p>)}</form>}
 {canContent&&<><form className="trade-search" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();setSearch(q);setPage(1);}}><input aria-label="搜索市场内容" placeholder="搜索卡片或已发布页面标题" value={q} onChange={e=>setQ(e.target.value)}/><button>搜索</button></form>{canWriteContent&&<form className="trade-panel" onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault();act(async()=>{await post('market',{...card,validUntil:card.validUntil||null});setCard(blankCard());},'已提交审核。');}}><h3>新增展示内容</h3><div className="trade-form"><label>内容类型<select value={card.kind} onChange={e=>setCard({...card,kind:e.target.value})}>{Object.entries({market:'市场推荐',certificate:'资质证书',case:'客户案例',service:'服务承诺'}).map(([k,v])=><option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}</select></label><label>展示语言<select required value={card.localeId} value={card.country} onChange={e=>setCard({...card,country:e.target.value.toUpperCase()})}/></label><label>有效期（证书必填）<input type="date" required={card.kind==='certificate'} value={card.validUntil} onChange={e=>setCard({...card,title:e.target.value})}/></label><label>当地市场说明<textarea required minLength={2} maxLength={2000} value={card.summary} onChange={e=>setCard({...card,sourceUrl:e.target.value})}><option value="">选择页面（可搜索标题缩小范围）</option>{market.pages.filter((p:Row)=>p.locale_id===card.localeId).map((p:Row)=><option key={p.route} value={p.route}>{p.title}</option>)}</select></label>{['certificate','service'].includes(card.kind)&&<label>或填写公开 HTTPS 证明地址<input value={card.sourceUrl} required maxLength={1000}  <div className="trade-card-grid">{market.cards.filter((r:Row)=>tab==='market'?r.kind==='market':['certificate','case','service'].includes(r.kind)).map((r:Row)=><article className="trade-panel" key={r.id}><p className="trade-eyebrow">{names[r.kind]} · {r.language} · {r.country||'全部国家'}</p><h3>{r.title}</h3><span className="trade-badge">{names[r.status]}{r.valid_until&&String(r.valid_until).slice(0,10)<new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)?' · 已到期':''}</span><p className="trade-pre">{r.summary}</p><p className="trade-help">来源：{r.source_url}<br/>作者：{r.author}<br/>有效至：{r.valid_until?String(r.valid_until).slice(0,10):'未限定'}</p><div className="trade-actions">{canWriteContent&&canReview&&r.status!=='published'&&r.created_by!==actorId&&<button onClick={()=>act(async()=>{await post('market-action',{id:r.id,action:'publish'});},'审核通过，官网将在下次访问时展示。')}>审核并展示</button>}{canWriteContent&&r.status!=='withdrawn'&&<button onClick={()=>act(async()=>{await post('market-action',{id:r.id,action:'withdraw'});},'已撤下展示。')}>撤下</button>}{canWriteContent&&<button onClick={()=>{setCard({localeId:r.locale_id,country:r.country,kind:r.kind,title:r.title,summary:r.summary,sourceUrl:r.source_url,validUntil:r.valid_until?String(r.valid_until).slice(0,10):''});setNotice('已复制到上方表单，核对来源后重新提交审核。');}}>复制修改</button>}</div></article>)}</div>{!market.cards.length&&<p className="trade-empty">还没有展示内容。先选择语言并创建第一张市场卡片。</p>}<div className="trade-pages"><button disabled={page===1} onClick={()=>setPage(page-1)}>上一页</button><span>第 {page} 页 · 共 {market.total||0} 条</span><button disabled={page*50>=market.total} onClick={()=>setPage(page+1)}>下一页</button></div></>}

## apps/cms/src/app/(console)/manage/TranslationCenter.tsx

````tsx
'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest as request,type Row} from './api-client';
import {AISettings} from './AISettings';

export type TranslationSource={id:string;title:string;entityType:'content_item_translations'|'product_translations'};
const statusNames:Row={pending:'等待翻译',processing:'翻译中',review:'待校对',approved:'已审核',failed:'失败'};

export function TranslationCenter({writableKinds,canConfigure,onOpenTarget,onChooseSource}:{writableKinds:string[];canConfigure:boolean;onOpenTarget:(job:Row)=>void;onChooseSource:(type:string)=>void}){
 const [data,setData]=useState<Row|null>(null),[error,setError]=useState(''),[busy,setBusy]=useState(''),[settingsOpen,setSettingsOpen]=useState(false);
 const reload=()=>request('translation-jobs').then(setData).catch(e=>setError(e.message));
 useEffect(()=>{reload();const timer=setInterval(reload,5000);return()=>clearInterval(timer);},[]);
 async function action(job:Row,what:'retry'|'approve'){
  setBusy(job.id);setError('');try{await request('translation-jobs',{id:job.id,action:what},'PATCH');await reload();}catch(e:any){setError(e.message);}finally{setBusy('');}
 }
 return <div className="translation-center">
  <div className="resource-intro"><p>选择一条页面或产品的原文，点击“自动翻译”，可一次选择多个目标语言。译文会保存为草稿，校对后再发布。</p></div>
  {data&&!data.config?.configured&&<div className="translation-setup"><strong>翻译服务尚未配置</strong><p>{data.config?.reason?data.config.reason+'。':'还没有可用的 DeepSeek API 密钥。'}请管理员打开下方“AI 设置”处理，密钥不会在后台回显。</p></div>}
  {canConfigure&&<><button className="llm-settings-toggle" onClick={()=>setSettingsOpen(x=>!x)}>⚙ AI 设置 {settingsOpen?'收起':'展开'}</button>{settingsOpen&&<AISettings onSaved={reload}/>}</>}
  <div className="translation-start"><button className="primary" onClick={()=>onChooseSource('content_item_translations')}>从页面与文章选择原文</button><button onClick={()=>onChooseSource('product_translations')}>从产品选择原文</button></div>
  <h2>翻译任务</h2>{error&&<p role="alert" className="form-error">{error}</p>}
  {!data?<p>正在加载任务…</p>:data.rows.length?<div className="translation-list">{data.rows.map((job:Row)=><article key={job.id}>
   <div><strong>{job.source_title}</strong><span>{job.source_language} → {job.target_language}</span></div>
   <div><span className={'badge '+job.status}>{statusNames[job.status]||job.status}</span><time>{new Date(job.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</time></div>
   {job.error_message&&<p className="translation-error">{job.error_message}</p>}
   <div className="translation-actions">{job.target_path&&<button onClick={()=>onOpenTarget(job)}>查看译文草稿</button>}{job.status==='review'&&writableKinds.includes(job.entity_type)&&<button disabled={busy===job.id} onClick={()=>action(job,'approve')}>标记已校对</button>}{job.status==='failed'&&writableKinds.includes(job.entity_type)&&<button disabled={busy===job.id} onClick={()=>action(job,'retry')}>重试</button>}</div>
  </article>)}</div>:<div className="empty"><strong>还没有翻译任务</strong><p>从页面或产品列表选择原文，点击“自动翻译”开始。</p></div>}
 </div>;
}

export function AutoTranslateDialog({source,onClose,onDone}:{source:TranslationSource;onClose:()=>void;onDone:()=>void}){
 const [data,setData]=useState<Row|null>(null),[config,setConfig]=useState<Row|null>(null),[selected,setSelected]=useState<string[]>([]),[overwrite,setOverwrite]=useState(false),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState('');
 useEffect(()=>{let cancelled=false;Promise.all([request('translation-targets?entityType='+encodeURIComponent(source.entityType)+'&entityId='+encodeURIComponent(source.id)),request('translation-jobs')]).then(([targets,jobs])=>{if(!cancelled){setData(targets);setConfig(jobs.config);}}).catch(e=>{if(!cancelled)setError(e.message);});return()=>{cancelled=true;};},[source.id,source.entityType]);
 function toggle(id:string){setSelected(current=>current.includes(id)?current.filter(x=>x!==id):[...current,id]);}
 async function submit(){setBusy(true);setError('');try{await request('translation-jobs',{entityType:source.entityType,entityId:source.id,targetLocaleIds:selected,overwriteDraft:overwrite});onDone();}catch(e:any){setError(e.message);}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 return <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose}><section className="editor translation-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="自动翻译" onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
  <header><div><p className="eyebrow">DEEPSEEK · 自动翻译</p><h2>{source.title}</h2></div><button onClick={onClose} aria-label="关闭">×</button></header>
  <div className="translation-dialog-body"><p>选择目标语言。页面标题、摘要、正文区块或产品介绍会翻译，网址标识、图片地址和产品编号会保留。翻译完成后请人工校对。</p>
   {error&&<p role="alert" className="form-error">{error}</p>}
   {config&&!config.configured&&<div className="translation-setup">翻译服务尚未配置{config.reason?'：'+config.reason:''}。请管理员在“自动翻译 → AI 设置”处理。</div>}
   {!data?<p>正在加载语言…</p>:<><div className="translation-languages">{data.locales.filter((locale:Row)=>locale.id!==data.source.locale_id).map((locale:Row)=>{
    const existing=locale.existing_status;const locked=existing&&!['draft','review'].includes(existing);const disabled=!!locked||!!existing&&!overwrite;
    return <label key={locale.id} className={disabled?'disabled':''}><input type="checkbox" checked={selected.includes(locale.id)} disabled={disabled} onChange={()=>toggle(locale.id)}/><span>{locale.native_name} <small>{locale.code}</small></span><em>{locked?'已有公开内容':existing?'已有草稿':'可翻译'}</em></label>;
   })}</div><label className="translation-overwrite"><input type="checkbox" checked={overwrite} onChange={e=>{setOverwrite(e.target.checked);if(!e.target.checked)setSelected(current=>current.filter(id=>!data.locales.some((locale:Row)=>locale.id===id&&locale.existing_id)));}}/>允许覆盖所选语言中已有的草稿（不会覆盖已发布内容）</label></>}
   <footer><button onClick={onClose}>取消</button><button className="primary" disabled={busy||!selected.length||!config?.configured} onClick={submit}>{busy?'提交中…':`开始翻译 ${selected.length} 种语言`}</button></footer>
  </div>
 </section></div>;
}

````

.v21 .v21-empty{color:#64786e;padding:1.1rem;background:#f6f8f4;border-radius:10px}
.v21 .v21-record{padding:1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e9df}

.v21 .v21-notice{padding:.8rem 1rem;background:#e9f3e5;border:1px solid #bcd6b2;border-radius:10px}
.v21 .v21-check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}

'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './v21-desk.css';

type Item=Record<string,any>;
const get=(path:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path);
const post=(path:string,body:Item,method?:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path,body,method);
const when=(value:unknown)=>value?new Date(String(value)).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'—';
function useWork(){const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');async function run(work:()=>Promise<void>){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{await work();}catch(error){setError(error instanceof Error?error.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}return {busy,error,notice,setNotice,run};}
function Empty({children}:{children:React.ReactNode}){return <p className="v21-empty">{children}</p>;}

export function V21Desk({canContent,canAssign,canSeo,canSeoWrite,canReview,onOpenGeo}:{canContent:boolean;canAssign:boolean;canSeo:boolean;canSeoWrite:boolean;canReview:boolean;onOpenGeo:()=>void}){
 const tabs=[canContent&&{key:'team',label:'团队任务'},canSeo&&{key:'monitor',label:'变化与趋势'},canSeo&&{key:'outreach',label:'合作外联'}].filter(Boolean) as {key:string;label:string}[];
 const [tab,setTab]=useState(tabs[0]?.key||'team');
 return <div className="v2 v21"><div className="v2-hero"><p>V2.1 · TEAM OPERATIONS</p><h2>协作、观察与跟进</h2><span>任务有负责人，研究有来源，外联需审核，客户同步保留冲突和失败记录。</span></div><nav className="v2-tabs" aria-label="V2.1 工作台">{tabs.map(x=><button key={x.key} className={tab===x.key?'active':''} onClick={()=>setTab(x.key)}>{x.label}</button>)}</nav>{tab==='team'&&canContent&&<TeamDesk canReview={canReview} canAssign={canAssign}/>} {tab==='monitor'&&canSeo&&<MonitorDesk canWrite={canSeoWrite} onOpenGeo={onOpenGeo}/>} {tab==='outreach'&&canSeo&&<OutreachDesk canReview={canReview} canWrite={canSeoWrite}/>}</div>;
}

function TeamDesk({canReview,canAssign}:{canReview:boolean;canAssign:boolean}){
 const [data,setData]=useState<Item>({rows:[],users:[]}),[terms,setTerms]=useState<Item[]>([]),[content,setContent]=useState<Item[]>([]),[kind,setKind]=useState('content_review'),[entityType,setEntityType]=useState('content_item_translations'),[selected,setSelected]=useState<string[]>([]),[title,setTitle]=useState(''),[instructions,setInstructions]=useState(''),[assignee,setAssignee]=useState(''),[due,setDue]=useState('');
 const work=useWork();async function reload(){const [a,b,c]=await Promise.all([get('v21-tasks'),get('translation-terms'),get('assistant-context')]);setData(a);setTerms(b.rows||[]);setContent(c.rows||[]);}useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(()=>{});},[]);
 async function create(){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-tasks',{kind,entityType,entityIds:selected,title,instructions,assignedTo:assignee||undefined,dueAt:due?new Date(due).toISOString():undefined});setSelected([]);setTitle('');setInstructions('');await reload();work.setNotice('任务已分配，公开页面不会因此改变。');});}
 async function change(id:string,status:string){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-tasks',{id,status},'PATCH');await reload();});}
 async function termReview(id:string,decision:'approved'|'rejected'){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-terms-review',{id,decision});await reload();work.setNotice(decision==='approved'?'术语已批准，后续翻译可使用。':'术语已退回修改。');});}
 const choices=content.filter(x=>x.entity_type===entityType);
 return <><Feedback {...work}/><div className="v2-two">{canAssign&&<section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">批量分工</p><h3>把内容交给合适的人</h3><p className="v2-muted">选择最多 30 条内容，设定负责人和截止时间。任务完成需审核员确认；保存任务不会发布页面。</p><div className="v2-row"><label>任务类型<select value={kind} onChange={e=>setKind(e.target.value)}><option value="content_review">内容审核</option><option onChange={e=>{setEntityType(e.target.value);setSelected([]);}}><option value="content_item_translations">页面与文章</option><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.display_name||x.email}</option>)}</select></label><label>截止时间<input type="datetime-local" value={due} onChange={e=>setDue(e.target.value)}/></label></div><div className="v21-picker" aria-label="选择要处理的内容">{choices.length?choices.map(x=><label key={x.id}><input type="checkbox" checked={selected.includes(x.id)} disabled={!selected.includes(x.id)&&selected.length>=30} onChange={e=>setSelected(e.target.checked?[...selected,x.id]:selected.filter(y=>y!==x.id))}/><span>{x.title}<small>{x.path}</small></span></label>):<Empty>先创建页面或产品，再在这里分配任务。</Empty>}</div><label>任务名称<input value={title} maxLength={200} onChange={e=>setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="例如：校对德语产品介绍"/></label><label>处理说明<textarea rows={3} value={instructions} maxLength={4000} onChange={e=>setInstructions(e.target.value)} placeholder="写清楚需要核对的事实、语言和修改范围"/></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={work.busy||selected.length===0||title.trim().length<2} onClick={create}>创建 {selected.length} 条任务</button></section>}<section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">工作清单</p><h3>分工与审核进度</h3>{data.rows.length?data.rows.map((x:Item)=><div {x.status==='done'?'已完成':x.status==='in_review'?'待审核':x.status==='in_progress'?'处理中':x.status==='cancelled'?'已取消':'待开始'}{x.due_at?' · 截止 '+when(x.due_at):''}</small>{x.instructions&&<p>{x.instructions}</p>}<div className="v21-actions">{x.status==='open'&&<button onClick={()=>change(x.id,'in_progress')}>开始处理</button>}{x.status==='in_progress'&&<button onClick={()=>change(x.id,'in_review')}>提交审核</button>}{x.status==='in_review'&&canReview&&<button onClick={()=>change(x.id,'done')}>确认完成</button>}{!['done','cancelled'].includes(x.status)&&<button onClick={()=>change(x.id,'cancelled')}>取消任务</button>}</div></div>):<Empty>目前没有协作任务。左侧可从已有内容创建。</Empty>}</section></div><section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">术语审批</p><h3>让品牌用词经过确认</h3><p className="v2-muted">新术语先进入待审；批准后才会用于自动翻译。已有术语保持批准状态。</p>{terms.length?terms.map(x=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.source_term} → {x.target_term}</strong><small>{x.source_language} → {x.target_language} · {x.approval_status==='approved'?'已批准':x.approval_status==='rejected'?'已退回':'待审批'}{x.review_note?' · '+x.review_note:''}</small></span>{x.approval_status==='pending'&&canReview&&<><button disabled={work.busy} onClick={()=>termReview(x.id,'approved')}>批准</button><button disabled={work.busy} onClick={()=>termReview(x.id,'rejected')}>退回</button></>}</div>):<Empty>术语表为空。请先到“自动翻译”添加术语。</Empty>}</section></>;
}

function MonitorDesk({canWrite,onOpenGeo}:{canWrite:boolean;onOpenGeo:()=>void}){
 const [pages,setPages]=useState<Item[]>([]),[history,setHistory]=useState<Item|null>(null);const work=useWork();
 async function reload(){setPages((await get('competitors')).rows||[]);}useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(()=>{});},[]);
 async function showPage(id:string){await work.run(async()=>setHistory(await get('competitor-history?id='+id)));}
 async function acknowledge(id:string){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-competitor-alert',{id});if(history)setHistory(await get('competitor-history?id='+history.page.id));await reload();});}
 return <><Feedback {...work}/><section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">竞品变化</p><h3>只提醒结构变化，再由编辑判断</h3>{pages.length?pages.map(x=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.label}</strong><small>{x.open_alerts?`${x.open_alerts} 条待查看变化 · `:''}{x.url} · 最近采样 {when(x.last_checked_at)}</small></span><button onClick={()=>showPage(x.id)}>查看变化与建议</button></div>):<Empty>先在“增长研究”添加公开竞品页面。</Empty>}{history&&<div className="v21-detail"><h4>{history.page.label}</h4><p>{history.updateAdvice||'目前没有新的结构变化。'}</p>{history.alerts?.filter((x:Item)=>!x.acknowledged_at).map((x:Item)=><div className="v21-record" key={x.id}><strong>变化：{x.changed_fields.join('、')}</strong><small>{when(x.created_at)}</small>{canWrite&&<button onClick={()=>acknowledge(x.id)}>已查看</button>}</div>)}<h4>本站可考虑的内链</h4>{history.suggestions?.length?history.suggestions.map((x:Item)=><p key={x.route}><strong>{x.title}</strong> · {x.route}<small> 共同主题词：{x.overlap.join('、')}。请人工判断链接是否真正有帮助。</small></p>):<Empty>未发现明确的本站页面匹配；无需为了链接而新建内容。</Empty>}</div>}</section><section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">GEO 监测</p><h3>统一查看模型、地区与预算</h3><p className="v2-muted">重复采样已迁移到 GEO 监测中心。旧计划已暂停；在新中心设置模型、地区、预算和采样目标。</p><button className="v2-primary" onClick={onOpenGeo}>打开 GEO 监测中心</button></section></>;
}

function OutreachDesk({canReview,canWrite}:{canReview:boolean;canWrite:boolean}){
 const [partners,setPartners]=useState<Item[]>([]),[detail,setDetail]=useState<Item|null>(null),[organization,setOrganization]=useState(''),[website,setWebsite]=useState(''),[contact,setContact]=useState(''),[email,setEmail]=useState(''),[fit,setFit]=useState(''),[subject,setSubject]=useState(''),[body,setBody]=useState(''),[reply,setReply]=useState(''),[source,setSource]=useState(''),[target,setTarget]=useState('');const work=useWork();
 async function reload(){setPartners((await get('v21-outreach')).partners||[]);}useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(()=>{});},[]);
 async function open(id:string){await work.run(async()=>setDetail(await get('v21-outreach-detail?id='+id)));}
 async function refresh(){await reload();if(detail)setDetail(await get('v21-outreach-detail?id='+detail.partner.id));}
 async function addPartner(){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-outreach',{organization,websiteUrl:website,contactName:contact,contactEmail:email,fitNote:fit});setOrganization('');setWebsite('');setContact('');setEmail('');setFit('');await reload();});}
 async function addDraft(){if(!detail)return;await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-outreach-draft',{partnerId:detail.partner.id,subject,body});setSubject('');setBody('');await refresh();});}

 async function addReply(){if(!detail)return;await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-outreach-reply',{partnerId:detail.partner.id,summary:reply,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()});setReply('');await refresh();});}
 async function addLink(){if(!detail)return;await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-outreach-link',{partnerId:detail.partner.id,sourceUrl:source,targetUrl:target});setSource('');setTarget('');await refresh();});}
 return <><Feedback {...work}/>{canWrite&&<section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">人工外联</p><h3>研究相关合作对象</h3><p className="v2-muted">系统只保存研究和草稿，不自动发送邮件或发布外链。联系前由团队确认适配性、事实和收件人。</p><div className="v2-row"><label>机构名称<input value={organization} onChange={e=>setOrganization(e.target.value)}/></label><label>网站<input type="url" value={website} placeholder="https://example.com" onChange={e=>setWebsite(e.target.value)}/></label><label>联系人<input value={contact} onChange={e=>setContact(e.target.value)}/></label><label>联系邮箱<input type="email" value={email} onChange={e=>setEmail(e.target.value)}/></label></div><label>合作理由<input value={fit} onChange={e=>setFit(e.target.value)} placeholder="说明相关性与可能提供的价值"/></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={work.busy||organization.trim().length<2||!website} onClick={addPartner}>保存合作对象</button></section>}<div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><h3>合作对象</h3>{partners.length?partners.map(x=><button className="v21-partner" key={x.id} onClick={()=>open(x.id)}><strong>{x.organization}</strong><small>{x.website_url} · {x.draft_count} 份草稿 · {x.link_count} 条记录链接</small></button>):<Empty>尚无合作对象。先记录相关网站。</Empty>}</section><section className="v2-card">{!detail?<Empty>选择合作对象，准备联系草稿并记录回复。</Empty>:<><p className="v2-kicker">{detail.partner.organization}</p><h3>人工审核与记录</h3><p>{detail.partner.fit_note||'暂无合作理由说明。'}</p><label>联系主题<input value={subject} onChange={e=>setSubject(e.target.value)}/></label><label>邮件草稿<textarea rows={5} value={body} onChange={e=>setBody(e.target.value)} placeholder="只写真实、相关、可提供价值的合作提议"/></label><button disabled={work.busy||!canWrite||subject.length<2||body.length<10} onClick={addDraft}>保存待审草稿</button><h4>草稿与人工发送</h4>{detail.drafts?.map((x:Item)=><div className="v21-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.subject}</strong><small>{x.author_name||'同事'} · {x.status==='sent_manually'?'已标记人工发送':x.status==='approved'?'已批准':x.status==='rejected'?'已退回':'待审核'} · {when(x.created_at)}</small><p>{x.body}</p><div className="v21-actions">{x.status==='draft'&&canReview&&<><button onClick={()=>review(x.id,'approve')}>批准草稿</button><button onClick={()=>review(x.id,'reject')}>退回</button></>}{x.status==='approved'&&canWrite&&<button onClick={()=>review(x.id,'mark_sent')}>我已在外部人工发送</button>}</div></div>)}<h4>记录收到的回复</h4><textarea rows={3} value={reply} onChange={e=>setReply(e.target.value)} placeholder="概述对方实际回复，避免粘贴无关个人信息"/><button disabled={work.busy||!canWrite||reply.trim().length<2} onClick={addReply}>记录回复</button>{detail.replies?.map((x:Item)=><p key={x.id}>{when(x.received_at)} · {x.summary}</p>)}<h4>记录自然获得的链接</h4><div className="v2-row"><label>来源页面<input type="url" disabled={work.busy||!canWrite||!source||!target} onClick={addLink}>记录链接</button>{detail.links?.map((x:Item)=><p key={x.id}>{x.source_url} → {x.target_url} <small>· {x.verification_status==='unverified'?'尚未独立核验':'已核验'}</small></p>)}</>}</section></div></>;
}

export function CrmSyncDesk({canAdmin}:{canAdmin:boolean}){
 const [data,setData]=useState<Item>({jobs:[],conflicts:[],links:[]}),[settings,setSettings]=useState<Item|null>(null),[inquiries,setInquiries]=useState<Item[]>([]),[endpoint,setEndpoint]=useState(''),[token,setToken]=useState(''),[enabled,setEnabled]=useState(false),[inquiryId,setInquiryId]=useState(''),[conflictChoice,setConflictChoice]=useState<Record<string,string>>({});const work=useWork();
 async function reload(){const [a,b]=await Promise.all([get('v21-crm'),get('inquiries')]);setData(a);setInquiries(b.inquiries||[]);}useEffect(()=>{reload().catch(()=>{});if(canAdmin)get('v21-crm-settings').then(x=>{setSettings(x);setEndpoint(x.endpoint||'');setEnabled(!!x.enabled);}).catch(()=>{});},[canAdmin]);
 async function save(){await work.run(async()=>{const value=await post('v21-crm-settings',{endpoint,token:token||undefined,enabled});setSettings(value);setToken('');work.setNotice('CRM 连接设置已保存。启用后 Worker 将同步未处理询盘。');});}
 async function queue(direction:'push'|'pull'){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-crm-queue',{direction,inquiryId:direction==='push'?inquiryId:undefined});await reload();work.setNotice('已加入同步队列，查看下方状态。');});}
 async function retry(id:string){await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-crm-retry',{id});await reload();});}
 async function resolve(id:string,resolution:'keep_local'|'use_remote'){if(!confirm(resolution==='use_remote'?'确认采用 CRM 记录？如未选择本地询盘，将创建新询盘。':'确认保留本地记录并重新推送？'))return;await work.run(async()=>{await post('v21-crm-resolve',{id,resolution,inquiryId:conflictChoice[id]||undefined});await reload();});}
 return <><Feedback {...work}/><section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">通用 HTTPS CRM</p><h3>双向同步与冲突处理</h3><p className="v2-muted">外部接口须实现项目文档中的 /leads 与 /leads/upsert 契约。启用后会将询盘姓名、邮箱、公司、电话、消息和状态传给该接口。凭据只在服务端加密保存；冲突不会自动覆盖。</p>{canAdmin&&<><div className="v2-row"><label>CRM 接口根地址<input type="url" value={endpoint} onChange={e=>setEndpoint(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://crm.example.com/api/"/></label><label>访问令牌<input type="password" value={token} onChange={e=>setToken(e.target.value)} placeholder={settings?.configured?'留空保持已保存令牌':'填写服务端令牌'}/></label><label className="v21-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={enabled} onChange={e=>setEnabled(e.target.checked)}/>启用同步</label></div><button className="v2-primary" disabled={work.busy||!endpoint} onClick={save}>保存 CRM 连接</button><p className="v2-muted">上次同步：{when(settings?.lastSyncedAt)}{settings?.lastError?' · 最近错误：'+settings.lastError:''}</p></>}</section><section className="v2-card"><h3>手动同步</h3><div className="v2-row"><label>本地询盘<select value={inquiryId} onChange={e=>setInquiryId(e.target.value)}><option value="">选择一条询盘</option>{inquiries.map(x=><option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.name} · {x.company||x.email} · {x.inquiry_number}</option>)}</select></label><button disabled={work.busy||!inquiryId} onClick={()=>queue('push')}>推送此询盘</button>{canAdmin&&<button disabled={work.busy} className="v2-card"><h3>待处理冲突</h3>{data.conflicts.length?data.conflicts.map((x:Item)=><div className="v21-record" key={x.id}><strong>{x.name||x.remote_name||'远端新线索'}</strong><small>发现时间：{when(x.created_at)}</small><p>本地：{x.name?([x.name,x.local_email,x.local_company||'无公司',x.local_status].join(' · ')):'尚未关联'}</p><p>CRM：{[x.remote_name,x.remote_email,x.remote_company||'无公司',x.remote_status].join(' · ')}</p>{!x.inquiry_id&&<label>关联本地询盘<select value={conflictChoice[x.id]||''} onChange={e=>setConflictChoice({...conflictChoice,[x.id]:e.target.value})}><option value="">不关联，作为新询盘导入</option>{inquiries.map(y=><option key={y.id} value={y.id}>{y.name} · {y.company||y.email} · {y.inquiry_number}</option>)}</select></label>}<div className="v21-actions">{x.inquiry_id&&<button onClick={()=>resolve(x.id,'keep_local')}>保留本地并推送</button>}<button onClick={()=>resolve(x.id,'use_remote')}>采用 CRM 记录</button></div></div>):<Empty>目前没有同步冲突。</Empty>}</section><section className="v2-card"><h3>最近同步任务</h3>{data.jobs.length?data.jobs.map((x:Item)=><div className="v2-list-row" key={x.id}><span><strong>{x.direction==='pull'?'拉取远端线索':`推送 ${x.name||x.inquiry_number||'询盘'}`}</strong><small>{x.status} · 尝试 {x.attempt_count}/5 · {when(x.created_at)}{x.error_message?' · '+x.error_message:''}</small></span>{x.status==='failed'&&<button onClick={()=>retry(x.id)}>重试</button>}</div>):<Empty>启用连接或手动同步后，任务会显示在这里。</Empty>}</section></>;
}

function Feedback({error,notice}:{error:string;notice:string}){return <>{error&&<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="v21-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}</>;}

'use client';
import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
import {apiRequest} from './api-client';
import './v2-workspaces.css';

type Locale={id:string;code:string;native_name:string};
type Item=Record<string,any>;
const get=(path:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path);
const post=(path:string,body:Item,method?:string)=>apiRequest('v2/'+path,body,method);
function ErrorLine({text}:{text:string}){return text?<p className="v2-error" role="alert">{text}</p>:null;}
function Empty({children}:{children:React.ReactNode}){return <div className="v2-empty">{children}</div>;}
function fmt(value:unknown){if(value==null)return '—';if(typeof value==='string')return value;return JSON.stringify(value,null,2);}
function date(value:string){return new Date(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN');}
function useBusy(){const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState('');async function run(fn:()=>Promise<void>){setBusy(true);setError('');try{await fn();}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'操作失败');}finally{setBusy(false);}}return {busy,error,run};}

export function ReviewWorkspace({canPublish,onOpenContent,initial}:{canPublish:boolean;onOpenContent:(table:string,title:string)=>void;initial?:{entityType:string;id:string}}){
 const [items,setItems]=useState<Item[]>([]),[entityType,setEntityType]=useState(initial?.entityType||'content_item_translations'),[id,setId]=useState(initial?.id||'');
 const [review,setReview]=useState<Item|null>(null),[preview,setPreview]=useState<Item|null>(null),[scheduled,setScheduled]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
 const {busy,error,run}=useBusy();

 useEffect(()=>{if(initial?.id){setId(initial.id);setEntityType(initial.entityType);}},[initial?.id,initial?.entityType]);
 const options=items.filter(x=>x.entity_type===entityType);
 async function inspect(){if(!id)return;await run(async()=>{const [a,b]=await Promise.all([get('seo?entityType='+entityType+'&id='+id),get('preview?entityType='+entityType+'&id='+id)]);setReview(a);setPreview(b);setNotice('');});}
 async function publish(){await run(async()=>{await apiRequest('publish',{resource:entityType,id,scheduledAt:scheduled?new Date(scheduled).toISOString():undefined});setNotice(scheduled?'定时发布任务已提交，请到发布记录确认。':'发布任务已提交，请到发布记录确认。');});}
 async function rollback(jobId:string){if(!confirm('确认将公开页面恢复到所选发布版本？当前编辑中的草稿仍会保留。'))return;await run(async()=>{await post('rollback',{jobId});setNotice('回滚任务已提交；完成后公开页面更新。');});}
 const selected=items.find(x=>x.id===id);
 return <div className="v2"><div className="v2-hero"><p>REVIEW & RELEASE</p><h2>发布前，看清每一处变化</h2><span>检查搜索展示、预览真实 HTML，再决定何时发布。</span></div><ErrorLine text={error}/>{notice&&<p className="v2-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
  <section className="v2-card"><div className="v2-row"><label>内容类型<select value={entityType} onChange={e=>{setEntityType(e.target.value);setId('');setReview(null);setPreview(null);}}><option value="content_item_translations">页面与文章</option><option value="product_translations">产品</option></select></label><label>选择内容<select value={id} onChange={e=>{setId(e.target.value);setReview(null);setPreview(null);}}><option value="">请选择内容</option>{options.map(x=><option value={x.id} key={x.id}>{x.title} · {x.path}</option>)}</select></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={!id||busy} onClick={inspect}>{busy?'加载中…':'检查并预览'}</button></div></section>
  {review&&preview&&<><div className="v2-two"><section className="v2-card"><div className="v2-card-title"><p>SEO 诊断</p><strong>{review.score}<small> / 100</small></strong></div><h3>{review.title}</h3><p className="v2-muted">{review.route} · {date(review.checkedAt)}</p>{review.issues.length?review.issues.map((x:Item)=><div className="v2-issue" key={x.key}><span className={'v2-severity '+x.severity}>{x.severity==='error'?'错误':x.severity==='warning'?'建议':'提示'}</span><div><strong>{x.label}</strong><p>{x.detail}</p><button onClick={()=>onOpenContent(x.fixResource,x.fixResource===entityType?selected?.title||'':'')}>前往修复 →</button></div></div>):<p>当前规则未发现问题。</p>}<button onClick={()=>onOpenContent(entityType,selected?.title||'')}>打开内容编辑 →</button></section><section className="v2-card"><p className="v2-kicker">页面预览</p><h3>草稿的实际渲染</h3><iframe title="页面草稿预览" sandbox="" srcDoc={preview.html} className="v2-frame"/><p className="v2-muted">预览禁用脚本。公开页面仍以发布任务完成后的静态文件为准。</p></section></div>
   <section className="v2-card"><div className="v2-card-title"><div><p>变更与发布</p><h3>当前草稿和公开版本</h3></div><span className="v2-count">{preview.differences.length} 项变化</span></div>{preview.released?preview.differences.map((x:Item)=><details className="v2-diff" key={x.key}><summary>{x.label} 已修改</summary><div><div><small>当前公开</small><pre>{fmt(x.before)}</pre></div><div><small>待发布</small><pre>{fmt(x.after)}</pre></div></div></details>):<Empty>这条内容尚未发布。首次发布后才会出现在公开站点。</Empty>}
    {canPublish&&<div className="v2-release"><label>定时发布 <small>留空则立即提交</small><input type="datetime-local" value={scheduled} onChange={e=>setScheduled(e.target.value)}/></label><button className="v2-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={publish}>{scheduled?'提交定时发布':'提交发布'}</button></div>}
    {canPublish&&preview.revisions?.length>0&&<details className="v2-history"><summary>历史发布版本 · {preview.revisions.length}</summary>{preview.revisions.map((r:Item)=><div key={r.id}><span>{r.title} · {date(r.created_at)}</span><button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>rollback(r.id)}>恢复此公开版本</button></div>)}</details>}
   </section></>}
 </div>;
}

export function TranslationTools({locales,onOpenTarget}:{locales:Locale[];onOpenTarget:(path:string,table:string)=>void}){
 const [terms,setTerms]=useState<Item[]>([]),[memory,setMemory]=useState<Item[]>([]),[jobs,setJobs]=useState<Item[]>([]),[selected,setSelected]=useState<string[]>([]),[inspected,setInspected]=useState<string[]>([]),[compare,setCompare]=useState<Item|null>(null);

export function InquiryDesk(){
 const [rows,setRows]=useState<Item[]>([]),[users,setUsers]=useState<Item[]>([]),[detail,setDetail]=useState<Item|null>(null),[status,setStatus]=useState('new'),[assignee,setAssignee]=useState(''),[followUp,setFollowUp]=useState(''),[note,setNote]=useState(''),[reply,setReply]=useState('');

贸易条款：{detail.inquiry.preferred_incoterm||'待确认'}</p>{detail.inquiry.specification_notes&&<p>规格 / 定制：{detail.inquiry.specification_notes}</p>}{detail.items?.length>0&&<><h4>询价产品</h4><ul>{detail.items.map((item:Item,i:number)=><li key={i}>{item.product_name_snapshot} · {item.sku_snapshot||'无 SKU'}
