## database/014_v2_workflows.sql

````sql
-- V2.0 operational records. Historical migrations remain immutable.
CREATE TABLE translation_terms (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),source_locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),target_locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),
 source_term text NOT NULL,target_term text NOT NULL,note text,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(source_locale_id<>target_locale_id),CHECK(length(trim(source_term)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),CHECK(length(trim(target_term)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_translation_terms_pair ON translation_terms(source_locale_id,target_locale_id,lower(source_term));
CREATE TABLE translation_memory (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),source_locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),target_locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),
 source_hash char(64) NOT NULL,source_text text NOT NULL,target_text text NOT NULL,approved_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(source_locale_id,target_locale_id,source_hash),CHECK(source_locale_id<>target_locale_id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_translation_memory_lookup ON translation_memory(source_locale_id,target_locale_id,source_hash);

CREATE TABLE keyword_imports (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),property_url text NOT NULL,locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),
 date_start date NOT NULL,date_end date NOT NULL,source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'search_console_csv' CHECK(source='search_console_csv'),
 row_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(row_count>=0),imported_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),CHECK(date_end>=date_start)
);
CREATE TABLE keyword_observations (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),import_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES keyword_imports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 query_text text NOT NULL,page_url text NOT NULL,clicks integer NOT NULL CHECK(clicks>=0),impressions integer NOT NULL CHECK(impressions>=0),
 ctr numeric(7,6) NOT NULL CHECK(ctr BETWEEN 0 AND 1),position numeric(8,3) NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0),
 UNIQUE(import_id,query_text,page_url)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_keyword_imports_date ON keyword_imports(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_keyword_observations_query ON keyword_observations USING gin(query_text gin_trgm_ops);

CREATE TABLE competitor_pages (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),url text NOT NULL UNIQUE,label text NOT NULL,locale_id uuid REFERENCES locales(id),
 created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),last_checked_at timestamptz
);
CREATE TABLE competitor_snapshots (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),page_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES competitor_pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 title text,description text,canonical_url text,headings jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',content_hash char(64) NOT NULL,
 fetched_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),CHECK(jsonb_typeof(headings)='array')
);
CREATE INDEX ix_competitor_snapshots_page_time ON competitor_snapshots(page_id,fetched_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE geo_prompts (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),market text NOT NULL,prompt text NOT NULL,
 brand_name text NOT NULL,is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(length(trim(market)) BETWEEN 2 AND 80),CHECK(length(trim(prompt)) BETWEEN 10 AND 1000)
);
CREATE TABLE geo_samples (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),prompt_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo_prompts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 model text NOT NULL,answer text NOT NULL,citations jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',brand_mentioned boolean NOT NULL,
 usage jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',duration_ms integer NOT NULL CHECK(duration_ms>=0),sampled_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(jsonb_typeof(citations)='array')
);
CREATE INDEX ix_geo_samples_prompt_time ON geo_samples(prompt_id,sampled_at DESC);

ALTER TABLE inquiries ADD COLUMN next_follow_up_at timestamptz;
CREATE INDEX ix_inquiries_follow_up ON inquiries(next_follow_up_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND next_follow_up_at IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TABLE inquiry_notes (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),inquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 note text NOT NULL,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(length(trim(note)) BETWEEN 2 AND 4000)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_inquiry_notes_history ON inquiry_notes(inquiry_id,created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE ai_assistant_runs (

 entity_id uuid NOT NULL,task text NOT NULL CHECK(task IN ('writing','translation','seo')),
 instruction text NOT NULL,result text NOT NULL,model text NOT NULL,usage jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',duration_ms integer NOT NULL CHECK(duration_ms>=0),

);
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_assistant_runs_actor_time ON ai_assistant_runs(requested_by,created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE ai_writing_runs (

 CHECK(jsonb_typeof(generated_draft)='object')
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_writing_runs_actor_time ON ai_writing_runs(requested_by,created_at DESC);

CREATE TRIGGER trg_translation_memory_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON translation_memory FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
````

````sql
 source_url text NOT NULL,target_url text NOT NULL,first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 verification_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified' CHECK(verification_status IN ('unverified','verified','lost')),
 recorded_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(partner_id,source_url,target_url)
);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_outreach_partners_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON outreach_partners FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_outreach_drafts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON outreach_drafts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE crm_sync_links (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),inquiry_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES inquiries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 external_id text UNIQUE,last_local_updated_at timestamptz,last_remote_updated_at timestamptz,
 last_synced_at timestamptz,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE crm_sync_jobs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),direction text NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('push','pull')),
 inquiry_id uuid REFERENCES inquiries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','processing','completed','failed','conflict')),
 attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5),next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 error_message text,requested_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(direction='pull' OR inquiry_id IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_sync_jobs_due ON crm_sync_jobs(next_attempt_at,created_at) WHERE status IN ('pending','failed');
CREATE TABLE crm_sync_conflicts (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),inquiry_id uuid REFERENCES inquiries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 external_id text NOT NULL,remote_record jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(remote_record)='object'),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(status IN ('open','keep_local','use_remote')),
 resolved_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,resolved_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_sync_conflicts_open ON crm_sync_conflicts(created_at DESC) WHERE status='open';
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_sync_links_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON crm_sync_links FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_sync_jobs_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON crm_sync_jobs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

````

## database/016_ai_agent.sql

````sql
-- V3 editorial agent: bounded plans, tool evidence and human decisions.
CREATE TABLE ai_agent_runs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 entity_type text NOT NULL CHECK(entity_type IN ('content_item_translations','product_translations')),
 entity_id uuid NOT NULL,
 objective text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(objective)) BETWEEN 10 AND 1500),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','planning','running','awaiting_approval','approved','applied','rejected','failed','cancelled')),
 max_steps integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK(max_steps BETWEEN 2 AND 8),
 token_budget integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 8000 CHECK(token_budget BETWEEN 3000 AND 16000),
 tokens_used integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(tokens_used>=0),
 calls_used integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(calls_used BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
 plan jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(jsonb_typeof(plan)='array'),
 proposal jsonb CHECK(proposal IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(proposal)='object'),
 source_updated_at timestamptz,
 model text,error_message text,
 requested_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 review_note text,reviewed_at timestamptz,
 applied_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,applied_at timestamptz,
 rating integer CHECK(rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),outcome_note text CHECK(outcome_note IS NULL OR length(outcome_note)<=1000),
 started_at timestamptz,finished_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_agent_runs_queue ON ai_agent_runs(created_at) WHERE status='pending';
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_agent_runs_owner ON ai_agent_runs(requested_by,created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_agent_runs_target ON ai_agent_runs(entity_type,entity_id,created_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ai_agent_runs_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON ai_agent_runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE ai_agent_steps (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 ordinal integer NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
 tool text NOT NULL CHECK(tool IN ('read_content','seo_review','keyword_evidence','competitor_evidence','geo_evidence','draft_proposal')),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','completed','failed')),
 rationale text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',result jsonb,token_usage jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 error_message text,started_at timestamptz,finished_at timestamptz,
 UNIQUE(run_id,ordinal)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_agent_steps_run ON ai_agent_steps(run_id,ordinal);

CREATE TABLE ai_agent_decisions (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 action text NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('approve','reject','apply','cancel','publish','rate')),
 actor_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,note text,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ai_agent_decisions_run ON ai_agent_decisions(run_id,created_at);

````

## database/017_geo_monitoring.sql

````sql
-- V3 GEO monitoring. Existing geo_prompts/geo_samples remain available for legacy views.
CREATE TABLE geo_model_profiles (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),code text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,39}$'),
 display_name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(display_name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 100),provider text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(provider)) BETWEEN 2 AND 80),
 model text NOT NULL,endpoint text NOT NULL,credential_source text NOT NULL CHECK(credential_source IN ('site_default','profile')),
 key_cipher text,has_credential boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 input_usd_per_million numeric(12,6) NOT NULL CHECK(input_usd_per_million>=0),
 output_usd_per_million numeric(12,6) NOT NULL CHECK(output_usd_per_million>=0),
 max_output_tokens integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1200 CHECK(max_output_tokens BETWEEN 300 AND 3000),
 is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(credential_source='site_default' OR has_credential)
);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_geo_model_profiles_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON geo_model_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE geo_regions (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),code text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,39}$'),
 display_name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(display_name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 100),
 country_code text CHECK(country_code IS NULL OR country_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'),
 description text,is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

INSERT INTO geo_regions(code,display_name,description) VALUES('local','本地服务器','使用当前 Worker 的出站网络；不代表目标市场所在地区。');

CREATE TABLE geo_worker_heartbeats (
 worker_id text PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(worker_id) BETWEEN 2 AND 120),
 region_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo_regions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(worker_id !~ '[[:space:]]')
);
CREATE INDEX ix_geo_worker_heartbeats_region ON geo_worker_heartbeats(region_id,last_seen_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE geo_monitor_targets (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),prompt_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo_prompts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

 region_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo_regions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 interval_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1440 CHECK(interval_minutes BETWEEN 60 AND 10080),
 is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,next_run_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 last_run_at timestamptz,last_error text,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,

 UNIQUE(prompt_id,model_profile_id,region_id)
);

CREATE TRIGGER trg_geo_monitor_targets_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON geo_monitor_targets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE geo_monitor_budget (
 singleton_key boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK(singleton_key),
 daily_limit_usd numeric(12,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK(daily_limit_usd BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000),
 monthly_limit_usd numeric(12,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(monthly_limit_usd BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000),
 max_queued_jobs integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 500 CHECK(max_queued_jobs BETWEEN 1 AND 100000),
 is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,updated_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO geo_monitor_budget(singleton_key) VALUES(true);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_geo_monitor_budget_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON geo_monitor_budget FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE geo_budget_windows (

 spent_usd numeric(16,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(spent_usd>=0),

 PRIMARY KEY(period,starts_on)
);

CREATE TABLE geo_sample_jobs (
````

## database/019_full_crm.sql

````sql
-- V3 CRM: customer identity, sales pipeline, collaboration and durable history.
CREATE TABLE crm_accounts (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 200),
 country text,
 dedupe_key text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (lower(btrim(name)) || '|' || lower(coalesce(btrim(country),''))) STORED UNIQUE,
 website text, phone text, description text,
 owner_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','archived')),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_accounts_name ON crm_accounts USING gin(name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_accounts_owner ON crm_accounts(owner_id,status);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_accounts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON crm_accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE crm_contacts (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 email citext NOT NULL UNIQUE,name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
 phone text,title text,owner_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','archived')),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_contacts_name ON crm_contacts USING gin(name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_contacts_owner ON crm_contacts(owner_id,status);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_contacts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON crm_contacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE crm_account_contacts (
 account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),PRIMARY KEY(account_id,contact_id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_account_contacts_contact ON crm_account_contacts(contact_id,account_id);

ALTER TABLE inquiries ADD COLUMN crm_account_id uuid REFERENCES crm_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE inquiries ADD COLUMN crm_contact_id uuid REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_inquiries_crm_account ON inquiries(crm_account_id,created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_inquiries_crm_contact ON inquiries(crm_contact_id,created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE FUNCTION crm_link_inquiry() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE linked_account uuid;linked_contact uuid;
BEGIN
 IF length(btrim(coalesce(NEW.company,'')))>=2 THEN
  INSERT INTO crm_accounts(name,country) VALUES(btrim(NEW.company),nullif(btrim(NEW.country),''))
  ON CONFLICT(dedupe_key) DO NOTHING;
  SELECT id INTO linked_account FROM crm_accounts
   WHERE dedupe_key=lower(btrim(NEW.company)) || '|' || lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(NEW.country),''),''));
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO crm_contacts(email,name,phone) VALUES(NEW.email,left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(NEW.name),''),NEW.email::text),160),NEW.phone)
 ON CONFLICT(email) DO NOTHING;
 SELECT id INTO linked_contact FROM crm_contacts WHERE email=NEW.email;
 NEW.crm_account_id=linked_account;NEW.crm_contact_id=linked_contact;
 IF linked_account IS NOT NULL AND linked_contact IS NOT NULL THEN
  INSERT INTO crm_account_contacts(account_id,contact_id) VALUES(linked_account,linked_contact) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_link_inquiry BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF email,name,company,country,phone ON inquiries
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION crm_link_inquiry();

-- Preserve the original inquiry timestamps while linking historical records.
ALTER TABLE inquiries DISABLE TRIGGER trg_inquiries_updated_at;
UPDATE inquiries SET email=email WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE inquiries ENABLE TRIGGER trg_inquiries_updated_at;

CREATE TABLE crm_opportunities (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 title text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(title)) BETWEEN 2 AND 200),
 account_id uuid REFERENCES crm_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 inquiry_id uuid REFERENCES inquiries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK(stage IN ('new','qualified','proposal','negotiation','won','lost')),
 amount numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(amount>=0),
 currency char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD' CHECK(currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
 probability integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK(probability BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
 owner_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 expected_close_on date,next_action text,next_action_at timestamptz,
 loss_reason text,closed_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),deleted_at timestamptz,
 CHECK(stage<>'lost' OR length(btrim(coalesce(loss_reason,'')))>=2)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_opportunities_stage ON crm_opportunities(stage,updated_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_opportunities_owner ON crm_opportunities(owner_id,stage,next_action_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_opportunities_contact ON crm_opportunities(contact_id,created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_opportunities_account ON crm_opportunities(account_id,created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_opportunities_title ON crm_opportunities USING gin(title gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_opportunities_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON crm_opportunities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE crm_opportunity_members (
 opportunity_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_opportunities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 added_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),PRIMARY KEY(opportunity_id,user_id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_members_user ON crm_opportunity_members(user_id,created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE crm_tasks (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 opportunity_id uuid REFERENCES crm_opportunities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 contact_id uuid REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 title text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(title)) BETWEEN 2 AND 200),
 description text,assigned_to uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 due_at timestamptz,status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(status IN ('open','done','cancelled')),
 completed_at timestamptz,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(opportunity_id IS NOT NULL OR contact_id IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_tasks_due ON crm_tasks(assigned_to,due_at) WHERE status='open';
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_tasks_opportunity ON crm_tasks(opportunity_id,created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_tasks_contact ON crm_tasks(contact_id,created_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_tasks_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON crm_tasks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE crm_activities (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 opportunity_id uuid REFERENCES crm_opportunities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 contact_id uuid REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 account_id uuid REFERENCES crm_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('note','call','email','meeting')),
 summary text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(summary)) BETWEEN 2 AND 200),
 detail text,occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(opportunity_id IS NOT NULL OR contact_id IS NOT NULL OR account_id IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_activities_opportunity ON crm_activities(opportunity_id,occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_activities_contact ON crm_activities(contact_id,occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_activities_account ON crm_activities(account_id,occurred_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE crm_history (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 account_id uuid REFERENCES crm_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 contact_id uuid REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 opportunity_id uuid REFERENCES crm_opportunities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 inquiry_id uuid REFERENCES inquiries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 task_id uuid REFERENCES crm_tasks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 event_type text NOT NULL,summary text NOT NULL,details jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
 actor_id uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_history_account ON crm_history(account_id,created_at DESC,id DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_history_contact ON crm_history(contact_id,created_at DESC,id DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_history_opportunity ON crm_history(opportunity_id,created_at DESC,id DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_history_inquiry ON crm_history(inquiry_id,created_at DESC,id DESC);

INSERT INTO crm_history(account_id,contact_id,inquiry_id,event_type,summary,details,created_at)
 SELECT crm_account_id,crm_contact_id,id,'lead_received','收到询盘',jsonb_build_object('number',inquiry_number,'status',status),created_at
 FROM inquiries WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
INSERT INTO crm_history(account_id,contact_id,inquiry_id,event_type,summary,details,actor_id,created_at)
 SELECT i.crm_account_id,i.crm_contact_id,i.id,'lead_note','询盘跟进备注',jsonb_build_object('note',n.note),n.created_by,n.created_at
 FROM inquiry_notes n JOIN inquiries i ON i.id=n.inquiry_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE FUNCTION crm_record_inquiry() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  INSERT INTO crm_history(account_id,contact_id,inquiry_id,event_type,summary,details,created_at)
  VALUES(NEW.crm_account_id,NEW.crm_contact_id,NEW.id,'lead_received','收到询盘',jsonb_build_object('number',NEW.inquiry_number,'status',NEW.status),NEW.created_at);
 ELSIF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status OR OLD.assigned_to IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.assigned_to
   OR OLD.email IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.email OR OLD.company IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.company
   OR OLD.crm_contact_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.crm_contact_id OR OLD.crm_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.crm_account_id THEN
  INSERT INTO crm_history(account_id,contact_id,inquiry_id,event_type,summary,details)
  VALUES(NEW.crm_account_id,NEW.crm_contact_id,NEW.id,'lead_updated','询盘信息更新',
   jsonb_build_object('oldStatus',OLD.status,'status',NEW.status,'oldAssignee',OLD.assigned_to,'assignee',NEW.assigned_to));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_record_inquiry AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status,assigned_to,email,company,name,phone,crm_contact_id,crm_account_id ON inquiries
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION crm_record_inquiry();

CREATE FUNCTION crm_record_inquiry_note() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO crm_history(account_id,contact_id,inquiry_id,event_type,summary,details,actor_id,created_at)
 SELECT i.crm_account_id,i.crm_contact_id,i.id,'lead_note','询盘跟进备注',jsonb_build_object('note',NEW.note),NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at
 FROM inquiries i WHERE i.id=NEW.inquiry_id;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_crm_record_inquiry_note AFTER INSERT ON inquiry_notes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION crm_record_inquiry_note();

````

## database/020_marketing_automation.sql

````sql
-- Explicit marketing consent is separate from inquiry privacy consent.
CREATE TABLE marketing_consents (
 contact_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK(state IN ('unknown','granted','revoked')),
 source text, evidence text,granted_at timestamptz,revoked_at timestamptz,
 updated_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(state<>'granted' OR (length(btrim(coalesce(source,'')))>=2 AND length(btrim(coalesce(evidence,'')))>=5 AND granted_at IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_marketing_consents_state ON marketing_consents(state,updated_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_marketing_consents_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON marketing_consents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
CREATE TABLE marketing_consent_events (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 previous_state text NOT NULL,new_state text NOT NULL,source text,evidence text,
 changed_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_marketing_consent_events_contact ON marketing_consent_events(contact_id,created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE marketing_segments (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),name text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(btrim(name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 120),
 criteria jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(criteria)='object'),
 is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_marketing_segments_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON marketing_segments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE marketing_settings (
 singleton_key boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK(singleton_key),
 is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 max_per_7_days integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(max_per_7_days BETWEEN 0 AND 10),
 max_per_30_days integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 4 CHECK(max_per_30_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30),
 global_daily_cap integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 CHECK(global_daily_cap BETWEEN 0 AND 100000),
 updated_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO marketing_settings(singleton_key) VALUES(true);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_marketing_settings_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON marketing_settings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE marketing_campaigns (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),code text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,59}$'),
 name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 160),
 segment_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES marketing_segments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 trigger_type text NOT NULL CHECK(trigger_type IN ('manual','lead_received','stage_changed')),
 subject text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(subject)) BETWEEN 2 AND 200),
 body text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(body)) BETWEEN 10 AND 10000),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','active','paused','completed')),
 cooldown_days integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 CHECK(cooldown_days BETWEEN 0 AND 365),
 daily_cap integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(daily_cap BETWEEN 0 AND 100000),
 activated_at timestamptz,manual_cursor uuid,manual_done boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,next_scan_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 event_cursor_at timestamptz,event_cursor_id uuid,
 created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_marketing_campaigns_active ON marketing_campaigns(trigger_type,created_at) WHERE status='active';
CREATE TRIGGER trg_marketing_campaigns_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON marketing_campaigns FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE marketing_deliveries (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),campaign_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES marketing_campaigns(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 contact_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 source_event_id uuid REFERENCES crm_history(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 dedupe_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','sending','sent','failed','skipped')),
 attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
 scheduled_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 started_at timestamptz,sent_at timestamptz,error_message text,skip_reason text,provider_response jsonb,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_marketing_deliveries_queue ON marketing_deliveries(next_attempt_at,created_at) WHERE status IN ('pending','failed');
CREATE INDEX ix_marketing_deliveries_contact_sent ON marketing_deliveries(contact_id,sent_at DESC) WHERE status='sent';
CREATE INDEX ix_marketing_deliveries_campaign ON marketing_deliveries(campaign_id,status,created_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_marketing_deliveries_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON marketing_deliveries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

````

````sql
-- Immutable, traceable reporting snapshots. Definitions describe fixed queries in packages/domain/src/bi.ts.
CREATE TABLE bi_metric_definitions (
 code text PRIMARY KEY,label text NOT NULL,unit text NOT NULL,formula text NOT NULL,
 source_tables text[] NOT NULL,version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0),
 is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO bi_metric_definitions(code,label,unit,formula,source_tables) VALUES
('leads_received','收到询盘','count','在 UTC 日期范围内创建且未软删除的询盘数量。按内容语言分组。',ARRAY['inquiries']),
('leads_qualified_current','当前有效询盘','count','在范围内收到、当前状态为 qualified/replied/closed 的询盘数量；状态是生成报告时的快照。',ARRAY['inquiries']),
('opportunities_created','新增商机','count','在范围内创建且未软删除的商机数量，按创建时报告所见销售阶段分组。',ARRAY['crm_opportunities']),
('pipeline_open_current','当前开放商机','count','在范围内创建、报告生成时阶段未成交也未丢单的商机数量；按当前阶段分组。',ARRAY['crm_opportunities']),
('deals_won','成交商机','count','在范围内关闭且报告生成时处于 won 阶段的商机数量。',ARRAY['crm_opportunities']),
('won_amount','成交金额','money','成交商机的原币金额之和；每种币种单独分组，不做汇率换算。',ARRAY['crm_opportunities']),
('marketing_sent','营销发送','count','范围内发送接口确认接收的营销投递数；不代表最终到达收件箱。按活动分组。',ARRAY['marketing_deliveries']),
('marketing_optouts','营销退订','count','范围内由已同意变为退订的同意事件数。',ARRAY['marketing_consent_events']),
('geo_cost','GEO 模型估算成本','USD','范围内 GEO 采样按 token 单价估算的美元成本；按地区和模型分组。',ARRAY['geo_samples']),
('tasks_completed','完成跟进任务','count','范围内标记完成的 CRM 跟进任务数；按执行人分组。',ARRAY['crm_tasks']),
('publishes_completed','完成发布任务','count','范围内完成的静态发布任务数；按任务类型分组。',ARRAY['publish_jobs']);

CREATE TABLE bi_report_runs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 160),
 date_from date NOT NULL,date_to date NOT NULL CHECK(date_to>=date_from),timezone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC' CHECK(timezone='UTC'),
 definition_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,definitions_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
 created_by uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 source_rows integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(source_rows>=0)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_bi_report_runs_time ON bi_report_runs(created_at DESC);
CREATE TABLE bi_report_values (
 report_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bi_report_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 metric_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES bi_metric_definitions(code),dimension text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',
 value numeric(22,6) NOT NULL,source_count integer NOT NULL CHECK(source_count>=0),
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,metric_code,dimension)
);
CREATE TABLE bi_report_lineage (
 report_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bi_report_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 metric_code text NOT NULL REFERENCES bi_metric_definitions(code),
 source_table text NOT NULL,source_id uuid NOT NULL,dimension text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',
 item_label text NOT NULL,occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,value numeric(22,6) NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,metric_code,source_table,source_id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_bi_lineage_drilldown ON bi_report_lineage(report_id,metric_code,dimension,occurred_at DESC);

````

## database/023_trade_operations.sql

````sql
-- Quotation content is an immutable revision; workflow state is separate.
CREATE TABLE trade_quotes (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), inquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiries(id),
 opportunity_id uuid REFERENCES crm_opportunities(id), version integer NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
 currency text NOT NULL CHECK(currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
 incoterm text NOT NULL CHECK(incoterm IN ('EXW','FCA','FOB','CFR','CIF','CPT','CIP','DAP','DPU','DDP')),
 valid_until date NOT NULL, terms text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(terms)<=5000),
 lines jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(lines)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(lines) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
 total numeric(20,2) NOT NULL CHECK(total>=0),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','review','approved','sent','accepted','rejected','void')),
 created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), sent_at timestamptz,
 UNIQUE(inquiry_id,version)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_trade_quotes_inquiry ON trade_quotes(inquiry_id,created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ix_trade_quotes_deal ON trade_quotes(opportunity_id);
CREATE FUNCTION trade_quote_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 IF ROW(NEW.inquiry_id,NEW.opportunity_id,NEW.version,NEW.currency,NEW.incoterm,NEW.valid_until,NEW.terms,NEW.lines,NEW.total,NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at)
 IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.inquiry_id,OLD.opportunity_id,OLD.version,OLD.currency,OLD.incoterm,OLD.valid_until,OLD.terms,OLD.lines,OLD.total,OLD.created_by,OLD.created_at) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Create a new quote revision instead of changing its content'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_trade_quote_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_quotes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trade_quote_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_trade_quotes_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_quotes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
CREATE TABLE trade_quote_events (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), quote_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES trade_quotes(id),
 action text NOT NULL, note text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', actor_id uuid REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_trade_quote_events ON trade_quote_events(quote_id,created_at);
CREATE TABLE trade_portal_grants (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), inquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiries(id),
 token_hash text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(token_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 recipient text NOT NULL CHECK(length(recipient) BETWEEN 1 AND 254),
 role text NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('customer','partner')), expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 revoked_at timestamptz, created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_trade_grants_inquiry ON trade_portal_grants(inquiry_id);
CREATE TABLE trade_market_cards (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),
 country text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(country='' OR country ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'),
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('market','certificate','case','service')),
 title text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(title)) BETWEEN 2 AND 160),
 summary text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(summary)) BETWEEN 2 AND 2000),
 source_url text NOT NULL CHECK(source_url ~ '^https://' OR source_url ~ '^/[^/]'),
 source_hash text, valid_until date, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'review' CHECK(status IN ('review','published','withdrawn')),
 created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES users(id),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(kind<>'certificate' OR valid_until IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_trade_market_public ON trade_market_cards(locale_id,country,kind) WHERE status='published';
CREATE TRIGGER trg_trade_market_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_market_cards FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
CREATE TABLE trade_service_rules (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id),
 country text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(country='' OR country ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'),
 response_hours integer NOT NULL CHECK(response_hours BETWEEN 1 AND 720),
 updated_by uuid REFERENCES users(id), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(locale_id,country)
);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_trade_service_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_service_rules FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE inquiries ADD COLUMN first_response_at timestamptz;
ALTER TABLE inquiries ADD COLUMN response_due_at timestamptz;
CREATE FUNCTION trade_inquiry_sla() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE hours integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT response_hours INTO hours FROM trade_service_rules WHERE locale_id=NEW.locale_id AND country IN ('',upper(coalesce(NEW.country,''))) ORDER BY length(country) DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF hours IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.response_due_at=NEW.created_at+make_interval(hours=>hours); END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_trade_inquiry_sla BEFORE INSERT ON inquiries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trade_inquiry_sla();
CREATE TABLE trade_visits (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY, locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES locales(id), source text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(source)<=200),
 path text NOT NULL CHECK(length(path)<=1000), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ix_trade_visits_created ON trade_visits(created_at,locale_id);
ALTER TABLE inquiries ADD COLUMN visit_id uuid REFERENCES trade_visits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_inquiries_visit ON inquiries(visit_id) WHERE visit_id IS NOT NULL;

````

## database/024_add_client_role.sql

````sql
-- 新增「客户运营」角色：面向 B 端商家自助运营。
-- 只开放内容/产品/媒体/外观（改首页）的读写 + 询盘读取 + 自助发布（publishing.write）。
-- publishing.write 同时赋予全站重建能力（rebuildSite 仅重渲染公开页，无破坏性），
-- 这是「AI 生成 → 一键发布」闭环成立的前提（见 docs/后台易用性改造方案.md 第 8.3 节）。
INSERT INTO roles(code,name,description,is_system) VALUES
 ('client','客户运营','Self-service storefront operator',true)
ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO role_permissions(role_id,permission_id)
SELECT r.id,p.id FROM roles r CROSS JOIN permissions p
WHERE r.code='client' AND p.code IN (
 'content.read','content.write',
 'product.read','product.write',
 'media.read','media.write',
 'appearance.read','appearance.write',
 'leads.read',
 'publishing.read','publishing.write'
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

````

## database/verify.sql

````sql
-- Run after 001..010. Raises an exception if expected schema features are missing.
DO $$
DECLARE missing text;
BEGIN
 SELECT string_agg(x.name, ', ') INTO missing
 FROM (VALUES
  ('locales'),('site_settings'),('users'),('roles'),('permissions'),('audit_logs'),
  ('content_items'),('content_item_translations'),('content_blocks'),('content_revisions'),
  ('taxonomies'),('taxonomy_terms'),('faq_items'),('products'),('product_translations'),
  ('product_spec_values'),('media_assets'),('seo_metadata'),('geo_profiles'),('schema_markup'),
  ('hero_slides'),('menus'),('customer_service_channels'),('publish_jobs'),('static_routes'),
  ('redirects'),('inquiries'),('inquiry_items'),('integration_connections')
 ) AS x(name)
 WHERE to_regclass('public.'||x.name) IS NULL;
 IF missing IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Missing required tables: %', missing; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM locales) < 9 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected at least 9 seeded locales'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgname LIKE 'trg\_%\_updated\_at' ESCAPE '\') < 20 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'updated_at triggers are missing'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND indexname='ix_content_search_vector') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Content GIN search index is missing'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND indexname='uq_content_locale_path_live') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Content localized route uniqueness index is missing'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='trg_product_path_redirect' AND NOT tgisinternal) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Product path redirect trigger is missing'; END IF;
 RAISE NOTICE 'CMS schema verification passed';
END $$;

````

## docker-compose.yml

````yaml
x-app-env: &app-env
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-suns}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Run pnpm run setup}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-suns}
  REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
  CMS_INTERNAL_URL: http://cms:3001
  MEDIA_DIR: /app/media
  STATIC_OUTPUT_DIR: /app/static-site
  TRUST_PROXY: "1"
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-suns}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-suns}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Run pnpm run setup}
      TZ: UTC
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:5432:5432"]
    volumes: ["postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--maxmemory-policy", "noeviction"]
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:6379:6379"]
    volumes: ["redis_data:/data"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
  init:
    image: suns-cms:local
    build: {context: ., dockerfile: infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile.cms}
    user: root
    env_file: .env
    environment: *app-env
    command: ["sh", "-c", "pnpm db:migrate && pnpm auth:migrate && mkdir -p /app/media /app/static-site && chown -R node:node /app/media /app/static-site"]
    volumes: ["media_data:/app/media", "static_data:/app/static-site"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: {condition: service_healthy}
  cms:
    image: suns-cms:local
    build: {context: ., dockerfile: infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile.cms}
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file: .env
    environment: *app-env
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:3001:3001"]
    volumes: ["media_data:/app/media"]
    depends_on:
      init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/v1/health').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
  web:
    build: {context: ., dockerfile: infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile.web}
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file: .env
    environment: *app-env
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:3000:3000"]
    depends_on:
      cms: {condition: service_healthy}
  worker:
    build: {context: ., dockerfile: infrastructure/docker/Dockerfile.worker}
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file: .env
    environment: *app-env
    volumes: ["media_data:/app/media:ro", "static_data:/app/static-site"]
    depends_on:
      init: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
      redis: {condition: service_healthy}
  nginx:
    image: nginx:stable-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports: ["8080:80"]
    environment:
      DEFAULT_LOCALE: ${DEFAULT_LOCALE:-en}
      NGINX_ENVSUBST_FILTER: DEFAULT_LOCALE
    volumes:
      - ./infrastructure/nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/templates/default.conf.template:ro
      - static_data:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    depends_on:
      cms: {condition: service_healthy}
volumes:
  postgres_data:
  redis_data:
  media_data:
  static_data:

````

## infrastructure/nginx/default.conf

````conf
server {
 listen 80;
 server_name _;
 root /usr/share/nginx/html;
 charset utf-8;
 client_max_body_size 26m;
 add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;
 add_header Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin always;
 gzip on;
 gzip_types text/css application/javascript application/json application/xml image/svg+xml;
 location = / { return 302 /${DEFAULT_LOCALE}; }
 location ~ ^/(admin|manage|api|media|graphql|_next|unsubscribe)(/|$) {
  proxy_pass http://cms:3001;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
  proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
  proxy_read_timeout 120s;
  add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
 }
 location ~ /\. { deny all; }
 location = /_redirects.json { deny all; }
 location = /manifest.json { deny all; }
 location /assets/ { try_files $uri =404; add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=300"; }
 location ~ ^/sitemap.*\.xml$ { try_files $uri =404; add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=60"; }
 location = /robots.txt { try_files $uri =404; add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=60"; }
 location / {
  try_files $uri/index.html $uri @resolve;
  add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=0, s-maxage=600, must-revalidate";
 }
 location @resolve {
  rewrite ^ /api/v1/resolve?path=$uri break;
  proxy_pass http://cms:3001;
  proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
  add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
 }
}

````

## infrastructure/scripts/assert-payload-schema.mjs

````javascript
/**
 * E-10 守卫：断言 Payload 的 `payload_internal` 已经 bootstrap 完成。
 *
 * 为什么需要它：CI 的 `pnpm auth:migrate` 步骤会**偶发零输出空跑** —— `payload migrate`
 * 跑满一次正常启动的时长（2026-10-01 实测 ~3.9s；历史记录的 0.3s 已证伪），却连
 * `No email adapter provided` 的 WARN 都没有（说明根本没跑起来/没加载 Payload config），
 * 于是 `payload_internal` 没被建出来；紧随其后的 `pnpm db:migrate` 会在 **025** 上报
 * `error: schema "payload_internal" does not exist`。
 *
 * ⚠️ 那个错误形状与 **E-8**（ci.yml 步骤顺序写错）**一模一样**，但根因不同。E-8 已修；
 *    本守卫的作用是把这个"静默空跑"变成**响亮失败**，并在报错里直接说清该查哪里、别改哪里。
 *    CI 里的常规路径已经换成 infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs（自断言 + 自动重试一次），
 *    本脚本是它重试仍失败时的"标准诊断出口"，也可单独手动运行。
 *
 * 用法：
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/assert-payload-schema.mjs            # 用 $env:DATABASE_URL
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/assert-payload-schema.mjs --local-runtime   # 用 .runtime/connection.json
 * 退出码：0 = 已 bootstrap；1 = 缺 schema/枚举（E-10 形状）；2 = 缺少 DATABASE_URL
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import pg from 'pg';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
if (process.argv.includes('--local-runtime')) {
  Object.assign(process.env, JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.runtime/connection.json'), 'utf8')));
}
const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
if (!connectionString) {
  console.error('✗ DATABASE_URL required（或加 --local-runtime 读 .runtime/connection.json）');
  process.exit(2);
}

const client = new pg.Client({ connectionString });
let schemaOk = false;
let enumOk = false;
let failure = '';
try {
  await client.connect();
  const r = await client.query(`SELECT to_regnamespace('payload_internal') IS NOT NULL AS schema_ok,
      to_regtype('payload_internal.enum_cms_admin_users_role') IS NOT NULL AS enum_ok`);
  schemaOk = r.rows[0].schema_ok === true;
  enumOk = r.rows[0].enum_ok === true;
} catch (error) {
  failure = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
} finally {
  await client.end().catch(() => {});
}

if (failure) {
  console.error('✗ 无法检查 Payload bootstrap：' + failure);
  process.exit(1);
}

if (!schemaOk || !enumOk) {
  console.error(`✗ Payload bootstrap 缺失：payload_internal schema=${schemaOk}，enum_cms_admin_users_role=${enumOk}`);
  console.error('');
  console.error('  这通常意味着 `pnpm auth:migrate` **静默空跑**（E-10）：payload migrate 跑满一次正常启动的');
  console.error('  时长（2026-10-01 实测 ~3.9s；历史文档写的 0.3s 已被证伪）却零输出、exit 0、且没建出 schema。');
  console.error('  处置顺序：');
  console.error('    1) 看 auth:migrate 那一步**有没有 `Reading migration files` / `Migrating:` 输出**；');
  console.error('       没有 → 就是本条，**直接重跑该 job / 该步骤即可**（实测同 commit 重跑即绿）。');
  console.error('       有 → 才去查连接串/迁移文件/步骤顺序。');
  console.error('    2) `pnpm auth:migrate` 现已被 infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs 包住');

  console.error('    2) ⚠️ **不要**因为这句报错去改 ci.yml 的步骤顺序 —— 那是已修复的 E-8，');

}

console.log('✓ Payload bootstrap confirmed: payload_internal schema 与 enum_cms_admin_users_role 均已就绪。');
````

## infrastructure/scripts/backup-db.sh

````sh
#!/bin/bash
# SUNS 生产库备份（服务器侧，由 /etc/cron.d/suns-backup 每夜调用）
#
# 为什么需要它：DEPLOY-PROD.md 第 6 节的最高优先级遗留项就是「生产库无备份任务」。
# V3.1 起 RFQ 附件以 bytea 存进数据库，故数据库备份是附件唯一的数据保障。
#
# 设计要点（都可测）：
#   1. pg_dump 自定义格式 + 压缩：单库体积小（约 0.5MB 级），可用 pg_restore 选择性恢复。
#   2. 写完立刻用 pg_restore -l 校验条目数 > 0，失败则删掉半成品并退出非零 —— 宁可不留坏备份。
#   3. 保留策略：最近 14 天 + 至少最近 7 份；先算保留集合再删，避免把新备份删掉。
#   4. 每次同时留一份 .env（600）：恢复时没有它连不上库；不含任何回显。
set -uo pipefail

APP="${APP:-/www/wwwroot/opctools}"
ENV_FILE="$APP/.env"
DEST="${DEST:-/root/suns-backups/db}"
LOG="${LOG:-/var/log/suns-backup.log}"
PGBIN="${PGBIN:-/www/server/pgsql/bin}"
KEEP_DAYS=14
KEEP_MIN=7

ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
mkdir -p "$DEST"
chmod 700 "$DEST"

log() { echo "$(date '+%F %T') $*" >> "$LOG"; }

[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || { log "ERROR 缺少 $ENV_FILE"; exit 1; }
URL=$(grep -m1 '^DATABASE_URL=' "$ENV_FILE" | cut -d= -f2-)
[ -n "$URL" ] || { log "ERROR .env 里没有 DATABASE_URL"; exit 1; }

OUT="$DEST/suns-$ts.dump"
TMP="$OUT.part"

# --- 1) 导出 ---
if ! "$PGBIN/pg_dump" --dbname="$URL" --format=custom --compress=6 --no-owner --no-privileges --file="$TMP" 2>>"$LOG"; then
  log "ERROR pg_dump 失败，已丢弃半成品"
  rm -f "$TMP"
  exit 1
fi

# --- 2) 校验（条目数 + 可读性）---
ENTRIES=$("$PGBIN/pg_restore" --list "$TMP" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^[0-9]')
if [ "${ENTRIES:-0}" -lt 1 ]; then
  log "ERROR 备份校验失败（pg_restore -l 条目数=$ENTRIES），已丢弃"
  rm -f "$TMP"
  exit 1
fi

mv "$TMP" "$OUT"
chmod 600 "$OUT"
SIZE=$(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1)
TABLES=$(grep -c '^[0-9].*TABLE DATA' <("$PGBIN/pg_restore" --list "$OUT") || true)
log "OK $(basename "$OUT") size=$SIZE entries=$ENTRIES tableData=$TABLES"

# --- 3) 附带 .env（600）---
cp -f "$ENV_FILE" "$DEST/env-$ts.bak"
chmod 600 "$DEST/env-$ts.bak"

# --- 3b) 媒体文件（nginx 直出的图片，磁盘上不可再生；体积很小）---
MEDIA_SRC="$APP/media"
MEDIA_OUT="$DEST/media-$ts.tar.gz"
if [ -d "$MEDIA_SRC" ]; then
  if tar -czf "$MEDIA_OUT.part" -C "$APP" media 2>>"$LOG"; then
    mv "$MEDIA_OUT.part" "$MEDIA_OUT"; chmod 600 "$MEDIA_OUT"
    log "OK $(basename "$MEDIA_OUT") size=$(du -h "$MEDIA_OUT" | cut -f1) files=$(tar -tzf "$MEDIA_OUT" | wc -l)"
  else
    log "WARN media 打包失败，已丢弃半成品"; rm -f "$MEDIA_OUT.part"
  fi
fi

# --- 4) 保留策略：按时间保最近 KEEP_MIN 份，并删除超过 KEEP_DAYS 的 ---
prune() {
  local pattern="$1" min="$2" days="$3" i f
  local -a all
  mapfile -t all < <(ls -1t $pattern 2>/dev/null)
  for i in "${!all[@]}"; do
    f="${all[$i]}"
    [ "$i" -lt "$min" ] && continue
    if [ -n "$(find "$f" -mtime +"$days" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then rm -f "$f" && log "prune $(basename "$f")"; fi
  done
}
prune "$DEST/suns-*.dump" "$KEEP_MIN" "$KEEP_DAYS"
prune "$DEST/env-*.bak" "$KEEP_MIN" "$KEEP_DAYS"
prune "$DEST/media-*.tar.gz" "$KEEP_MIN" "$KEEP_DAYS"

# 日志超过 5MB 截断（同机 mem-guard 的做法，避免长期堆积）
if [ -f "$LOG" ] && [ "$(stat -c %s "$LOG")" -gt 5242880 ]; then tail -c 1048576 "$LOG" > "$LOG.tmp" && mv "$LOG.tmp" "$LOG"; fi

exit 0

````

## infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs

````javascript
/**
 * ensure-payload-schema.mjs —— Payload bootstrap（`payload_internal`）的自断言 + 自愈入口。
 *
 * 为什么要这个脚本（E-10，2026-10-01 取证）：
 *   CI 的独立 `pnpm auth:migrate` 会**偶发零输出空跑**：进程跑满一次正常启动的时长（实测 ~3.9s，
 *   不是历史记录的 0.3s），却什么都没打印、也没建出 `payload_internal`，然后 **exit 0**；
 *   紧随其后的 `db:migrate` 就在 025 上报 `schema "payload_internal" does not exist`。
 *   已验证的机制类别：`payload/bin.js` 用 `void start()`（非顶层 await）拉起 CLI，而 tsx 的加载链上
 *   有被 `unref()` 的句柄（esbuild 的 service 子进程：esbuild/lib/main.js:2158-2163），
 *   当某个线程只剩"待决 promise + 无人 ref 的句柄"时，Node 会**放弃未完成的加载直接结束**——
 *   非顶层 await 时退出码正是 **0**（顶层 await 则报 unsettled top-level await / exit 13）。
 *   详见 docs/待验收与遗留清单.md 的 E-10 与 .runtime/probe-e10-*.mjs。
 *
 * 本脚本做的事：
 *   1. 前置检查：schema 已就绪 → 直接返回（幂等，不白跑迁移）；
 *   2. 跑 `pnpm auth:migrate`（stdin 绝不给子进程；检测交互式提问；有超时兜底）；
 *   3. 断言 schema；缺失且子进程 exit 0（= E-10 静默空跑的形状）→ **原样重试**（默认最多 5 次，见下方 attempts 注释）；
 *   4. 仍缺失 → 交给 assert-payload-schema.mjs 打印标准诊断并以非 0 退出（把静默空跑变成响亮失败）。
 *
 * ⚠️ 本脚本只负责 Payload 自己的 schema；业务迁移（database/001–026）仍由 `pnpm db:migrate` 负责。
 *
 * 用法：
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs                 # 用 $env:DATABASE_URL
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs --local-runtime # 用 .runtime/connection.json
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs --attempts 1    # 关掉重试（排查时用；默认 5 次）
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs --force         # 跳过前置检查，强制跑一次（排查/测试用）
 *   node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-payload-schema.mjs --command "cmd /c exit 0"  # 注入假命令（测试用）
 * 退出码：0 = 已就绪；1 = 迁移失败/仍缺 schema；2 = 缺少 DATABASE_URL
 */
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import pg from 'pg';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
if (argv.includes('--local-runtime')) {
  Object.assign(process.env, JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.runtime/connection.json'), 'utf8')));
}
const opt = (name, fallback) => {
  const i = argv.indexOf(name);
  return i === -1 ? fallback : argv[i + 1];
};
// 默认重试 5 次：2026-10-01 现场实测（CI run 36832057991）第 1 次静默空跑、第 2 次成功；
// 三组 CI 探针合并后的单次发生率约 10~20%（按 job/runner 抽样，存在整组 6/6 全正常的 job），
// 不是"偶发到可忽略"。每次静默空跑只花 ~2.5s，所以多试几次的代价极小；5 次全部撞上的
// 残余概率约 10⁻⁴~10⁻³（按各次独立估算）。
const attempts = Math.max(1, Number(opt('--attempts', '5')) || 5);
const timeoutMs = Math.max(1, Number(opt('--timeout-seconds', '180')) || 180) * 1000;
const command = opt('--command', 'pnpm auth:migrate');

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
if (!connectionString) {
  console.error('✗ DATABASE_URL required（或加 --local-runtime 读 .runtime/connection.json）');
  process.exit(2);
}

// 与 verify.mjs 同一套交互式提问指纹：Payload 在「库里有 dev 模式 batch=-1 标记」时会弹
// “data loss will occur … Would you like to proceed? » (y/N)”。非交互终端下它会**一直等输入**
// （实测：stdin=ignore 也照样挂住 90s+），所以必须靠扫输出主动拦截，而不是等它自己返回。
const INTERACTIVE_PROMPT = /data loss|would you like to proceed|do you want to continue|are you sure|\(y\/n\)|\[y\/n\]/i;

async function schemaState() {
  const client = new pg.Client({ connectionString });
  try {
    await client.connect();
    const r = await client.query(`SELECT to_regnamespace('payload_internal') IS NOT NULL AS schema_ok,
        to_regtype('payload_internal.enum_cms_admin_users_role') IS NOT NULL AS enum_ok`);
    return { schemaOk: r.rows[0].schema_ok === true, enumOk: r.rows[0].enum_ok === true };
  } finally {
    await client.end().catch(() => {});
  }
}

function runMigrate() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // stdin 必须是 'ignore'：绝不把本进程的 stdin 交给 Payload，否则一旦弹确认框就永久等待。
    const child = spawn(command, { cwd: root, env: process.env, shell: true, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    const t0 = Date.now();
    let tail = '';
    let killed = null;

    const kill = (reason) => {
      if (killed) return;
      killed = reason;
      if (child.pid) {
        if (process.platform === 'win32') spawn('taskkill', ['/PID', String(child.pid), '/T', '/F'], { stdio: 'ignore' }).unref();
        else child.kill('SIGTERM');
      }
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => kill(`超时（${timeoutMs / 1000}s 内未结束）`), timeoutMs);

    const inspect = (chunk, sink) => {
      sink.write(chunk);
      tail = (tail + chunk.toString('utf8')).slice(-8192);
      if (INTERACTIVE_PROMPT.test(tail)) kill('Payload 要求交互式确认（疑似库里有 dev 模式 batch=-1 标记）');
    };
    child.stdout.on('data', (c) => inspect(c, process.stdout));
    child.stderr.on('data', (c) => inspect(c, process.stderr));

    child.on('close', (code) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve({
        code: killed ? null : code,
        out: tail.replace(/\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/g, ''),
        ms: Date.now() - t0,
        killed,
      });
    });
  });
}

if (!argv.includes('--force')) {
  const initial = await schemaState();
  if (initial.schemaOk && initial.enumOk) {
    console.log('✓ payload_internal 已就绪，无需再跑 auth:migrate。');
    process.exit(0);
  }
}

let silentNoopSeen = false;
for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++) {
  console.log(`\n▶ auth:migrate 第 ${attempt}/${attempts} 次（command: ${command}）`);
  const result = await runMigrate();
  const state = await schemaState();
  console.log(
    `◀ 第 ${attempt} 次结束：exit=${result.code === null ? 'killed' : result.code} 用时=${(result.ms / 1000).toFixed(2)}s` +
      ` stdout/stderr尾长=${result.out.length}B → payload_internal schema=${state.schemaOk} enum=${state.enumOk}`,
  );

  if (result.killed) {
    console.error(`✗ ${result.killed}`);
    if (result.killed.includes('交互式确认')) {
      console.error('  处置：该库带 dev 模式的 batch=-1 迁移标记，`payload migrate` 会要求确认「data loss will occur」。');
      console.error('  请在有终端的窗口人工执行 `pnpm auth:migrate`（脚本不代你确认破坏性操作）。');
    }
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (state.schemaOk && state.enumOk) {
    if (attempt > 1) {
      console.log(`\n⚠️ E-10 自愈：第 1 次 auth:migrate 静默空跑（exit 0 但没建 schema），第 ${attempt} 次成功。`);
      if (process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true') {
        console.log('::warning title=E-10 静默空跑::auth:migrate 第 1 次 exit 0 但未建出 payload_internal，重试后成功（这是已知偶发，非代码缺陷）');
      }
    } else {
      console.log('\n✓ Payload bootstrap 完成：payload_internal schema 与 enum_cms_admin_users_role 均已就绪。');
    }
    process.exit(0);
  }
  if (result.code === 0) {
    silentNoopSeen = true;
    console.error(`✗ 第 ${attempt} 次：auth:migrate **exit 0 却没建出 payload_internal** —— 正是 E-10 的静默空跑形状。`);
  } else {
    console.error(`✗ 第 ${attempt} 次：auth:migrate 以 exit ${result.code} 失败（非静默空跑，按上方输出排查）。`);
    if (attempt < attempts) console.error(`  仍会继续重试（${attempt + 1}/${attempts}）。`);
  }
}

console.error('');
console.error(silentNoopSeen ? `✗ ${attempts} 次尝试全部落空（每次都 exit 0 却没建 schema，E-10 静默空跑持续复现）。` : `✗ ${attempts} 次尝试后仍未 bootstrap 成功。`);
console.error('  交给标准断言脚本给出处置指引：');
const assertScript = path.join(root, 'infrastructure/scripts/assert-payload-schema.mjs');
const child = spawn(process.execPath, [assertScript], { cwd: root, env: process.env, stdio: 'inherit' });
child.on('close', (code) => process.exit(code === 0 ? 1 : code));

````

````javascript
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';import path from 'node:path';import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
const root=path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'../..');
// Directory names are matched by location on purpose: output directories such as media/ and static-site/
// only exist at the project root, while matching those names at any depth silently dropped real source
// (packages/media/ and apps/cms/src/app/(payload)/media/).
const skipAnywhere=new Set(['node_modules','.next','.runtime','.git','dist']);
const skipAtRoot=new Set(['static-site','media','work','outputs']);const files=[];
async function walk(dir){const atRoot=dir===root;for(const e of await fs.readdir(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){if(skipAnywhere.has(e.name)||(atRoot&&skipAtRoot.has(e.name))||e.isSymbolicLink())continue;const abs=path.join(dir,e.name),relative=path.relative(root,abs).replaceAll('\\','/');if(e.isDirectory()){await walk(abs);continue;}if((e.name.startsWith('.env')&&e.name!=='.env.example')||/\.(log|tsbuildinfo)$/.test(e.name)||['FULL_SOURCE.md','FILE_MANIFEST.json','AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md'].includes(e.name))continue;const content=await fs.readFile(abs);files.push({path:relative,bytes:content.length,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex'),content:content.toString('utf8')});}}
await walk(root);files.sort((a,b)=>a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
await fs.writeFile(path.join(root,'docs/FILE_MANIFEST.json'),JSON.stringify({generatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),fileCount:files.length,files:files.map(({content,...f})=>f)},null,2));
const code=files.filter(f=>!f.path.startsWith('docs/')&&!f.path.endsWith('.md')&&!f.path.endsWith('pnpm-lock.yaml')&&!f.path.endsWith('payload-types.ts')&&!f.path.match(/migrations\/.*\.json$/));
let out='# V1.0 完整代码文件汇编\n\n生成自实际项目文件；不包含密钥、依赖包、数据库或构建缓存。实际文件是运行入口。\n\n## 目录\n\n'+code.map(f=>'- `'+f.path+'`').join('\n')+'\n\n';
for(const f of code){const ext=f.path.split('.').pop(),lang=ext==='mjs'?'javascript':ext==='ps1'?'powershell':ext==='yml'?'yaml':ext;out+='## '+f.path+'\n\n````'+lang+'\n'+f.content+'\n````\n\n';}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(root,'docs/FULL_SOURCE.md'),out);console.log('Exported',files.length,'files;',code.length,'complete code files. Secrets and runtime data excluded.');

````

````javascript
const url='postgresql://suns:'+encodeURIComponent(password)+'@127.0.0.1:55432/suns';await fs.writeFile(path.join(root,'.runtime/connection.json'),JSON.stringify({DATABASE_URL:url}),{mode:0o600});console.log('Temporary PostgreSQL 16 listening on 127.0.0.1:55432. Credentials saved in .runtime/connection.json.');
let stopping=false;async function stop(){if(stopping)return;stopping=true;if(owned){if(process.platform==='win32')await exec(ctl,['stop','-D',path.join(root,'.runtime/pg-data'),'-m','fast','-w'],{windowsHide:true});else await pg.stop();}process.exit(0);}process.on('SIGINT',stop);process.on('SIGTERM',stop);setInterval(()=>{},60000);
````

## infrastructure/scripts/local-demo-stop.ps1

````powershell
param([switch]$Force,[switch]$IncludeServices)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=(Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../..')).Path
$runtime=Join-Path $root '.runtime'
$pidFile=Join-Path $runtime 'demo-pids.json'
$stopped=0
if(Test-Path $pidFile){
  $tracked=Get-Content $pidFile -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  foreach($p in $tracked.PSObject.Properties){& taskkill.exe /PID ([int]$p.Value) /T /F 2>&1|Out-Null;$stopped++;Write-Host "已停止 $($p.Name) (pid $($p.Value))"}
  Remove-Item $pidFile -Force
}
if($Force){
  $leftovers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match 'suns-New-code' -or $_.CommandLine -match '--parallel --filter @suns'})
  foreach($t in $leftovers){& taskkill.exe /PID $t.ProcessId /T /F 2>&1|Out-Null}
  Write-Host "已强制清理 $($leftovers.Count) 个本项目 Node 进程"
}
if($IncludeServices){
  $envText=Get-Content (Join-Path $root '.env') -Raw
  function ReadEnv([string]$key){if($envText -match "(?m)^$key=(.*)$"){$Matches[1].Trim()}else{''}}
  $redisPort=([uri](ReadEnv 'REDIS_URL')).Port
  & (Join-Path $runtime 'redis/redis-cli.exe') -p $redisPort shutdown nosave 2>&1|Out-Null
  Write-Host "Redis 已停止 (127.0.0.1:$redisPort)"
  & (Join-Path $runtime 'node_modules/@embedded-postgres/windows-x64/native/bin/pg_ctl.exe') stop -D (Join-Path $runtime 'pg-data') -m fast -w 2>&1|Out-Null
  Write-Host 'PostgreSQL 已停止（数据保留在 .runtime/pg-data）'
}
Write-Host "演示应用已停止（脚本管理内 $stopped 个）"
````

````powershell
$redisUrl=ReadEnv 'REDIS_URL';if(-not $redisUrl){throw '.env 缺少 REDIS_URL'}
$locale=ReadEnv 'DEFAULT_LOCALE';if(-not $locale){$locale='en'}

$env:DATABASE_URL=$dbUrl;$env:REDIS_URL=$redisUrl
$envDb=(ReadEnv 'DATABASE_URL');if($envDb -and $envDb -ne $dbUrl){Write-Host "提示：.env 的 DATABASE_URL 指向 $(([uri]$envDb).Port) 端口（Docker 路径），本地演示用 $dbSource 的 $pgPort 端口"}
$pgCtl=Join-Path $runtime 'node_modules/@embedded-postgres/windows-x64/native/bin/pg_ctl.exe';$pgData=Join-Path $runtime 'pg-data'
if(-not (Test-Path $pgCtl)){throw '本机缺少 embedded-postgres：npm install --prefix .runtime embedded-postgres@16.14.0-beta.17 后运行 node infrastructure/scripts/local-db.mjs'}

$redisExe=Join-Path $runtime 'redis/redis-server.exe'

Push-Location $root
try{
  & node (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'migrate.mjs') up|Out-Null
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '业务迁移失败（database/*.sql）'}
  Write-Host '业务迁移（database/*.sql）已是最新'

  $probe=@'
import pg from 'pg';
const c=new pg.Client({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL});await c.connect();
try{const r=await c.query('SELECT name,batch FROM payload_internal.payload_migrations');console.log(JSON.stringify(r.rows));}catch{console.log('[]');}
await c.end();
'@
  $applied=@();$devMarker=$false
  try{foreach($row in (($probe|node --input-type=module|Out-String).Trim()|ConvertFrom-Json)){if([int]$row.batch -eq -1){$devMarker=$true}else{$applied+=$row.name}}}catch{}
  $migFiles=@(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'apps/cms/src/migrations') -File -Filter '*.ts'|Where-Object{$_.Name -match '^\d{8}_'}|ForEach-Object{$_.BaseName})
  $pending=@($migFiles|Where-Object{$applied -notcontains $_})
  if(-not $pending.Count){Write-Host 'Payload 账号迁移已是最新（payload_internal.payload_migrations）'}
  elseif($devMarker){Write-Warning "有待执行的账号迁移：$($pending -join ', ')。该库带 dev 模式标记，payload migrate 会要求确认「data loss will occur」，请在有终端的窗口手动执行：pnpm auth:migrate"}
  else{& pnpm auth:migrate|Out-Null;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Payload 账号迁移失败'};Write-Host "已执行账号迁移：$($pending -join ', ')"}
}finally{Pop-Location}
$apps=@(@{name='cms';filter='@suns/cms';port=3001;health='http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/v1/health'},@{name='web';filter='@suns/web';port=3000;health="http://127.0.0.1:3000/$locale"},@{name='worker';filter='@suns/worker';port=0;health=''})
$pids=@{};foreach($app in $apps){if(Test-App $app.name){Write-Host "$($app.name) 已在运行（非本脚本启动；用 local-demo-stop.ps1 -Force 清理）";continue};$out=Join-Path $logs "$($app.name).out.log";$err=Join-Path $logs "$($app.name).err.log";$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'pnpm.cmd' -ArgumentList '--filter',$app.filter,'dev' -WorkingDirectory $root -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru;$pids[$app.name]=$p.Id;Write-Host "$($app.name) 已启动 pid=$($p.Id)（日志 .runtime/logs/$($app.name).out.log）"}
if($pids.Count){$pids|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $runtime 'demo-pids.json') -Encoding utf8}
$deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds($TimeoutSeconds)
foreach($app in $apps){if(-not $app.health){continue};$ok=$false;while((Get-Date) -lt $deadline){try{$r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $app.health -TimeoutSec 15 -SkipHttpErrorCheck;if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ok=$true;break}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Seconds 3};if($ok){Write-Host "$($app.name) 健康：$($app.health) -> 200"}else{Write-Warning "$($app.name) 在 $TimeoutSeconds 秒内未就绪，查看 .runtime/logs/$($app.name).err.log"}}
$redisCli=Join-Path $runtime 'redis/redis-cli.exe';$queueKeys=0
$workerDeadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds($WorkerWaitSeconds)
while((Get-Date) -lt $workerDeadline){$queueKeys=@(& $redisCli -p $redisPort keys 'bull:static-publish:*' 2>&1).Count;if($queueKeys -gt 0){break};Start-Sleep -Seconds 2}
if($queueKeys -gt 0){Write-Host "队列已连通：bull:static-publish 键 $queueKeys 个（worker 已连上 Redis）"}else{Write-Warning "未检测到 bull:static-publish 键：worker 可能未连上 Redis，查看 .runtime/logs/worker.err.log"}
Write-Host ''
Write-Host "演示环境入口：前台 http://127.0.0.1:3000/$locale  后台 http://127.0.0.1:3001/admin  业务管理 http://127.0.0.1:3001/manage"
Write-Host "静态发布产物：$root\static-site（本机无 Nginx，前台由 web 应用读取已发布快照）"
````

## infrastructure/scripts/migrate.mjs

````javascript
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import pg from 'pg';
import {config} from 'dotenv';
const root=path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'../..');config({path:path.join(root,'.env')});
const direction=process.argv[2]||'up',target=process.argv[3];
if(!['up','down','status'].includes(direction))throw Error('Usage: migrate.mjs up|down|status [target version]');
if(!process.env.DATABASE_URL)throw Error('DATABASE_URL is required');
const c=new pg.Client({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL});await c.connect();
try{
 const v=(await c.query('SHOW server_version_num')).rows[0].server_version_num;if(Number(v)<160000)throw Error('PostgreSQL 16+ required');
 await c.query('SELECT pg_advisory_lock(837611,2)');
 await c.query(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.schema_migrations(version text PRIMARY KEY,checksum text NOT NULL,applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())`);
 const names=(await fs.readdir(path.join(root,'database'))).filter(n=>/^\d{3}_.*\.sql$/.test(n)).sort();
 const applied=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version')).rows;
 for(const entry of applied){if(!names.includes(entry.version))throw Error('Applied migration missing: '+entry.version);const data=await fs.readFile(path.join(root,'database',entry.version));if(createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')!==entry.checksum)throw Error('Applied migration changed: '+entry.version);}
 if(direction==='status'){console.table(names.map(n=>({version:n,applied:applied.some(a=>a.version===n)})));}
 else{
  const chosen=direction==='up'?names.filter(n=>!applied.some(a=>a.version===n)&&(!target||n.slice(0,3)<=target.padStart(3,'0'))):applied.map(a=>a.version).reverse().filter((n,i)=>target?n.slice(0,3)>target.padStart(3,'0'):i===0);
  for(const name of chosen){const file=direction==='up'?path.join(root,'database',name):path.join(root,'database/rollback',name.replace('.sql','.down.sql'));const data=await fs.readFile(file);await c.query('BEGIN');try{await c.query("SET LOCAL timezone='UTC'");await c.query(data.toString('utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/,''));if(direction==='up')await c.query('INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version,checksum) VALUES($1,$2)',[name,createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')]);else await c.query('DELETE FROM schema_migrations WHERE version=$1',[name]);await c.query('COMMIT');console.log(direction,name);}catch(e){await c.query('ROLLBACK');throw e;}}
 }
}finally{await c.query('SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(837611,2)').catch(()=>{});await c.end();}

````
