````ts
import {query,transaction} from './db';
import {audit,DomainError} from './crud';
import {canRead,canWrite,getResource} from './registry';
import type {Actor} from './types';

function access(actor:Actor,write=false){const r=getResource('seo_metadata');if(!(write?canWrite(actor,r):canRead(actor,r)))throw new DomainError('没有外联工作台权限',403);}
function httpsURL(value:string){let url:URL;try{url=new URL(value.trim());}catch{throw new DomainError('请输入完整 HTTPS 网址');}if(url.protocol!=='https:'||url.username||url.password||url.port||url.hash||url.hostname==='localhost'||url.hostname.endsWith('.local'))throw new DomainError('只接受公开 HTTPS 网址');return url.href;}
function reviewer(actor:Actor){if(!['admin','super_admin','reviewer'].includes(actor.role))throw new DomainError('外联草稿需要审核员或管理员批准',403);}

export async function outreachWorkspace(actor:Actor){access(actor);const partners=await query(`SELECT p.*,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM outreach_drafts d WHERE d.partner_id=p.id AND d.status='draft') AS draft_count,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM outreach_links l WHERE l.partner_id=p.id) AS link_count FROM outreach_partners p ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 150`);return {partners};}
export async function outreachPartner(actor:Actor,id:string){access(actor);const partner=(await query('SELECT * FROM outreach_partners WHERE id=$1',[id]))[0];if(!partner)throw new DomainError('合作对象不存在',404);const [drafts,replies,links]=await Promise.all([
 query('SELECT d.*,u.display_name AS author_name FROM outreach_drafts d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=d.author_id WHERE d.partner_id=$1 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 50',[id]),
 query('SELECT * FROM outreach_replies WHERE partner_id=$1 ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50',[id]),
 query('SELECT * FROM outreach_links WHERE partner_id=$1 ORDER BY first_seen_at DESC LIMIT 50',[id])]);return {partner,drafts,replies,links};}
export async function saveOutreachPartner(actor:Actor,input:{id?:string;organization:string;websiteUrl:string;contactName?:string;contactEmail?:string;fitNote?:string}){
 access(actor,true);const website=httpsURL(input.websiteUrl);return transaction(async c=>{const before=input.id?(await c.query('SELECT * FROM outreach_partners WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[input.id])).rows[0]:null;if(input.id&&!before)throw new DomainError('合作对象不存在',404);
  const data=input.id?(await c.query('UPDATE outreach_partners SET organization=$2,website_url=$3,contact_name=$4,contact_email=$5,fit_note=$6 WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *',[input.id,input.organization.trim(),website,input.contactName?.trim()||null,input.contactEmail?.trim()||null,input.fitNote?.trim()||null])).rows[0]
   :(await c.query('INSERT INTO outreach_partners(organization,website_url,contact_name,contact_email,fit_note,created_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING *',[input.organization.trim(),website,input.contactName?.trim()||null,input.contactEmail?.trim()||null,input.fitNote?.trim()||null,actor.id])).rows[0];
  await audit(c,actor,'outreach_partners',input.id?'update':'create',before,data);return data;});
}
export async function createOutreachDraft(actor:Actor,input:{partnerId:string;subject:string;body:string}){
 access(actor,true);return transaction(async c=>{const partner=(await c.query('SELECT id FROM outreach_partners WHERE id=$1',[input.partnerId])).rows[0];if(!partner)throw new DomainError('合作对象不存在',404);
  const draft=(await c.query('INSERT INTO outreach_drafts(partner_id,subject,body,author_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) RETURNING *',[input.partnerId,input.subject.trim(),input.body.trim(),actor.id])).rows[0];
  await c.query("UPDATE outreach_partners SET status='drafting' WHERE id=$1 AND status='research'",[input.partnerId]);await audit(c,actor,'outreach_drafts','create',null,draft);return draft;});
}
export async function reviewOutreachDraft(actor:Actor,input:{id:string;action:'approve'|'reject'|'mark_sent';note?:string}){
 access(actor,input.action==='mark_sent');if(input.action!=='mark_sent')reviewer(actor);return transaction(async c=>{const before=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM outreach_drafts WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[input.id])).rows[0];if(!before)throw new DomainError('外联草稿不存在',404);
  if(input.action==='mark_sent'){if(before.status!=='approved')throw new DomainError('只能将已批准的草稿标记为人工发送',409);}
  else{reviewer(actor);if(before.status!=='draft')throw new DomainError('该草稿已审批',409);if(before.author_id===actor.id)throw new DomainError('不能审批自己撰写的草稿',403);}
  const status=input.action==='mark_sent'?'sent_manually':input.action==='approve'?'approved':'rejected';
  const after=(await c.query('UPDATE outreach_drafts SET status=$2,reviewer_id=$3,reviewed_at=$4,review_note=$5,manual_sent_at=$6 WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *',[input.id,status,input.action==='mark_sent'?before.reviewer_id:actor.id,input.action==='mark_sent'?before.reviewed_at:new Date(),input.note?.trim()||before.review_note,input.action==='mark_sent'?new Date():null])).rows[0];
  if(status==='sent_manually')await c.query("UPDATE outreach_partners SET status='contacted' WHERE id=$1",[before.partner_id]);
  await audit(c,actor,'outreach_drafts',input.action,before,after);return after;});
}
export async function recordOutreachReply(actor:Actor,input:{partnerId:string;summary:string;receivedAt:string}){
 access(actor,true);return transaction(async c=>{const partner=(await c.query('SELECT id FROM outreach_partners WHERE id=$1',[input.partnerId])).rows[0];if(!partner)throw new DomainError('合作对象不存在',404);
  const row=(await c.query('INSERT INTO outreach_replies(partner_id,summary,received_at,recorded_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) RETURNING *',[input.partnerId,input.summary.trim(),input.receivedAt,actor.id])).rows[0];await c.query("UPDATE outreach_partners SET status='replied' WHERE id=$1",[input.partnerId]);await audit(c,actor,'outreach_replies','create',null,row);return row;});
}
export async function recordOutreachLink(actor:Actor,input:{partnerId:string;sourceUrl:string;targetUrl:string}){
 access(actor,true);const source=httpsURL(input.sourceUrl),target=httpsURL(input.targetUrl);
 const site=(await query('SELECT primary_domain FROM site_settings LIMIT 1'))[0];if(!site?.primary_domain||new URL(target).hostname!==new URL(site.primary_domain).hostname)throw new DomainError('目标链接必须指向当前站点');
 return transaction(async c=>{const partner=(await c.query('SELECT id FROM outreach_partners WHERE id=$1',[input.partnerId])).rows[0];if(!partner)throw new DomainError('合作对象不存在',404);
  const row=(await c.query('INSERT INTO outreach_links(partner_id,source_url,target_url,recorded_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT(partner_id,source_url,target_url) DO UPDATE SET verification_status=EXCLUDED.verification_status RETURNING *',[input.partnerId,source,target,actor.id])).rows[0];
  await c.query("UPDATE outreach_partners SET status='linked' WHERE id=$1",[input.partnerId]);await audit(c,actor,'outreach_links','record',null,row);return row;});
}
````

## packages/domain/src/publishing.ts

````ts
import { query, transaction } from './db';
import { sourceDocument } from './documents';
import { DomainError, audit } from './crud';
import { publishModeFor } from './registry';
import type { Actor } from './types';
export async function requestPublish(actor:Actor,table:string,id:string,action='publish',scheduledAt?:string){
 if(!(['admin','super_admin'].includes(actor.role)||(actor.permissions?actor.permissions.includes('publishing.write'):actor.role==='reviewer')))throw new DomainError('需要审核或管理员发布权限',403);
 // 可发布的资源由 registry 单点声明，避免这里再维护一份副本。
 if(publishModeFor(table)!=='record')throw new DomainError('不支持发布此类型');
 if(!['publish','unpublish','rebuild'].includes(action))throw new DomainError('Invalid publish action');
 const at=scheduledAt?new Date(scheduledAt):null;if(at&&(!Number.isFinite(at.getTime())||at.getTime()<Date.now()))throw new DomainError('定时发布时间必须在未来');
 return transaction(async c=>{
  await c.query('SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ');
  const old=(await c.query(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE`,[id])).rows[0];
  const snapshot=await sourceDocument(table,id);
  if(!old||new Date(old.updated_at).getTime()!==new Date(snapshot.updatedAt).getTime())throw new DomainError('内容已修改，请重新提交发布',409);
  const task=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO publish_jobs(job_type,entity_type,entity_id,locale_id,requested_by,scheduled_at,metadata) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7) RETURNING *`,[action,table,id,snapshot.localeId,actor.id,at,JSON.stringify({snapshot,route:snapshot.route})])).rows[0];
  if(at&&table!=='taxonomy_term_translations'){const status=table==='product_translations'?'publish_status':'status';await c.query(`UPDATE ${table} SET ${status}='scheduled',scheduled_at=$2 WHERE id=$1`,[id,at]);}
  await audit(c,actor,table,action==='unpublish'?'unpublish.requested':'publish.requested',old,{id,job_id:task.id,scheduled_at:at});return task;
 });
}
export async function rebuildSite(actor:Actor){if(!(['admin','super_admin'].includes(actor.role)||(actor.permissions?actor.permissions.includes('publishing.write'):actor.role==='reviewer')))throw new DomainError('没有发布权限',403);return(await query(`INSERT INTO publish_jobs(job_type,entity_type,requested_by,metadata) VALUES('rebuild','site',$1,'{}') RETURNING *`,[actor.id]))[0];}
export async function jobAction(actor:Actor,id:string,action:string){
 if(!(['admin','super_admin'].includes(actor.role)||(actor.permissions?actor.permissions.includes('publishing.write'):actor.role==='reviewer')))throw new DomainError('没有发布权限',403);
 return transaction(async c=>{const j=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM publish_jobs WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[id])).rows[0];if(!j)throw new DomainError('Task not found',404);
  if(action==='cancel'){if(!['pending','retrying'].includes(j.status))throw new DomainError('只能取消尚未处理的任务',409);return(await c.query("UPDATE publish_jobs SET status='cancelled',finished_at=now() WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *",[id])).rows[0];}
  if(action==='retry'&&['failed','cancelled'].includes(j.status))return(await c.query(`INSERT INTO publish_jobs(job_type,entity_type,entity_id,locale_id,requested_by,metadata) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING *`,[j.job_type,j.entity_type,j.entity_id,j.locale_id,actor.id,j.metadata])).rows[0];throw new DomainError('Invalid job action');
 });
}
````

````ts
import {identifier,query} from './db';
import {canRead,getResource} from './registry';
import type {Actor} from './types';

const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const primary:Record<string,string[]>={
 locales:['native_name','name','code'],media_assets:['original_filename'],
 products:['sku'],content_items:['content_type'],taxonomy_terms:['code'],
 taxonomies:['name','code'],faq_items:['code'],site_settings:['site_name'],
 menus:['code'],customer_service_channels:['name'],users:['display_name','email'],
 hero_slide_translations:['title'],content_item_translations:['title'],
 product_translations:['name'],taxonomy_term_translations:['name'],
 media_asset_translations:['alt_text','title'],menu_item_translations:['label'],
 faq_item_translations:['question'],product_spec_definitions:['code','name'],
 product_spec_definition_translations:['name'],permissions:['name','code'],
 roles:['name','code'],publish_jobs:['job_type']
};
const translated:Record<string,{table:string;fk:string;field:string}>={
 products:{table:'product_translations',fk:'product_id',field:'name'},
 content_items:{table:'content_item_translations',fk:'content_item_id',field:'title'},
 taxonomy_terms:{table:'taxonomy_term_translations',fk:'term_id',field:'name'},
 faq_items:{table:'faq_item_translations',fk:'faq_id',field:'question'},
 hero_slides:{table:'hero_slide_translations',fk:'hero_slide_id',field:'title'},
 menu_items:{table:'menu_item_translations',fk:'menu_item_id',field:'label'}
};
const visibleThrough:Record<string,string>={
 media_assets:'media_asset_translations',products:'product_translations',
 content_items:'content_item_translations',taxonomy_terms:'taxonomy_term_translations',
 faq_items:'faq_item_translations',hero_slides:'hero_slide_translations',
 menu_items:'menu_item_translations',site_settings:'site_setting_translations'
};
// 文字存在翻译表里的表，一旦对应翻译还没填，就只能退化成「记录 #xxxx」——在「轮播翻译」里选轮播时
// 根本认不出是哪张图。这里给出与语言无关的兜底名称（轮播 → 「第 N 张 · 图片文件名」）。
const fallbackLabel:Record<string,{join:string;expr:string}>={
 hero_slides:{join:'LEFT JOIN media_assets m ON m.id=t.desktop_media_id',expr:"'第 ' || COALESCE(t.sort_order,0) || ' 张' || COALESCE(' · ' || NULLIF(m.original_filename,''), '')"},
};

export function canResolveReference(actor:Actor,table:string){
 const target=getResource(table);
 return table==='locales'||canRead(actor,target)||!!(visibleThrough[table]&&canRead(actor,getResource(visibleThrough[table])));
}

/** Resolve only IDs already visible in the current admin page, with the same read permissions. */
export async function referenceLabels(actor:Actor,requested:unknown){
 if(!requested||typeof requested!=='object'||Array.isArray(requested))throw new Error('Invalid references');
 const result:Record<string,Record<string,string>>={};
 const entries=Object.entries(requested);
 if(entries.length>25)throw new Error('Too many reference groups');
 for(const [table,input] of entries){
  if(!canResolveReference(actor,table)){result[table]={};continue;}
  if(!Array.isArray(input)||input.length>100||input.some(id=>typeof id!=='string'||!uuid.test(id)))throw new Error('Invalid reference IDs');
  const ids=[...new Set(input)];if(!ids.length){result[table]={};continue;}
  const cols=await query<{column_name:string}>('SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=$1 AND table_name=$2',['public',table]);
  const names=new Set(cols.map(c=>c.column_name));
  if(!names.has('id')){result[table]={};continue;}
  const fields=(primary[table]||['title','name','code','sku','original_filename','email','path','label','question','job_type']).filter(x=>names.has(x));
  const direct=fields.length?'COALESCE('+fields.map(x=>`NULLIF(t.${identifier(x)}::text,'')`).join(',')+',NULL)':'NULL::text';
  const translation=translated[table];
  const join=translation?`LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ${identifier(translation.field)}::text AS label FROM ${identifier(translation.table)} x WHERE x.${identifier(translation.fk)}=t.id ORDER BY (x.locale_id=(SELECT id FROM locales WHERE is_default)) DESC LIMIT 1) translated ON true`:'';
  const base=translation?`COALESCE(NULLIF(translated.label,''),${direct})`:direct;
  const fallback=fallbackLabel[table];
  const expr=fallback?`COALESCE(NULLIF(${base},''),${fallback.expr})`:base;
  const rows=await query<{id:string;label:string|null}>(`SELECT t.id,${expr} AS label FROM ${identifier(table)} t ${fallback?fallback.join:''} ${join} WHERE t.id=ANY($1::uuid[])`,[ids]);
  result[table]=Object.fromEntries(rows.filter(r=>r.label).map(r=>[r.id,String(r.label)]));
 }
 return result;
}

````

````ts
export type PublishMode = 'record' | 'rebuild';
export type Resource = { table: string; label: string; group: string; permission: string; readonly?: boolean; key?: string[]; publishMode?: PublishMode };
const resource = (table:string,label:string,group:string,permission=group,readonly=false,key=['id']):Resource => ({table,label,group,permission,readonly,key});
// 「这项改动怎样才能在公开站点生效」的单一 owner。
// record：可以单独发布这一条（requestPublish 支持，列表操作列有“发布”按钮）。
// rebuild：内容会被写进每一张已发布页面（见 packages/domain/src/documents.ts 的 siteContext()），
//          改动后必须全站重建，refreshSite 才会把所有路由重新渲染一遍。
const recordPublishable=new Set(['content_item_translations','product_translations','taxonomy_term_translations']);
const rebuildRequired=new Set(['site_settings','site_setting_translations','menus','menu_items','menu_item_translations','hero_slides','hero_slide_translations','customer_service_channels','customer_service_rules','locales']);
export function publishModeFor(table:string):PublishMode|undefined{return recordPublishable.has(table)?'record':rebuildRequired.has(table)?'rebuild':undefined;}
export const resources: Resource[] = [
 resource('content_items','页面 / 文章','content'), resource('content_item_translations','内容翻译','content'), resource('content_blocks','页面区块','content'),
 resource('taxonomies','分类体系','content'),resource('taxonomy_terms','分类','content'),resource('taxonomy_term_translations','分类翻译','content'),resource('content_term_links','内容分类关联','content','content',false,['content_item_id','term_id']),
 resource('faq_items','常见问题','content'),resource('faq_item_translations','FAQ 翻译','content'),resource('content_faq_links','内容 FAQ 关联','content','content',false,['content_item_id','faq_id']),
 resource('products','产品','product'),resource('product_translations','产品翻译','product'),resource('product_spec_definitions','规格定义','product'),resource('product_spec_definition_translations','规格名称翻译','product'),resource('product_spec_values','产品规格值','product'),
 resource('product_term_links','产品分类','product','product',false,['product_id','term_id']),resource('product_media','产品图库','product'),resource('product_documents','产品资料','product'),resource('product_relations','关联产品','product','product',false,['product_id','related_product_id','relation_type']),
 resource('seo_metadata','SEO 元数据','seo'),resource('geo_profiles','GEO 知识实体','seo'),resource('geo_key_facts','知识事实','seo'),resource('geo_references','证据与引用','seo'),resource('schema_markup','JSON-LD','seo'),resource('redirects','301 / 302','seo'),resource('robots_rules','Robots 规则','seo'),resource('sitemap_files','站点地图','seo','seo',true),
 resource('media_assets','媒体库','media'),resource('media_variants','图片版本','media','media',true),resource('media_asset_translations','图片 ALT 翻译','media'),
 resource('hero_slides','首页轮播','appearance'),resource('hero_slide_translations','轮播翻译','appearance'),resource('menus','导航菜单','appearance'),resource('menu_items','导航项目','appearance'),resource('menu_item_translations','导航翻译','appearance'),resource('customer_service_channels','客服渠道','appearance'),resource('customer_service_rules','客服市场规则','appearance'),
 resource('inquiries','询盘 / RFQ','leads'),resource('inquiry_items','询盘产品','leads'),resource('download_events','下载记录','leads','leads',true),
 resource('publish_jobs','发布任务','publishing','publishing',true),resource('publish_job_routes','任务路由','publishing','publishing',true),resource('static_routes','静态路由','publishing','publishing',true),resource('cdn_purge_logs','CDN 刷新日志','publishing','publishing',true),
 resource('translation_jobs','翻译工作流','translation'),resource('content_revisions','内容版本','history','history',true),resource('audit_logs','审计记录','history','history',true),
 resource('locales','语言','system'),resource('site_settings','站点配置','system'),resource('site_setting_translations','站点翻译','system'),resource('users','业务用户映射','system','system',true),resource('roles','角色','system'),resource('permissions','权限定义','system'),resource('user_roles','用户角色','system','system',false,['user_id','role_id']),resource('role_permissions','角色权限','system','system',false,['role_id','permission_id']),resource('integration_connections','集成配置','system'),resource('integration_sync_logs','同步日志','system','system',true),
].map(r=>({...r,publishMode:publishModeFor(r.table)}));
export function getResource(table:string) { const r=resources.find(r=>r.table===table); if(!r)throw new Error('Unknown resource');return r; }
export const roleGroups:Record<string,string[]>={admin:['*'],super_admin:['*'],editor:['content','product','media','appearance'],seo_manager:['seo'],translator:['translation'],reviewer:['publishing'],client:['content','product','media','appearance','leads','publishing']};
export function canWrite(subject:string|{role:string;permissions?:string[]}, r:Resource) {const role=typeof subject==='string'?subject:subject.role;if(typeof subject!=='string'&&subject.permissions&&!['admin','super_admin'].includes(role))return !r.readonly&&(subject.permissions.includes(r.permission+'.write')||(role==='translator'&&r.table.endsWith('_translations')&&subject.permissions.includes('translation.write')));return !r.readonly && (roleGroups[role]?.includes('*') || roleGroups[role]?.includes(r.permission) || (role==='translator' && r.table.endsWith('_translations')));}
export function canRead(subject:string|{role:string;permissions?:string[]}, r:Resource) {const role=typeof subject==='string'?subject:subject.role;if(typeof subject!=='string'&&subject.permissions&&!['admin','super_admin'].includes(role))return subject.permissions.includes(r.permission+'.read')||canWrite(subject,r);return ['admin','super_admin'].includes(role)||(!['system','leads','history'].includes(r.group));}
````

````ts
import {query,transaction} from './db';
import {sourceDocument} from './documents';
import {audit,DomainError} from './crud';
import {canRead,getResource} from './registry';
import type {Actor,Document,Row} from './types';

export type ReviewEntity='content_item_translations'|'product_translations';
function kind(value:string):ReviewEntity{
 if(value!=='content_item_translations'&&value!=='product_translations')throw new DomainError('只支持页面、文章和产品');
 return value;
}
function read(actor:Actor,table:ReviewEntity){if(!canRead(actor,getResource(table)))throw new DomainError('没有查看此内容的权限',403);}
function publish(actor:Actor){if(!(['admin','super_admin'].includes(actor.role)||(actor.permissions?actor.permissions.includes('publishing.write'):actor.role==='reviewer')))throw new DomainError('没有发布权限',403);}
function textLength(value:unknown){return Array.from(String(value||'')).length;}
function internalLinks(value:unknown){const found=new Set<string>();function visit(x:unknown){if(typeof x==='string'){for(const match of x.matchAll(/(?:href\s*=\s*["']|^)(\/[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z]{2})?\/[a-zA-Z0-9_/#?&=.%~-]*)/g))found.add(match[1].split(/[?#]/)[0].replace(/\/$/,'')||'/');}else if(Array.isArray(x))x.forEach(visit);else if(x&&typeof x==='object')Object.entries(x).forEach(([key,v])=>{if(['url','href','html','text'].includes(key))visit(v);else if(typeof v==='object')visit(v);});}visit(value);return [...found].filter(Boolean).slice(0,100);}

export async function seoReview(actor:Actor,tableName:string,id:string){
 const table=kind(tableName);read(actor,table);
 const doc=await sourceDocument(table,id);
 const issues:{key:string;label:string;severity:'error'|'warning'|'info';detail:string;fixResource:string}[]=[];
 const add=(key:string,label:string,severity:'error'|'warning'|'info',detail:string,fixResource:string=table)=>issues.push({key,label,severity,detail,fixResource});
 const title=String(doc.seo.meta_title||doc.title||'');
 const summary=String(doc.seo.meta_description||doc.description||'');
 if(!title.trim())add('title','搜索标题','error','缺少标题。');else if(textLength(title)>65)add('title','搜索标题','warning',`当前 ${textLength(title)} 字符，建议精简，避免搜索结果截断。`);
 if(!summary.trim())add('description','搜索摘要','warning','没有搜索摘要，搜索引擎可能自行截取正文。');else if(textLength(summary)>160)add('description','搜索摘要','warning',`当前 ${textLength(summary)} 字符，建议精简。`);
 const siteOrigin=String(doc.site.primary_domain||'');
 if(doc.seo.canonical_url){try{const canonical=new URL(doc.seo.canonical_url,siteOrigin);if(!['https:','http:'].includes(canonical.protocol))throw Error();if(canonical.pathname!==doc.route)add('canonical','规范地址','warning','canonical 指向与本页面不同的路径，请确认是否有意合并。','seo_metadata');}catch{add('canonical','规范地址','error','canonical 不是有效的 HTTP(S) 地址。','seo_metadata');}}
 else add('canonical','规范地址','info','未手动设置，发布渲染会使用本页路径。','seo_metadata');
 const locale=(await query('SELECT code,hreflang FROM locales WHERE id=$1',[doc.localeId]))[0];
 const siblings=await query(`SELECT l.code,l.hreflang,t.path,t.id FROM ${table} t JOIN locales l ON l.id=t.locale_id WHERE t.${table==='content_item_translations'?'content_item_id':'product_id'}=$1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.is_enabled`,[doc.groupId]);
 const missing=siblings.filter(x=>x.id!==id&&!doc.alternates.some(a=>a.locale===x.code));
 if(missing.length)add('hreflang','多语言关联','info',`${missing.map(x=>x.code).join('、')} 尚未发布，不会出现在当前 hreflang 中。`);
 if(!locale?.hreflang)add('hreflang','多语言关联','warning','当前语言缺少 hreflang 代码。','locales');
 if(!doc.schema?.id)add('schema','结构化数据','info','没有绑定自定义 JSON-LD；请确认自动生成的页面类型满足需求。','schema_markup');
 else if(doc.schema?.override_json&&!['object'].includes(typeof doc.schema.override_json))add('schema','结构化数据','error','覆盖数据格式不正确。','schema_markup');
 const links=internalLinks(doc.body);
 if(!links.length)add('links','站内链接','info','正文没有站内链接；可在相关内容中补充有帮助的导航。');
 else{const found=await query<{route:string}>('SELECT route FROM published_documents WHERE route=ANY($1::text[])',[links]);const live=new Set(found.map(x=>x.route));const broken=links.filter(x=>x!==doc.route&&!live.has(x));if(broken.length)add('links','站内链接','warning',`以下站内路径尚未发布：${broken.slice(0,5).join('、')}`);}
 const missingAlt=doc.media.filter(m=>!String(m.alt_text||'').trim());
 if(missingAlt.length)add('alt','图片描述','warning',`${missingAlt.length} 张图片缺少当前语言的 ALT 描述。`,'media_asset_translations');
 if(!doc.site.enable_indexing)add('index','索引状态','warning','站点当前关闭搜索引擎收录。','site_settings');
 if(doc.seo.robots_index===false)add('index','索引状态','warning','本页设置为 noindex。','seo_metadata');
 const score=Math.max(0,100-issues.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+(x.severity==='error'?20:x.severity==='warning'?10:0),0));
 return {title:doc.title,route:doc.route,locale:doc.locale,score,issues,checkedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
}

export async function publishPreview(actor:Actor,tableName:string,id:string){
 const table=kind(tableName);read(actor,table);
 const draft=await sourceDocument(table,id);
 const released=(await query<{snapshot:Document}>('SELECT snapshot FROM published_documents WHERE entity_type=$1 AND entity_id=$2',[table,id]))[0]?.snapshot||null;
 const fields:['title'|'description'|'route'|'body'|'seo',string][]=[['title','标题'],['description','摘要'],['route','路径'],['body','正文'],['seo','搜索设置']];
 const differences=fields.filter(([key])=>JSON.stringify(draft[key])!==JSON.stringify(released?.[key])).map(([key,label])=>({key,label,before:released?.[key]??null,after:draft[key]}));
 const revisions=await query<{id:string;created_at:string;route:string;title:string}>(`SELECT id,created_at,metadata->'snapshot'->>'route' AS route,metadata->'snapshot'->>'title' AS title FROM publish_jobs WHERE entity_type=$1 AND entity_id=$2 AND job_type='publish' AND status='completed' AND metadata ? 'snapshot' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15`,[table,id]);
 return {draft,released,differences,revisions};
}

export async function rollbackPublished(actor:Actor,jobId:string){
 publish(actor);
 return transaction(async c=>{
  const old=(await c.query(`SELECT * FROM publish_jobs WHERE id=$1 AND job_type='publish' AND status='completed' AND entity_type IN ('content_item_translations','product_translations') FOR UPDATE`,[jobId])).rows[0];
  if(!old?.metadata?.snapshot)throw new DomainError('找不到可恢复的已发布版本',404);
  const table=kind(old.entity_type);const doc=old.metadata.snapshot as Document;
  const live=(await c.query(`SELECT id,path,deleted_at FROM ${table} WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE`,[old.entity_id])).rows[0];
  if(!live||live.deleted_at)throw new DomainError('内容已删除，不能回滚');
  if(live.path!==doc.route)throw new DomainError('网址已更改；请先检查路径后重新发布');
  const task=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO publish_jobs(job_type,entity_type,entity_id,locale_id,requested_by,metadata) VALUES('publish',$1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb) RETURNING id`,[table,old.entity_id,old.locale_id,actor.id,JSON.stringify({snapshot:doc,route:doc.route,rollbackOf:old.id})])).rows[0];
  await audit(c,actor,table,'rollback.requested',{id:old.entity_id,job_id:old.id},{id:old.entity_id,job_id:task.id});
  return {jobId:task.id,route:doc.route};
 });
}

````

````ts
import type {Row} from './types';
export function serviceForVisitor(channels:Row[],country=''){
 const selected=new Map<string,Row>();
 for(const channel of channels){if(channel.country_code&&channel.country_code!==country)continue;const key=channel.id||channel.name;if(selected.has(key))continue;const hours=channel.working_hours||{};let available=true;
  if(hours.days&&typeof hours.days==='object'){try{const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{timeZone:hours.timezone||'UTC',weekday:'short',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'}).formatToParts(new Date());const val=(type:string)=>parts.find(x=>x.type===type)?.value||'';const weekday=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'].indexOf(val('weekday'));const now=Number(val('hour'))*60+Number(val('minute'));const minutes=(s:string)=>{const m=/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(s);return m?Number(m[1])*60+Number(m[2]):-1;};const slots=hours.days[String(weekday)]||[];available=Array.isArray(slots)&&slots.some((slot:any)=>Array.isArray(slot)&&now>=minutes(slot[0])&&now<minutes(slot[1]));}catch{available=false;}}
  const config=channel.config||{};const target=channel.channel_type==='email'?'mailto:'+config.email:channel.channel_type==='phone'?'tel:'+config.phone:channel.channel_type==='whatsapp'?'https://wa.me/'+String(config.phone||'').replace(/\D/g,''):config.url;
  selected.set(key,{name:channel.name,url:target,available,welcome_text:available?channel.welcome_text:hours.offlineText||'',channel_type:channel.channel_type});
 }
 return [...selected.values()];
}
````

````ts
import {createHash,randomBytes} from 'node:crypto';

import {query,transaction} from './db';
import {audit,DomainError} from './crud';
import {canRead,canWrite,getResource} from './registry';
import {inquiryScope} from './lead-scope';
import type {Actor,Row} from './types';

const uuid=z.string().uuid();
const day=z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/).refine(v=>{const d=new Date(v+'T00:00:00Z');return Number.isFinite(d.getTime())&&d.toISOString().slice(0,10)===v;},'日期无效');
const country=z.string().regex(/^([A-Z]{2})?$/);
function access(a:Actor,area:'leads'|'content',write=false){const r=getResource(area==='leads'?'inquiries':'content_item_translations');if(!(write?canWrite(a,r):canRead(a,r)))throw new DomainError('没有此功能的操作权限',403);}
function reviewer(a:Actor){if(!['admin','super_admin'].includes(a.role)&&!a.permissions?.includes('publishing.write'))throw new DomainError('需要发布审核权限',403);}
const hash=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const dateString=(v:any)=>v instanceof Date?v.toISOString().slice(0,10):String(v).slice(0,10);
async function inquiry(c:any,id:string){const row=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM inquiries WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE',[id])).rows[0];if(!row)throw new DomainError('询盘不存在',404);return row;}
async function event(c:any,i:Row,a:Actor|null,summary:string,details:Row={}){await c.query(`INSERT INTO crm_history(account_id,contact_id,inquiry_id,event_type,summary,details,actor_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,'trade_operation',$4,$5::jsonb,$6)`,[i.crm_account_id,i.crm_contact_id,i.id,summary,JSON.stringify(details),a?.id||null]);}

export async function tradeWorkspace(a:Actor,q='',page=1){access(a,'leads');const term='%'+q.trim().slice(0,100)+'%';const pList:unknown[]=[term,(page-1)*50];const sList=inquiryScope(a,'i',pList);const pTotal:unknown[]=[term];const sTotal=inquiryScope(a,'i',pTotal);const [inquiries,total,locales,rules]=await Promise.all([
 query(`SELECT i.id,i.inquiry_number,i.name,i.company,i.country,i.status,i.created_at,i.response_due_at,i.first_response_at,l.native_name AS language,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM trade_quotes WHERE inquiry_id=i.id) AS quotes FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN locales l ON l.id=i.locale_id
 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.inquiry_number ILIKE $1 OR i.name ILIKE $1 OR i.company ILIKE $1)${sList} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET $2`,pList),
 query(`SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM inquiries i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.inquiry_number ILIKE $1 OR i.name ILIKE $1 OR i.company ILIKE $1)${sTotal}`,pTotal),
 query('SELECT id,code,native_name FROM locales WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY code'),query('SELECT r.*,l.native_name AS language FROM trade_service_rules r JOIN locales l ON l.id=r.locale_id ORDER BY l.code,r.country')]);return {inquiries,total:total[0].n,locales,rules};}
export async function tradeInquiry(a:Actor,id:string){access(a,'leads');const p:unknown[]=[id];const s=inquiryScope(a,'inquiries',p);const i=(await query(`SELECT id,inquiry_number,name,email,company,country,status,message,first_response_at,response_due_at FROM inquiries WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL${s}`,p))[0];if(!i)throw new DomainError('询盘不存在',404);
 const [items,quotes,events,grants,deals]=await Promise.all([query('SELECT id,product_name_snapshot,sku_snapshot,quantity,unit FROM inquiry_items WHERE inquiry_id=$1 ORDER BY id',[id]),query('SELECT q.*,q.valid_until::text AS valid_until,u.display_name AS author FROM trade_quotes q JOIN users u ON u.id=q.created_by WHERE q.inquiry_id=$1 ORDER BY version DESC',[id]),query(`SELECT e.*,u.display_name AS actor FROM trade_quote_events e JOIN trade_quotes q ON q.id=e.quote_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE q.inquiry_id=$1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 100`,[id]),query('SELECT id,recipient,role,expires_at,revoked_at,created_at FROM trade_portal_grants WHERE inquiry_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100',[id]),query('SELECT id,title,stage FROM crm_opportunities WHERE inquiry_id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC',[id])]);return {inquiry:i,items,quotes,events,grants,deals};}

export const quoteSchema=z.object({inquiryId:uuid,opportunityId:uuid.nullable().optional(),currency:z.string().regex(/^[A-Z]{3}$/),incoterm:z.enum(['EXW','FCA','FOB','CFR','CIF','CPT','CIP','DAP','DPU','DDP']),validUntil:day,terms:z.string().max(5000),lines:z.array(z.object({itemId:uuid,quantity:z.number().positive().max(1e9).multipleOf(0.001),unitPrice:z.number().min(0).max(1e9).multipleOf(0.01)})).min(1).max(50)});
export async function createTradeQuote(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'leads',true);const input=quoteSchema.parse(raw);if(input.validUntil<today())throw new DomainError('报价有效期不能早于今天');if(new Set(input.lines.map(l=>l.itemId)).size!==input.lines.length)throw new DomainError('报价行不能重复');
 return transaction(async c=>{const i=await inquiry(c,input.inquiryId);if(input.opportunityId&&!(await c.query('SELECT id FROM crm_opportunities WHERE id=$1 AND inquiry_id=$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL',[input.opportunityId,i.id])).rowCount)throw new DomainError('商机必须属于当前询盘');
 const lines:Row[]=[];for(const line of input.lines){const item=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM inquiry_items WHERE id=$1 AND inquiry_id=$2',[line.itemId,i.id])).rows[0];if(!item)throw new DomainError('报价产品必须来自当前询盘');lines.push({itemId:item.id,name:item.product_name_snapshot,sku:item.sku_snapshot,unit:item.unit||'',quantity:line.quantity,unitPrice:line.unitPrice});}
 const priced=(await c.query(`SELECT jsonb_agg(v||jsonb_build_object('lineTotal',round((v->>'quantity')::numeric*(v->>'unitPrice')::numeric,2)::text) ORDER BY n) AS lines FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(v,n)`,[JSON.stringify(lines)])).rows[0].lines;
 const version=(await c.query('SELECT coalesce(max(version),0)+1 AS n FROM trade_quotes WHERE inquiry_id=$1',[i.id])).rows[0].n;
 const quote=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO trade_quotes(inquiry_id,opportunity_id,version,currency,incoterm,valid_until,terms,lines,total,created_by)
 VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb,(SELECT sum((v->>'lineTotal')::numeric) FROM jsonb_array_elements($8::jsonb) v),$9) RETURNING *`,[i.id,input.opportunityId||null,version,input.currency,input.incoterm,input.validUntil,input.terms,JSON.stringify(priced),a.id])).rows[0];
 await c.query(`INSERT INTO trade_quote_events(quote_id,action,actor_id) VALUES($1,'created',$2)`,[quote.id,a.id]);await event(c,i,a,'创建报价 V'+version,{quoteId:quote.id});await audit(c,a,'trade_quotes','create',null,quote);return quote;});}

export async function changeTradeQuote(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'leads',true);const v=z.object({id:uuid,action:z.enum(['submit','approve','return','issue','void']),note:z.string().trim().max(2000).default('')}).parse(raw);
 return transaction(async c=>{const found=(await c.query('SELECT inquiry_id FROM trade_quotes WHERE id=$1',[v.id])).rows[0];if(!found)throw new DomainError('报价不存在',404);const i=await inquiry(c,found.inquiry_id);const q=(await c.query('SELECT *,valid_until::text AS valid_until FROM trade_quotes WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[v.id])).rows[0];
 const transitions:Record<string,[string[],string]>={submit:[['draft'],'review'],approve:[['review'],'approved'],return:[['review'],'draft'],issue:[['approved'],'sent'],void:[['draft','review','approved','sent'],'void']};const [from,to]=transitions[v.action];if(!from.includes(q.status))throw new DomainError('报价状态已变化，请刷新',409);
 if(['approve','return'].includes(v.action)){reviewer(a);if(v.action==='approve'&&q.created_by===a.id)throw new DomainError('报价须由另一位审核员确认',403);}
 if(['approve','issue'].includes(v.action)&&dateString(q.valid_until)<today())throw new DomainError('报价已过期，请创建新版本');
 if(v.action==='issue'){const newer=(await c.query(`SELECT id FROM trade_quotes WHERE inquiry_id=$1 AND version>$2 AND sent_at IS NOT NULL`,[i.id,q.version])).rows[0];if(newer)throw new DomainError('较新版本已发出，不能发出旧版本');}
 const result=(await c.query(`UPDATE trade_quotes SET status=$2,reviewed_by=CASE WHEN $3='approve' THEN $4::uuid WHEN $3='return' THEN NULL ELSE reviewed_by END,sent_at=CASE WHEN $3='issue' THEN now() ELSE sent_at END WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *`,[q.id,to,v.action,a.id])).rows[0];
 await c.query('INSERT INTO trade_quote_events(quote_id,action,note,actor_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4)',[q.id,v.action,v.note,a.id]);await event(c,i,a,'报价 V'+q.version+' · '+to,{quoteId:q.id,note:v.note});await audit(c,a,'trade_quotes','update',q,result);return result;});}

export async function createPortalGrant(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'leads',true);const v=z.object({inquiryId:uuid,recipient:z.string().trim().email().max(254),role:z.enum(['customer','partner']),days:z.number().int().min(1).max(30)}).parse(raw);return transaction(async c=>{const i=await inquiry(c,v.inquiryId);if(v.role==='customer'&&v.recipient.toLowerCase()!==String(i.email).toLowerCase())throw new DomainError('客户邀请必须使用询盘联系人邮箱');const token=randomBytes(32).toString('hex');const row=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO trade_portal_grants(inquiry_id,recipient,role,expires_at,token_hash,created_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,now()+make_interval(days=>$4),$5,$6) RETURNING id,expires_at`,[i.id,v.recipient,v.role,v.days,hash(token),a.id])).rows[0];await event(c,i,a,'创建'+(v.role==='customer'?'客户':'渠道')+'访问邀请',{grantId:row.id,recipient:v.recipient});await audit(c,a,'trade_portal_grants','create',null,{id:row.id,inquiryId:i.id,role:v.role});return {...row,token};});}
export async function revokePortalGrant(a:Actor,id:string){access(a,'leads',true);return transaction(async c=>{const before=(await c.query('SELECT id,inquiry_id,revoked_at FROM trade_portal_grants WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[id])).rows[0];if(!before)throw new DomainError('邀请不存在',404);await c.query('UPDATE trade_portal_grants SET revoked_at=coalesce(revoked_at,now()) WHERE id=$1',[id]);await audit(c,a,'trade_portal_grants','revoke',before,{id});return {ok:true};});}
async function grant(token:string){if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(token))throw new DomainError('邀请无效或已过期',401);const g=(await query(`SELECT g.id,g.inquiry_id,g.role FROM trade_portal_grants g JOIN inquiries i ON i.id=g.inquiry_id WHERE g.token_hash=$1 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.expires_at>now() AND i.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF g`,[hash(token)]))[0];if(!g)throw new DomainError('邀请无效或已过期',401);return g;}
export async function portalWorkspace(token:string){return transaction(async()=>{const g=await grant(token);const i=(await query('SELECT inquiry_number,name,company,status,message FROM inquiries WHERE id=$1',[g.inquiry_id]))[0];const items=await query('SELECT product_name_snapshot,sku_snapshot,quantity,unit FROM inquiry_items WHERE inquiry_id=$1 ORDER BY id',[g.inquiry_id]);const quotes=await query(`SELECT id,version,currency,incoterm,valid_until::text AS valid_until,terms,lines,total,status,sent_at FROM trade_quotes WHERE inquiry_id=$1 AND sent_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY version DESC`,[g.inquiry_id]);return {role:g.role,inquiry:i,items,quotes};});}
export async function portalDecision(token:string,raw:unknown){const v=z.object({quoteId:uuid,decision:z.enum(['accepted','rejected']),note:z.string().trim().max(2000).default('')}).parse(raw);return transaction(async c=>{const g=await grant(token);if(g.role!=='customer')throw new DomainError('渠道邀请只有查看权限',403);const i=await inquiry(c,g.inquiry_id);const q=(await c.query('SELECT *,valid_until::text AS valid_until FROM trade_quotes WHERE id=$1 AND inquiry_id=$2 FOR UPDATE',[v.quoteId,i.id])).rows[0];if(!q||q.status!=='sent'||dateString(q.valid_until)<today())throw new DomainError('报价已变更或过期，请联系销售',409);if((await c.query('SELECT id FROM trade_quotes WHERE inquiry_id=$1 AND version>$2 AND sent_at IS NOT NULL',[i.id,q.version])).rowCount)throw new DomainError('请使用最新已发出的报价',409);
 await c.query('UPDATE trade_quotes SET status=$2 WHERE id=$1',[q.id,v.decision]);await c.query('INSERT INTO trade_quote_events(quote_id,action,note) VALUES($1,$2,$3)',[q.id,v.decision,v.note]);await event(c,i,null,'客户'+(v.decision==='accepted'?'确认':'拒绝')+'报价 V'+q.version,{quoteId:q.id,grantId:g.id,note:v.note});return {ok:true};});}

export const marketCardSchema=z.object({localeId:uuid,country:country.default(''),kind:z.enum(['market','certificate','case','service']),title:z.string().trim().min(2).max(160),summary:z.string().trim().min(2).max(2000),sourceUrl:z.string().max(1000).refine(v=>!/[\s\\]/.test(v)&&(/^https:\/\//.test(v)||/^\/[^/]/.test(v)), '请使用 HTTPS 或站内页面路径'),validUntil:day.nullable()});
export async function marketWorkspace(a:Actor,q='',page=1){access(a,'content');const [cards,locales,rules,pages,total]=await Promise.all([query(`SELECT m.*,m.valid_until::text AS valid_until,l.native_name AS language,u.display_name AS author FROM trade_market_cards m JOIN locales l ON l.id=m.locale_id JOIN users u ON u.id=m.created_by WHERE m.title ILIKE $1 ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET $2`,['%'+q+'%',(page-1)*50]),query('SELECT id,code,native_name FROM locales WHERE is_enabled ORDER BY code'),query('SELECT r.*,l.native_name AS language FROM trade_service_rules r JOIN locales l ON l.id=r.locale_id ORDER BY l.code,r.country'),query(`SELECT route,snapshot->>'title' AS title,locale_id FROM published_documents WHERE snapshot->>'title' ILIKE $1 ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 100`,['%'+q+'%']),query('SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM trade_market_cards WHERE title ILIKE $1',['%'+q+'%'])]);return {cards,locales,rules,pages,total:total[0].n};}
export async function createMarketCard(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'content',true);const v=marketCardSchema.parse(raw);if(v.kind==='certificate'&&!v.validUntil)throw new DomainError('证书必须填写有效期');if(v.validUntil&&v.validUntil<today())throw new DomainError('有效期不能早于今天');return transaction(async c=>{let sourceHash=null;if(v.sourceUrl.startsWith('/')){const p=(await c.query('SELECT md5(snapshot::text) AS hash FROM published_documents WHERE route=$1 AND locale_id=$2',[v.sourceUrl,v.localeId])).rows[0];if(!p)throw new DomainError('请选择当前语言的已发布页面');sourceHash=p.hash;}else if(v.kind==='market'||v.kind==='case')throw new DomainError('市场推荐和案例必须关联本站已发布页面');const row=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO trade_market_cards(locale_id,country,kind,title,summary,source_url,source_hash,valid_until,created_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9) RETURNING *`,[v.localeId,v.country,v.kind,v.title,v.summary,v.sourceUrl,sourceHash,v.validUntil,a.id])).rows[0];await audit(c,a,'trade_market_cards','create',null,row);return row;});}
export async function changeMarketCard(a:Actor,id:string,action:'publish'|'withdraw'){access(a,'content',true);if(action==='publish')reviewer(a);return transaction(async c=>{const before=(await c.query('SELECT *,valid_until::text AS valid_until FROM trade_market_cards WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[id])).rows[0];if(!before)throw new DomainError('内容不存在',404);if(action==='publish'){if(before.created_by===a.id)throw new DomainError('请由另一位审核员核对内容和证明',403);if(before.valid_until&&dateString(before.valid_until)<today())throw new DomainError('内容已过期');if(before.source_hash&&!(await c.query('SELECT 1 FROM published_documents WHERE route=$1 AND md5(snapshot::text)=$2',[before.source_url,before.source_hash])).rowCount)throw new DomainError('关联页面已变更，请创建新卡片并重新审核');}
 const row=(await c.query(`UPDATE trade_market_cards SET status=$2,reviewed_by=CASE WHEN $2='published' THEN $3::uuid ELSE reviewed_by END WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *`,[id,action==='publish'?'published':'withdrawn',a.id])).rows[0];await audit(c,a,'trade_market_cards','update',before,row);return row;});}
export async function saveTradeService(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'leads',true);const v=z.object({localeId:uuid,country:country.default(''),hours:z.number().int().min(1).max(720)}).parse(raw);return transaction(async c=>{const before=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM trade_service_rules WHERE locale_id=$1 AND country=$2',[v.localeId,v.country])).rows[0];const row=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO trade_service_rules(locale_id,country,response_hours,updated_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT(locale_id,country) DO UPDATE SET response_hours=excluded.response_hours,updated_by=excluded.updated_by RETURNING *`,[v.localeId,v.country,v.hours,a.id])).rows[0];await audit(c,a,'trade_service_rules','save',before,row);return row;});}
export async function recordTradeResponse(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'leads',true);const v=z.object({inquiryId:uuid,note:z.string().trim().min(5).max(2000)}).parse(raw);return transaction(async c=>{const i=await inquiry(c,v.inquiryId);if(i.first_response_at)throw new DomainError('已记录首次回复',409);await c.query('UPDATE inquiries SET first_response_at=now() WHERE id=$1',[i.id]);await event(c,i,a,'记录首次人工回复',{note:v.note});await audit(c,a,'inquiries','first_response',{id:i.id},{id:i.id,note:v.note});return {ok:true};});}
export async function publicTradeCards(locale:string,market:string){return {cards:await query(`SELECT m.kind,m.title,m.summary,m.source_url,m.valid_until::text AS valid_until FROM trade_market_cards m JOIN locales l ON l.id=m.locale_id
 WHERE l.code=$1 AND l.is_enabled AND m.country IN ('',$2) AND m.status='published' AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until>=CURRENT_DATE)
 AND (m.source_hash IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published_documents p WHERE p.route=m.source_url AND md5(p.snapshot::text)=m.source_hash)) ORDER BY m.country DESC,m.created_at DESC LIMIT 30`,[locale,market])};}
export async function recordTradeVisit(raw:unknown){const v=z.object({id:uuid,locale:z.string().max(10),path:z.string().regex(/^\/[^?#]*$/).max(1000),source:z.string().max(200).default(''),consent:z.literal(true)}).parse(raw);await query(`INSERT INTO trade_visits(id,locale_id,path,source) SELECT $1,id,$3,$4 FROM locales WHERE code=$2 AND is_enabled ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING`,[v.id,v.locale,v.path,v.source]);return {ok:true};}

export const funnelSchema=z.object({from:day,to:day,source:z.string().max(200).default(''),locale:z.string().max(10).default(''),country:z.string().max(80).default(''),product:z.string().max(100).default('')});
// 获客漏斗是**内部经营视图**（全量询盘的编号/客户姓名/国家/来源），不是客户自助视图：
// 门禁用 leads.**write**，避免只有 leads.read 的 client 角色读到别人的询盘（F-3 裁定 (b)，2026-10-01）。
export async function tradeFunnel(a:Actor,raw:unknown){access(a,'leads',true);const v=funnelSchema.parse(raw);if(v.to<v.from||new Date(v.to).getTime()-new Date(v.from).getTime()>366*86400000)throw new DomainError('请选择一年以内的日期范围');return transaction(async c=>{await c.query('SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ');const rows=await query(`SELECT i.id,i.inquiry_number,i.name,i.country,coalesce(i.utm_source,'') AS source,l.code AS locale,i.visit_id,
 (i.status='qualified' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_history h WHERE h.inquiry_id=i.id AND (h.details->>'status'='qualified' OR h.details->>'oldStatus'='qualified'))) AS qualified,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trade_quotes q WHERE q.inquiry_id=i.id AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS quoted,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunities d WHERE d.inquiry_id=i.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.stage='won') AS won,
 i.created_at FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN locales l ON l.id=i.locale_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status<>'spam'
 AND i.created_at>=$1::date AND i.created_at<$2::date+interval '1 day' AND ($3='' OR i.utm_source=$3) AND ($4='' OR l.code=$4) AND ($5='' OR upper(i.country)=upper($5))
 AND ($6='' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inquiry_items x WHERE x.inquiry_id=i.id AND (x.sku_snapshot ILIKE '%'||$6||'%' OR x.product_name_snapshot ILIKE '%'||$6||'%'))) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 10001`,[v.from,v.to,v.source,v.locale,v.country,v.product]);if(rows.length>10000)throw new DomainError('超过一万条，请缩小范围');const visits=(await query(`SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM trade_visits v JOIN locales l ON l.id=v.locale_id WHERE v.created_at>=$1::date AND v.created_at<$2::date+interval '1 day' AND ($3='' OR v.source=$3) AND ($4='' OR l.code=$4)`,[v.from,v.to,v.source,v.locale]))[0].n;return {rows,visits:v.country||v.product?null:visits,totals:{inquiries:rows.length,qualified:rows.filter(r=>r.qualified).length,quoted:rows.filter(r=>r.quoted).length,won:rows.filter(r=>r.won).length,tracked:rows.filter(r=>r.visit_id).length},generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};});}
````

## packages/domain/src/translation-tools.ts

````ts
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {query,transaction} from './db';
import {audit,DomainError} from './crud';
import {canRead,canWrite,getResource} from './registry';
import type {Actor,Row} from './types';

function requireTranslation(actor:Actor,write=false){
 const r=getResource('content_item_translations');
 if(!(write?canWrite(actor,r):canRead(actor,r))&&!(write?canWrite(actor,getResource('product_translations')):canRead(actor,getResource('product_translations'))))throw new DomainError('没有翻译权限',403);
}
export function sourceHash(text:string){return createHash('sha256').update(text.trim()).digest('hex');}
export async function translationTerms(actor:Actor){requireTranslation(actor);return query(`SELECT t.id,t.source_term,t.target_term,t.note,t.source_locale_id,t.target_locale_id,t.approval_status,t.review_note,t.reviewed_at,s.native_name AS source_language,d.native_name AS target_language,u.display_name AS reviewer_name FROM translation_terms t JOIN locales s ON s.id=t.source_locale_id JOIN locales d ON d.id=t.target_locale_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=t.reviewed_by ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.approval_status='pending' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,t.updated_at DESC LIMIT 200`);}
export async function saveTranslationTerm(actor:Actor,input:{id?:string;sourceLocaleId:string;targetLocaleId:string;sourceTerm:string;targetTerm:string;note?:string}){
 requireTranslation(actor,true);
 if(input.sourceLocaleId===input.targetLocaleId)throw new DomainError('源语言与目标语言不能相同');
 return transaction(async c=>{
  const result=input.id?
   (await c.query("UPDATE translation_terms SET source_locale_id=$2,target_locale_id=$3,source_term=$4,target_term=$5,note=$6,approval_status='pending',reviewed_by=NULL,reviewed_at=NULL,review_note=NULL WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *",[input.id,input.sourceLocaleId,input.targetLocaleId,input.sourceTerm.trim(),input.targetTerm.trim(),input.note||null])).rows[0]:
   (await c.query('INSERT INTO translation_terms(source_locale_id,target_locale_id,source_term,target_term,note,created_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING *',[input.sourceLocaleId,input.targetLocaleId,input.sourceTerm.trim(),input.targetTerm.trim(),input.note||null,actor.id])).rows[0];
  if(!result)throw new DomainError('术语不存在',404);
  await audit(c,actor,'translation_terms',input.id?'update':'create',null,result);return result;
 });
}
export async function removeTranslationTerm(actor:Actor,id:string){requireTranslation(actor,true);return transaction(async c=>{const old=(await c.query('DELETE FROM translation_terms WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *',[id])).rows[0];if(!old)throw new DomainError('术语不存在',404);await audit(c,actor,'translation_terms','delete',old,null);return {ok:true};});}
export function canReviewTranslationTerm(actor:Actor){return ['admin','super_admin','reviewer'].includes(actor.role)||!!actor.permissions?.includes('translation.approve');}
export async function reviewTranslationTerm(actor:Actor,id:string,decision:'approved'|'rejected',note=''){
 requireTranslation(actor);if(!canReviewTranslationTerm(actor))throw new DomainError('只有审核员或管理员可审批术语',403);
 return transaction(async c=>{
  const before=(await c.query('SELECT * FROM translation_terms WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE',[id])).rows[0];if(!before)throw new DomainError('术语不存在',404);
  if(before.approval_status!=='pending')throw new DomainError('这条术语已经审批；修改后才能重新提交',409);
  const after=(await c.query('UPDATE translation_terms SET approval_status=$2,reviewed_by=$3,reviewed_at=now(),review_note=$4 WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *',[id,decision,actor.id,note.trim()||null])).rows[0];
  await c.query('INSERT INTO translation_term_reviews(term_id,decision,note,reviewer_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4)',[id,decision,note.trim()||null,actor.id]);
  await audit(c,actor,'translation_terms','review',before,after);return after;
 });
}
export async function translationMemories(actor:Actor){requireTranslation(actor);return query(`SELECT m.id,m.source_text,m.target_text,m.source_locale_id,m.target_locale_id,m.updated_at,s.native_name AS source_language,d.native_name AS target_language FROM translation_memory m JOIN locales s ON s.id=m.source_locale_id JOIN locales d ON d.id=m.target_locale_id ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100`);}
export async function translationComparison(actor:Actor,id:string){
 requireTranslation(actor);
 const job=(await query('SELECT * FROM translation_jobs WHERE id=$1',[id]))[0];if(!job)throw new DomainError('翻译任务不存在',404);
 if(!['content_item_translations','product_translations'].includes(job.entity_type)||!canRead(actor,getResource(job.entity_type)))throw new DomainError('没有查看此翻译的权限',403);
 const table=job.entity_type;
 const source=(await query(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,[job.entity_id]))[0];
 const target=job.target_translation_id?(await query(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,[job.target_translation_id]))[0]:null;
 if(!source||!target)throw new DomainError('原文或译文草稿不存在',404);
 const fields=table==='content_item_translations'?['title','excerpt','body']:['name','short_description','description','features','applications'];
 return {job:{id:job.id,status:job.status},source:Object.fromEntries(fields.map(k=>[k,source[k]])),target:Object.fromEntries(fields.map(k=>[k,target[k]])),targetPath:target.path};
}
export async function memoryLookup(sourceCode:string,targetCode:string,texts:string[]){
 const hashes=texts.map(sourceHash);
 const rows=await query<Row>(`SELECT source_hash,source_text,target_text FROM translation_memory WHERE source_locale_id=(SELECT id FROM locales WHERE code=$1) AND target_locale_id=(SELECT id FROM locales WHERE code=$2) AND source_hash=ANY($3::char(64)[])`,[sourceCode,targetCode,hashes]);
 const byHash=new Map(rows.map(r=>[String(r.source_hash).trim(),r]));
 return texts.map((text,i)=>{const candidate=byHash.get(hashes[i]);return candidate?.source_text===text.trim()?String(candidate.target_text):null;});
}
export async function glossaryFor(sourceCode:string,targetCode:string){return query<{source_term:string;target_term:string}>(`SELECT source_term,target_term FROM translation_terms WHERE approval_status='approved' AND source_locale_id=(SELECT id FROM locales WHERE code=$1) AND target_locale_id=(SELECT id FROM locales WHERE code=$2) ORDER BY length(source_term) DESC LIMIT 100`,[sourceCode,targetCode]);}

export async function approveTranslationBatch(actor:Actor,ids:string[]){
 requireTranslation(actor,true);
 const done:string[]=[];const failed:{id:string;error:string}[]=[];
 for(const id of [...new Set(ids)].slice(0,30)){
  try{const {translationAction}=await import('./translation');await translationAction(actor,id,'approve');done.push(id);}
  catch(error){failed.push({id,error:error instanceof Error?error.message:'审核失败'});}
 }
 return {done,failed};
}
````

## packages/domain/src/translation.ts

````ts
import {query, transaction} from './db';
import {audit, DomainError} from './crud';
import {canRead, canWrite, getResource} from './registry';
import type {Actor, Row} from './types';
import {activeLLMConfig,llmTranslateBatch,normalizeLLMEndpoint,LLM_PROVIDER} from './llm';
import {glossaryFor,memoryLookup,sourceHash} from './translation-tools';

export type TranslationKind = 'content_item_translations' | 'product_translations';
const kinds:TranslationKind[] = ['content_item_translations','product_translations'];
const translatedKeys = new Set(['title','name','excerpt','short_description','description','text','subtitle','alt','label','question','answer','quote','author','primary_button_text','secondary_button_text']);

function kind(value:string):TranslationKind {
 if (!kinds.includes(value as TranslationKind)) throw new DomainError('只支持页面、文章和产品自动翻译');
 return value as TranslationKind;
}
function allowed(actor:Actor, table:TranslationKind, write=false) {
 if (!(write ? canWrite(actor,getResource(table)) : canRead(actor,getResource(table)))) throw new DomainError('没有翻译权限',403);
}

// 对外只暴露“能不能翻译、为什么不能”，具体凭据由 llm 模块负责。
export async function translationConfig(){
 const value=await activeLLMConfig();
 const reason=value.keyProblem||(!value.apiKey?'尚未保存 DeepSeek API 密钥':!value.enabled?'自动翻译已停用':'');
 return {configured:!!value.apiKey&&value.enabled&&!value.keyProblem,provider:value.provider,model:value.model,enabled:value.enabled,reason};
}

function route(locale:string, source:Row, table:TranslationKind, slug:string) {
 return '/'+locale+(table==='product_translations'?'/products/':source.content_type==='article'?'/blog/':'/')+slug;
}
async function sourceRow(table:TranslationKind,id:string) {
 const parent=table==='product_translations'?'products':'content_items';
 const fk=table==='product_translations'?'product_id':'content_item_id';
 const contentType=table==='content_item_translations'?'p.content_type':'NULL::text';
 const row=(await query(`SELECT t.*,${contentType} AS content_type,l.code AS source_code,l.native_name AS source_language FROM ${table} t JOIN ${parent} p ON p.id=t.${fk} JOIN locales l ON l.id=t.locale_id WHERE t.id=$1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL`,[id]))[0];
 if(!row)throw new DomainError('原文不存在或已删除',404);
 return row;
}
function sameParent(table:TranslationKind){return table==='product_translations'?'product_id':'content_item_id';}

export async function translationTargets(actor:Actor,tableName:string,sourceId:string){
 const table=kind(tableName);allowed(actor,table);
 const source=await sourceRow(table,sourceId);
 const fk=sameParent(table);
 const statusName=table==='product_translations'?'publish_status':'status';
 const locales=await query(`SELECT l.id,l.code,l.native_name,t.id AS existing_id,t.${statusName} AS existing_status FROM locales l LEFT JOIN ${table} t ON t.locale_id=l.id AND t.${fk}=$1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE l.is_enabled ORDER BY l.sort_order,l.code`,[source[fk]]);
 return {source:{id:source.id,title:source.title||source.name,locale_id:source.locale_id,language:source.source_language},locales};
}

export async function enqueueTranslations(actor:Actor,input:{entityType:string;entityId:string;targetLocaleIds:string[];overwriteDraft?:boolean}){
 const table=kind(input.entityType);allowed(actor,table,true);
 const config=await translationConfig();
 if(!config.configured)throw new DomainError(config.reason||'请先到“自动翻译 → AI 设置”配置 DeepSeek',503);
 const source=await sourceRow(table,input.entityId);
 const fk=sameParent(table);
 const targets=[...new Set(input.targetLocaleIds)];
 if(!targets.length||targets.length>20)throw new DomainError('请选择 1 到 20 种目标语言');
 return transaction(async c=>{
  const jobs:Row[]=[];
  for(const localeId of targets){
   if(localeId===source.locale_id)throw new DomainError('目标语言不能与原文相同');
   const locale=(await c.query('SELECT id,code FROM locales WHERE id=$1 AND is_enabled',[localeId])).rows[0];
   if(!locale)throw new DomainError('目标语言未启用');
   const existing=(await c.query(`SELECT id,${table==='product_translations'?'publish_status':'status'} AS status FROM ${table} WHERE ${fk}=$1 AND locale_id=$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,[source[fk],localeId])).rows[0];
   if(existing&&(!input.overwriteDraft||!['draft','review'].includes(existing.status)))throw new DomainError('目标语言已有内容；只能勾选覆盖已有草稿，已发布内容不可覆盖');
   const duplicate=(await c.query("SELECT 1 FROM translation_jobs WHERE entity_type=$1 AND entity_id=$2 AND target_locale_id=$3 AND status IN ('pending','processing') LIMIT 1",[table,source.id,localeId])).rows[0];
   if(duplicate)throw new DomainError('该目标语言已有翻译任务，请等待完成');
   const job=(await c.query(`INSERT INTO translation_jobs(entity_type,entity_id,source_locale_id,target_locale_id,provider,requested_by,result_data)
    VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7) RETURNING id,status`,[table,source.id,source.locale_id,localeId,config.provider,actor.id,JSON.stringify({overwriteDraft:!!input.overwriteDraft})])).rows[0];
   jobs.push(job);
  }
  return {jobs};
 });
}

export async function translationJobs(actor:Actor){
 if(!kinds.some(t=>canRead(actor,getResource(t))))throw new DomainError('没有翻译权限',403);
 const rows=await query(`SELECT j.id,j.entity_type,j.status,j.provider,j.error_message,j.created_at,j.started_at,j.completed_at,
  sl.native_name AS source_language,tl.native_name AS target_language,
  coalesce(ct.title,pt.name,'原文已删除') AS source_title,
  coalesce(target_content.path,target_product.path) AS target_path,
  j.target_translation_id
  FROM translation_jobs j
  JOIN locales sl ON sl.id=j.source_locale_id JOIN locales tl ON tl.id=j.target_locale_id
  LEFT JOIN content_item_translations ct ON j.entity_type='content_item_translations' AND ct.id=j.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN product_translations pt ON j.entity_type='product_translations' AND pt.id=j.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN content_item_translations target_content ON j.entity_type='content_item_translations' AND target_content.id=j.target_translation_id
  LEFT JOIN product_translations target_product ON j.entity_type='product_translations' AND target_product.id=j.target_translation_id
  WHERE j.entity_type=ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 100`,[kinds.filter(t=>canRead(actor,getResource(t)))]);
 return {rows,config:await translationConfig()};
}

export async function translationAction(actor:Actor,id:string,action:'retry'|'approve'){
 const current=(await query('SELECT * FROM translation_jobs WHERE id=$1',[id]))[0];
 if(!current)throw new DomainError('翻译任务不存在',404);
 const table=kind(current.entity_type);
 allowed(actor,table,true);
 if(action==='retry'){
  if(current.status!=='failed')throw new DomainError('只有失败任务可以重试');
  const config=await translationConfig();
  if(!config.configured)throw new DomainError(config.reason||'请先配置翻译服务',503);
  await query("UPDATE translation_jobs SET status='pending',error_message=NULL,started_at=NULL,completed_at=NULL,attempt_count=0 WHERE id=$1 AND status='failed'",[id]);
 }else if(action==='approve'){
  if(current.status!=='review')throw new DomainError('任务尚未进入待审核状态');
  await transaction(async c=>{
   const job=(await c.query("SELECT * FROM translation_jobs WHERE id=$1 AND status='review' FOR UPDATE",[id])).rows[0];
   if(!job)throw new DomainError('任务状态已改变，请刷新后重试',409);
   const target=job.target_translation_id?(await c.query(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL`,[job.target_translation_id])).rows[0]:null;
   if(!target)throw new DomainError('译文草稿不存在，请先检查内容');
   const pairs=Array.isArray(job.result_data?.segmentPairs)?job.result_data.segmentPairs:[];
   for(const pair of pairs){
    if(!Array.isArray(pair.path)||typeof pair.source!=='string')continue;
    let value:any=target;for(const key of pair.path)value=value?.[key];
    if(typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim())continue;
    await c.query(`INSERT INTO translation_memory(source_locale_id,target_locale_id,source_hash,source_text,target_text,approved_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT(source_locale_id,target_locale_id,source_hash) DO UPDATE SET target_text=EXCLUDED.target_text,approved_by=EXCLUDED.approved_by`,[job.source_locale_id,job.target_locale_id,sourceHash(pair.source),pair.source.trim(),value.trim(),actor.id]);
   }
   await c.query("UPDATE translation_jobs SET status='approved' WHERE id=$1",[id]);
   await audit(c,actor,'translation_jobs','approve',job,{...job,status:'approved'});
  });
 }else throw new DomainError('未知操作');
 return {ok:true};
}

type Segment={path:(string|number)[];text:string};
function segments(document:Row){
 const found:Segment[]=[];
 function visit(value:unknown,path:(string|number)[]){
  if(typeof value==='string'){
   const key=path.at(-1);
   if(value.trim()&&(typeof key==='string'&&translatedKeys.has(key)||typeof key==='number'&&['features','applications'].includes(String(path[0]))))found.push({path,text:value});
  }else if(Array.isArray(value))value.forEach((x,i)=>visit(x,[...path,i]));
  else if(value&&typeof value==='object')for(const [key,item] of Object.entries(value))visit(item,[...path,key]);
 }
 visit(document,[]);return found;
}
function setPath(object:Row,path:(string|number)[],value:string){let target:Row=object;for(const key of path.slice(0,-1))target=target[key];target[path.at(-1)!]=value;}
const usageKeys=['prompt_tokens','completion_tokens','total_tokens'] as const;

// 分批调用上游并按原顺序拼回。任一批失败即整体失败，已产生的译文不落库。
async function translateTexts(texts:string[],sourceLocale:string,targetLocale:string){
 const config=await activeLLMConfig();
 if(config.keyProblem)throw new DomainError(config.keyProblem,503);
 if(!config.apiKey)throw new DomainError('尚未配置 DeepSeek API 密钥，请到“自动翻译 → AI 设置”填写并保存',503);
 if(!config.enabled)throw new DomainError('自动翻译已停用，请在“自动翻译 → AI 设置”勾选“启用自动翻译”',503);
 const endpoint=normalizeLLMEndpoint(config.url);
 const all:string[]=new Array(texts.length);
 const usage:Row={prompt_tokens:0,completion_tokens:0,total_tokens:0};
 const startedAt=Date.now();
 const remembered=await memoryLookup(sourceLocale,targetLocale,texts);
 const terms=await glossaryFor(sourceLocale,targetLocale);
 const missing=texts.map((text,index)=>({text,index})).filter(x=>{if(remembered[x.index]){all[x.index]=remembered[x.index]!;return false;}return true;});
 let batches=0,offset=0;
 while(offset<missing.length){
  const batch:{text:string;index:number}[]=[];let length=0;
  while(offset<missing.length&&batch.length<12&&(length+missing[offset].text.length<4500||!batch.length)){
   batch.push(missing[offset]);length+=missing[offset].text.length;offset++;
  }
  const result=await llmTranslateBatch({endpoint,apiKey:config.apiKey,model:config.model},batch.map(x=>x.text),sourceLocale,targetLocale,terms);
  for(const key of usageKeys)usage[key]=(Number(usage[key])||0)+(Number(result.usage?.[key])||0);
  batch.forEach((item,i)=>{all[item.index]=result.texts[i];});
  batches++;
 }
 return {texts:all,usage,model:config.model,durationMs:Date.now()-startedAt,batches};
}

export async function claimTranslationJob(){
 await query("UPDATE translation_jobs SET status=CASE WHEN attempt_count>=3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END,error_message=CASE WHEN attempt_count>=3 THEN '任务中断次数过多，请手动重试' ELSE NULL END WHERE status='processing' AND started_at<now()-interval '60 minutes'");
 return (await query(`WITH next AS (SELECT id FROM translation_jobs WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1)
  UPDATE translation_jobs j SET status='processing',started_at=now(),completed_at=NULL,error_message=NULL,attempt_count=attempt_count+1 FROM next WHERE j.id=next.id RETURNING j.*`))[0];
}

export async function processTranslationJob(job:Row){
 const table=kind(job.entity_type);
 try{
  const source=await sourceRow(table,job.entity_id);
  const targetLocale=(await query('SELECT id,code FROM locales WHERE id=$1 AND is_enabled',[job.target_locale_id]))[0];
  if(!targetLocale)throw new Error('目标语言已停用');
  const fk=sameParent(table);
  const statusName=table==='product_translations'?'publish_status':'status';
  const existing=(await query(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE ${fk}=$1 AND locale_id=$2`,[source[fk],targetLocale.id]))[0];
  if(existing&&!existing.deleted_at&&(!job.result_data?.overwriteDraft||!['draft','review'].includes(existing[statusName])))throw new Error('目标语言已有内容，任务未覆盖它');
  const originalUpdated=existing?.updated_at?new Date(existing.updated_at).getTime():null;
  let document:Row=table==='product_translations'
   ?{name:source.name,short_description:source.short_description,description:source.description,features:source.features,applications:source.applications}
   :{title:source.title,excerpt:source.excerpt,body:source.body};
  if(table==='content_item_translations'){
   const blocks=await query('SELECT block_type AS type,data FROM content_blocks WHERE content_translation_id=$1 AND is_enabled ORDER BY sort_order,id',[source.id]);
   if(blocks.length)document.body=blocks;
  }
  document=structuredClone(document);
  const parts=segments(document);
  if(!parts.length)throw new Error('原文没有可翻译的文字');
  if(parts.length>150||parts.reduce((n,item)=>n+item.text.length,0)>60000)throw new Error('原文超过单次翻译上限，请拆分内容后重试');
  const translated=await translateTexts(parts.map(x=>x.text),source.source_code,targetLocale.code);
  parts.forEach((item,i)=>setPath(document,item.path,translated.texts[i]));
  await transaction(async c=>{
   const fresh=(await c.query(`SELECT * FROM ${table} WHERE ${fk}=$1 AND locale_id=$2 FOR UPDATE`,[source[fk],targetLocale.id])).rows[0];
   if((fresh?.updated_at?new Date(fresh.updated_at).getTime():null)!==originalUpdated)throw new Error('目标草稿已被其他人修改，翻译没有覆盖');
   if(fresh&&!fresh.deleted_at&&(!job.result_data?.overwriteDraft||!['draft','review'].includes(fresh[statusName])))throw new Error('目标语言不再允许覆盖');
   const title=table==='product_translations'?document.name:document.title;
   const reviving=!!fresh?.deleted_at;
   let slug=reviving?source.slug:fresh?.slug||source.slug;
   if(!fresh||reviving){
    let candidate=route(targetLocale.code,source,table,slug);
    if((await c.query('SELECT 1 FROM site_paths WHERE path=$1',[candidate])).rowCount){slug=(source.slug+'-'+String(source[fk]).slice(0,8)).slice(0,200);candidate=route(targetLocale.code,source,table,slug);}
    if((await c.query('SELECT 1 FROM site_paths WHERE path=$1',[candidate])).rowCount)throw new Error('目标语言的网址路径已被占用');
   }
   const path=reviving?route(targetLocale.code,source,table,slug):fresh?.path||route(targetLocale.code,source,table,slug);
   const row=table==='product_translations'
    ?fresh?(await c.query(`UPDATE product_translations SET name=$2,short_description=$3,description=$4,features=$5,applications=$6,publish_status='draft',slug=$7,path=$8,deleted_at=NULL WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *`,[fresh.id,title,document.short_description,document.description,JSON.stringify(document.features),JSON.stringify(document.applications),slug,path])).rows[0]
      :(await c.query(`INSERT INTO product_translations(product_id,locale_id,name,slug,path,short_description,description,features,applications) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9) RETURNING *`,[source.product_id,targetLocale.id,title,slug,path,document.short_description,document.description,JSON.stringify(document.features),JSON.stringify(document.applications)])).rows[0]
    :fresh?(await c.query(`UPDATE content_item_translations SET title=$2,excerpt=$3,body=$4,status='draft',slug=$5,path=$6,deleted_at=NULL WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *`,[fresh.id,title,document.excerpt,JSON.stringify(document.body),slug,path])).rows[0]
      :(await c.query(`INSERT INTO content_item_translations(content_item_id,locale_id,title,slug,path,excerpt,body) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7) RETURNING *`,[source.content_item_id,targetLocale.id,title,slug,path,document.excerpt,JSON.stringify(document.body)])).rows[0];
   // Target page blocks take precedence over body during publishing. Keep them for recovery but disable them after an explicit draft overwrite.
   if(table==='content_item_translations'&&fresh)await c.query('UPDATE content_blocks SET is_enabled=false WHERE content_translation_id=$1 AND is_enabled',[fresh.id]);
   if(job.requested_by)await audit(c,{id:job.requested_by,email:'',role:'translator'},table,fresh?'update':'create',fresh||null,row);
   await c.query("UPDATE translation_jobs SET status='review',target_translation_id=$2,result_data=$3,error_message=NULL,completed_at=now() WHERE id=$1",[job.id,row.id,JSON.stringify({
    sourceUpdatedAt:source.updated_at,targetPath:row.path,translatedFields:parts.length,
    segmentPairs:parts.map(item=>({path:item.path,source:item.text})),
    metrics:{provider:LLM_PROVIDER,model:translated.model,batches:translated.batches,durationMs:translated.durationMs,promptTokens:translated.usage.prompt_tokens,completionTokens:translated.usage.completion_tokens,totalTokens:translated.usage.total_tokens},
   })]);
  });
 }catch(error){
  const message=error instanceof Error?error.message:'翻译任务失败';
  await query("UPDATE translation_jobs SET status='failed',error_message=$2,completed_at=now() WHERE id=$1 AND status='processing'",[job.id,message.slice(0,500)]);
  throw error;
 }
}

````
