## packages/ui/src/styles.ts

````ts
import {premiumCSS} from './premium';
import {tradeCSS} from './trade-style';
import {tradePublicCSS} from './trade-public';
const baseCSS=String.raw`
@layer reset,base,components;

@layer reset{
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body,h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit}
button,a,input,summary{touch-action:manipulation}
a{color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
}

@layer base{
:root{
  --ink:#0d1b2a;
  --ink-soft:#243a52;
  --paper:#ffffff;
  --surface:#f2f5f8;
  --surface-2:#e7edf4;
  --line:#dde4ec;
  --brand:#10365e;
  --brand-700:#0b2745;
  --brand-900:#071628;
  --accent:#c8963e;
  --accent-600:#a97c2b;
  --accent-ink:#86611d;
  --accent-tint:#faf4e8;
  --muted:#5a6b7f;
  --radius:6px;
  --shadow-sm:0 2px 10px rgba(13,27,42,.06);
  --shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(13,27,42,.12);
  --wrap:1380px;
  --pad:5%;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65}
a{text-decoration:none}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:700;line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5.2vw,4.6rem)}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.75rem,2.9vw,2.8rem);margin-bottom:1.1rem}
h3{font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.01em}
button{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#241a06}
html[lang=zh] h1,html[lang=zh] h2,html[lang=zh] h3{letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.35}
html[lang=zh] h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.2vw,3.5rem)}
html[lang=zh] h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.4vw,2.2rem)}
html[lang=zh] p,html[lang=zh] li{line-height:1.9}
}

@layer components{
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:10px;top:-100px;z-index:100;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:0 0 var(--radius) 0}
.skip-link:focus{top:0}

.site-header{display:flex;gap:30px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:92px;padding:16px var(--pad);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;backdrop-filter:saturate(150%) blur(6px)}
.wordmark{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:28px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.5px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--brand)}
.wordmark small{display:block;font:8px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:2.4px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px}
.site-header nav>ul{display:flex;align-items:center;list-style:none;padding:0;gap:28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.site-header nav li{position:relative}
.site-header nav a{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.site-header nav a:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.site-header nav li ul{display:none;position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 14px);left:0;min-width:200px;list-style:none;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.site-header nav li:hover>ul,.site-header nav li:focus-within>ul{display:block}
.site-header nav li ul li{padding:7px 0}
.header-tools{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;font-size:13px}
.header-phone{font-weight:600;color:var(--brand);white-space:nowrap}
.header-phone:before{content:'\260E';margin-right:7px;color:var(--accent)}
.header-phone:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.header-tools>a[href$='/search']{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted)}
.header-tools>a[href$='/search']:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.quote-link{background:var(--accent);color:#241a06;border:1px solid var(--accent);padding:11px 20px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}
.quote-link:hover{background:var(--accent-600);border-color:var(--accent-600);color:#241a06}
.language{position:relative}
.language summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.language ul{position:absolute;background:var(--paper);padding:10px 20px;list-style:none;right:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin:14px 0 0}
.language ul li{padding:5px 0}
.language ul a:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.nav-toggle{display:none;border:0;background:none;font-size:24px;color:var(--brand)}

.hero{position:relative;min-height:min(880px,92svh);background:var(--brand-900);color:#fff;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.hero-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(115% 85% at 80% 12%,rgba(200,150,62,.30),transparent 62%)}
.slide{min-height:min(880px,92svh);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:112px var(--pad);position:relative}
.slide[hidden]{display:none}
.slide picture{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1}
.slide picture:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(7,22,40,calc(var(--overlay) + .55)) 0%,rgba(7,22,40,var(--overlay)) 58%,rgba(7,22,40,calc(var(--overlay) + .24)) 100%)}
.slide img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.slide-copy{max-width:780px;position:relative}
.slide-copy.center{margin:auto;text-align:center}
.slide-copy.right{margin-left:auto;text-align:right}
.slide h1,.slide h2{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5.4vw,4.9rem);color:#fff;max-width:16ch;margin-bottom:26px;text-wrap:balance}
.slide-copy.center h1,.slide-copy.center h2{max-width:none}
.slide-copy>p:not(.kicker){max-width:56ch;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);font-size:17px;line-height:1.85}
.slide-copy.center>p:not(.kicker){margin-inline:auto}
.kicker{text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:20px;color:var(--accent-ink)}
.slide .kicker,.page-title .kicker,.cta .kicker{color:var(--accent)}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:22px;margin-top:38px}
.slide-copy.center .hero-actions{justify-content:center}
.button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;background:var(--accent);color:#241a06;border:0;padding:16px 28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;border-radius:var(--radius);transition:background .2s,color .2s,transform .2s}
.button:hover{background:var(--accent-600);color:#241a06;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.text-link{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:5px}
.text-link:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.slide .text-link{color:#fff}
.slide .text-link:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.hero-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;position:absolute;bottom:36px;right:var(--pad);font-size:12px;color:#fff}
.hero-controls button{color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}
.hero-controls button:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#241a06}
.hero-note{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);bottom:44px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68)}

.section{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:auto;padding:clamp(64px,7vw,116px) var(--pad)}
.section h2:after{content:'';display:block;width:56px;height:3px;background:var(--accent);margin-top:22px}
.section>h2{max-width:26ch}
.section>p{max-width:68ch;color:var(--muted)}
.page-title{padding:clamp(76px,9vw,136px) var(--pad) clamp(52px,5vw,78px);background:var(--brand-900);color:#fff;max-width:none}
.page-title h1{max-width:22ch;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.6vw,4rem)}
.page-title>p:last-child{margin-top:26px;max-width:62ch;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
.page-title h2:after,.page-title h1:after{display:none}

.banner{position:relative;max-width:none;padding:0;background:var(--brand-900);color:#fff;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:stretch}
.banner:not(.has-media){grid-template-columns:1fr}
.banner-media{position:relative;min-height:min(560px,58svh)}
.banner-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.banner-copy{padding:clamp(44px,6vw,84px) clamp(28px,6vw,72px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start}
.banner-copy h2{color:#fff;max-width:20ch}
.banner-copy h2:after{background:var(--accent)}
.banner-copy p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);max-width:52ch}
.banner-copy .button{margin-top:18px}

.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px;margin-top:44px}
.card{position:relative;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 24px 30px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.card picture{display:block}
.card img{aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;background:var(--surface-2);width:100%;margin-bottom:20px;border-radius:4px}
.serial{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;display:inline-block;color:var(--accent-ink);margin:2px 0 14px}
.card-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--accent-tint);color:var(--accent-ink);margin:2px 0 16px}
.card-icon svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.card h3{margin-right:36px;margin-bottom:12px}
.card h3 a:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:18px;margin-bottom:0}
.card-arrow{position:absolute;right:24px;bottom:24px;font-size:20px;color:var(--accent);transition:transform .25s}
.card:hover .card-arrow{transform:translate(3px,-3px)}

.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(32px,5vw,72px);align-items:center}
.split img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:5/4;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.split h2:after{margin-top:20px}

.prose{max-width:960px}
.prose p,.prose li{font-size:17px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.prose h3{margin:34px 0 18px}
.prose blockquote{border-left:3px solid var(--accent);margin-left:0;padding-left:26px;color:var(--muted)}

.statistics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:30px;background:var(--brand-700);color:#fff;padding:clamp(36px,4vw,56px) clamp(28px,4vw,52px);border-radius:var(--radius)}
.statistics strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,3.4vw,3.2rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
.statistics p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);margin:14px 0 0}
.timeline{border-left:2px solid var(--line);margin-left:20px}
.timeline article{padding:0 0 34px 36px;position:relative}
.timeline article:before{content:'';height:11px;width:11px;background:var(--accent);position:absolute;left:-6px;top:9px;border-radius:50%}
.timeline strong{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand);line-height:1.2}
.timeline p{color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0}

.table-scroll{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius)}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;min-width:420px}
td,th{text-align:left;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
th{background:var(--surface);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--brand);white-space:nowrap}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#fafbfd}

.faq{max-width:1000px}
.faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0}
.faq summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--brand)}
.faq summary:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.faq details p{margin:16px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}

video{width:100%;max-height:80vh;background:var(--brand-900);border-radius:var(--radius)}

.downloads a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;font-weight:500}
.downloads a:first-of-type{border-radius:var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0}
.downloads a:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0 0 var(--radius) var(--radius)}
.downloads a:hover{background:var(--accent-tint);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.downloads a span{color:var(--accent)}

.testimonials{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:30px}
.testimonials blockquote{margin:0;padding:34px;background:var(--surface);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:var(--radius)}
.testimonials p{font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.testimonials cite{display:block;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-style:normal;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}

.cta{background:var(--brand-700);color:#fff;text-align:center;max-width:none}
.cta h2{color:#fff}
.cta>h2,.cta>p{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.cta h2:after{margin-inline:auto}
.cta>p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);max-width:60ch}
.cta .button{margin-top:14px}

.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;gap:clamp(32px,5vw,72px);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.inquiry-form label,.search-form label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px}
.inquiry-form input:not([type=checkbox]),.inquiry-form textarea,.search-form input{width:100%;display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:13px 15px;background:var(--paper);font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}
.inquiry-form input:not([type=checkbox]):focus,.inquiry-form textarea:focus,.search-form input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(200,150,62,.18)}
.inquiry-form textarea{resize:vertical}
.inquiry-form .consent{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:400}
.inquiry-form .trap{position:absolute;left:-10000px;height:1px;width:1px;overflow:hidden}
.inquiry-form .form-result{font-size:14px;padding:15px 0;color:var(--brand)}

.product-lead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(32px,5vw,64px);align-items:start}
.product-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.product-gallery img{aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;width:100%;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius)}
.product-gallery img:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}
.no-image{grid-column:1/-1;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--surface);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);border-radius:var(--radius)}
.sku{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--accent-ink);margin:16px 0}
.features{padding:0;list-style:none;margin:22px 0}
.features li{margin:10px 0;padding-left:26px;position:relative;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.features li:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.62em;width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%}

.knowledge{background:var(--surface);max-width:none;padding-inline:max(var(--pad),calc((100vw - 1100px)/2))}
.knowledge dl{margin:26px 0 0}
.knowledge dl>div{display:flex;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:26px}
.knowledge dt{width:35%;font-weight:700;color:var(--brand)}
.knowledge dd{margin:0;flex:1;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.knowledge li{font-size:14px}
.knowledge ol{padding-left:20px}
.knowledge a{color:var(--accent-ink);text-decoration:underline}

.search-form{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:flex-end}
.search-form label{flex:1;margin-bottom:0}
.search-results article{padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}

.site-footer{padding:clamp(56px,6vw,84px) var(--pad) 28px;background:var(--brand-900);color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:44px}
.site-footer strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.6rem;color:#fff}
.site-footer p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);max-width:44ch;margin-top:18px}
.site-footer h2{font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px}
.site-footer h2:after{display:none}
.site-footer a{display:block;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
.site-footer a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.site-footer small{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-top:24px;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.site-footer [data-trade-privacy]{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:center;padding:9px 16px;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:var(--radius);transition:color .2s,border-color .2s}
.site-footer [data-trade-privacy]:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}

.service-widget{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:10}
.service-widget summary{cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:#241a06;font-weight:600;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:30px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-size:13px;list-style:none}
.service-widget summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.service-widget>div{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:66px;background:var(--paper);width:250px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius)}
.service-widget a{display:block;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px}
.service-widget a:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.service-widget a:hover{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.service-widget p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 0}
}

@media(max-width:1000px){
.site-header{padding:14px 4%;gap:16px;min-height:78px}
.header-tools .quote-link{display:none}
.site-header nav>ul{gap:20px}
.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.section{padding:64px 6%}
.contact,.product-lead,.split{gap:5%}
.slide{padding:104px 7%}
.statistics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.banner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

@media(max-width:650px){
.site-header{min-height:68px;padding:12px 5%}
.wordmark{font-size:22px}
.wordmark small{font-size:6px;letter-spacing:1.4px}
.nav-toggle{display:block;margin-left:auto}
.header-tools{gap:12px}
.header-phone{display:none}
.site-header nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:18px 6%}
.site-header nav.open{display:block}
.site-header nav>ul{display:block}
.site-header nav li{padding:10px 0}
.site-header nav li ul{position:static;display:block;border:0;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;padding:6px 18px;margin:0}
.hero,.slide{min-height:620px}
.slide{padding:88px 7% 124px}
.hero-controls{bottom:28px;left:7%;right:auto}
.hero-note{display:none}
.slide h1,.slide h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,8vw,2.6rem)}
.slide-copy>p:not(.kicker){font-size:15px}
.hero-actions{gap:16px}
.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.card img{aspect-ratio:5/4}
.split,.contact,.product-lead,.testimonials{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}
.section{padding:52px 6%}
.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
.page-title{padding:64px 6% 46px}
.page-title h1{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,7vw,2.5rem)}
.banner{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.banner-media{min-height:280px}
.site-footer{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;padding:52px 6% 24px}
.site-footer>div:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}
.knowledge dl>div{display:block}
.knowledge dt{width:auto;margin-bottom:8px}
.search-form{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:15px}
.search-form .button{padding:15px;justify-content:center}
.statistics{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}
.service-widget{right:12px;bottom:12px}
.site-footer small{padding-bottom:44px}
}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.analytics-consent{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:20px;z-index:20;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-width:340px}
.analytics-consent button{margin-right:12px;padding:9px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--accent-tint)}
.analytics-consent button:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#241a06;border-color:var(--accent)}
`;

export const siteCSS=baseCSS+premiumCSS+tradeCSS+tradePublicCSS;
````

````ts
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f4f5ef;color:#183e33;font:16px/1.6 'Segoe UI',sans-serif}main{max-width:1050px;margin:auto;padding:42px 24px}header{border-bottom:1px solid #bbc9bc;padding-bottom:28px}h1{font:clamp(30px,5vw,54px)/1.15 Georgia,serif;max-width:700px}small{letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}section,article{background:white;border:1px solid #d6dfd3;padding:24px;margin:24px 0;border-radius:12px}input,textarea,button{font:inherit;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #b6c7b9;border-radius:6px}input,textarea{max-width:100%;width:100%}button{background:#1c4f3f;color:white;cursor:pointer;margin:8px 8px 0 0}button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}th,td{padding:12px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #dde4dc}.scroll{overflow:auto}p{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.amount{font-size:28px}#status{color:#963d29}label{display:block;margin:14px 0}.subtle{color:#687b71}nav{float:right}a{color:inherit}@media(max-width:600px){main{padding:20px 14px}section,article{padding:16px}nav{float:none}}@media print{button,#login,nav,#status,.decision{display:none}body{background:white}article{break-inside:avoid}}
</style></head><body><main><header><nav><button id="print" type="button">Print / 保存 PDF</button><button id="logout" type="button">Exit / 退出</button></nav><small>PRIVATE TRADE DESK · 专属业务入口</small><h1>Your inquiry.<br>Your next step.</h1><p>查看询盘、报价与采购进度 / Review your inquiry and quotations.</p></header><p id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p><section id="login"><h2>Open your invitation / 打开邀请</h2><p>Use the private link supplied by your sales contact. Do not forward a customer confirmation link.</p><form id="access"><label>Access code / 访问码<input id="token" type="password" required minlength="64" maxlength="64" autocomplete="off"></label><button>Open / 查看</button></form></section><div id="content"></div></main><script>
(()=>{'use strict';let token=location.hash.slice(1);history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname);const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),status=$('status'),root=$('content');const names={draft:'Draft / 草稿',review:'Under review / 审核中',approved:'Approved / 已审核',sent:'Issued / 已发出',accepted:'Accepted / 已确认',rejected:'Declined / 已拒绝',void:'Withdrawn / 已作废',new:'Received / 已收到',processing:'In progress / 跟进中',qualified:'Qualified / 有效询盘',replied:'Replied / 已回复',closed:'Closed / 已结束'};
function el(tag,text,parent){const n=document.createElement(tag);if(text!=null)n.textContent=String(text);if(parent)parent.append(n);return n;}async function api(action,body){const r=await fetch('/api/v1/trade-public/'+action,{method:body?'POST':'GET',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+token,...(body?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{})},body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined,cache:'no-store',credentials:'omit'});const d=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error(d.error||'Unable to load');return d;}
async function load(){root.replaceChildren();try{const d=await api('portal');$('login').hidden=true;status.textContent='';const summary=el('section',null,root);el('small',d.role==='partner'?'PARTNER · READ ONLY / 渠道只读':'CUSTOMER / 客户',summary);el('h2',d.inquiry.inquiry_number,summary);el('p',[d.inquiry.name,d.inquiry.company].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),summary);el('p',names[d.inquiry.status]||d.inquiry.status,summary);el('p',d.inquiry.message,summary);for(const item of d.items)el('p',item.product_name_snapshot+' · '+item.quantity+' '+(item.unit||''),summary);if(!d.quotes.length)el('p','Your sales contact is preparing a quotation. / 销售人员正在处理您的需求。',root);
for(const [index,q] of d.quotes.entries()){const card=el('article',null,root);el('small','Quotation / 报价 · V'+q.version,card);el('h2',names[q.status]||q.status,card);el('p',q.incoterm+' · Valid until / 有效期 '+String(q.valid_until).slice(0,10)+' (UTC)',card);const wrap=el('div',null,card);wrap.className='scroll';const table=el('table',null,wrap),head=el('tr',null,el('thead',null,table));['Product / 产品','Qty / 数量','Unit price / 单价','Amount / 金额'].forEach(t=>el('th',t,head));const body=el('tbody',null,table);for(const l of q.lines){const row=el('tr',null,body);[l.name+' · '+(l.sku||''),l.quantity+' '+(l.unit||''),q.currency+' '+Number(l.unitPrice).toFixed(2),q.currency+' '+String(l.lineTotal)].forEach(t=>el('td',t,row));}el('p',q.currency+' '+String(q.total),card).className='amount';el('p',q.terms,card);if(d.role==='customer'&&index===0&&q.status==='sent'&&String(q.valid_until).slice(0,10)>=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)){const controls=el('div',null,card);controls.className='decision';const label=el('label','Comment / 确认备注',controls),note=el('textarea',null,label);note.maxLength=2000;for(const [decision,title] of [['accepted','Accept quotation / 确认报价'],['rejected','Decline / 拒绝']]){const b=el('button',title,controls);b.onclick=async()=>{if(!confirm(title+' V'+q.version+'?'))return;controls.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.disabled=true);try{await api('decision',{quoteId:q.id,decision,note:note.value});await load();status.textContent='Decision recorded. / 已记录您的决定。';}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message;controls.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.disabled=false);}};}}}
}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message;$('login').hidden=false;}}
$('access').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();token=$('token').value.trim();$('token').value='';load();};$('print').onclick=()=>window.print();$('logout').onclick=()=>{token='';root.replaceChildren();$('login').hidden=false;status.textContent='Session cleared / 已退出';};if(token)load();})();
</script></body></html>`;
````

````ts
export function countryOptions(locale:string){const codes='AD AE AF AG AI AL AM AO AQ AR AS AT AU AW AX AZ BA BB BD BE BF BG BH BI BJ BL BM BN BO BQ BR BS BT BV BW BY BZ CA CC CD CF CG CH CI CK CL CM CN CO CR CU CV CW CX CY CZ DE DJ DK DM DO DZ EC EE EG EH ER ES ET FI FJ FK FM FO FR GA GB GD GE GF GG GH GI GL GM GN GP GQ GR GS GT GU GW GY HK HM HN HR HT HU ID IE IL IM IN IO IQ IR IS IT JE JM JO JP KE KG KH KI KM KN KP KR KW KY KZ LA LB LC LI LK LR LS LT LU LV LY MA MC MD ME MF MG MH MK ML MM MN MO MP MQ MR MS MT MU MV MW MX MY MZ NA NC NE NF NG NI NL NO NP NR NU NZ OM PA PE PF PG PH PK PL PM PN PR PS PT PW PY QA RE RO RS RU RW SA SB SC SD SE SG SH SI SJ SK SL SM SN SO SR SS ST SV SX SY SZ TC TD TF TG TH TJ TK TL TM TN TO TR TT TV TW TZ UA UG UM US UY UZ VA VC VE VG VI VN VU WF WS YE YT ZA ZM ZW'.split(' ');let names:Intl.DisplayNames;try{names=new Intl.DisplayNames([locale],{type:'region'});}catch{names=new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'],{type:'region'});}return codes.map(code=>({code,name:names.of(code)||code})).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).map(x=>'<option value="'+x.code+'">'+x.name.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]!))+'</option>').join('');}
export const tradePublicJS=String.raw`
(()=>{'use strict';let recorded=false;
function track(){if(recorded)return;try{if(localStorage.getItem('suns_analytics_v2')!=='yes')return;recorded=true;let v=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('suns_trade_visit')||'null');const locale=document.documentElement.lang||'en';if(!v||Date.now()-v.at>86400000||v.locale!==locale)v={id:crypto.randomUUID(),at:Date.now(),locale,source:(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('utm_source')||'').slice(0,200)};fetch('/api/v1/trade-public/visit',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({id:v.id,locale,path:location.pathname.slice(0,1000),source:v.source,consent:true})}).then(r=>{if(r.ok)sessionStorage.setItem('suns_trade_visit',JSON.stringify(v));}).catch(()=>{});}catch{}}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-trade-privacy]')){const box=document.querySelector('[data-analytics]');if(box){box.hidden=false;box.querySelector('button')?.focus();}return;}const b=e.target.closest('[data-analytics-choice]');if(!b)return;if(b.dataset.analyticsChoice==='yes'){recorded=false;track();}else{try{sessionStorage.removeItem('suns_trade_visit');}catch{}location.reload();}});track();
function init(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-trade-public]:not([data-ready])').forEach(root=>{root.dataset.ready='1';const select=root.querySelector('select'),cards=root.querySelector('[data-trade-cards]'),message=root.querySelector('[role=status]');let version=0;async function load(){const current=++version;try{const r=await fetch('/api/v1/trade-public/cards?locale='+encodeURIComponent(root.dataset.locale)+'&country='+encodeURIComponent(select.value),{cache:'no-store'});const d=await r.json();if(current!==version)return;if(!r.ok)throw new Error();cards.replaceChildren();message.textContent=d.cards.length?'':root.dataset.empty;const kinds=root.dataset.locale==='zh'?{market:'市场推荐',certificate:'资质证书',case:'客户案例',service:'采购服务'}:{market:'For your market',certificate:'Credentials',case:'Customer stories',service:'Service'};for(const c of d.cards){const article=document.createElement('article'),tag=document.createElement('small'),h=document.createElement('h3'),p=document.createElement('p'),a=document.createElement('a');tag.textContent=kinds[c.kind];h.textContent=c.title;p.textContent=c.summary;a.textContent=root.dataset.more+' ↗';a.href=typeof c.source_url==='string'&&!/[\s\\]/.test(c.source_url)&&(/^(https:\/\/|\/[^/])/.test(c.source_url))?c.source_url:'#';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';article.append(tag,h,p,a);if(c.valid_until){const expiry=document.createElement('p');expiry.className='trade-expiry';expiry.textContent=root.dataset.valid+' '+String(c.valid_until).slice(0,10);article.append(expiry);}cards.append(article);}}catch{if(current===version){cards.replaceChildren();message.textContent=root.dataset.error;}}}select.onchange=load;load();});}
new MutationObserver(init).observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});init();
})();
`;
````

````ts
/** L1 GEO contract tests. Run only in verify.mjs's disposable database.
 * No product patches, real credentials, or external LLM requests.
 * Deliberately strict G53: the supplied implementation is expected to fail it.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

if(process.env.VERIFY_DATABASE!=='1'||!/^\/suns_verify_[a-f0-9]+$/.test(databaseUrl.pathname))
 throw Error('Run through verify.mjs in its isolated suns_verify_<hex> database');
const {query,pool}=await import('../packages/domain/src/db');
const {ensureActor,DomainError}=await import('../packages/domain/src/crud');
const geo=await import('../packages/domain/src/geo-monitoring');
const {v2Api}=await import('../apps/cms/src/server/v2-api');
assert.equal((await query('SELECT current_database() AS name'))[0].name,databaseUrl.pathname.slice(1));

const envKeys=['GEO_MONITOR_SECRET','GEO_WORKER_REGION_CODE','GEO_WORKER_ID','TRANSLATION_API_KEY','TRANSLATION_API_URL'] as const;
const savedEnv=Object.fromEntries(envKeys.map(k=>[k,process.env[k]]));
process.env.GEO_MONITOR_SECRET='GEO-test-only-secret-never-a-production-key-20261001';
process.env.TRANSLATION_API_KEY='test-only-site-key-000000000000';
let content=JSON.stringify({answer:'BRAND glassware',citations:['https://example.invalid/evidence']});
let finish='stop',usage:Row|undefined={prompt_tokens:101,completion_tokens:23},upstreamStatus=200;
let upstreamError='',requestCount=0,lastRequest:Row={};
const fake=createServer(async(req,res)=>{
 try{
  assert.equal(req.method,'POST');let body='';for await(const part of req)body+=part;
  lastRequest=JSON.parse(body);requestCount++;
  assert.match(String(req.headers.authorization),/^Bearer test-only-/);
  res.writeHead(upstreamStatus,{'Content-Type':'application/json'});
  res.end(upstreamStatus===200?JSON.stringify({choices:[{finish_reason:finish,message:{content}}],...(usage===undefined?{}:{usage})}):JSON.stringify({error:{message:upstreamError}}));
 }catch(error){res.writeHead(500);res.end(JSON.stringify({error:{message:String(error)}}));}
});
fake.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(fake,'listening');
const port=(fake.address() as {port:number}).port,endpoint=`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/geo`;
const originalFetch=globalThis.fetch;
globalThis.fetch=(async(input:any,init?:RequestInit)=>{
 const url=new URL(typeof input==='string'||input instanceof URL?String(input):input.url);
 assert.equal(url.origin,new URL(endpoint).origin,'GEO test refuses every non-fake network destination');
 return originalFetch(input,{...init,redirect:'error'});
}) as typeof fetch;
process.env.TRANSLATION_API_URL=endpoint;

type Fixture={actor:Actor;prompt:Row;model:Row;region:Row;target:Row;modelInput:Parameters<typeof geo.saveGeoModel>[1]};
type Case={ids:string[];title:string;run:(f:Fixture)=>Promise<void>};
const cases:Case[]=[];
function test(ids:string,title:string,run:Case['run']){cases.push({ids:ids.split(','),title,run});}
const one=async(sql:string,args:unknown[]=[])=>{const rows=await query(sql,args);assert.equal(rows.length,1);return rows[0];};
const count=async(table:string,where='',args:unknown[]=[])=>Number((await one(`SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM ${table} ${where}`,args)).n);
const jobRow=(id:string)=>one('SELECT * FROM geo_sample_jobs WHERE id=$1',[id]);
const targetRow=(f:Fixture)=>one('SELECT * FROM geo_monitor_targets WHERE id=$1',[f.target.id]);
async function rejected(fn:()=>Promise<unknown>,status:number,message:string){await assert.rejects(fn,(e:any)=>e instanceof DomainError&&e.status===status&&e.message===message);}
async function http(f:Fixture,action:string,input:Row){
 const url=new URL(`http://localhost/api/v1/v2/${action}`);
 const request=new Request(url,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(input)});
 return v2Api(request,['v2',action],f.actor,url,r=>r.json(),(data,status=200)=>Response.json(data,{status}));
}
async function zodReject(f:Fixture,action:string,input:Row,field:string){
 await assert.rejects(()=>http(f,action,input),(e:any)=>e?.name==='ZodError'&&Array.isArray(e.issues)&&e.issues.some((x:any)=>x.path[0]===field));
}
async function job(f:Fixture){
 // Direct insertion isolates processing from the independent manual-throttle contract.
 return one("INSERT INTO geo_sample_jobs(target_id,kind) VALUES($1,'manual') RETURNING *",[f.target.id]);
}
async function claim(f:Fixture){const pending=await job(f);const claimed=await geo.claimGeoSampleJob(f.region.code,'test-worker');assert.equal(claimed?.id,pending.id);return claimed!;}
async function sample(f:Fixture,patch:Row={}){const claimed=await claim(f);const result=await geo.processGeoSampleJob({...claimed,...patch});return one('SELECT * FROM geo_samples WHERE id=$1',[result.id]);}
const ledger=()=>query("SELECT period,spent_usd,reserved_usd,sample_count FROM geo_budget_windows ORDER BY period");
function ledgerEquals(rows:Row[],spent:string,reserved:string,n:number){
 assert.equal(rows.length,2);for(const row of rows){assert.equal(row.spent_usd,spent);assert.equal(row.reserved_usd,reserved);assert.equal(Number(row.sample_count),n);}
}
async function failed(f:Fixture,message:string,status=400){
 const j=await claim(f),before=await ledger();await rejected(()=>geo.processGeoSampleJob(j),status,message);
 const after=await jobRow(j.id);assert.equal(after.status,'failed');assert.equal(after.error_message,message);assert.ok(after.finished_at);
 for(const row of await ledger()){const old=before.find(x=>x.period===row.period)!;assert.equal(row.reserved_usd,'0.00000000');assert.equal(row.spent_usd,old.spent_usd);assert.equal(row.sample_count,old.sample_count);}
 assert.equal((await targetRow(f)).last_error,message);assert.equal(await count('geo_samples'),0);
}
const targetInput=(f:Fixture)=>({id:f.target.id,promptId:f.prompt.id,modelProfileId:f.model.id,regionId:f.region.id,intervalMinutes:60,enabled:true});
const budgetInput={dailyLimitUsd:100,monthlyLimitUsd:1000,maxQueuedJobs:500,enabled:true};
async function withinEnv(changes:Record<string,string|undefined>,fn:()=>Promise<void>|void){const before=Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(changes).map(k=>[k,process.env[k]]));try{for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(changes))v===undefined?delete process.env[k]:process.env[k]=v;await fn();}finally{for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(before))v===undefined?delete process.env[k]:process.env[k]=v;}}
function hash(j:Row){return createHash('sha256').update([j.prompt,j.market,j.brand_name,j.locale_code,j.model,j.endpoint,j.profile_id,j.region_id].join('\n')).digest('hex');}

for(const field of ['prompt','market','brand_name','locale_code','model','endpoint','profile_id','region_id'])test('G24',`changing only ${field} changes the recorded hash`,async f=>{
 const first=await claim(f),result=await geo.processGeoSampleJob(first),baseline=(await one('SELECT config_hash FROM geo_samples WHERE id=$1',[result.id])).config_hash;
 const next=await claim(f);let changed:any;
 if(field==='endpoint')changed=endpoint+'/alternate';
 else if(field==='profile_id')changed=(await geo.saveGeoModel(f.actor,{...f.modelInput,code:'alt-'+randomUUID().slice(0,8)})).id;
 else if(field==='region_id')changed=(await geo.saveGeoRegion(f.actor,{code:'alt-'+randomUUID().slice(0,8),displayName:'Alternate region',enabled:true})).id;
 else changed=field==='model'?'test-model-v2':field==='locale_code'?'zh':String(next[field])+' changed';
 // A claimed job is the public processor's snapshot input. Every field except one stays equal.
 const mutated={...next,[field]:changed},res=await geo.processGeoSampleJob(mutated),actual=(await one('SELECT config_hash FROM geo_samples WHERE id=$1',[res.id])).config_hash;
 assert.notEqual(actual,baseline);assert.equal(actual,hash(mutated));
});

test('G27,G28','two successes accumulate one daily rollup and complete all five writes',async f=>{
 await query("UPDATE geo_monitor_targets SET last_error='old error' WHERE id=$1",[f.target.id]);const j1=await claim(f);await geo.processGeoSampleJob(j1);const roll1=(await query('SELECT * FROM geo_daily_rollups'))[0];
 const j2=await claim(f);await geo.processGeoSampleJob(j2);assert.equal(await count('geo_samples'),2);assert.equal(await count('geo_daily_rollups'),1);const roll=(await query('SELECT * FROM geo_daily_rollups'))[0];
 assert.equal(roll.samples,2);assert.equal(roll.mentions,2);assert.equal(roll.citations,2);assert.equal(Number(roll.input_tokens),202);assert.equal(Number(roll.output_tokens),46);assert.equal(roll.cost_usd,'0.00036750');assert.ok(Number(roll.duration_ms)>=Number(roll1.duration_ms));
 for(const id of [j1.id,j2.id]){const j=await jobRow(id);assert.equal(j.status,'completed');assert.ok(j.finished_at);}
 const target=await targetRow(f);assert.ok(target.last_run_at);assert.equal(target.last_error,null);ledgerEquals(await ledger(),'0.00036750','0.00000000',2);
 const daily=(await geo.geoMonitorTrend(f.actor,f.prompt.id,7)).series[0].daily[0];assert.equal(daily.avgDurationMs,Math.round(Number(roll.duration_ms)/2));
 // Controlled duration oracle: independent per-row observations can differ by a millisecond
 // between the sample and rollup writes. Set the actual stored per-day total and verify averaging.
 await query('UPDATE geo_daily_rollups SET duration_ms=101 WHERE target_id=$1',[f.target.id]);assert.equal((await geo.geoMonitorTrend(f.actor,f.prompt.id,7)).series[0].daily[0].avgDurationMs,51);
});
test('G28','deterministic processing clock proves rollup duration adds both samples',async f=>{
 const originalNow=Date.now;let clock=1000;
 Date.now=()=>String(new Error().stack).replace(/\\/g,'/').includes('/packages/domain/src/geo-monitoring.ts:')?(clock+=10):originalNow();
 try{
  await sample(f);const first=(await query('SELECT * FROM geo_daily_rollups'))[0];assert.equal(Number(first.duration_ms),20);
  await sample(f);const roll=(await query('SELECT * FROM geo_daily_rollups'))[0];assert.equal(Number(roll.duration_ms),40);assert.equal(roll.samples,2);
  assert.equal((await geo.geoMonitorTrend(f.actor,f.prompt.id,7)).series[0].daily[0].avgDurationMs,20);
 }finally{Date.now=originalNow;}
});
async function sentinel(f:Fixture,j:Row){return one("INSERT INTO geo_samples(prompt_id,model,answer,brand_mentioned,duration_ms,monitor_job_id,prompt_snapshot,market_snapshot,brand_snapshot,config_hash,sample_kind) VALUES($1,'sentinel','sentinel answer',false,1,$2,'sentinel prompt','US','BRAND',repeat('0',64),'manual') RETURNING *",[f.prompt.id,j.id]);}
test('G27b','duplicate sentinel survives rollback; no success data or expense is committed',async f=>{
 const j=await claim(f),s=await sentinel(f,j),before=await ledger();
 await assert.rejects(()=>geo.processGeoSampleJob(j),(e:any)=>e.code==='23505'&&e.constraint==='geo_samples_monitor_job_id_key');
 assert.equal(await count('geo_samples'),1);assert.deepEqual(await one('SELECT * FROM geo_samples WHERE id=$1',[s.id]),s);assert.equal(await count('geo_daily_rollups'),0);
 for(const r of await ledger()){const b=before.find(x=>x.period===r.period)!;assert.equal(r.spent_usd,b.spent_usd);assert.equal(r.sample_count,b.sample_count);}
 assert.equal((await targetRow(f)).last_run_at,null);assert.notEqual((await jobRow(j.id)).status,'completed');
});
test('G27b','late target-write failure rolls back earlier sample, rollup, expense and completion',async f=>{
 const j=await claim(f),before=await ledger();
 // This test-only trigger belongs to this disposable database, not an applied migration.
 await query("CREATE FUNCTION geo_test_abort_target() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.last_run_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_run_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'geo-test late transaction failure'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$");
 await query('CREATE TRIGGER geo_test_abort_target BEFORE UPDATE ON geo_monitor_targets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION geo_test_abort_target()');
 try{await assert.rejects(()=>geo.processGeoSampleJob(j),/geo-test late transaction failure/);assert.equal(await count('geo_samples'),0);assert.equal(await count('geo_daily_rollups'),0);for(const r of await ledger()){const b=before.find(x=>x.period===r.period)!;assert.equal(r.spent_usd,b.spent_usd);assert.equal(r.sample_count,b.sample_count);}assert.equal((await targetRow(f)).last_run_at,null);assert.notEqual((await jobRow(j.id)).status,'completed');}
 finally{await query('DROP TRIGGER geo_test_abort_target ON geo_monitor_targets');await query('DROP FUNCTION geo_test_abort_target()');}
});
test('G6,G53','transaction rejection must reach compensation immediately, not after recovery',async f=>{
 const j=await claim(f);await sentinel(f,j);await assert.rejects(()=>geo.processGeoSampleJob(j),(e:any)=>e.code==='23505');
 const row=await jobRow(j.id),target=await targetRow(f),windows=await ledger();
 assert.deepEqual({status:row.status,finished:!!row.finished_at,jobError:!!row.error_message,targetError:!!target.last_error,windows:windows.map(r=>({period:r.period,reserved:r.reserved_usd,spent:r.spent_usd,samples:Number(r.sample_count)}))},
 {status:'failed',finished:true,jobError:true,targetError:true,windows:[{period:'day',reserved:'0.00000000',spent:'0.00000000',samples:0},{period:'month',reserved:'0.00000000',spent:'0.00000000',samples:0}]},'G53: product must await success transaction so catch can compensate its rejection');
});

// P3: credentials, errors and authorization.
test('G29','upstream errors redact URLs and are bounded',async f=>{

 assert.equal(row.error_message.length,500);assert.ok(row.error_message.includes('[URL]'));assert.ok(!row.error_message.includes('https://api.example.com/v1'));assert.equal((await targetRow(f)).last_error,row.error_message);

test('G30,G34','profile key is sealed, omitted from views, and retained by blank updates',async f=>{

 for(const apiKey of [undefined,'','   ']){await geo.saveGeoModel(f.actor,{...f.modelInput,id:f.model.id,apiKey});assert.equal((await one('SELECT key_cipher FROM geo_model_profiles WHERE id=$1',[f.model.id])).key_cipher,row.key_cipher);}
 const workspace=await geo.geoMonitorWorkspace(f.actor);assert.ok(!('key_cipher' in workspace.models.find(x=>x.id===f.model.id)!));assert.equal(workspace.models.find(x=>x.id===f.model.id)!.has_credential,true);
 await rejected(()=>geo.saveGeoModel(f.actor,{...f.modelInput,code:'no-key',apiKey:undefined}),400,'专用模型需要 API 密钥');
});
for(const segment of [0,1,2,3])test('G31',`cipher segment ${segment} tampering fails authenticated decryption`,async f=>{
 const parts=(await one('SELECT key_cipher FROM geo_model_profiles WHERE id=$1',[f.model.id])).key_cipher.split(':');
 if(segment===0)parts[0]='v2';else{const bytes=Buffer.from(parts[segment],'base64url');bytes[0]^=1;parts[segment]=bytes.toString('base64url');}
 await query('UPDATE geo_model_profiles SET key_cipher=$2 WHERE id=$1',[f.model.id,parts.join(':')]);await failed(f,'监测模型密钥无法解密，请管理员重新保存',503);assert.equal(requestCount,0);
});

 await rejected(()=>geo.saveGeoModel(f.actor,{...f.modelInput,code:'site-model',credentialSource:'site_default',apiKey:undefined}),400,'复用站点密钥时，端点必须与当前 AI 设置完全一致');

 const t=await geo.saveGeoTarget(f.actor,{promptId:f.prompt.id,modelProfileId:model.id,regionId:f.region.id,intervalMinutes:60,enabled:true});const s=await sample({...f,model,target:t});assert.equal(s.model_profile_id,model.id);assert.equal(requestCount,1);

// P5: identity, heartbeat and stale reservation recovery.
test('G47','worker defaults, whitespace normalization and length cap',async()=>{
 await withinEnv({GEO_WORKER_REGION_CODE:undefined,GEO_WORKER_ID:undefined},()=>assert.deepEqual(geo.geoWorkerIdentity(),{region:'local',workerId:hostname()+'-'+process.pid}));
 await withinEnv({GEO_WORKER_REGION_CODE:' CN ',GEO_WORKER_ID:'worker \t one'},()=>assert.deepEqual(geo.geoWorkerIdentity(),{region:'cn',workerId:'worker-one'}));await withinEnv({GEO_WORKER_ID:'x'.repeat(121)},()=>assert.equal(geo.geoWorkerIdentity().workerId.length,120));

test('G49,G50','heartbeat upsert refreshes once and workspace excludes stale workers',async f=>{
 await geo.geoWorkerHeartbeat(f.region.code,'test-worker');await query("UPDATE geo_worker_heartbeats SET last_seen_at=now()-interval '3 minutes' WHERE worker_id='test-worker'");const old=await one("SELECT * FROM geo_worker_heartbeats WHERE worker_id='test-worker'");assert.ok(!(await geo.geoMonitorWorkspace(f.actor)).workers.some(x=>x.worker_id==='test-worker'));
 await geo.geoWorkerHeartbeat(f.region.code,'test-worker');assert.equal(await count('geo_worker_heartbeats'),1);const fresh=await one("SELECT * FROM geo_worker_heartbeats WHERE worker_id='test-worker'");assert.ok(fresh.last_seen_at>old.last_seen_at);assert.equal(fresh.started_at.getTime(),old.started_at.getTime());assert.ok((await geo.geoMonitorWorkspace(f.actor)).workers.some(x=>x.worker_id==='test-worker'));

test('G51','stale processing recovers once; fresh processing retains its reservation',async f=>{
 const stale=await claim(f);await query("UPDATE geo_sample_jobs SET started_at=now()-interval '11 minutes' WHERE id=$1",[stale.id]);const fresh=await claim(f);assert.equal(await geo.recoverGeoJobs(),1);
 const r=await jobRow(stale.id);assert.equal(r.status,'failed');assert.equal(r.error_message,'Worker 中断；是否产生供应商费用需核对账单');assert.ok(r.finished_at);assert.equal((await jobRow(fresh.id)).status,'processing');ledgerEquals(await ledger(),'0.00000000','0.00800250',0);assert.equal(await geo.recoverGeoJobs(),0);ledgerEquals(await ledger(),'0.00000000','0.00800250',0);
});

// Serial cases are essential: budget windows and environment are process/global state.
let passed=0;const failures:Row[]=[];
const restoredTables=['geo_samples','geo_daily_rollups','geo_sample_jobs','geo_monitor_targets','geo_model_profiles','geo_prompts','geo_worker_heartbeats'];
const initialCounts:Record<string,number>={};
const initialBudget=await one('SELECT * FROM geo_monitor_budget WHERE singleton_key=true');
const initialWindows=await query('SELECT * FROM geo_budget_windows');
const initialSettings=await query("SELECT * FROM runtime_settings WHERE key='translation.llm'");
async function restoreShared(){
 await query('DELETE FROM geo_budget_windows');for(const r of initialWindows)await query('INSERT INTO geo_budget_windows(period,starts_on,spent_usd,reserved_usd,sample_count,updated_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)',[r.period,r.starts_on,r.spent_usd,r.reserved_usd,r.sample_count,r.updated_at]);
 await query('UPDATE geo_monitor_budget SET daily_limit_usd=$1,monthly_limit_usd=$2,max_queued_jobs=$3,is_enabled=$4,updated_by=$5 WHERE singleton_key=true',[initialBudget.daily_limit_usd,initialBudget.monthly_limit_usd,initialBudget.max_queued_jobs,initialBudget.is_enabled,initialBudget.updated_by]);
 await query("DELETE FROM runtime_settings WHERE key='translation.llm'");for(const r of initialSettings)await query('INSERT INTO runtime_settings(key,value) VALUES($1,$2::jsonb)',[r.key,JSON.stringify(r.value)]);
}
async function cleanup(actor:Actor){
 // Samples must be removed BEFORE targets (monitor_job_id otherwise becomes NULL).
 await query('DELETE FROM geo_samples WHERE prompt_id IN (SELECT id FROM geo_prompts WHERE created_by=$1)',[actor.id]);
 await query('DELETE FROM geo_monitor_targets WHERE created_by=$1',[actor.id]);
 await query('DELETE FROM geo_prompts WHERE created_by=$1',[actor.id]);
 await query('DELETE FROM geo_model_profiles WHERE created_by=$1',[actor.id]);
 await query('DELETE FROM geo_regions WHERE created_by=$1',[actor.id]); // heartbeats cascade
 await query('DELETE FROM audit_logs WHERE user_id=$1',[actor.id]);
 await restoreShared();await query('DELETE FROM users WHERE id=$1',[actor.id]);
 for(const table of restoredTables)assert.equal(await count(table),initialCounts[table],`${table}: fixture residue`);
 assert.equal(await count('geo_regions'),initialCounts.geo_regions);assert.equal(await count('users','WHERE id=$1',[actor.id]),0);assert.equal(await count('audit_logs','WHERE user_id=$1',[actor.id]),0);
}
try{
 for(const table of [...restoredTables,'geo_regions'])initialCounts[table]=await count(table);
 for(const table of restoredTables)assert.equal(initialCounts[table],0,`${table} must start empty in isolated verification database`);
 for(const t of cases){const id=randomUUID(),actor:Actor={id,email:`geo-${id}@example.invalid`,role:'super_admin',displayName:'GEO L1 test'};
  content=JSON.stringify({answer:'BRAND glassware',citations:['https://example.invalid/evidence']});finish='stop';usage={prompt_tokens:101,completion_tokens:23};upstreamStatus=200;upstreamError='';requestCount=0;lastRequest={};
  try{
   await ensureActor(actor);await query('DELETE FROM geo_budget_windows');await query("INSERT INTO geo_budget_windows(period,starts_on) VALUES('day',(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date),('month',date_trunc('month',now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)");
   await geo.saveGeoBudget(actor,budgetInput);await query("DELETE FROM runtime_settings WHERE key='translation.llm'");
   const locale=await one("SELECT id FROM locales WHERE code='en'");const prompt=await one("INSERT INTO geo_prompts(locale_id,market,prompt,brand_name,created_by) VALUES($1,'US','Which glassware brands are available?','BRAND',$2) RETURNING *",[locale.id,id]);
   const modelInput={code:'model-'+id.slice(0,8),displayName:'Test model',provider:'Test provider',model:'test-model',endpoint,credentialSource:'profile' as const,apiKey:'test-only-profile-key-000000000000',inputRate:1.25,outputRate:2.5,maxOutputTokens:1201,enabled:true};
   const model=await geo.saveGeoModel(actor,modelInput),region=await geo.saveGeoRegion(actor,{code:'region-'+id.slice(0,8),displayName:'Test region',enabled:true});
   const target=await geo.saveGeoTarget(actor,{promptId:prompt.id,modelProfileId:model.id,regionId:region.id,intervalMinutes:60,enabled:true});
   await t.run({actor,prompt,model,region,target,modelInput});passed++;console.log(`PASS ${t.ids.join('/')} | ${t.title}`);
  }catch(error:any){failures.push({ids:t.ids,title:t.title,message:error.message});console.error(`FAIL ${t.ids.join('/')} | ${t.title}\n${error.stack||error}`);}
  finally{await cleanup(actor);}
 }
 for(const table of restoredTables)assert.equal(await count(table),0,`${table} final residue`);
 const covered=new Set(cases.flatMap(t=>t.ids));for(let n=1;n<=51;n++)assert.ok(covered.has('G'+n));assert.ok(covered.has('G27b'));assert.ok(covered.has('G53'));
 console.log(`GEO: ${passed}/${cases.length} passed; ${failures.length} failed; 53 contract IDs covered (G1–G51, G27b, G53; no G52 was defined).`);
 console.log('PASS GEO fixture cleanup: samples/jobs/targets/rollups/models/prompts/heartbeats=0; seeded local region and shared settings restored.');
 if(failures.length)process.exitCode=1;
}finally{
 try{await restoreShared();}finally{globalThis.fetch=originalFetch;for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(savedEnv))v===undefined?delete process.env[k]:process.env[k]=v;fake.closeAllConnections();await new Promise<void>((resolve,reject)=>fake.close(e=>e?reject(e):resolve()));await pool.end();}
}
````

## tests/http-smoke.mjs

````javascript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {randomUUID,randomBytes} from 'node:crypto';import fs from 'node:fs/promises';import path from 'node:path';import {createRequire} from 'node:module';import pg from 'pg';
if(process.env.RUN_LOCAL_SMOKE!=='1')throw Error('Set RUN_LOCAL_SMOKE=1. Run only against a fresh local development instance.');
const cms='http://localhost:3001',web='http://localhost:3000';const connection=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('.runtime/connection.json','utf8'));const db=new pg.Client({connectionString:connection.DATABASE_URL});await db.connect();
const adminEmail='smoke-'+randomUUID()+'@example.invalid',password=randomBytes(24).toString('base64url');let cookie='',actorId,productId,translationId,inquiryId,mediaId;const results=[];
async function request(route,{body,method='GET',auth=true,origin=cms}={}){const res=await fetch(cms+route,{method,headers:{...(body?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{}),...(auth&&cookie?{Cookie:cookie}:{}),Origin:origin},body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined});let data;try{data=await res.json();}catch{data=null;}return {res,data};}
const record=async(resource,data)=>{const r=await request('/api/v1/records?resource='+resource,{method:'POST',body:{data}});assert.equal(r.res.status,201,JSON.stringify(r.data));return r.data;};
async function waitJob(id){for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const rows=(await db.query('SELECT status,error_message FROM publish_jobs WHERE id=$1',[id])).rows;const j=rows[0];if(j.status==='failed')throw Error(j.error_message);if(j.status==='completed')return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));}throw Error('Queue timed out');}
try{
 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/meta',{auth:false})).res.status,401);
 assert.equal((await db.query('SELECT count(*)::int n FROM payload_internal.cms_admin_users')).rows[0].n,0,'Use a fresh local instance; existing accounts preserved');
 const first=await request('/api/cms-admin-users/first-register',{method:'POST',body:{email:adminEmail,password,displayName:'Smoke verification'},auth:false});assert.ok(first.res.ok,JSON.stringify(first.data));
 const login=await request('/api/cms-admin-users/login',{method:'POST',body:{email:adminEmail,password},auth:false});assert.equal(login.res.status,200,JSON.stringify(login.data));cookie=login.res.headers.getSetCookie().map(c=>c.split(';')[0]).join('; ');assert.ok(cookie);actorId=login.data.user.id;
 const meta=await request('/api/v1/meta');assert.equal(meta.res.status,200,JSON.stringify(meta.data));assert.equal(meta.data.actor.role,'super_admin');results.push('first admin, login, session, RBAC metadata');
 const locales=(await request('/api/v1/records?resource=locales')).data.rows,locale=locales.find(l=>l.code==='en');
 const product=await record('products',{sku:'SMOKE-'+randomUUID().slice(0,8),status:'active'});productId=product.id;
 const route='/en/products/smoke-'+randomUUID().slice(0,8);const translation=await record('product_translations',{product_id:productId,locale_id:locale.id,name:'Queue verification product',slug:route.split('/').pop(),path:route,short_description:'Temporary integration fixture'});translationId=translation.id;
 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/document?path='+route,{auth:false})).res.status,404);
 const publish=await request('/api/v1/publish',{method:'POST',body:{resource:'product_translations',id:translationId}});assert.equal(publish.res.status,202,JSON.stringify(publish.data));await waitJob(publish.data.id);
 const publicDoc=await request('/api/v1/document?path='+route,{auth:false});assert.equal(publicDoc.data.title,'Queue verification product');
 const frontend=await fetch(web+route);assert.equal(frontend.status,200);const html=await frontend.text();assert.match(html,/Queue verification product/);assert.match(html,/application\/ld\+json/);assert.match(html,/rel="canonical"/);results.push('Redis queue, static publish, SSR product, SEO metadata');
 const sharp=createRequire(path.resolve('apps/cms/package.json'))('sharp');const png=await sharp({create:{width:64,height:48,channels:3,background:'#184032'}}).png().toBuffer();const form=new FormData();form.set('file',new File([png],'smoke.png',{type:'image/png'}));const uploaded=await fetch(cms+'/api/v1/upload',{method:'POST',headers:{Cookie:cookie,Origin:cms},body:form});const media=await uploaded.json();assert.equal(uploaded.status,201,JSON.stringify(media));mediaId=media.id;assert.equal((await db.query('SELECT count(*)::int n FROM media_variants WHERE media_id=$1',[mediaId])).rows[0].n,8);assert.equal((await fetch(cms+'/media/'+media.object_key)).status,200);results.push('image upload, 8 AVIF/WebP variants, local serving');
 const submission={key:randomUUID(),locale:'en',name:'Integration test',email:'inquiry@example.invalid',message:'Temporary RFQ verification',consent:true,inquiry_type:'rfq',items:[{product_id:productId,quantity:2}]};
 const lead=await request('/api/v1/inquiries',{method:'POST',body:submission,auth:false,origin:web});assert.equal(lead.res.status,201,JSON.stringify(lead.data));const duplicate=await request('/api/v1/inquiries',{method:'POST',body:submission,auth:false,origin:web});assert.equal(duplicate.data.inquiry_number,lead.data.inquiry_number);inquiryId=(await db.query('SELECT id FROM inquiries WHERE inquiry_number=$1',[lead.data.inquiry_number])).rows[0].id;
 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/inquiries',{method:'POST',body:{...submission,key:randomUUID()},auth:false,origin:'https://untrusted.example'})).res.status,403);results.push('RFQ, idempotency, origin protection');
 const search=await request('/api/v1/search?locale=en&q=Queue',{auth:false});assert.ok(search.data.rows.some(r=>r.route===route));
 const unpublish=await request('/api/v1/publish',{method:'POST',body:{resource:'product_translations',id:translationId,action:'unpublish'}});assert.equal(unpublish.res.status,202);await waitJob(unpublish.data.id);assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/document?path='+route,{auth:false})).res.status,404);results.push('public search and unpublish');
 await fs.writeFile('docs/http-verification.json',JSON.stringify({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),results,passed:true,redis:'5.0.14.1 temporary Windows port; production compose uses Redis 7'},null,2));console.log('PASS',results.join('; '));
}finally{
 if(inquiryId)await db.query('DELETE FROM inquiries WHERE id=$1',[inquiryId]);
 if(translationId){await db.query('DELETE FROM published_documents WHERE entity_id=$1',[translationId]);await db.query('DELETE FROM static_routes WHERE entity_id=$1',[translationId]);await db.query('DELETE FROM publish_jobs WHERE entity_id=$1',[translationId]);}
 if(productId)await db.query('DELETE FROM products WHERE id=$1',[productId]);
 if(mediaId){const files=(await db.query('SELECT object_key FROM media_assets WHERE id=$1 UNION SELECT object_key FROM media_variants WHERE media_id=$1',[mediaId])).rows;await db.query('DELETE FROM media_assets WHERE id=$1',[mediaId]);for(const f of files)await fs.unlink(path.resolve('media',f.object_key)).catch(()=>{});}
 if(actorId){await db.query('DELETE FROM audit_logs WHERE user_id=$1',[actorId]);await db.query('DELETE FROM content_revisions WHERE created_by=$1',[actorId]);await db.query('DELETE FROM users WHERE id=$1',[actorId]);await db.query('DELETE FROM payload_internal.cms_admin_users WHERE id=$1',[actorId]);}
 await db.end();
}
````

````ts
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';import fs from 'node:fs/promises';import path from 'node:path';
if(process.env.VERIFY_DATABASE!=='1'||!new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL!).pathname.startsWith('/suns_verify_'))throw Error('Run through db:verify in its isolated database');
process.env.STATIC_OUTPUT_DIR=path.resolve('.runtime/verify-output',randomUUID());
const {query,pool,save,ensureActor,requestPublish,released,remove,sourceDocument,list,restoreRevision,jobAction}=await import('../packages/domain/src/index');
const {processPublishJob}=await import('../packages/publisher/src/index');
const actor={id:randomUUID(),email:'verification@example.invalid',role:'super_admin',displayName:'Verification'};
try{
 await ensureActor(actor);const locale=(await query("SELECT id FROM locales WHERE code='en'"))[0].id;
 const parent=await save(actor,'content_items',{content_type:'article'});
 const doc=await save(actor,'content_item_translations',{content_item_id:parent.id,locale_id:locale,title:'Original published title',slug:'integration',path:'/en/integration',body:[{type:'rich_text',data:{text:'Safe body <script>unsafe</script>'}}]});
 assert.equal(await released(doc.path),undefined,'Draft must not leak');
 await assert.rejects(()=>save({...actor,role:'translator'},'products',{sku:'DENIED'}),/权限/);
 const j=await requestPublish(actor,'content_item_translations',doc.id);await processPublishJob({data:{jobId:j.id}} as any);
 assert.equal((await released(doc.path))?.title,'Original published title');
 const before=(await fs.stat(path.join(process.env.STATIC_OUTPUT_DIR,'en/integration/index.html'))).mtimeMs;const same=await requestPublish(actor,'content_item_translations',doc.id);await processPublishJob({data:{jobId:same.id}} as any);assert.equal((await fs.stat(path.join(process.env.STATIC_OUTPUT_DIR,'en/integration/index.html'))).mtimeMs,before,'Unchanged HTML should not be rewritten');
 const html=await fs.readFile(path.join(process.env.STATIC_OUTPUT_DIR,'en/integration/index.html'),'utf8');assert.match(html,/application\/ld\+json/);assert.match(html,/rel="canonical"/);assert.ok(!html.includes('<script>unsafe</script>'));
 await save(actor,'content_item_translations',{title:'Unpublished revision'},{id:doc.id});assert.equal((await released(doc.path))?.title,'Original published title');
 const rev=(await list(actor,'content_revisions',{filter:{entity_id:doc.id}})).rows.find(r=>r.snapshot.title==='Original published title');assert.ok(rev);await restoreRevision(actor,rev.id);
 await save(actor,'content_item_translations',{title:'Scheduled snapshot'},{id:doc.id});const scheduled=await requestPublish(actor,'content_item_translations',doc.id,'publish',new Date(Date.now()+60000).toISOString());await save(actor,'content_item_translations',{title:'Later draft'},{id:doc.id});await query('UPDATE publish_jobs SET scheduled_at=now() WHERE id=$1',[scheduled.id]);await processPublishJob({data:{jobId:scheduled.id}} as any);assert.equal((await released(doc.path))?.title,'Scheduled snapshot');
 const cancel=await requestPublish(actor,'content_item_translations',doc.id);await jobAction(actor,cancel.id,'cancel');await processPublishJob({data:{jobId:cancel.id}} as any);assert.equal((await query('SELECT status FROM publish_jobs WHERE id=$1',[cancel.id]))[0].status,'cancelled');
 const invalid=await requestPublish(actor,'content_item_translations',doc.id);await query("UPDATE publish_jobs SET metadata='{}',max_attempts=1 WHERE id=$1",[invalid.id]);await assert.rejects(()=>processPublishJob({data:{jobId:invalid.id}} as any),/snapshot missing/);assert.equal((await query('SELECT status FROM publish_jobs WHERE id=$1',[invalid.id]))[0].status,'failed');
 await remove(actor,'content_item_translations',{id:doc.id});const unpublish=(await query("SELECT id FROM publish_jobs WHERE entity_id=$1 AND job_type='unpublish' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",[doc.id]))[0];await processPublishJob({data:{jobId:unpublish.id}} as any);assert.equal(await released(doc.path),undefined);await assert.rejects(()=>fs.access(path.join(process.env.STATIC_OUTPUT_DIR,'en/integration/index.html')));
 console.log('PASS: CRUD, RBAC, published snapshots, static rendering, version restore, scheduling, cancellation, failure state and unpublish.');
 // Remove fixture records so full rollback verifies only migration ownership.
 await query('TRUNCATE published_documents,site_paths,public_submissions,publish_jobs,content_revisions,audit_logs,content_item_translations,content_items,users RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE');
}finally{await pool.end();}
````

## tests/llm.test.ts

````ts
import {test,after} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {pool} from '../packages/domain/src/db';
import {DomainError} from '../packages/domain/src/crud';
import {normalizeLLMModel,normalizeLLMEndpoint,normalizeLLMApiKey,llmEndpointProblem,encryptLLMApiKey,decryptLLMApiKey,llmKeyFingerprint,llmProviderFailure,llmNetworkFailure,llmTranslateBatch,LLM_TIMEOUT_MS} from '../packages/domain/src/llm';

process.env.PAYLOAD_SECRET='unit-test-secret-value-at-least-32-chars-long';
after(()=>pool.end());

const KEY='sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345';
const ENDPOINT='https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions';
const config={endpoint:ENDPOINT,apiKey:KEY,model:'deepseek-flash'};
const reply=(body:unknown,status=200)=>Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify(body),{status,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}));
const content=(value:unknown,finish_reason='stop')=>({choices:[{message:{content:JSON.stringify(value)},finish_reason}],usage:{prompt_tokens:10,completion_tokens:5,total_tokens:15}});
async function withFetch(handler:()=>Promise<Response>,run:()=>Promise<void>){const original=globalThis.fetch;globalThis.fetch=handler as typeof fetch;try{await run();}finally{globalThis.fetch=original;}}

test('接口地址只接受 HTTPS，本机调试才放行 localhost',()=>{
 assert.equal(normalizeLLMEndpoint(ENDPOINT),ENDPOINT);
 assert.match(normalizeLLMEndpoint('http://localhost:8080/v1/chat'),/^http:\/\/localhost:8080\/v1\/chat/);
 for(const bad of ['api.deepseek.com','http://api.deepseek.com/chat','https://u:p@api.deepseek.com/chat','https://api.deepseek.com/chat?x=1','https://api.deepseek.com/chat#a','file:///etc/passwd'])
  assert.throws(()=>normalizeLLMEndpoint(bad),DomainError,bad);
 assert.equal(llmEndpointProblem(ENDPOINT),'');
 assert.match(llmEndpointProblem('api.deepseek.com'),/完整网址/);
});

test('模型名与密钥在入库前先规范化',()=>{
 assert.equal(normalizeLLMModel(' deepseek-chat '),'deepseek-chat');
 for(const bad of ['','a','deepseek chat','模-型'])assert.throws(()=>normalizeLLMModel(bad),DomainError,bad);
 assert.equal(normalizeLLMApiKey(' '+KEY+' '),KEY);
 for(const bad of ['','sk-short','sk-abcdefgh ijklmnop','sk-'+'x'.repeat(600)])assert.throws(()=>normalizeLLMApiKey(bad),DomainError,bad);
});

test('密钥可加解密且密文被篡改后必然失败',()=>{
 const sealed=encryptLLMApiKey(KEY);
 assert.ok(!sealed.includes(KEY));
 assert.match(sealed,/^v1:/);
 assert.equal(decryptLLMApiKey(sealed),KEY);
 assert.notEqual(encryptLLMApiKey(KEY).split(':')[1],encryptLLMApiKey(KEY).split(':')[1],'每次加密应使用新的 IV');
 const parts=sealed.split(':');parts[3]=Buffer.from('tampered-secret-value').toString('base64url');
 assert.throws(()=>decryptLLMApiKey(parts.join(':')),/无法解密/);
 assert.throws(()=>decryptLLMApiKey('v2:a:b:c'),/无法解密/);
});

test('指纹稳定、可区分，且不泄露密钥本身',()=>{
 const fingerprint=llmKeyFingerprint(KEY);
 assert.equal(fingerprint,llmKeyFingerprint(KEY));
 assert.match(fingerprint,/^[0-9A-F]{12}$/);
 assert.notEqual(fingerprint,llmKeyFingerprint(KEY+'x'));
 assert.ok(!KEY.includes(fingerprint));
});

test('上游状态码被分级，且绝不把 401/403 透传成后台登录失效',()=>{
 const unauthorized=llmProviderFailure(401,'{"error":{"message":"Authentication Fails"}}','deepseek-flash');
 assert.equal(unauthorized.status,400);
 assert.match(unauthorized.message,/密钥无效/);
 assert.equal(llmProviderFailure(402,'',"deepseek-flash").status,400);
 assert.match(llmProviderFailure(402,'','deepseek-flash').message,/余额不足/);
 assert.equal(llmProviderFailure(403,'','deepseek-flash').status,400);
 assert.match(llmProviderFailure(404,'','deepseek-flash').message,/模型不存在/);
 assert.equal(llmProviderFailure(429,'','deepseek-flash').status,429);
 assert.equal(llmProviderFailure(503,'','deepseek-flash').status,502);
 assert.match(llmProviderFailure(400,'{"error":{"message":"Model Not Exist"}}','deepseek-flash').message,/Model Not Exist/);
});

test('超时与网络故障给出可执行的提示',()=>{
 assert.equal(llmNetworkFailure(Object.assign(new Error('timed out'),{name:'TimeoutError'})).status,504);
 assert.match(llmNetworkFailure(Object.assign(new Error('timed out'),{name:'TimeoutError'})).message,new RegExp(String(Math.round(LLM_TIMEOUT_MS/1000))));
 assert.equal(llmNetworkFailure(new Error('getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND api.deepseek.com')).status,502);
 assert.match(llmNetworkFailure(new Error('getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND')).message,/无法连接/);
});

test('一批文本一次请求，逐段对应且缺段即失败',async()=>{
 await withFetch(()=>reply(content({translations:{0:'你好',1:'世界'}})),async()=>{
  const result=await llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello','World'],'en','zh');
  assert.deepEqual(result.texts,['你好','世界']);
  assert.equal(result.usage.total_tokens,15);
 });
 await withFetch(()=>reply(content({translations:{0:'你好'}})),async()=>{
  await assert.rejects(()=>llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello','World'],'en','zh'),/遗漏了第 2 段/);
 });
 await withFetch(()=>reply(content({translations:{0:''}})),async()=>{
  await assert.rejects(()=>llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello'],'en','zh'),/遗漏了第 1 段/);
 });
});

test('截断、非 JSON、缺字段、上游报错都要显式失败',async()=>{
 await withFetch(()=>reply(content({translations:{0:'你好'}},'length')),async()=>{
  await assert.rejects(()=>llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello'],'en','zh'),/截断/);
 });
 await withFetch(()=>Promise.resolve(new Response('not json at all',{status:200})),async()=>{
  await assert.rejects(()=>llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello'],'en','zh'),/无法解析/);
 });
 await withFetch(()=>reply({choices:[{message:{content:'{"result":"x"}'},finish_reason:'stop'}]}),async()=>{
  await assert.rejects(()=>llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello'],'en','zh'),/结构不正确/);
 });
 await withFetch(()=>reply({},200),async()=>{
  await assert.rejects(()=>llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello'],'en','zh'),/没有返回翻译结果/);
 });
 await withFetch(()=>reply({error:{message:'Authentication Fails'}},401),async()=>{
  const error=await llmTranslateBatch(config,['Hello'],'en','zh').catch(e=>e);
  assert.equal(error.status,400);
  assert.match(error.message,/密钥无效/);
 });
});

````

## tests/publish-mode.test.ts

````ts
import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {resources,publishModeFor,getResource} from '../packages/domain/src/registry';

test('发布方式由 registry 单点声明',()=>{
 for(const table of ['content_item_translations','product_translations','taxonomy_term_translations'])
  assert.equal(publishModeFor(table),'record',table);
 for(const table of ['site_settings','site_setting_translations','menus','menu_items','menu_item_translations','hero_slides','hero_slide_translations','customer_service_channels','customer_service_rules','locales'])
  assert.equal(publishModeFor(table),'rebuild',table);
 for(const table of ['inquiries','media_assets','content_blocks','redirects','audit_logs'])
  assert.equal(publishModeFor(table),undefined,table);
});

test('每个资源都带上 publishMode，后台才能据此决定提示与按钮',()=>{
 assert.deepEqual(resources.filter(r=>!('publishMode' in r)).map(r=>r.table),[]);
 assert.equal(getResource('site_settings').publishMode,'rebuild');
 assert.equal(getResource('content_item_translations').publishMode,'record');
});

// 可单独发布的资源必须与后端 requestPublish 接受的集合一致：多一个是谎报，少一个是功能缺失。
test('可单独发布的集合恰好是 requestPublish 支持的三个',()=>{
 assert.deepEqual(resources.filter(r=>r.publishMode==='record').map(r=>r.table).sort(),['content_item_translations','product_translations','taxonomy_term_translations']);
});

````
